# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: node_modules, dist, coverage, .git, uploads, logs, *.log, *.png, *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.svg, *.pdf
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

    onOrderPress: (orderId: string) => void;
}

const RecentActivity: React.FC<RecentActivityProps> = ({ orders, onViewAll, onOrderPress }) => {
    if (orders.length === 0) return null;

    return (
        <View style={styles.container}>
            <View style={styles.headerRow}>
                <Text style={styles.title}>Recent Activity</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={onViewAll} hitSlop={8}>
                    <Text style={styles.viewAll}>View All</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {orders.map((order) => (
                <TouchableOpacity
                    key={order.id}
                    style={styles.row}
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                    onPress={() => onOrderPress(order.id)}
                >
                    <View style={styles.imgWrapper}>
                        {order.imageUrl ? (
                            <Image source={{ uri: order.imageUrl }} style={styles.img} resizeMode="cover" />
                        ) : (
                            <View style={styles.imgPlaceholder} />
                        )}
                    </View>

                    <View style={styles.info}>
                        <View style={styles.statusBadge}>
                            <Text style={styles.statusText}>
                                {order.status === 'cancelled' ? 'Cancelled' : 'Completed'}
                            </Text>
                        </View>
                        <Text style={styles.productName} numberOfLines={1}>{order.productName}</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.meta}>
                            #{order.orderNumber} · ${order.price} · {order.completedDate ?? order.cancelledDate}
                        </Text>
                    </View>

                    <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color="#D1D5DB" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
        </View>
    );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    container: {
        marginTop: 4,
        paddingHorizontal: 4,

    },

/**
 * SplashScreen.tsx
 * Pure React Native — zero native dependencies.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Animated,
  Easing,
  Dimensions,
  StyleSheet,
  StatusBar,
} from 'react-native'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'

// ── Replace with your actual imports ───────────────────────────
import SplashSvg   from '@/assets/images/onboarding/splash.svg'
import ShowPicture from '@/components/shared/ShowPicture'

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window')

// ── Geometry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STREAK_W     = width * 0.86
const STREAK_H     = 5
const STREAK_TOP   = height * 0.62
const STREAK_LEFT  = (width - STREAK_W) / 2
const ANGLE        = '-18deg'
const POINT_TRAVEL = STREAK_W * 0.44

// ── Timing (ms) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const T_LOGO_IN       = 650
const T_SPARK_SHOOT   = 500
const T_SPARK_HOLD    = 300
const T_SPARK_FADE    = 440
const T_SQUEEZE_PRESS = 300
const T_SQUEEZE_HOLD  = 480
const T_SCREEN_OUT    = 560
const SQUEEZE_ITERS   = 3

interface Props {
  nextRoute?: string
}

const SplashScreen: React.FC<Props> = ({
  nextRoute = '/onboarding/slidingScreen',
}) => {
  const router = useRouter()

  // ── Animated values ────────────────────────────────────────
  const logoOpacity   = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current
  const logoTint      = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current  // 0..1, only during spark
  const squeeze       = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current
  const sparkProgress = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current
  const sparkAlpha    = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current  // master spark visibility
  const pointAlpha    = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current
  const pointX        = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current
  const screenOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current

  // Pre-computed layer opacities — created ONCE in refs so they
  // never re-instantiate and always track sparkAlpha correctly.
  const bloomOpacity  = useRef(Animated.multiply(sparkAlpha, 0.11)).current
  const coronaOpacity = useRef(Animated.multiply(sparkAlpha, 0.20)).current
  const innerOpacity  = useRef(Animated.multiply(sparkAlpha, 0.40)).current
  const tipOpacity    = useRef(Animated.multiply(sparkAlpha, 0.93)).current

  // ── Spark + logo-flash cycle ──────────────────────────────
  const runSparkCycle = (onDone?: () => void) => {
    // Hard-reset everything to 0 before each cycle
    sparkProgress.setValue(0)
    sparkAlpha.setValue(0)
    pointAlpha.setValue(0)
    pointX.setValue(0)
    logoTint.setValue(0)

    Animated.sequence([
      // Flash point blinks on
      Animated.timing(pointAlpha, {
        toValue: 1, duration: 55, useNativeDriver: true,
      }),

      // Shoot streak + logo flash
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(sparkProgress, {
          toValue: 1, duration: T_SPARK_SHOOT,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.exp), useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(pointX, {
          toValue: 1, duration: T_SPARK_SHOOT,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.exp), useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(sparkAlpha, {
          toValue: 1, duration: 190, useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        // Logo tint: ramp up then back to 0 within the shoot window
        Animated.sequence([
          Animated.timing(logoTint, {
            toValue: 1, duration: T_SPARK_SHOOT * 0.4,
            easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: true,
          }),
          Animated.timing(logoTint, {
            toValue: 0, duration: T_SPARK_SHOOT * 0.6,
            easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: true,
          }),
        ]),
      ]),

      Animated.delay(T_SPARK_HOLD),

      // Fade out spark layers AND point together
      Animated.parallel([
        Animated.timing(sparkAlpha, {
          toValue: 0, duration: T_SPARK_FADE, useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(pointAlpha, {
          toValue: 0, duration: T_SPARK_FADE * 0.55, useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        // Guarantee logoTint is 0 after spark (belt + braces)
        Animated.timing(logoTint, {
          toValue: 0, duration: 80, useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ]),
    ]).start(({ finished }) => {
      if (finished) {
        // Hard-reset all spark values to absolute 0 so nothing bleeds
        sparkAlpha.setValue(0)
        sparkProgress.setValue(0)
        pointAlpha.setValue(0)
        logoTint.setValue(0)
      }
      onDone?.()
    })
  }

  // ── Squeeze loop ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const runSqueezeLoop = (onDone?: () => void) => {
    squeeze.setValue(1)
    Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(squeeze, {
          toValue: 0.82, duration: T_SQUEEZE_PRESS,
          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.spring(squeeze, {
          toValue: 1, friction: 3, tension: 150, useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.delay(T_SQUEEZE_HOLD),
      ]),
      { iterations: SQUEEZE_ITERS },
    ).start(onDone)
  }

  // ── Master sequence ───────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.timing(logoOpacity, {
      toValue: 1, duration: T_LOGO_IN,
      easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: true,
    }).start(() => {
      runSparkCycle(() => {
        runSqueezeLoop(() => {
          runSparkCycle(() => {
            Animated.timing(screenOpacity, {
              toValue: 0, duration: T_SCREEN_OUT,
              easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), useNativeDriver: true,
            }).start(() => router.replace(nextRoute as never))
          })
        })
      })
    })
  }, [])

  // ── Interpolations ────────────────────────────────────────
  const streakScaleX = sparkProgress.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.001, 1],
  })

  const pointTranslate = pointX.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0, POINT_TRAVEL],
  })

  // Logo tint opacity 0→0.22 (green flash) then back to 0
  const logoTintOpacity = logoTint.interpolate({
    inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0, 0.22],
  })

  // Shared streak transform — grows left→right
  const streakTransform = [
    { rotate: ANGLE },
    { translateX: -(STREAK_W / 2) },
    { scaleX: streakScaleX },
    { translateX: STREAK_W / 2 },
  ] as const

  return (
    <Animated.View style={[s.root, { opacity: screenOpacity }]}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="light-content" backgroundColor="#000" />

      {/* ── Logo ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Animated.View
        style={[
          s.logoWrap,
          {
            top:       height * 0.28,
            opacity:   logoOpacity,
            transform: [{ scale: squeeze }],
          },
        ]}
      >

          <ShowPicture
            SvgComponent={SplashSvg}
            width={width * 0.72}
            height={height * 0.22}
          />
       
        <View style={s.logoPlaceholder} />

        {/* Green blink — ONLY visible during spark, hard-0 otherwise */}
        <Animated.View
          pointerEvents="none"
          style={[s.logoTint, { opacity: logoTintOpacity }]}
        />
      </Animated.View>

      {/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          SPARK LAYERS
          All opacity is driven by sparkAlpha (0 when idle).
          Pre-multiplied refs prevent inline Value leaks.
      ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}

      {/* Layer 1 — Outer bloom  60 px */}
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[s.layer, {
          top:          STREAK_TOP - 27,
          left:         STREAK_LEFT,
          width:        STREAK_W,
          height:       60,
          borderRadius: 30,
          backgroundColor: '#22c55e',
          opacity:      bloomOpacity,
          transform:    streakTransform,
        }]}
      />

      {/* Layer 2 — Mid corona  36 px */}
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[s.layer, {
          top:          STREAK_TOP - 15,
          left:         STREAK_LEFT,
          width:        STREAK_W,
          height:       36,
          borderRadius: 18,
          backgroundColor: '#4ade80',
          opacity:      coronaOpacity,
          transform:    streakTransform,
        }]}
      />

      {/* Layer 3 — Inner corona  18 px */}
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[s.layer, {
          top:          STREAK_TOP - 6,
          left:         STREAK_LEFT,
          width:        STREAK_W,
          height:       18,
          borderRadius: 9,
          backgroundColor: '#86efac',
          opacity:      innerOpacity,
          transform:    streakTransform,
        }]}
      />

      {/* Layer 4 — Bright core line  5 px */}
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[s.layer, {
          top:          STREAK_TOP - STREAK_H / 2,
          left:         STREAK_LEFT,
          width:        STREAK_W,
          height:       STREAK_H,
          borderRadius: STREAK_H / 2,
          overflow:     'hidden',
          opacity:      sparkAlpha,
          transform:    streakTransform,
        }]}
      >
        {/* Dark green tail */}
        <View style={[s.strip, { left: 0,     width: '45%', backgroundColor: '#052e16', opacity: 0.85 }]} />
        {/* Mid */}
        <View style={[s.strip, { left: '30%', width: '40%', backgroundColor: '#16a34a', opacity: 0.95 }]} />
        {/* Bright */}
        <View style={[s.strip, { left: '58%', width: '28%', backgroundColor: '#4ade80'                }]} />
        {/* Near-white */}
        <View style={[s.strip, { left: '78%', width: '16%', backgroundColor: '#dcfce7'                }]} />
        {/* White tip */}
        <View style={[s.strip, { left: '90%', right: 0,     backgroundColor: '#ffffff'                }]} />
      </Animated.View>

      {/* Layer 5 — White-hot tip orb */}
      <Animated.View
        pointerEvents="none"
        style={[s.layer, {
          top:          STREAK_TOP - 10,
          left:         STREAK_LEFT + STREAK_W - 22,

import React from 'react'
import {
  Switch,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { router } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { usePickupRules } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/home/usePickUpRules'

const DAYS = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'] as const

type RuleToggleProps = {
  icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  value: boolean
  onChange: (value: boolean) => void
}

const RuleToggle: React.FC<RuleToggleProps> = ({
  icon,
  title,
  subtitle,
  value,
  onChange,
}) => (
  <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 px-4 py-4">
    <View className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center">
      <Feather name={icon} size={17} color="#111827" />
    </View>

    <View className="flex-1 pr-2">
      <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</Text>
      <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5 leading-4">{subtitle}</Text>
    </View>

    <Switch
      value={value}
      onValueChange={onChange}
      trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#22C55E' }}
      thumbColor="#FFFFFF"
    />
  </View>
)

const Divider = () => <View className="h-px bg-gray-100 mx-4" />

const SectionLabel: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-[1.4px] uppercase mt-6 mb-2 px-4">
    {children}
  </Text>
)

export default function PickupRulesScreen() {
  const { rules, setField, windowOptions, handleSave } = usePickupRules()

  const toggleBlackoutDay = (day: string) => {
    const exists = rules.blackoutDays.includes(day)
    setField(
      'blackoutDays',
      exists
        ? rules.blackoutDays.filter((current) => current !== day)
        : [...rules.blackoutDays, day],
    )
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#FFFFFF" scrollable>
      <View className="pt-10 pb-12">
        <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
          >
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <Text className="flex-1 text-center text-lg font-black text-gray-900">
            Pickup Rules
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSave}>
            <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-green-500">Save</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-2xl bg-green-50 border border-green-100 px-4 py-4 flex-row gap-3">
          <View className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-green-500 items-center justify-center">
            <Feather name="clock" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </View>
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-green-900">Custom pickup rules</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-green-700 mt-1 leading-5">
              Set how long customers have to collect reserved items and what happens when a pickup is missed.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <SectionLabel>Pickup window</SectionLabel>
        <View className="mx-4 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 p-3">
          <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3">
            Customer has this long to pick up
          </Text>
          <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-2">
            {windowOptions.map((option) => {
              const active = rules.pickupWindowHours === option.value
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={option.value}
                  onPress={() => setField('pickupWindowHours', option.value)}
                  activeOpacity={0.85}
                  className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-900'
                      : 'bg-white border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Text
                    className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                      active ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {option.label}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <SectionLabel>Automation</SectionLabel>
        <View className="mx-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
          <RuleToggle
            icon="rotate-ccw"
            title="Auto-refund deposit"
            subtitle="Refund the hold deposit automatically when the pickup window expires."
            value={rules.autoRefundDeposit}
            onChange={(value) => setField('autoRefundDeposit', value)}
          />
          <Divider />
          <RuleToggle
            icon="bell"
            title="Send pickup reminder"
            subtitle="Remind the customer before their collection window ends."
            value={rules.sendReminder}
            onChange={(value) => setField('sendReminder', value)}
          />
          <Divider />
          <RuleToggle
            icon="refresh-cw"
            title="Auto-restock missed pickups"
            subtitle="Return the item to available inventory after an expired pickup."
            value={rules.autoRestock}
            onChange={(value) => setField('autoRestock', value)}
          />
        </View>

        <SectionLabel>Blackout days</SectionLabel>
        <View className="mx-4 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 p-4">
          <Text className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3 leading-5">
            Select days when customers cannot schedule or complete an in-store pickup.
          </Text>
          <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-2">
            {DAYS.map((day) => {
              const active = rules.blackoutDays.includes(day)
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={day}
                  onPress={() => toggleBlackoutDay(day)}
                  activeOpacity={0.85}
                  className={`w-[44px] h-[44px] rounded-full items-center justify-center border ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-900'
                      : 'bg-white border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Text
                    className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${
                      active ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {day}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <SectionLabel>Pickup instructions</SectionLabel>
        <View className="mx-4 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 p-4">
          <TextInput
            value={rules.instructions}
            onChangeText={(value) => setField('instructions', value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Bring your QR code and a valid photo ID. Pickups are available at the front counter."
            placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
            multiline
            textAlignVertical="top"
            maxLength={300}
            className="text-sm text-gray-800 leading-5"
            style={{ minHeight: 112 }}
          />
          <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 text-right mt-2">
            {rules.instructions.length}/300
          </Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={handleSave}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          className="mx-4 mt-8 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gray-900 items-center justify-center"
        >
          <Text className="text-white text-sm font-black">Save Pickup Rules</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const USERS = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Marcus L.', handle: '@marcusl', avatar: 'ML', pairs: 124, followers: '3.2K', isFollowing: false },
  { id: '2', name: 'Sarah K.', handle: '@sarahk', avatar: 'SK', pairs: 87, followers: '1.8K', isFollowing: true },
  { id: '3', name: 'James P.', handle: '@jamesp', avatar: 'JP', pairs: 203, followers: '5.1K', isFollowing: false },
  { id: '4', name: 'Aisha M.', handle: '@aisham', avatar: 'AM', pairs: 56, followers: '892', isFollowing: false },
  { id: '5', name: 'Chris R.', handle: '@chrisr', avatar: 'CR', pairs: 145, followers: '2.4K', isFollowing: true },
]

export default function DiscoverUsersScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(USERS)

  const toggleFollow = (id: string) => {
    setUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.id === id ? { ...u, isFollowing: !u.isFollowing } : u))
  }

  const filtered = users.filter(u =>
    u.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    u.handle.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  )

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Discover People</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <View style={styles.searchBar}>
        <Feather name="search" size={16} color="#9ca3af" />
        <TextInput
          value={search}
          onChangeText={setSearch}
          placeholder="Search users..."
          placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
          style={styles.searchInput}
        />
      </View>

      <FlatList
        data={filtered}
        keyExtractor={u => u.id}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.userRow}
            onPress={() => router.push('/screens/community/userProfileScreen' as any)}
          >
            <View style={styles.avatar}>
              <Text style={styles.avatarText}>{item.avatar}</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.userInfo}>
              <Text style={styles.name}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.handle}>{item.handle} · {item.pairs} pairs · {item.followers} followers</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.followBtn, item.isFollowing && styles.followingBtn]}
              onPress={() => toggleFollow(item.id)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.followText, item.isFollowing && styles.followingText]}>
                {item.isFollowing ? 'Following' : 'Follow'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 8 },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0a0a0a' },
  searchBar: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, backgroundColor: '#f3f4f6', marginHorizontal: 16, marginBottom: 12, borderRadius: 12, paddingHorizontal: 12, height: 44 },
  searchInput: { flex: 1, fontSize: 14, color: '#0a0a0a' },

                                            <Text className="text-white text-sm font-bold">Browse Drops</Text>
                                        </TouchableOpacity>
                                    </View>
                                ) : (
                                    <View className="mt-1">
                                        {items.map(item => (
                                            <WishlistCard
                                                key={item.id}
                                                item={item}
                                                onWishlistToggle={() => toggleWishlist(item.id)}
                                                onBuy={() => handleBuy(item)}
                                                onNotify={() => handleNotify(item)}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                    </View>
                                )}
                            </>
                        )}

                    </View>
                </ScrollView>
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}

import {
    View,
    Text,
    ScrollView,
    TouchableOpacity,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native'

import { useNotifications } from '@/services/hooks/discover/useNotifications'
import NotificationBanner from '@/components/discover/notifications/NotificationBanner'
import NotificationFilterTabs from '@/components/discover/notifications/NotificationsFilterTabs'
import NotificationGroup from '@/components/discover/notifications/NotificationGroup'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { router } from 'expo-router'
const NotificationsScreen = () => {
    const navigation = useNavigation()
    const {
        grouped,
        activeCategory,
        unreadCount,
        setActiveCategory,
        markAllRead,
        clearAll,
        markRead,
    } = useNotifications()

    return (
        <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor='#fff'>

            <View className='pt-10'>
                <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}>
                        <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#374151" />
                    </TouchableOpacity>

                    <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900">Notifications</Text>

                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push("/screens/discover/notificationsSettingsScreen")}>
                        <Feather name="settings" size={20} color="#374151" />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {/* ── Mark all read ── */}
                <View className="flex-row justify-end px-5 pt-2">
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={markAllRead}>
                        <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-500">Mark all read</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {/* ── Unread banner ── */}
                <NotificationBanner unreadCount={unreadCount} onClearAll={clearAll} />

                {/* ── Category pills ── */}
                <NotificationFilterTabs active={activeCategory} onChange={setActiveCategory} />

                {/* ── Grouped list ── */}
                <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
                    {grouped.length === 0 ? (
                        <View className="items-center justify-center py-24">
                            <Feather name="bell-off" size={40} color="#D1D5DB" />
                            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-4 font-medium">
                                No notifications here
                            </Text>
                        </View>
                    ) : (
                        grouped.map(({ group, items }) => (
                            <NotificationGroup
                                key={group}
                                group={group}
                                items={items}
                                onPressItem={markRead}
                            />
                        ))
                    )}
                </ScrollView>
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}

export default NotificationsScreen

// app/screens/discover/setDropReminderScreen.tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import {
    View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image,
    ScrollView, ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useSetDropReminder } from '@/services/hooks/discover/useSetDropReminder'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
// ─── Mini calendar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const DAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']
const MONTH_NAMES = [
    'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
    'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
]

function buildCalendarDays(year: number, month: number) {
    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay()
    const totalDays = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate()
    const cells: (number | null)[] = Array(firstDay).fill(null)
    for (let d = 1; d <= totalDays; d++) cells.push(d)
    return cells
}

interface CalendarProps {
    selectedDate: string | null
    onSelect: (date: string) => void
}

const MiniCalendar: React.FC<CalendarProps> = ({ selectedDate, onSelect }) => {
    const today = new Date()
    const [year, setYear] = useState(today.getFullYear())
    const [month, setMonth] = useState(today.getMonth())

    const cells = buildCalendarDays(year, month)

    const todayKey = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`

    const prev = () => {
        if (month === 0) { setMonth(11); setYear(y => y - 1) }
        else setMonth(m => m - 1)
    }
    const next = () => {
        if (month === 11) { setMonth(0); setYear(y => y + 1) }
        else setMonth(m => m + 1)
    }

    const toKey = (d: number) =>
        `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`

    const isPast = (d: number) => {
        const key = toKey(d)
        return key < todayKey
    }

    return (
        <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm mx-4 mt-4">
            {/* Header */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={prev} className="p-1">
                    <Feather name="chevron-left" size={20} color="#374151" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">
                    {MONTH_NAMES[month]} {year}
                </Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={next} className="p-1">
                    <Feather name="chevron-right" size={20} color="#374151" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {/* Day labels */}
            <View className="flex-row mb-2">
                {DAYS.map(d => (
                    <Text key={d} className="flex-1 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-400">
                        {d}
                    </Text>
                ))}
            </View>

            {/* Cells */}
            <View className="flex-row flex-wrap">
                {cells.map((day, idx) => {
                    if (!day) return <View key={`e-${idx}`} style={{ width: '14.28%' }} />
                    const key = toKey(day)
                    const isToday = key === todayKey
                    const isSel = key === selectedDate
                    const disabled = isPast(day)

                    return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            key={key}
                            onPress={() => !disabled && onSelect(key)}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            style={{ width: '14.28%' }}
                            className="items-center py-1"
                        >
                            <View
                                className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full items-center justify-center
                  ${isSel ? 'bg-green-500' : ''}
                  ${isToday && !isSel ? 'border border-green-400' : ''}`}
                            >
                                <Text
                                    className={`text-sm font-medium
                    ${isSel ? 'text-white' : ''}
                    ${disabled ? 'text-gray-300' : !isSel ? 'text-gray-800' : ''}`}
                                >
                                    {day}
                                </Text>
                            </View>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )
                })}
            </View>
        </View>
    )
}

// ─── Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SetDropReminderScreen() {
    const router = useRouter()
    const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string; brand?: string; name?: string; dropTime?: string; imageUri?: string }>()

    const { selectedDate, loading, selectDate, setReminder } = useSetDropReminder()


    const handleSetReminder = async () => {
        const ok = await setReminder()

        if (ok) {
            Toast.show({
                type: 'success',
                text1: 'Reminder set!',
                text2: 'We’ll notify you before the drop.',
                position: 'top',
                visibilityTime: 2000,
                onHide: () => {
                    router.back()
                },
            })
        }
    }
    const formatDisplay = (key: string) => {
        const [y, m, d] = key.split('-')
        const date = new Date(+y, +m - 1, +d)
        return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })
    }

    return (
        <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor='#fff'>
            <View className='py-10'>
                <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100 bg-white">
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} className="p-1 mr-3">
                        <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">Set Drop Reminder</Text>
                </View>

                <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 120 }}>
                    {/* Product card */}
                    <View className="mx-4 mt-4 bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 flex-row items-center gap-3 shadow-sm">
                        {params.imageUri ? (
                            <Image source={{ uri: params.imageUri }} className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl bg-gray-100" resizeMode="cover" />
                        ) : (
                            <View className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center">
                                <Feather name="box" size={24} color="#9CA3AF" />
                            </View>
                        )}
                        <View className="flex-1">
                            {params.brand && (
                                <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-0.5">
                                    {params.brand}
                                </Text>
                            )}
                            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 leading-snug">
                                {params.name ?? 'Upcoming Drop'}
                            </Text>
                            {params.dropTime && (
                                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 mt-1">
                                    <Feather name="clock" size={11} color="#22C55E" />
                                    <Text className="text-xs text-green-600 font-medium">{params.dropTime}</Text>
                                </View>
                            )}
                        </View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Instruction */}
                    <Text className="mx-4 mt-5 mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">
                        Choose reminder date
                    </Text>
                    <Text className="mx-4 text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">
                        We'll notify you on the selected day before the drop.
                    </Text>

                    {/* Calendar */}
                    <MiniCalendar selectedDate={selectedDate} onSelect={selectDate} />

                    {/* Selected date pill */}
                    {selectedDate && (
                        <View className="mx-4 mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-2 bg-green-50 border border-green-100 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5">
                            <Feather name="calendar" size={14} color="#22C55E" />
                            <Text className="text-sm text-green-700 font-medium">{formatDisplay(selectedDate)}</Text>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </ScrollView>

                {/* CTA */}
                <View className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 px-4 pb-8 pt-3 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-100">
                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={handleSetReminder}
                        disabled={!selectedDate || loading}
                        className={`rounded-2xl py-4 items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2
            ${selectedDate && !loading ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-gray-200'}`}
                        activeOpacity={0.85}
                    >
                        {loading
                            ? <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" size="small" />
                            : <>
                                <Feather name="bell" size={16} color={selectedDate ? '#fff' : '#9CA3AF'} />
                                <Text className={`text-sm font-bold ${selectedDate ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
                                    Set Reminder
                                </Text>
                            </>
                        }
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}

export default function TrendingNewArrivalsScreen() {

// app/screens/messages/chatScreen.tsx
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react'
import {
  View, Text, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet,
  TextInput, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

interface Message {
  id: string
  text: string
  fromMe: boolean
  time: string
  type?: 'text' | 'offer' | 'system'
  offerAmount?: number
  offerStatus?: 'pending' | 'accepted' | 'declined'
}

const INITIAL_MESSAGES: Message[] = [
  { id: '1', text: 'Hi! Is the Air Jordan 1 still available?', fromMe: true, time: '9:10 AM', type: 'text' },
  { id: '2', text: 'Yes it is! Size 10.5, brand new with box.', fromMe: false, time: '9:12 AM', type: 'text' },
  { id: '3', text: '', fromMe: true, time: '9:14 AM', type: 'offer', offerAmount: 190, offerStatus: 'pending' },
  { id: '4', text: 'I can\'t go lower than $205. It\'s a fair price.', fromMe: false, time: '9:20 AM', type: 'text' },
]

export default function ChatScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>(INITIAL_MESSAGES)
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('')
  const flatListRef = useRef<FlatList>(null)

  const sendMessage = () => {
    if (!inputText.trim()) return
    const newMsg: Message = {
      id: String(Date.now()),
      text: inputText.trim(),
      fromMe: true,
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      type: 'text',
    }
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, newMsg])
    setInputText('')
    setTimeout(() => flatListRef.current?.scrollToEnd({ animated: true }), 100)
  }

  const renderMessage = ({ item }: { item: Message }) => {
    if (item.type === 'offer') {
      return (
        <View style={[styles.offerBubble, item.fromMe ? styles.offerBubbleMe : styles.offerBubbleThem]}>
          <Text style={styles.offerLabel}>Offer Sent</Text>
          <Text style={styles.offerAmount}>${item.offerAmount}</Text>
          <View style={[styles.offerStatusBadge,
            item.offerStatus === 'accepted' ? styles.offerAccepted
            : item.offerStatus === 'declined' ? styles.offerDeclined
            : styles.offerPending
          ]}>
            <Text style={styles.offerStatusText}>
              {item.offerStatus === 'pending' ? '⏳ Pending' : item.offerStatus === 'accepted' ? '✓ Accepted' : '✗ Declined'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      )
    }

    return (
      <View style={[styles.messageRow, item.fromMe ? styles.messageRowMe : styles.messageRowThem]}>
        {!item.fromMe && <View style={styles.senderAvatar}><Text style={styles.senderAvatarText}>MK</Text></View>}
        <View>
          <View style={[styles.bubble, item.fromMe ? styles.bubbleMe : styles.bubbleThem]}>
            <Text style={[styles.bubbleText, item.fromMe && styles.bubbleTextMe]}>{item.text}</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={[styles.msgTime, item.fromMe && styles.msgTimeMe]}>{item.time}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    )
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.headerCenter} onPress={() => router.push('/screens/reseller/resellerProfileScreen' as any)}>
          <View style={styles.headerAvatar}><Text style={styles.headerAvatarText}>MK</Text></View>
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.headerName}>marcus_kicks</Text>
            <Text style={styles.headerStatus}>Active now</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity>
          <Feather name="more-horizontal" size={22} color="#374151" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Product context */}
      <View style={styles.productContext}>
        <View style={styles.contextImage} />
        <View style={styles.contextInfo}>
          <Text style={styles.contextName}>Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG</Text>
          <Text style={styles.contextMeta}>Size 10.5 · $220</Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/screens/product/productScreen')}>
          <Text style={styles.viewProduct}>View</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        keyboardVerticalOffset={0}
      >
        <FlatList
          ref={flatListRef}
          data={messages}
          keyExtractor={m => m.id}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.messageList}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          renderItem={renderMessage}
        />

        {/* Offer quick action */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.makeOfferBar}
          onPress={() => router.push('/screens/reseller/sendOfferScreen' as any)}
        >
          <Feather name="tag" size={14} color="#374151" />
          <Text style={styles.makeOfferText}>Make an Offer</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Input */}
        <View style={styles.inputBar}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.attachBtn}>
            <Feather name="paperclip" size={20} color="#9ca3af" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TextInput
            value={inputText}
            onChangeText={setInputText}
            placeholder="Message..."
            placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
            style={styles.textInput}
            multiline
          />
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.sendBtn, !inputText.trim() && styles.sendBtnDisabled]}
            onPress={sendMessage}
            disabled={!inputText.trim()}
          >
            <Feather name="send" size={18} color={inputText.trim() ? '#fff' : '#9ca3af'} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

// app/screens/store/addCardScreen.tsx
import React from 'react'
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput,
  ScrollView, Switch, KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform,
} from 'react-native'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useAddCard } from '@/services/hooks/order/useAddCard'
import CreditCardPreview from '@/components/profile/orders/CreditCardPreview'
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
export default function AddCardScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { form, updateField, formatCardNumber, formatExpiry, handleAddCard } = useAddCard()

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor='#fff'>
      <View className='pt-10'>
        <KeyboardAvoidingView
          behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
          className="flex-1"
        >
          {/* Nav */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} className="p-1 mr-3">
              <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text className="flex-1 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 text-center">Add Card</Text>
            <View style={{ width: 30 }} />
          </View>

          <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 120 }}>

            {/* Card Preview */}
            <View className="mt-6">
              <CreditCardPreview
                number={form.number}
                name={form.name}
                expiry={form.expiry}
              />
            </View>

            {/* Form */}
            <View className="px-4 gap-3">
              {/* Card number */}
              <View className="flex-row items-center border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5 gap-3">
                <Feather name="credit-card" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" />
                <TextInput
                  placeholder="1234 5678 9012 3456"
                  placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  value={form.number}
                  onChangeText={v => updateField('number', formatCardNumber(v))}
                  className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900"
                  maxLength={19}
                />
              </View>

              {/* Name */}
              <View className="flex-row items-center border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5 gap-3">
                <Feather name="user" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" />
                <TextInput
                  placeholder="Name on card"
                  placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChangeText={v => updateField('name', v)}
                  className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900"
                  autoCapitalize="words"
                />
              </View>

              {/* Expiry + CVV */}
              <View className="flex-row gap-3">
                <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5">
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="MM/YY"
                    placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                    keyboardType="numeric"
                    value={form.expiry}
                    onChangeText={v => updateField('expiry', formatExpiry(v))}
                    className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900"
                    maxLength={5}
                  />
                </View>
                <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5">
                  <TextInput
                    placeholder="CVV"
                    placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                    keyboardType="numeric"
                    secureTextEntry
                    value={form.cvv}
                    onChangeText={v => updateField('cvv', v.slice(0, 4))}
                    className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900"
                    maxLength={4}
                  />
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Save card toggle */}
              <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between py-2">
                <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">Save card for future purchases</Text>
                <Switch
                  value={form.saveCard}
                  onValueChange={v => updateField('saveCard', v)}
                  trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#22C55E' }}
                  thumbColor="#fff"
                />
              </View>
            </View>
          </ScrollView>

          {/* Add Card button */}

// app/screens/order/ordersListScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const TABS = ['All', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Cancelled']

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  'Pickup Ready': '#22c55e',
  'Processing': '#3b82f6',
  'On Hold': '#f59e0b',
  'Completed': '#6b7280',
  'Cancelled': '#ef4444',
}

interface Order {
  id: string
  product: string
  store: string
  size: string
  price: number
  status: string
  date: string
}

const ORDERS: Order[] = [
  { id: 'ORD-001', product: 'Air Jordan 1 Retro High', store: 'Kicks City', size: '10.5', price: 220, status: 'Pickup Ready', date: 'Aug 16' },
  { id: 'ORD-002', product: 'Yeezy Boost 350 V2', store: 'Urban Vault', size: '9', price: 280, status: 'Processing', date: 'Aug 15' },
  { id: 'ORD-003', product: 'Nike Dunk Low', store: 'Street Elite', size: '11', price: 150, status: 'On Hold', date: 'Aug 14' },
  { id: 'ORD-004', product: 'New Balance 550', store: 'Sole House', size: '10', price: 140, status: 'Completed', date: 'Aug 10' },
  { id: 'ORD-005', product: 'Travis Scott x Nike', store: 'Kicks City', size: '10', price: 580, status: 'Completed', date: 'Aug 5' },
  { id: 'ORD-006', product: 'Off-White Blazer', store: 'Urban Vault', size: '9.5', price: 420, status: 'Cancelled', date: 'Aug 1' },
]

export default function OrdersListScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('All')

  const filtered = activeTab === 'All' ? ORDERS
    : activeTab === 'Active' ? ORDERS.filter(o => ['Pickup Ready', 'Processing', 'On Hold'].includes(o.status))
    : activeTab === 'Completed' ? ORDERS.filter(o => o.status === 'Completed')
    : ORDERS.filter(o => o.status === 'Cancelled')

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#f9fafb">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>My Orders</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.tabs}>
        {TABS.map(tab => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={tab}
            style={[styles.tab, activeTab === tab && styles.tabActive]}
            onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, activeTab === tab && styles.tabTextActive]}>{tab}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        data={filtered}
        keyExtractor={o => o.id}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.card}
            onPress={() => router.push('/screens/order/orderDetailsScreen')}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            <View style={styles.imageBox} />
            <View style={styles.info}>
              <Text style={styles.orderId}>{item.id}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.productName} numberOfLines={1}>{item.product}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.store}>{item.store} · Size {item.size}</Text>
              <View style={styles.bottom}>
                <Text style={styles.price}>${item.price}</Text>
                <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: STATUS_COLOR[item.status] + '20' }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.statusText, { color: STATUS_COLOR[item.status] }]}>{item.status}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.right}>
              <Text style={styles.date}>{item.date}</Text>
              <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color="#9ca3af" />
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 8, backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0a0a0a' },
  tabs: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 12, gap: 8, backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  tab: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 20, backgroundColor: '#f3f4f6' },
  tabActive: { backgroundColor: '#0a0a0a' },
  tabText: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600', color: '#374151' },
  tabTextActive: { color: '#fff' },
  list: { padding: 16, gap: 12, paddingBottom: 40 },
  card: { flexDirection: 'row', backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: 16, padding: 12, gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  imageBox: { width: 72, height: 72, backgroundColor: '#f9fafb', borderRadius: 12 },
  info: { flex: 1 },
  orderId: { fontSize: 11, color: '#9ca3af', marginBottom: 2 },
  productName: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '600', color: '#0a0a0a', marginBottom: 2 },

// app/screens/store/qrCodeScreen.tsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, SafeAreaView, Animated } from 'react-native'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { FontAwesome5, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useQRCode } from '@/services/hooks/order/useQRCode'
import QRTimer from '@/components/profile/orders/QRTimer'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
export default function QRCodeScreen() {
  const router  = useRouter()
  const { display, progress, scanned, refresh, simulateScan } = useQRCode(585)

  // When scanned → navigate to pickup complete
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scanned) {
      const t = setTimeout(() => {
        router.replace('/screens/order/pickupCompletedScreen')
      }, 800) // brief delay so user sees the scanned state
      return () => clearTimeout(t)
    }
  }, [scanned])

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-gray-900">
       <BaseContainer scrollable >
      <View className='pt-10'>

        {/* Top info */}
        <View className="items-center pt-10 pb-6">
          <View className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-green-500 items-center justify-center mb-3">
            <Text className="text-white text-xs font-extrabold">GS</Text>
          </View>
          <Text className="text-white/60 text-xs font-semibold mb-1">Show this to store staff</Text>
          <Text className="text-green-400 text-sm font-extrabold tracking-widest">GS-2024-7843</Text>
        </View>

        {/* QR frame — turns green when scanned */}
        <View
          className={`mx-6 rounded-3xl border-2 overflow-hidden bg-white p-6 items-center transition-all ${
            scanned ? 'border-green-500' : 'border-green-500/30'
          }`}
        >
          {scanned ? (
            // Scanned state — show checkmark overlay
            <View className="w-56 h-56 items-center justify-center">
              <View className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-green-500 items-center justify-center">
                <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={52} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text className="text-gray-900 font-extrabold text-base mt-4">Scanned!</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <FontAwesome5 name="qrcode" size={220} color="#111827" />
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Timer or scanned message */}
        <View className="items-center mt-8">
          {scanned ? (
            <Text className="text-green-400 text-sm font-bold">Pickup confirmed ✓</Text>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Text className="text-white/50 text-xs font-semibold mb-4">Valid for 10 minutes</Text>
              <QRTimer display={display} progress={progress} />
            </>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Product info */}
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3 mt-8">
          <Text className="text-white text-sm font-bold">Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'</Text>
          <View className="bg-green-500 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
            <Text className="text-white text-[10px] font-extrabold">10.5</Text>
          </View>
          <Text className="text-white/50 text-sm">Sonny's Kicks</Text>
        </View>

        {/* Simulate scan button — remove in production */}
        {!scanned && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={simulateScan}
            className="mx-6 mt-8 border border-green-500/40 py-3 rounded-2xl items-center"
          >
            <Text className="text-green-400 text-xs font-semibold">Simulate QR Scan</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        {!scanned && (
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={refresh} className="items-center mt-4">
            <Text className="text-white/30 text-xs">Having trouble?</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
    </View>
    </BaseContainer>
    </View>
  )
}

// app/screens/order/submitDisputeScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, TextInput, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const REASONS = [
  'Item not as described',
  'Wrong item received',
  'Item not received',
  'Item damaged on arrival',
  'Counterfeit item',
  'Other',
]

export default function SubmitDisputeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [selectedReason, setSelectedReason] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')

  const canSubmit = selectedReason && description.length > 10

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Submit Dispute</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Order summary */}
        <View style={styles.orderCard}>
          <View style={styles.orderImageBox} />
          <View style={styles.orderInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.orderId}>ORD-001</Text>
            <Text style={styles.orderProduct}>Air Jordan 1 Retro High</Text>
            <Text style={styles.orderStore}>Kicks City · Size 10.5</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.orderPrice}>$220</Text>
        </View>

        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>What's the issue?</Text>

        {REASONS.map(reason => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={reason}
            style={[styles.reasonRow, selectedReason === reason && styles.reasonRowActive]}
            onPress={() => setSelectedReason(reason)}
          >
            <View style={[styles.radio, selectedReason === reason && styles.radioActive]}>
              {selectedReason === reason && <View style={styles.radioDot} />}
            </View>
            <Text style={[styles.reasonText, selectedReason === reason && styles.reasonTextActive]}>{reason}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}

        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Describe the issue</Text>
        <TextInput
          value={description}
          onChangeText={setDescription}
          placeholder="Please provide as much detail as possible..."
          placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
          multiline
          numberOfLines={5}
          style={styles.textarea}
          textAlignVertical="top"
        />

        <View style={styles.evidenceSection}>
          <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Add Photos (Optional)</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.uploadBox}>
            <Feather name="camera" size={24} color="#9ca3af" />
            <Text style={styles.uploadText}>Tap to add photos</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.submitBtn, !canSubmit && styles.submitBtnDisabled]}
          onPress={() => canSubmit && router.push('/screens/order/disputeStatusScreen' as any)}
          disabled={!canSubmit}
        >
          <Text style={styles.submitBtnText}>Submit Dispute</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

          <View className="h-14 bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl" />

      </ScrollView>

)

// ─── Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const RestockAlertScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { id: notificationId } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>()
  const { alert, watchlistPairs, loading } = useRestockAlert(notificationId)
  const handleBuyNow = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(
      `/screens/discover/buyNowScreen?productId=${alert.productId}&size=${encodeURIComponent(alert.size)}` as any
    )
  }, [alert, router])
  const handleHold = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(
      `/screens/discover/holdWithDepositScreen?productId=${alert.productId}&size=${encodeURIComponent(alert.size)}` as any
    )
  }, [alert, router])

  const handleReserve = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(
      `/screens/discover/reserveForPickupScreen?productId=${alert.productId}&storeId=${alert.store.id}&size=${encodeURIComponent(alert.size)}` as any
    )
  }, [alert, router])

  const handleSeeOtherStores = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(`/screens/discover/storeListScreen?productId=${alert.productId}` as any)
  }, [alert, router])

  // ✅ Skeleton instead of null — eliminates blank screen flash
  if (loading || !alert) return <RestockAlertSkeleton />

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="pt-10">
        <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 pt-2 pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
          >
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-center text-base font-bold text-gray-900">
            Product
            </Text>
          </View>
          <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400">Just now</Text>
        </View>

        <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} bounces>

          {/* ── Hero card ── */}
          <View className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-3xl bg-gray-900 overflow-hidden">
            <RestockHeroBadge />

            <View className="items-center py-5">
              <Image
                source={{ uri: alert.imageUrl }}
                className="w-56 h-36"
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            </View>

            <View className="items-center px-6 pb-6">
              <Text className="text-white text-xl font-bold text-center leading-snug">
                {alert.name}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1">{alert.colorway}</Text>
              <View className="mt-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full px-5 py-1.5">
                <Text className="text-white text-xs font-bold">{alert.size}</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <RestockStoreInfo store={alert.store} />
          </View>

          {/* ── Scarcity + social proof ── */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-5 mt-4">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
              <MaterialCommunityIcons name="fire" size={16} color="#F97316" />
              <Text className="text-orange-600 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-tight">
                Only {alert.stockLeft} left in this size
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text className="text-gray-400 text-xs">{alert.viewerCount} viewing</Text>
          </View>

          {/* ── Price ── */}
          <View className="px-5 mt-5">
            <Text className="text-4xl font-black text-gray-900">
              ${alert.currentPrice.toFixed(2)}
            </Text>
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 mt-1">
              <Text className="text-gray-400 text-sm line-through">
                Was ${alert.originalPrice}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-green-600 text-sm font-bold">
                ${(alert.originalPrice - alert.currentPrice).toFixed(2)} saved
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* ── Action buttons ── */}
          <View className="px-1">
            <RestockActionButtons
              onBuyNow={handleBuyNow}
              onHold={handleHold}
              onReserve={handleReserve}
              onSeeOtherStores={handleSeeOtherStores}
            />
          </View>

          {/* ── Watchlist pairs ── */}
          <RestockWatchlistPairs pairs={watchlistPairs} />

          <View className="h-10" />
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default RestockAlertScreen

import React, { useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Image,
  Share,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { usePublicLocker } from '@/services/hooks/profile/usePublicLocker'

export default function ItemDetailScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { itemId, lockerId, username } = useLocalSearchParams<{
    itemId?: string
    lockerId?: string
    username?: string
  }>()

  const { profile } = usePublicLocker(lockerId)

  const item = useMemo(
    () => profile.items.find((current) => current.id === itemId),
    [itemId, profile.items],
  )

  const handleShare = async () => {
    if (!item) return
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: `Check out ${item.name} in @${username || profile.username}'s GoSNKR locker.`,
      })
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  if (!item) {
    return (
      <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#FFFFFF">
        <View className="flex-1 px-4 pt-12 items-center justify-center">
          <View className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center">
            <Feather name="search" size={24} color="#9CA3AF" />
          </View>
          <Text className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 mt-4">Pair not found</Text>
          <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 text-center mt-1">
            This locker item may have been removed.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            className="mt-6 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-900"
          >
            <Text className="text-white font-bold">Go Back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </BaseContainer>
    )
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#FFFFFF" scrollable>
      <View className="pb-12">
        <View className="absolute top-12 left-4 right-4 z-10 flex-row justify-between">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/95 items-center justify-center shadow-sm"
          >
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={20} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handleShare}
            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/95 items-center justify-center shadow-sm"
          >
            <Feather name="share-2" size={18} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <View className="bg-gray-100" style={{ height: 430 }}>
          <Image
            source={{ uri: item.image }}
            className="w-full h-full"
            resizeMode="cover"
          />
        </View>

        <View className="px-4 pt-5">
          <View className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <View className="flex-1">
              <Text className="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900 leading-8">{item.name}</Text>
              <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-1">Size {item.size || '—'}</Text>
            </View>

            {item.isForSale ? (
              <View className="bg-green-50 border border-green-100 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 items-end">
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-green-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  For sale
                </Text>
                <Text className="text-lg font-black text-green-700">
                  ${item.price?.toLocaleString() ?? '—'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>

          <View className="flex-row gap-3 mt-5">
            <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 px-4 py-4">
              <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                Condition
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-base font-black text-gray-900 mt-1">{item.condition}</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="flex-1 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 px-4 py-4">
              <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                Locker
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-base font-black text-gray-900 mt-1" numberOfLines={1}>
                @{username || profile.username}
              </Text>

            </View>
            <View className="flex-1">
              <Text className="text-sm font-black text-gray-900">{profile.displayName}</Text>
              <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                {profile.role} · {profile.location}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1">

const LockerBrowserScreen: React.FC = () => {

    const { lockers, searchQuery, setSearchQuery, isRefreshing, refresh, toggleFollow } =
        useLockerBrowser()

    const handleLockerPress = (locker: LockerPreview) => {
        router.push({
            pathname: '/screens/profile/publicLockerScreen',
            params: { lockerId: locker.id, username: locker.username },
        })
    }

    return (
        <BaseContainer backgroundColor='#fff'>

                <View style={styles.header}>
                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={() => router.canGoBack() && router.back()}

                        <Feather name="chevron-left" size={22} color="#111827" />

                    <View style={styles.backBtn} />

                {/* Search */}
                <View style={styles.searchWrapper}>
                    <Feather name="search" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" style={styles.searchIcon} />
                    <TextInput
                        value={searchQuery}
                        onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
                        placeholder="Search by username or city..."
                        placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                        style={styles.searchInput}
                        returnKeyType="search"
                        autoCapitalize="none"
                    />
                    {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
                        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')}>
                            <Feather name="x" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                </View>

                {/* Count */}
                <Text style={styles.count}>{lockers.length} lockers</Text>

                {/* List */}
                <FlatList
                    data={lockers}
                    keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
                    renderItem={({ item }) => (
                        <LockerBrowserCard
                            locker={item}
                            onPress={handleLockerPress}
                            onFollowPress={toggleFollow}
                        />
                    )}
                    contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
                    showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                    refreshControl={
                        <RefreshControl

                        />
                    }
                    ListEmptyComponent={
                        <View style={styles.empty}>

                            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No lockers found</Text>

    )

            <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Wanted</Text>
          </View>
          
          <View className="w-[1px] h-8 bg-gray-100" />
          
          <View className="flex-1 items-center">
            <Text className="text-2xl font-black text-green-500">{stats.availableNow}</Text>
            <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">In Stock</Text>
          </View>
          
          <View className="w-[1px] h-8 bg-gray-100" />
          
          <View className="flex-1 items-center">
            <Text className="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900">{stats.watching}</Text>
            <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Watching</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Filter Tabs */}
        <FilterTabs
          activeTab={activeTab}
          onTabChange={setActiveTab}
          availableCount={allPairs.length}
        />

        {/* List */}
        <ScrollView
          className="flex-1"
          contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingBottom: 32 }}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {pairs.length === 0 ? (
            <View className="items-center pt-20 gap-y-3">
              <MaterialCommunityIcons name="shoe-sneaker" size={64} color="#e5e7eb" />
              <View className="items-center">
                <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">No pairs here</Text>
                <Text className="text-[13px] text-gray-400 text-center px-10 mt-1">
                  {activeTab === 'All'
                    ? 'Add sneakers to your Wanted list to start tracking stock nearby.'
                    : `No pairs match the "${activeTab}" filter right now.`}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : (
            pairs.map(pair => (
              <SneakerCard
                key={pair.id}
                pair={pair}
                onPress={handleCardPress}
                onAvailableNowPress={handleAvailableNowPress}
                onToggleAlert={toggleAlert}
                onManageAlerts={manageAlerts}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </ScrollView>

      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default WantedPairsScreen
