```typescript
// screens/auth/changePasswordScreen.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import PasswordField from '@/components/shared/PasswordField';
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button';
import { useChangePassword } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useChangePassword';

export default function ChangePasswordScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { 
    form, 
    errors, 
    loading, 
    showCurrent, 
    showNew, 
    showConfirm,
    setShowCurrent,
    setShowNew,
    setShowConfirm,
    updateField, 
    handleSave 
  } = useChangePassword();

  // Helper for visual strength indicator
  const getStrengthScore = (pwd: string) => {
    let score = 0;
    if (pwd.length >= 8) score++;
    if (/[A-Z]/.test(pwd) && /[0-9]/.test(pwd)) score++;
    if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pwd)) score++;
    return score > 3 ? 4 : score + 1; // Scale 1-4
  };

  const strength = form.newPassword ? getStrengthScore(form.newPassword) : 0;
  const strengthColors = ['#EF4444', '#F97316', '#EAB308', '#22C55E'];
  const strengthLabels = ['Weak', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Strong'];

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>
      {/* ── Header ── */}
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-5 py-4 pt-12 border-b border-gray-50 relative">
        <TouchableOpacity 
          onPress={() => router.back()} 
          className="z-10 p-1"
        >
          <Feather name="chevron-left" size={28} color="#111827" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        
        <View className="absolute left-0 right-0 pt-12 flex-row justify-center">
          <Text className="text-xl font-black text-gray-900 tracking-tight">
            Change Password
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View className="px-6 py-8">
        <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-8 text-center px-4">
          Your new password must be at least 8 characters long and include special characters.
        </Text>

        {/* ── Current Password ── */}
        <Text className="text-sm font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
          Current Password
        </Text>
        <PasswordField
          focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
          value={form.currentPassword}
          onChangeText={(val) => updateField('currentPassword', val)}
          placeholder="Enter current password"
          error={errors.currentPassword}
        />

        {/* ── New Password ── */}
        <Text className="text-sm font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 mt-6 ml-1">
          New Password
        </Text>
        <PasswordField
          focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
          value={form.newPassword}
          onChangeText={(val) => updateField('newPassword', val)}
          placeholder="New Password"
          error={errors.newPassword}
        />

        {/* ── Strength Bar ── */}
        {form.newPassword.length > 0 && (
          <View className="mt-3 mb-1">
            <View className="flex-row gap-1 mb-1">
              {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                <View
                  key={i}
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    height: 4,
                    borderRadius: 4,
                    backgroundColor: i < strength ? strengthColors[strength - 1] : '#E5E7EB',
                  }}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
            <Text
              style={{ color: strengthColors[strength - 1] ?? '#E5E7EB' }}
              className="text-[10px] font-black text-right uppercase"
            >
              {strength > 0 ? strengthLabels[strength - 1] : ''}
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* ── Confirm New Password ── */}
        <Text className="text-sm font-black text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 mt-6 ml-1">
          Confirm New Password
        </Text>
        <PasswordField
          focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
          value={form.confirmPassword}
          onChangeText={(val) => updateField('confirmPassword', val)}
          placeholder="Confirm New Password"
          error={errors.confirmPassword}
        />

        {/* ── Submit ── */}
        <Button
          text={loading ? "Updating..." : "Update Password"}
          backgroundColor='#000000'
          height={60}
          borderRadius={14}
          fontSize={18}
          fontWeight="700"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={() => handleSave(() => router.back())}
          style={{ marginTop: 40 }}
        />
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}
```

```typescript
  const [offerAmount, setOfferAmount] = useState('190')

            <Text style={styles.listingName}>Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG</Text>

            <Text style={styles.listingAsking}>Asking: $220</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Offer input */}

        {/* Market context */}

          <Text style={styles.marketLabel}>Market Price</Text>
          <Text style={styles.marketValue}>${marketPrice}</Text>
          <View style={styles.savingBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.savingText}>
              {((1 - Number(offerAmount) / marketPrice) * 100).toFixed(0)}% below
            </Text>
          </View>

        {/* Quick amounts */}
        <View style={styles.quickRow}>
          {QUICK_AMOUNTS.map(amt => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={amt}
              style={[styles.quickBtn, offerAmount === String(amt) && styles.quickBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setOfferAmount(String(amt))}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.quickBtnText, offerAmount === String(amt) && styles.quickBtnTextActive]}>${amt}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Expiry */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Offer Expires In</Text>

          {[12, 24, 48, 72].map(h => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={h}
              style={[styles.expiryBtn, expiryHours === h && styles.expiryBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setExpiryHours(h)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.expiryBtnText, expiryHours === h && styles.expiryBtnTextActive]}>{h}h</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Note */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Add a Note (Optional)</Text>
        <TextInput
          value={note}
          onChangeText={setNote}
          placeholder="E.g. Willing to bundle if you have other sizes..."
          placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
          multiline
          numberOfLines={3}
          style={styles.noteInput}
          textAlignVertical="top"
        />

        <TouchableOpacity

}
```

```typescript
// app/screens/reseller/submittedRequestsScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const TABS = ['All', 'Pending', 'Accepted', 'Declined']

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<string, { color: string; bg: string }> = {
  Pending:  { color: '#f59e0b', bg: '#fffbeb' },
  Accepted: { color: '#22c55e', bg: '#f0fdf4' },
  Declined: { color: '#ef4444', bg: '#fef2f2' },
  Countered:{ color: '#3b82f6', bg: '#eff6ff' },
}

const REQUESTS = [
  { id: '1', product: 'Air Jordan 1 Retro High', seller: 'marcus_kicks', myOffer: 190, askingPrice: 220, status: 'Pending', date: 'Aug 16' },
  { id: '2', product: 'Yeezy 350 V2 "Zebra"', seller: 'sarahsneaks', myOffer: 250, askingPrice: 290, status: 'Accepted', date: 'Aug 14' },
  { id: '3', product: 'Travis Scott x Nike', seller: 'jpcollects', myOffer: 520, askingPrice: 580, status: 'Declined', date: 'Aug 10' },
  { id: '4', product: 'Nike Dunk Low Panda', seller: 'kickvault', myOffer: 100, askingPrice: 110, status: 'Countered', date: 'Aug 8' },
]

export default function SubmittedRequestsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('All')

  const filtered = tab === 'All' ? REQUESTS : REQUESTS.filter(r => r.status === tab)

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#f9fafb">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>My Offers</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.tabs}>
        {TABS.map(t => (
          <TouchableOpacity key={t} style={[styles.tab, tab === t && styles.tabActive]} onPress={() => setTab(t)}>
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, tab === t && styles.tabTextActive]}>{t}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        data={filtered}
        keyExtractor={r => r.id}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        renderItem={({ item }) => {
          const cfg = STATUS_CONFIG[item.status] ?? { color: '#6b7280', bg: '#f3f4f6' }
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.card}
              onPress={() => router.push('/screens/reseller/requestDetailsScreen' as any)}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <View style={styles.imageBox} />
              <View style={styles.info}>
                <Text style={styles.productName} numberOfLines={1}>{item.product}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.seller}>@{item.seller}</Text>
                <View style={styles.priceRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.myOffer}>My offer: <Text style={styles.offerAmt}>${item.myOffer}</Text></Text>
                  <Text style={styles.asking}>Ask: ${item.askingPrice}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.right}>
                <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: cfg.bg }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.statusText, { color: cfg.color }]}>{item.status}</Text>
                </View>
                <Text style={styles.date}>{item.date}</Text>
              </View>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )
        }}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 10 }} />}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// app/screens/reseller/visibilityControlsScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Switch } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

interface ControlItem {
  id: string
  label: string
  desc: string
  value: boolean
}

export default function VisibilityControlsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [controls, setControls] = useState<ControlItem[]>([
    { id: 'profile', label: 'Public Profile', desc: 'Allow anyone to view your reseller profile', value: true },
    { id: 'listings', label: 'Show Listings Publicly', desc: 'Display your active listings to all users', value: true },
    { id: 'price', label: 'Show Prices', desc: 'Show prices on public listing cards', value: true },
    { id: 'location', label: 'Show Approximate Location', desc: 'Show your city/region on profile', value: false },
    { id: 'activity', label: 'Show Activity Feed', desc: 'Let followers see your recent activity', value: true },
    { id: 'online', label: 'Show Online Status', desc: "Let buyers know when you're active", value: false },
    { id: 'analytics', label: 'Share Stats', desc: 'Show total sales count on profile', value: true },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Appear in Search', desc: 'Include profile in user discovery', value: true },
  ])

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setControls(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, value: !c.value } : c))
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Visibility Controls</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionDesc}>Control what others can see on your reseller profile and listings.</Text>

        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Profile Visibility</Text>
        {controls.slice(0, 4).map(item => (
          <View key={item.id} style={styles.row}>
            <View style={styles.rowInfo}>
              <Text style={styles.rowLabel}>{item.label}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.rowDesc}>{item.desc}</Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={item.value}
              onValueChange={() => toggle(item.id)}
              trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }}
              thumbColor="#fff"
            />
          </View>
        ))}

        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Activity & Discovery</Text>
        {controls.slice(4).map(item => (
          <View key={item.id} style={styles.row}>
            <View style={styles.rowInfo}>
              <Text style={styles.rowLabel}>{item.label}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.rowDesc}>{item.desc}</Text>
            </View>
            <Switch
              value={item.value}
              onValueChange={() => toggle(item.id)}
              trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }}
              thumbColor="#fff"
            />
          </View>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 16 },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0a0a0a' },
  scroll: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingBottom: 40 },
```

```typescript
            onToggle={(v) => setField('pickupAvailable', v)}
          />
          <View style={s.divider} />
          <View style={s.settingRow}>
            <View style={s.settingLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons name="clock-outline" size={18} color="#111" />
              <Text style={s.settingLabel}>Custom Pickup Rules</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSetupCustomPickup}>
              <Text style={s.setupText}>Set up →</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Inventory */}
        <View style={s.sectionLabel}>
          <Text style={s.sectionLabelText}>INVENTORY</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={s.inventoryGroup}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[s.inventoryOption, inventoryMode === 'shared' && s.inventoryOptionSelected]}
            onPress={() => setInventoryMode('shared')}
          >
            <View style={s.inventoryLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons
                name="earth"
                size={20}
                color={inventoryMode === 'shared' ? '#10B981' : '#9CA3AF'}
              />
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
                <Text style={s.inventoryTitle}>Share inventory with all branches</Text>
                <Text style={s.inventorySub}>Products sync across locations</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {inventoryMode === 'shared' && (
              <Feather name="check" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={s.divider} />

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[s.inventoryOption, inventoryMode === 'separate' && s.inventoryOptionSelected]}
            onPress={() => setInventoryMode('separate')}
          >
            <View style={s.inventoryLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons
                name="store-outline"
                size={20}
                color={inventoryMode === 'separate' ? '#10B981' : '#9CA3AF'}
              />
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
                <Text style={s.inventoryTitle}>Separate inventory for this branch</Text>
                <Text style={s.inventorySub}>Recommended for distinct branches</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {inventoryMode === 'separate' && (
              <Feather name="check" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Save Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.saveBtn} onPress={handleSave}>
          <Text style={s.saveBtnText}>Save Branch</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function SettingRow({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  onToggle,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: boolean;
  onToggle: (v: boolean) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={s.settingRow}>
      <View style={s.settingLeft}>
        {icon}
        <Text style={s.settingLabel}>{label}</Text>
      </View>
      <Switch
        value={value}
        onValueChange={onToggle}
        trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#10B981' }}
        thumbColor="#fff"
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
                    <Text style={s.vsText}>vs Yesterday</Text>
                </View>

                {/* Main Revenue Card */}

                        <View style={s.cardStatItem}><Text style={s.cardStatNum}>{stats.pickups}</Text><Text style={s.cardStatLabel}>Pickups</Text></View>
                        <View style={s.cardStatItem}><Text style={s.cardStatNum}>{stats.holds}</Text><Text style={s.cardStatLabel}>Holds</Text></View>
                    </View>
                </View>

                {/* Metric Grid */}
                <View style={s.metricGrid}>
                    {stats.metrics.map((m, i) => (
                        <View key={i} style={s.metricCard}>
                            <View style={[s.metricIcon, { backgroundColor: i === 0 ? '#DCFCE7' : i === 1 ? '#DBEAFE' : i === 2 ? '#FEF3C7' : '#EDE9FE' }]}>
                                <Feather name={i === 0 ? "eye" : i === 1 ? "box" : i === 2 ? "search" : "refresh-cw"} size={16} color="#111" />
                            </View>
                            <Text style={s.metricLabel}>{m.label}</Text>
                            <View style={s.metricValueRow}>
                                <Text style={s.metricValue}>{m.value}</Text>
                                <Text style={[s.metricChange, { color: m.type === 'up' ? '#10B981' : m.type === 'stable' ? '#F59E0B' : '#8B5CF6' }]}>{m.change}</Text>
                            </View>
                        </View>
                    ))}
                </View>

                {/* Orders This Week Chart Placeholder */}
                <View style={s.sectionCard}>
                    <Text style={s.sectionTitle}>Orders This Week</Text>
                    <View style={s.chartPlaceholder} />
                    <View style={s.chartLabels}>
                        {['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].map(d => <Text key={d} style={s.dayLabel}>{d}</Text>)}
                    </View>
                </View>

                {/* Conversion Funnel */}
                <View style={s.sectionCard}>
                    <Text style={s.sectionTitle}>Conversion Funnel</Text>
                    {stats.funnel.map((item, i) => (
                        <View key={i} style={s.funnelItem}>
                            <View style={s.funnelLabelRow}>
                                <Text style={s.funnelLabel}>{item.count} {item.label}</Text>
                                <Text style={s.funnelPercent}>{item.percentage}</Text>
                            </View>
                            <View style={s.progressTrack}>
                                {/* The cast to 'any' or 'DimensionValue' fixes the overload error */}
                                <View style={[s.progressBar, { width: item.percentage as any }]} />
                            </View>
                        </View>
                    ))}
                </View>
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    );
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import {
  useBusinessOverview,

} from '@/services/hooks/retailer/home/useBusinessOverview';

export default function BusinessOverviewScreen() {

  } = useBusinessOverview();

  return (

      <View className="flex-1 pb-10">

          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>

          <Text style={s.headerTitle}>Business Overview</Text>

        </View>

        {/* Business Identity */}

          <View style={s.avatar}>
            <Text style={s.avatarText}>{business.initials}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={s.businessName}>{business.name}</Text>
            <Text style={s.businessMeta}>{business.locationCount} locations · {business.city}</Text>
            <View style={s.pillRow}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={s.pill}>
                <Text style={s.pillText}>Owner</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={s.pill}>
                <Text style={s.pillText}>Business Settings →</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Period tabs */}
        <View style={s.periodRow}>
          <View style={s.periodTabs}>
            {periods.map((p) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={p}
                onPress={() => setPeriod(p)}
                style={[s.periodTab, period === p && s.periodTabActive]}
              >
                <Text style={[s.periodTabText, period === p && s.periodTabTextActive]}>{p}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.calendarBtn}>
            <Feather name="calendar" size={18} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Gross sales hero card */}
        <View style={s.heroCard}>
          <Text style={s.heroValue}>{stats.grossSales}</Text>
          <View style={s.heroFooterRow}>
            <Text style={s.heroLabel}>Gross sales</Text>
            <View style={s.deltaRow}>
              <Feather
                name={stats.deltaIsPositive ? 'arrow-up-right' : 'arrow-down-right'}
                size={12}
                color={stats.deltaIsPositive ? '#34D399' : '#F87171'}
              />
              <Text style={[s.deltaText, { color: stats.deltaIsPositive ? '#34D399' : '#F87171' }]}>
                {stats.deltaVsPrevious}

              <Text style={s.deltaSubtext}>vs yesterday</Text>

            <Text style={s.statLabel}>Net sales</Text>

            <Text style={s.statLabel}>Orders</Text>

            <Text style={s.statLabel}>Avg order</Text>

          <TouchableOpacity style={s.addNewCard} onPress={() => router.push('/')}>
            <Text style={s.addNewText}>+ Add another location</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function LocationCard({ location }: { location: Location }) {
  return (
    <View style={s.locationCard}>
      <View style={s.locLeft}>
        <View style={s.locAvatar}>
          <Text style={s.locAvatarText}>{location.initials}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
          <View style={s.locNameRow}>
            <Text style={s.locName}>{location.name}</Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color="#D1D5DB" />
          </View>
          <Text style={s.locAddress}>{location.address}</Text>
          <View style={s.locStatusRow}>
            <View style={[s.statusDot, { backgroundColor: location.isOpen ? '#10B981' : '#EF4444' }]} />
            <Text style={s.locStatus}>
              {location.isOpen ? 'Open' : 'Closed'} · {location.hoursNote}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={s.locRevenue}>{location.salesToday} sales · {location.ordersToday} orders</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Alert chips */}
      {location.alerts.length > 0 && (
        <View style={s.alertChipsRow}>
          {location.alerts.map((alert, i) => (
            <AlertChip key={i} alert={alert} />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      <View style={s.locActions}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.manageBtn} onPress={() => router.push('/')}>
          <Text style={s.manageBtnText}>Manage Location</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.viewOrdersBtn} onPress={() => router.push('/')}>
          <Text style={s.viewOrdersText}>View Orders</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <Text style={s.syncedText}>{location.syncedAgo}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function AlertChip({ alert }: { alert: LocationAlert }) {
  if (alert.type === 'ready') {
    return (
      <View style={[s.alertChip, s.chipGreen]}>
        <Feather name="check-circle" size={11} color="#059669" />
        <Text style={[s.alertChipText, { color: '#059669' }]}>{alert.count} ready</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (alert.type === 'overdue') {
    return (
      <View style={[s.alertChip, alert.count > 0 ? s.chipAmber : s.chipGray]}>
        <Feather name={alert.count > 0 ? 'alert-triangle' : 'check-circle'} size={11} color={alert.count > 0 ? '#D97706' : '#9CA3AF'} />
        <Text style={[s.alertChipText, { color: alert.count > 0 ? '#D97706' : '#9CA3AF' }]}>
          {alert.count > 0 ? `${alert.count} overdue` : 'No overdue'}
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={[s.alertChip, s.chipAmber]}>
      <Feather name="alert-triangle" size={11} color="#D97706" />
      <Text style={[s.alertChipText, { color: '#D97706' }]}>{alert.count} low-stock alerts</Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
```

```typescript
            />
          </View>

          <View style={s.inputRow}>
            <Feather name="phone" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" style={s.inputIcon} />

              style={s.inputFlex}
              placeholder="+1 (305) 555-0198"
              placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
              keyboardType="phone-pad"
              value={form.phone}
              onChangeText={(v) => setField('phone', v)}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Branch Settings */}
        <View style={s.sectionLabel}>
          <Text style={s.sectionLabelText}>BRANCH SETTINGS</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={s.settingsGroup}>
          <SettingRow
            icon={<MaterialCommunityIcons name="shopping" size={18} color="#111" />}
            label="Accept In-App Orders"
            value={form.acceptOrders}
            onToggle={(v) => setField('acceptOrders', v)}
          />
          <View style={s.divider} />
          <SettingRow
            icon={<MaterialCommunityIcons name="lock-outline" size={18} color="#111" />}
            label="Accept Hold with Deposit"
            value={form.acceptDeposit}
            onToggle={(v) => setField('acceptDeposit', v)}
          />
          <View style={s.divider} />
          <SettingRow
            icon={<MaterialCommunityIcons name="map-marker-outline" size={18} color="#111" />}
            label="In-Store Pickup Available"
            value={form.pickupAvailable}
            onToggle={(v) => setField('pickupAvailable', v)}
          />
          <View style={s.divider} />
          <View style={s.settingRow}>
            <View style={s.settingLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons name="clock-outline" size={18} color="#111" />
              <Text style={s.settingLabel}>Custom Pickup Rules</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSetupCustomPickup}>
              <Text style={s.setupText}>Set up →</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Inventory */}
        <View style={s.sectionLabel}>
          <Text style={s.sectionLabelText}>INVENTORY</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={s.inventoryGroup}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[s.inventoryOption, inventoryMode === 'shared' && s.inventoryOptionSelected]}
            onPress={() => setInventoryMode('shared')}
          >
            <View style={s.inventoryLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons
                name="earth"
                size={20}
                color={inventoryMode === 'shared' ? '#10B981' : '#9CA3AF'}
              />
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
                <Text style={s.inventoryTitle}>Share inventory with all branches</Text>
                <Text style={s.inventorySub}>Products sync across locations</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {inventoryMode === 'shared' && (
              <Feather name="check" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={s.divider} />

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[s.inventoryOption, inventoryMode === 'separate' && s.inventoryOptionSelected]}
            onPress={() => setInventoryMode('separate')}
          >
            <View style={s.inventoryLeft}>
              <MaterialCommunityIcons
                name="store-outline"
                size={20}
                color={inventoryMode === 'separate' ? '#10B981' : '#9CA3AF'}
              />
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
                <Text style={s.inventoryTitle}>Separate inventory for this branch</Text>
                <Text style={s.inventorySub}>Recommended for distinct branches</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {inventoryMode === 'separate' && (
              <Feather name="check" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Save Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.saveBtn} onPress={handleSave}>
          <Text style={s.saveBtnText}>Save Branch</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function SettingRow({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  onToggle,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: boolean;
  onToggle: (v: boolean) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={s.settingRow}>
      <View style={s.settingLeft}>
        {icon}
        <Text style={s.settingLabel}>{label}</Text>
      </View>
      <Switch
        value={value}
        onValueChange={onToggle}
        trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#10B981' }}
        thumbColor="#fff"
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// app/screens/retailer/home/more/editDropScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet,
  ScrollView, TextInput, Switch,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const SIZES = ['7', '7.5', '8', '8.5', '9', '9.5', '10', '10.5', '11', '11.5', '12', '13']

export default function EditDropScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [name, setName] = useState('Air Jordan 4 "Red Thunder"')
  const [retailPrice, setRetailPrice] = useState('210')
  const [dropDate, setDropDate] = useState('Aug 25, 2026')
  const [dropTime, setDropTime] = useState('10:00 AM')
  const [limitPerCustomer, setLimitPerCustomer] = useState('1')
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(true)
  const [isInStore, setIsInStore] = useState(true)
  const [notifyFollowers, setNotifyFollowers] = useState(true)
  const [selectedSizes, setSelectedSizes] = useState<string[]>(['9', '9.5', '10', '10.5', '11'])

  const toggleSize = (size: string) =>
    setSelectedSizes(prev =>
      prev.includes(size) ? prev.filter(s => s !== size) : [...prev, size]
    )

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Edit Drop</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={styles.deleteText}>Delete</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Product */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Product</Text>
        <View style={styles.productPreview}>
          <View style={styles.productImage} />
          <View style={styles.productMeta}>
            <Text style={styles.productName}>{name}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.productSku}>SKU: 308497-006</Text>
          </View>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.changeProductBtn}>
            <Text style={styles.changeProductText}>Change</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Drop name override */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Drop Name</Text>
        <TextInput value={name} onChangeText={setName} style={styles.input} />

        {/* Date & time */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Drop Date & Time</Text>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrap, { flex: 1.4 }]}>
            <Feather name="calendar" size={14} color="#9ca3af" />
            <TextInput value={dropDate} onChangeText={setDropDate} style={styles.inlineInput} />
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.inputWrap, { flex: 1 }]}>
            <Feather name="clock" size={14} color="#9ca3af" />
            <TextInput value={dropTime} onChangeText={setDropTime} style={styles.inlineInput} />
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Price */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Retail Price</Text>
        <View style={styles.inputWrap}>
          <Text style={styles.dollarSign}>$</Text>
          <TextInput value={retailPrice} onChangeText={setRetailPrice} keyboardType="numeric" style={styles.inlineInput} />
        </View>

        {/* Sizes */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Available Sizes</Text>
        <View style={styles.sizeGrid}>
          {SIZES.map(size => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={size}
              style={[styles.sizeBtn, selectedSizes.includes(size) && styles.sizeBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => toggleSize(size)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.sizeBtnText, selectedSizes.includes(size) && styles.sizeBtnTextActive]}>
                {size}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Limit */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Limit Per Customer</Text>
        <View style={styles.limitRow}>
          {['1', '2', '3', 'No Limit'].map(l => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={l}
              style={[styles.limitBtn, limitPerCustomer === l && styles.limitBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setLimitPerCustomer(l)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.limitBtnText, limitPerCustomer === l && styles.limitBtnTextActive]}>{l}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Channel */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Drop Channel</Text>
        <View style={styles.switchRow}>
          <Text style={styles.switchLabel}>Online (App)</Text>
          <Switch value={isOnline} onValueChange={setIsOnline} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.switchRow}>
          <Text style={styles.switchLabel}>In-Store</Text>
          <Switch value={isInStore} onValueChange={setIsInStore} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.switchRow}>
          <Text style={styles.switchLabel}>Notify Followers</Text>
          <Switch value={notifyFollowers} onValueChange={setNotifyFollowers} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.cancelBtn} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.cancelBtnText}>Cancel</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Save Changes</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Feather, MaterialCommunityIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import {
  useLocalDemand,
  type OpportunityItem,
  type SizeDemand,
} from '@/services/hooks/retailer/home/useLocalDemand';

export default function LocalDemandScreen() {
  const {
    store,
    dayRanges,
    dayRange,
    setDayRange,
    categoryFilters,
    category,
    setCategory,
    missedSearchesCount,
    opportunities,
    bestOpportunity,
  } = useLocalDemand();

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#F9FAFB" scrollable>
      <View className="flex-1 pb-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={s.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={24} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={s.headerTitle}>Local Demand</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>
            <Feather name="info" size={20} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Store + Radius selectors */}
        <View style={s.selectorsRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.selectorPill}>
            <Feather name="home" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            <Text style={s.selectorText} numberOfLines={1}>{store.name}</Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={16} color="#6B7280" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.selectorPill}>
            <Feather name="map-pin" size={16} color="#10B981" />
            <Text style={s.selectorText}>{store.radiusMiles} mi</Text>
            <Feather name="chevron-down" size={16} color="#6B7280" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Day range tabs */}
        <View style={s.dayTabsRow}>
          {dayRanges.map((d) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={d.key}
              onPress={() => setDayRange(d.key)}
              style={[s.dayTab, dayRange === d.key && s.dayTabActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[s.dayTabText, dayRange === d.key && s.dayTabTextActive]}>{d.label}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Category filter tabs */}
        <View style={s.categoryTabsRow}>
          {categoryFilters.map((c) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={c}
              onPress={() => setCategory(c)}
              style={[s.categoryTab, category === c && s.categoryTabActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[s.categoryTabText, category === c && s.categoryTabTextActive]}>{c}</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        <Text style={s.aggregatedText}>Aggregated nearby shopper activity · Updated today</Text>

        {/* Missed searches banner */}
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.missedBanner} activeOpacity={0.85}>
          <View style={s.missedIconWrap}>
            <Feather name="bar-chart-2" size={18} color="#10B981" />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={s.missedTitle}>{missedSearchesCount} missed searches this week</Text>
            <Text style={s.missedSubtitle}>Products and sizes shoppers wanted but you did not have.</Text>
          </View>
          <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color="#9CA3AF" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Section title */}
        <View style={s.sectionHeader}>
          <Text style={s.sectionTitle}>Top Opportunities Near You</Text>
          <Text style={s.sectionSubtitle}>Based on search demand</Text>
        </View>

        {/* Opportunity cards */}
        <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16 }}>
          {opportunities.map((item) => (
            <OpportunityCard key={item.id} item={item} />
          ))}

          {opportunities.length === 0 && (
            <View style={s.emptyState}>
              <Feather name="search" size={28} color="#D1D5DB" />
              <Text style={s.emptyStateText}>No opportunities in this category yet.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Best opportunity callout */}
        {bestOpportunity && (
          <View style={s.bestOppCard}>
            <View style={s.bestOppHeader}>
              <View style={s.bestOppIconWrap}>
                <Ionicons name="flash" size={16} color="#F59E0B" />
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={s.bestOppTitle}>Best opportunity</Text>
                <Text style={s.bestOppBody}>
                  {bestOpportunity.itemName} {bestOpportunity.reason}
                </Text>
                <Text style={s.bestOppBuyers}>Potential demand: {bestOpportunity.potentialBuyers} buyers</Text>
              </View>
              <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color="#B45309" />
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity style={s.bestOppBtn}>
              <Feather name="plus-circle" size={16} color="#fff" />
              <Text style={s.bestOppBtnText}>Add to Sourcing List</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function OpportunityCard({ item }: { item: OpportunityItem }) {
  const statusMeta = getStockStatusMeta(item.stockStatus);

  return (
    <View style={s.card}>
      <View style={s.cardTopRow}>
        <View style={s.rankBadge}>
          <Text style={s.rankBadgeText}>#{item.rank}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={s.imgPlaceholder}>
          <MaterialCommunityIcons name="shoe-sneaker" size={26} color="#9CA3AF" />
        </View>

        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <View style={s.nameRow}>
            <Text style={s.itemName} numberOfLines={1}>{item.name}</Text>
            <View style={[s.statusDot, { backgroundColor: statusMeta.dotColor }]} />
            <Text style={[s.statusLabel, { color: statusMeta.dotColor }]}>{statusMeta.label}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={s.metaRow}>
            <Text style={s.searchesText}>{item.searchesLabel}</Text>
            <Feather
              name={item.trendPct >= 0 ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down'}
              size={12}
              color={item.trendPct >= 0 ? '#10B981' : '#EF4444'}
            />
            <Text style={[s.trendText, { color: item.trendPct >= 0 ? '#10B981' : '#EF4444' }]}>
              {Math.abs(item.trendPct)}% vs last week
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      <Text style={s.sizesLabel}>Most requested sizes</Text>
      <View style={s.sizesRow}>
        {item.sizes.map((size) => (
          <SizeChip key={size.label} size={size} />
        ))}
      </View>

      <View style={s.cardBottomRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.viewDemandBtn}>
          <Feather name="bar-chart-2" size={14} color="#111827" />
          <Text style={s.viewDemandText}>View Demand</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <PrimaryActionButton action={item.primaryAction} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function SizeChip({ size }: { size: SizeDemand }) {
  if (size.status === 'out') {
    return (
      <View style={[s.sizeChip, s.sizeChipOut]}>
        <Text style={s.sizeChipLabel}>{size.label}</Text>
        <Text style={s.sizeChipOutText}>Out</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (size.status === 'low') {
    return (
      <View style={[s.sizeChip, s.sizeChipLow]}>
        <Text style={s.sizeChipLabel}>{size.label}</Text>
        <Text style={s.sizeChipLowText}>Low</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View style={s.sizeChip}>
      <Text style={s.sizeChipLabel}>{size.label}</Text>
      <Text style={s.sizeChipSearches}>{size.searches} searches</Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function PrimaryActionButton({ action }: { action: OpportunityItem['primaryAction'] }) {
  const iconName = action.icon === 'plus' ? 'plus-circle' : action.icon === 'box' ? 'package' : 'file-text';
  const isSecondary = action.kind === 'view_details';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity style={[s.primaryActionBtn, isSecondary && s.primaryActionBtnSecondary]}>
      <Feather name={iconName as any} size={14} color={isSecondary ? '#111827' : '#fff'} />
      <Text style={[s.primaryActionText, isSecondary && s.primaryActionTextSecondary]}>{action.label}</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

function getStockStatusMeta(status: OpportunityItem['stockStatus']) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'not_stocked':
      return { label: 'Not Stocked', dotColor: '#EF4444' };
    case 'missing_sizes':
      return { label: 'Missing Top Sizes', dotColor: '#F59E0B' };
    case 'demand_covered':
      return { label: 'Demand Covered', dotColor: '#10B981' };
  }
}
```

```typescript
  { id: '2', name: 'Brickell Branch', address: '456 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL' },
]

export default function PickupSettingsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [selectedBranch, setSelectedBranch] = useState('1')
  const [selectedWindow, setSelectedWindow] = useState(0)
  const [notifyReady, setNotifyReady] = useState(true)
  const [notifyReminder, setNotifyReminder] = useState(true)
  const [prepTime, setPrepTime] = useState('30')
  const [holdDuration, setHoldDuration] = useState('48')

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Pickup Settings</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Branch selection */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Branch Selection</Text>
        {BRANCHES.map(branch => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={branch.id}
            style={[styles.branchRow, selectedBranch === branch.id && styles.branchRowActive]}
            onPress={() => setSelectedBranch(branch.id)}
          >
            <View style={[styles.radio, selectedBranch === branch.id && styles.radioActive]}>
              {selectedBranch === branch.id && <View style={styles.radioDot} />}
            </View>
            <View style={styles.branchInfo}>
              <Text style={styles.branchName}>{branch.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.branchAddr}>{branch.address}</Text>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}

        {/* Pickup window */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Pickup Time Window</Text>
        {TIME_WINDOWS.map((w, i) => (
          <TouchableOpacity key={w} style={[styles.windowRow, selectedWindow === i && styles.windowRowActive]} onPress={() => setSelectedWindow(i)}>
            <View style={[styles.radio, selectedWindow === i && styles.radioActive]}>
              {selectedWindow === i && <View style={styles.radioDot} />}
            </View>
            <Text style={styles.windowText}>{w}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}

        {/* Prep time */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Preparation Time (minutes)</Text>
        <View style={styles.inputRow}>
          <TextInput
            value={prepTime}
            onChangeText={setPrepTime}
            keyboardType="numeric"
            style={styles.numInput}
          />
          <Text style={styles.inputUnit}>min</Text>
        </View>

        {/* Hold duration */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Hold Duration (hours)</Text>
        <View style={styles.holdRow}>
          {['1', '3', '6'].map(h => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={h}
              style={[styles.holdBtn, holdDuration === h && styles.holdBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setHoldDuration(h)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.holdBtnText, holdDuration === h && styles.holdBtnTextActive]}>{h}h</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Notifications */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Order Ready Notifications</Text>
        <View style={styles.switchRow}>
          <View style={styles.switchInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.switchLabel}>Notify when order is ready</Text>
            <Text style={styles.switchDesc}>Send customer notification when pickup is prepared</Text>
          </View>
          <Switch value={notifyReady} onValueChange={setNotifyReady} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.switchRow}>
          <View style={styles.switchInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.switchLabel}>Send pickup reminder</Text>
            <Text style={styles.switchDesc}>Remind customer 2hrs before hold expires</Text>
          </View>
          <Switch value={notifyReminder} onValueChange={setNotifyReminder} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>

        {/* Policies */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Pickup Instructions</Text>
        <View style={styles.policyCard}>
          {[
            { icon: 'clock', text: `Hold duration: ${holdDuration} hours after notification` },
            { icon: 'alert-circle', text: 'Late pickup: Item returned to inventory' },
            { icon: 'x-circle', text: 'No-show: Deposit forfeited after 2nd missed pickup' },
          ].map(p => (
            <View key={p.text} style={styles.policyRow}>
              <Feather name={p.icon as any} size={14} color="#6b7280" />
              <Text style={styles.policyText}>{p.text}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      <View style={styles.footer}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Save Settings</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
function StockTableRow({ row }: { row: StockRow }) {
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, TextInput, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { Feather, MaterialCommunityIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import { useSourceInventory, type SourceListing } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/home/useSourceInventory';

export default function SourceInventoryScreen() {
  const {
    shipTo,
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    filters,
    activeFilter,
    setActiveFilter,
    listings,
    demandMatchCount,
  } = useSourceInventory();

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#F9FAFB" scrollable>
      <View className="flex-1 pb-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={s.header}>
          <Text style={s.headerTitle}>Source Inventory</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>
            <Feather name="search" size={22} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Ship to selector */}
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.shipToPill}>
          <Feather name="map-pin" size={14} color="#6B7280" />
          <Text style={s.shipToText}>Ship to: {shipTo}</Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-down" size={16} color="#6B7280" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Search bar */}
        <View style={s.searchBar}>
          <Feather name="search" size={18} color="#9CA3AF" />
          <TextInput
            style={s.searchInput}
            placeholder="Search product, SKU or supplier"
            placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          />
        </View>

        {/* Protected sourcing banner */}
        <View style={s.protectedBanner}>
          <View style={s.protectedIconWrap}>
            <Feather name="shield" size={18} color="#fff" />
          </View>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text style={s.protectedTitle}>Protected sourcing</Text>
            <Text style={s.protectedSubtitle}>Verified suppliers · Secure payment · Order tracking</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Demand match alert */}
        {demandMatchCount > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity style={s.demandAlert} activeOpacity={0.85}>
            <MaterialCommunityIcons name="chart-bar" size={18} color="#B45309" />
            <Text style={s.demandAlertText}>
              {demandMatchCount} listings match products your customers want
            </Text>
            <Text style={s.demandAlertLink}>View Matches →</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        {/* Filter chips */}
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={s.filterContainer}
        >
          {filters.map((filter) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter}
              onPress={() => setActiveFilter(filter)}
              style={[s.filterPill, activeFilter === filter && s.filterPillActive]}
            >
              <Text style={[s.filterText, activeFilter === filter && s.filterTextActive]}>
                {filter}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Listings */}
        <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16 }}>
          {listings.map((listing) => (
            <ListingCard key={listing.id} listing={listing} />
          ))}

          {listings.length === 0 && (
            <View style={s.emptyState}>
              <Feather name="search" size={28} color="#D1D5DB" />
              <Text style={s.emptyStateText}>No listings match this filter yet.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Buyer protection footer */}
        <View style={s.protectionFooter}>
          <View style={s.protectionFooterHeader}>
            <Feather name="shield" size={16} color="#059669" />
            <Text style={s.protectionFooterTitle}>GoSNKR Buyer Protection</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={s.protectionFooterBody}>
            Keep payment and messages inside GoSNKR. Funds release after delivery confirmation.
          </Text>
          <TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={s.protectionFooterLink}>How protection works →</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function ListingCard({ listing }: { listing: SourceListing }) {
  return (
    <View style={s.card}>
      {/* Badge row */}
      {(listing.isDemandMatch || listing.isBulkAvailable) && (
        <View style={s.badgeRow}>
          {listing.isDemandMatch && (
            <View style={s.demandBadge}>
              <Feather name="trending-up" size={11} color="#fff" />
              <Text style={s.demandBadgeText}>Demand Match</Text>
              <View style={s.newDot}>
                <Text style={s.newDotText}>New</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}
          {listing.isBulkAvailable && (
            <View style={s.bulkBadge}>
              <Feather name="package" size={11} color="#B45309" />
              <Text style={s.bulkBadgeText}>Bulk Available</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Product row */}
      <View style={s.productRow}>
        <View style={s.imgPlaceholder}>
          <MaterialCommunityIcons name="shoe-sneaker" size={30} color="#9CA3AF" />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <Text style={s.productName}>{listing.productName}</Text>
          <Text style={s.productSize}>{listing.sizeLabel}</Text>
          <Text style={s.availabilityText}>
            {listing.availableCount} available · Minimum {listing.minPairs} pair{listing.minPairs > 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}>
          <Feather name="heart" size={20} color="#D1D5DB" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Supplier row */}
      <View style={s.supplierRow}>
        <View style={s.avatar}>
          <Text style={s.avatarText}>{listing.supplier.initials}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          <View style={s.supplierNameRow}>
            <Text style={s.supplierName}>{listing.supplier.name}</Text>
            <Feather name="check-circle" size={13} color="#10B981" />
          </View>
          <Text style={s.supplierMeta}>
            {listing.supplier.rating} ★ · {listing.supplier.completedOrders} completed orders
            {listing.supplier.respondsIn ? ` · Responds in ${listing.supplier.respondsIn}` : ''}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Feather name="chevron-right" size={18} color="#D1D5DB" />
      </View>

      {/* Pricing grid */}
      <View style={s.pricingRow}>
        <PricingCell label="Item" value={`$${listing.pricing.itemCost}`} />
        <PricingCell label="Shipping + fees" value={`$${listing.pricing.shippingFees}`} />
        <PricingCell label="Landed cost" value={`$${listing.pricing.landedCost}`} valueColor="#059669" />
        <PricingCell label="Expected retail" value={`$${listing.pricing.expectedRetail}`} valueColor="#059669" />
        <PricingCell label="Estimated margin" value={`${listing.pricing.estimatedMarginPct}%`} valueColor="#059669" />
      </View>

      {/* Fulfillment note */}
      <View style={s.fulfillmentRow}>
        <Feather
          name={listing.fulfillment === 'ships' ? 'truck' : 'package'}
          size={13}
          color="#6B7280"
        />
        <Text style={s.fulfillmentText}>{listing.fulfillmentNote}</Text>
      </View>

      {/* Actions */}
      <View style={s.cardActions}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.quoteBtn}>
          <Text style={s.quoteBtnText}>Request Quote</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity style={s.listingBtn} onPress={() => router.push('/')}>
          <Text style={s.listingBtnText}>View Listing</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function PricingCell({
  label,
  value,
  valueColor = '#111827',
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  valueColor?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={s.pricingCell}>
      <Text style={s.pricingLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={[s.pricingValue, { color: valueColor }]}>{value}</Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// app/screens/retailer/home/more/storeSubscriptionScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const PLANS = [
  {
    id: 'starter',
    name: 'Starter',
    price: 0,
    period: 'Forever free',
    features: ['Up to 20 listings', 'Basic analytics', 'Standard visibility', 'Email support'],
    highlight: false,
  },
  {
    id: 'pro',
    name: 'Pro',
    price: 49,
    period: '/month',
    features: ['Unlimited listings', 'Advanced analytics', 'Priority visibility', 'Drop campaigns', 'Sync integrations', 'Priority support'],
    highlight: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'enterprise',
    name: 'Enterprise',
    price: 149,
    period: '/month',
    features: ['Everything in Pro', 'Multi-branch management', 'Reseller sourcing', 'Custom promotions', 'Dedicated manager'],
    highlight: false,
  },
]

export default function StoreSubscriptionScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [billingCycle, setBillingCycle] = useState<'monthly' | 'annual'>('monthly')
  const currentPlan = 'starter'

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Subscription</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Billing toggle */}
        <View style={styles.billingToggle}>
          {(['monthly', 'annual'] as const).map(cycle => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={cycle}
              style={[styles.billingBtn, billingCycle === cycle && styles.billingBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setBillingCycle(cycle)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.billingBtnText, billingCycle === cycle && styles.billingBtnTextActive]}>
                {cycle === 'monthly' ? 'Monthly' : 'Annual (Save 20%)'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Plans */}
        {PLANS.map(plan => {
          const isCurrent = plan.id === currentPlan
          const price = billingCycle === 'annual' && plan.price > 0
            ? Math.round(plan.price * 0.8) : plan.price

          return (
            <View key={plan.id} style={[styles.planCard, plan.highlight && styles.planCardHighlight]}>
              {plan.highlight && (
                <View style={styles.popularBadge}>
                  <Text style={styles.popularText}>Most Popular</Text>
                </View>
              )}
              <View style={styles.planHeader}>
                <Text style={[styles.planName, plan.highlight && styles.planNameLight]}>{plan.name}</Text>
                <View>
                  <Text style={[styles.planPrice, plan.highlight && styles.planPriceLight]}>
                    {price === 0 ? 'Free' : `$${price}`}
                  </Text>
                  {price > 0 && (
                    <Text style={[styles.planPeriod, plan.highlight && styles.planPeriodLight]}>{plan.period}</Text>
                  )}
                </View>
              </View>

              {plan.features.map(f => (
                <View key={f} style={styles.featureRow}>
                  <Feather name="check" size={14} color={plan.highlight ? '#22c55e' : '#374151'} />
                  <Text style={[styles.featureText, plan.highlight && styles.featureTextLight]}>{f}</Text>
                </View>
              ))}

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[
                  styles.planBtn,
                  isCurrent ? styles.planBtnCurrent : plan.highlight ? styles.planBtnHighlight : styles.planBtnDefault,
                ]}
                onPress={() => !isCurrent && router.push('/screens/retailer/pro/goProCheckoutScreen' as any)}
                disabled={isCurrent}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.planBtnText, isCurrent && styles.planBtnTextCurrent, plan.highlight && !isCurrent && styles.planBtnTextHighlight]}>
                  {isCurrent ? 'Current Plan' : `Upgrade to ${plan.name}`}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )
        })}
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 16 },
  headerTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0a0a0a' },
  scroll: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingBottom: 40, gap: 16 },
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, FlatList, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const LOGS = [
  { id: '1', channel: 'Shopify', status: 'success', items: 12, time: '2 min ago', detail: '12 items updated' },
  { id: '2', channel: 'Square POS', status: 'success', items: 5, time: '15 min ago', detail: '5 items updated' },
  { id: '3', channel: 'Shopify', status: 'error', items: 0, time: '1 hr ago', detail: 'Connection timeout' },
  { id: '4', channel: 'Shopify', status: 'success', items: 8, time: '2 hrs ago', detail: '8 items updated' },
  { id: '5', channel: 'Square POS', status: 'warning', items: 3, time: '3 hrs ago', detail: '3 items skipped (duplicates)' },
  { id: '6', channel: 'Shopify', status: 'success', items: 20, time: 'Yesterday', detail: '20 items updated' },
]

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<string, { color: string; bg: string; icon: string }> = {
  success: { color: '#22c55e', bg: '#f0fdf4', icon: 'check-circle' },
  error: { color: '#ef4444', bg: '#fef2f2', icon: 'x-circle' },
  warning: { color: '#f59e0b', bg: '#fffbeb', icon: 'alert-circle' },
}

export default function SyncLogsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#f9fafb">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Sync Logs</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity>
          <Feather name="trash-2" size={18} color="#9ca3af" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Stats */}
      <View style={styles.statsRow}>
        {[
          { label: 'Total Syncs', value: '128', icon: 'refresh-cw', color: '#374151' },
          { label: 'Success', value: '121', icon: 'check-circle', color: '#22c55e' },
          { label: 'Errors', value: '7', icon: 'x-circle', color: '#ef4444' },
        ].map(s => (
          <View key={s.label} style={styles.statCard}>
            <Feather name={s.icon as any} size={16} color={s.color} />
            <Text style={[styles.statValue, { color: s.color }]}>{s.value}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.statLabel}>{s.label}</Text>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      <FlatList
        data={LOGS}
        keyExtractor={l => l.id}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        renderItem={({ item }) => {
          const cfg = STATUS_CONFIG[item.status]
          return (
            <View style={styles.logCard}>
              <View style={[styles.logIcon, { backgroundColor: cfg.bg }]}>
                <Feather name={cfg.icon as any} size={18} color={cfg.color} />
              </View>
              <View style={styles.logInfo}>
                <Text style={styles.logChannel}>{item.channel}</Text>
                <Text style={[styles.logDetail, { color: item.status === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : '#6b7280' }]}>
                  {item.detail}
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.logTime}>{item.time}</Text>
            </View>
          )
        }}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 8 }} />}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 8, backgroundColor: '#fff' },
```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Switch } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const CHANNELS = [
  { id: 'shopify', name: 'Shopify', icon: 'shopping-bag', connected: true, lastSync: '2 min ago' },
  { id: 'square', name: 'Square POS', icon: 'credit-card', connected: true, lastSync: '15 min ago' },
  { id: 'clover', name: 'Clover', icon: 'layers', connected: false, lastSync: 'Never' },
  { id: 'woocommerce', name: 'WooCommerce', icon: 'globe', connected: false, lastSync: 'Never' },
]

export default function SyncSettingsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [autoSync, setAutoSync] = useState(true)
  const [syncInterval, setSyncInterval] = useState('15min')
  const [stockAlerts, setStockAlerts] = useState(true)

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Sync Settings</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/screens/retailer/home/more/syncLogsScreen' as any)}>
          <Text style={styles.logsBtn}>Logs</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Connected channels */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Connected Channels</Text>
        {CHANNELS.map(ch => (
          <View key={ch.id} style={styles.channelRow}>
            <View style={[styles.channelIcon, { backgroundColor: ch.connected ? '#f0fdf4' : '#f3f4f6' }]}>
              <Feather name={ch.icon as any} size={20} color={ch.connected ? '#22c55e' : '#9ca3af'} />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.channelInfo}>
              <Text style={styles.channelName}>{ch.name}</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.channelStatus, { color: ch.connected ? '#22c55e' : '#9ca3af' }]}>
                {ch.connected ? `Synced ${ch.lastSync}` : 'Not connected'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity style={[styles.connectBtn, ch.connected && styles.connectedBtn]}>
              <Text style={[styles.connectBtnText, ch.connected && styles.connectedBtnText]}>
                {ch.connected ? 'Connected' : 'Connect'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        ))}

        {/* Sync preferences */}
        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Sync Preferences</Text>

        <View style={styles.prefRow}>
          <View style={styles.prefInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.prefLabel}>Auto Sync</Text>
            <Text style={styles.prefDesc}>Automatically sync inventory changes</Text>
          </View>
          <Switch value={autoSync} onValueChange={setAutoSync} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>

        <View style={styles.prefRow}>
          <View style={styles.prefInfo}>
            <Text style={styles.prefLabel}>Low Stock Alerts</Text>
            <Text style={styles.prefDesc}>Alert when items fall below threshold</Text>
          </View>
          <Switch value={stockAlerts} onValueChange={setStockAlerts} trackColor={{ true: '#0a0a0a', false: '#e5e7eb' }} thumbColor="#fff" />
        </View>

        <Text style={[styles.sectionTitle, { marginTop: 24 }]}>Sync Interval</Text>
        <View style={styles.intervalRow}>
          {['5min', '15min', '30min', '1hr'].map(interval => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={interval}
              style={[styles.intervalBtn, syncInterval === interval && styles.intervalBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setSyncInterval(interval)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.intervalBtnText, syncInterval === interval && styles.intervalBtnTextActive]}>
                {interval}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.syncNowBtn}>
          <Feather name="refresh-cw" size={16} color="#fff" />
          <Text style={styles.syncNowText}>Sync Now</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, View, Text, TextInput, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import ProductHeader from '@/components/retailer/home/addproduct/productHeader';

import { useAddProduct } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/home/useAddProduct';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';

interface InputFieldProps {
    placeholder: string;
    value: string;
    onChangeText: (v: string) => void;
}

const InputField = ({ placeholder, value, onChangeText }: InputFieldProps) => (
    <View style={styles.inputWrapper}>
        <TextInput
            style={styles.input}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            value={value}
            onChangeText={onChangeText}
            placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
            autoCorrect={false}
            underlineColorAndroid="transparent"
        />
    </View>
);

const AddProductScreen = () => {
    const {
        form,
        sizes,
        scannedFound,
        updateField,
        updateSizeQty,
        addSize,
        removeSize,
        openScanner,
        enterBarcodeManually,
        handleSave,
    } = useAddProduct();

    return (
        <BaseContainer backgroundColor='#fff'>
            <View style={styles.container}>
                <ProductHeader />

                <ScrollView
                    showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                    keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
                    contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
                >
                    <ProductBarcodeScan
                        onOpenScanner={openScanner}
                        onEnterManually={enterBarcodeManually}
                    />

                    <OrDivider />

                    <ProductImageUpload />

                    {scannedFound && <ProductFoundCard productName={form.name} />}

                    <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>PRODUCT DETAILS</Text>

                    <InputField
                        placeholder="Product Name"
                        value={form.name}
                        onChangeText={(v) => updateField('name', v)}
                    />
                    <InputField
                        placeholder="Brand"
                        value={form.brand}
                        onChangeText={(v) => updateField('brand', v)}
                    />
                    <InputField
                        placeholder="Category"
                        value={form.category}
                        onChangeText={(v) => updateField('category', v)}
                    />
                    <InputField
                        placeholder="Colorway"
                        value={form.colorway}
                        onChangeText={(v) => updateField('colorway', v)}
                    />
                    <InputField
                        placeholder="SKU / Style Code"
                        value={form.sku}
                        onChangeText={(v) => updateField('sku', v)}
                    />

                    <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>SIZES & PRICING</Text>
                    <ProductSizeTable
                        sizes={sizes}
                        onUpdateQty={updateSizeQty}
                        onRemove={removeSize}
                        onAddSize={addSize}
                    />

                    <Text style={styles.sectionLabel}>AVAILABILITY</Text>
                    <View style={styles.availabilityRow}>
                        {(['Active', 'Coming Soon'] as const).map((status) => (
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                key={status}

                            >
                                <Text style={[

                                ]}>

                                </Text>

                        ))}
                    </View>

                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.saveBtn} onPress={handleSave}>
                        <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Save Product</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>

            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    );
};
```
