```typescript
// app/screens/retailer/pro/freeTrialOnboardingScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView, Dimensions } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window')

const SLIDES = [
  {
    icon: 'trending-up',
    title: 'Advanced Analytics',
    desc: 'See what your customers want before they ask. Local demand heatmaps, size gaps, and competitor insights.',
    color: '#3b82f6',
  },
  {
    icon: 'zap',
    title: 'Unlimited Listings',
    desc: 'List your full inventory with no cap. Every pair visible to thousands of nearby sneaker buyers.',
    color: '#8b5cf6',
  },
  {
    icon: 'star',
    title: 'Priority Placement',
    desc: 'Your store appears first in local search results and on the discover map for relevant searches.',
    color: '#f59e0b',
  },
  {
    icon: 'package',
    title: 'Drop Campaigns',
    desc: 'Build hype before releases. Create countdowns, notify followers, and manage raffle entries.',
    color: '#22c55e',
  },
]

export default function FreeTrialOnboardingScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0)

  const isLast = step === SLIDES.length - 1
  const slide = SLIDES[step]

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      {/* Skip */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <View style={{ width: 44 }} />
        <View style={styles.dots}>
          {SLIDES.map((_, i) => (
            <View key={i} style={[styles.dot, i === step && styles.dotActive]} />
          ))}
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/screens/retailer/pro/goProCheckoutScreen' as any)}>
          <Text style={styles.skipText}>Skip</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Slide content */}
      <View style={styles.slideContent}>
        <View style={[styles.iconCircle, { backgroundColor: slide.color + '15' }]}>
          <Feather name={slide.icon as any} size={48} color={slide.color} />
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.slideTitle}>{slide.title}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.slideDesc}>{slide.desc}</Text>
      </View>

      {/* Pro badge */}
      <View style={styles.proBadge}>
        <Feather name="award" size={14} color="#f59e0b" />
        <Text style={styles.proBadgeText}>Included in Pro & Enterprise plans</Text>
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {step > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={() => setStep(s => s - 1)}>
            <Text style={styles.backBtnText}>Back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.nextBtn, step === 0 && { flex: 1 }]}
          onPress={() =>
            isLast
              ? router.push('/screens/retailer/pro/goProCheckoutScreen' as any)
              : setStep(s => s + 1)
          }
        >
          <Text style={styles.nextBtnText}>{isLast ? 'Start Free Trial' : 'Next'}</Text>
          <Feather name="arrow-right" size={18} color="#fff" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  topBar: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 20, paddingTop: 56, paddingBottom: 8 },
  dots: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 },
```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'

]

export default function GoProCheckoutScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [billing, setBilling] = useState<'monthly' | 'annual'>('annual')
  const [selectedCard, setSelectedCard] = useState('visa')

  const monthlyPrice = 49
  const annualPrice = Math.round(monthlyPrice * 0.8)
  const displayPrice = billing === 'annual' ? annualPrice : monthlyPrice

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />

        <View style={{ width: 22 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        {/* Plan hero */}
        <View style={styles.planHero}>
          <View style={styles.proCrown}>
            <Feather name="award" size={24} color="#f59e0b" />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.planTitle}>GOSNKR Pro</Text>
          <Text style={styles.planSubtitle}>Everything you need to grow your store</Text>
        </View>

        {/* Billing toggle */}
        <View style={styles.billingToggle}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.billingBtn, billing === 'monthly' && styles.billingBtnActive]}
            onPress={() => setBilling('monthly')}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.billingBtnText, billing === 'monthly' && styles.billingBtnTextActive]}>Monthly</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.billingPrice, billing === 'monthly' && styles.billingPriceActive]}>${monthlyPrice}/mo</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.billingBtn, billing === 'annual' && styles.billingBtnActive]}
            onPress={() => setBilling('annual')}
          >
            <View style={styles.saveBadge}><Text style={styles.saveBadgeText}>Save 20%</Text></View>
            <Text style={[styles.billingBtnText, billing === 'annual' && styles.billingBtnTextActive]}>Annual</Text>
            <Text style={[styles.billingPrice, billing === 'annual' && styles.billingPriceActive]}>${annualPrice}/mo</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Features */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>What's included</Text>
        <View style={styles.featureList}>
          {PRO_FEATURES.map(f => (
            <View key={f} style={styles.featureRow}>
              <View style={styles.checkIcon}>

              <Text style={styles.featureText}>{f}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* Payment method */}
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Payment Method</Text>
        {[
          { id: 'visa', label: 'Visa ending in 4242', icon: 'credit-card' },
          { id: 'new', label: 'Add new card', icon: 'plus-circle' },
        ].map(card => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={card.id}

          >
            <View style={[styles.cardRadio, selectedCard === card.id && styles.cardRadioActive]}>
              {selectedCard === card.id && <View style={styles.cardRadioDot} />}

            <Feather name={card.icon as any} size={18} color="#374151" />
            <Text style={styles.cardLabel}>{card.label}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}

        {/* Order summary */}

        <View style={styles.summary}>

            <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>GOSNKR Pro ({billing})</Text>

          {billing === 'annual' && (
```

```typescript
// app/screens/retailer/pro/successConfirmationScreen.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Animated } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const UNLOCKED = [
  'Unlimited listings',
  'Advanced analytics',
  'Priority placement',
  'Drop campaigns',
  'Sync integrations',
]

export default function SuccessConfirmationScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current
  const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.sequence([
      Animated.spring(scaleAnim, { toValue: 1, useNativeDriver: true, tension: 80, friction: 6 }),
      Animated.timing(fadeAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 400, useNativeDriver: true }),
    ]).start()
  }, [])

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={styles.container}>
        {/* Animated checkmark */}
        <Animated.View style={[styles.successCircle, { transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }] }]}>
          <Feather name="check" size={52} color="#fff" />
        </Animated.View>

        <Animated.View style={[styles.textBlock, { opacity: fadeAnim }]}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>You're Now Pro! 🎉</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Your 14-day free trial has started. Enjoy all Pro features.</Text>

          {/* Confetti dots — static decorative */}
          <View style={styles.divider} />

          <Text style={styles.unlockedTitle}>What you've unlocked:</Text>
          {UNLOCKED.map((item) => (
            <View key={item} style={styles.unlockedRow}>
              <View style={styles.unlockedCheck}>
                <Feather name="check" size={12} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text style={styles.unlockedText}>{item}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}

          <View style={styles.trialNote}>
            <Feather name="info" size={14} color="#3b82f6" />
            <Text style={styles.trialNoteText}>
              You won't be charged until Aug 30, 2026. Cancel anytime before then.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </Animated.View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.exploreBtn}
          onPress={() => router.push('/screens/retailer/pro/proDashboardScreen' as any)}
        >
          <Text style={styles.exploreBtnText}>Explore Pro Dashboard</Text>
          <Feather name="arrow-right" size={18} color="#fff" />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.push('/retailerTabs/home' as any)}>
          <Text style={styles.laterText}>Maybe later</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react'

const PROMOTIONS = [

]
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, StyleSheet,
} from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import ClaimsActionBanner from '@/components/retailer/refund/ClaimSectionBanner';
import ClaimCard from '@/components/retailer/refund/ClaimCard';
import ClaimEmptyPrevious from '@/components/retailer/refund/ClaimEmptyPrevious';
import { useClaims,RefundClaim } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/refund/useClaims';

const SECTION_LABEL = {
  fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '700' as const, color: '#9CA3AF',
  letterSpacing: 0.8, paddingHorizontal: 16,
  paddingTop: 14, paddingBottom: 6,
} as const;

export const RefundClaimsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    newClaims,
    previousClaims,
    isProcessing,
    handleDismiss,
  } = useClaims();

  const activeClaim = newClaims[0] ?? null;

  const handleReviewPress = (claim: RefundClaim) => {
    router.push({
      pathname: '/screens/retailer/refund/reviewClaimScreen',
      params: { claimId: claim.id },
    });
  };

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>
      <View style={styles.container} className='pt-10'>

        {/* ── Header ── */}
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
            <Feather name="chevron-left" size={24} color="#111" />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <Text style={styles.title}>Refund Claims</Text>
            {newClaims.length > 0 && (
              <View style={styles.badge}>
                <Text style={styles.badgeText}>{newClaims.length} New</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={{ width: 24 }} />
        </View>

        {/* ── Body ── */}
        <ScrollView
          style={styles.scroll}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        >
          {/* Action banner */}
          {activeClaim && (
            <ClaimsActionBanner deadlineIso={activeClaim.deadlineIso} />
          )}

          {/* NEW CLAIMS */}
          <Text style={SECTION_LABEL}>NEW CLAIM</Text>
          {newClaims.length > 0 ? (
            newClaims.map(claim => (
              <ClaimCard
                key={claim.id}
                claim={claim}
                timeLabel="just now"
                onReviewPress={handleReviewPress}
              />
            ))
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.emptyNew}>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#9CA3AF', textAlign: 'center' }}>
                No new claims. You're all caught up!
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* PREVIOUS CLAIMS */}
          <Text style={SECTION_LABEL}>PREVIOUS CLAIMS</Text>
          {previousClaims.length > 0 ? (
            previousClaims.map(claim => (
              <ClaimCard key={claim.id} claim={claim} />
            ))
          ) : (
            <ClaimEmptyPrevious />
          )}
        </ScrollView>

        {/* ── Bottom actions (only when there's a pending claim) ── */}
        {activeClaim && (
          <View style={styles.bottomBar}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => handleReviewPress(activeClaim)}
              style={styles.reviewBtn}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Text style={styles.reviewBtnText}>Review This Claim</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => handleDismiss(activeClaim.id)}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              style={styles.dismissBtn}
            >
              <Text style={styles.dismissBtnText}>Dismiss for Now</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <Text style={styles.disclaimer}>
              Auto-approval will complete in 24hrs on {activeClaim.deadlineDisplay}
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container:    { flex: 1 },
  header: {
    flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',

  },
```

```typescript
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    Text,
    TouchableOpacity,
    ScrollView,
    StyleSheet,
} from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { router, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';

import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import ReviewClaimCountdownBanner from '@/components/retailer/refund/ReviewClaimCountDownBanner';
import ReviewClaimCustomer from '@/components/retailer/refund/ReviewClaimCustomer';
import ReviewClaimOrder from '@/components/retailer/refund/ReviewClaimOrder';
import ReviewClaimActions from '@/components/retailer/refund/ReviewClaimActions';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';
import { useClaims } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/refund/useClaims';

const SECTION_LABEL = {
    fontSize: 10,
    fontWeight: '700' as const,
    color: '#9CA3AF',
    letterSpacing: 0.8,
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingTop: 14,
    paddingBottom: 6,
    backgroundColor: '#F5F5F5',
} as const;

export const ReviewClaimScreen: React.FC = () => {
    const { claimId } = useLocalSearchParams<{ claimId: string }>();

    const {
        newClaims,
        previousClaims,
        isProcessing,
        handleApproveClaim,
        handleRejectClaim,
        handleViewCustomerProfile,
    } = useClaims();

    const [confirmType, setConfirmType] = useState<'approve' | 'reject' | null>(null);
    const [isProcessingAction, setIsProcessingAction] = useState(false);

    const claim = useMemo(() => {
        return [...newClaims, ...previousClaims].find(c => c.id === claimId) ?? null;
    }, [newClaims, previousClaims, claimId]);

    if (!claim) {
        return (
            <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
                <View style={styles.notFound}>
                    <Text style={{ color: '#9CA3AF', fontSize: 14 }}>
                        Claim not found.
                    </Text>
                </View>
            </BaseContainer>
        );
    }

    const onApprove = () => setConfirmType('approve');
    const onReject = () => setConfirmType('reject');

    const handleConfirm = async () => {
        if (!confirmType) return;

        try {
            setIsProcessingAction(true);

            if (confirmType === 'approve') {
                await handleApproveClaim(claim.id);

                Toast.show({
                    type: 'success',
                    text1: 'Refund Approved',
                    text2: 'The refund has been successfully processed.',
                });
            } else {
                await handleRejectClaim(claim.id);

                Toast.show({
                    type: 'success',
                    text1: 'Claim Rejected',
                    text2: 'The refund claim has been rejected.',
                });
            }

            setConfirmType(null);
            router.back();
        } catch (error) {
            Toast.show({
                type: 'error',
                text1:
                    confirmType === 'approve'
                        ? 'Approval Failed'
                        : 'Rejection Failed',
                text2: 'Something went wrong. Try again.',
            });
        } finally {
            setIsProcessingAction(false);
        }
    };

    return (
        <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
            <View style={styles.container} className="pt-10">

                {/* Header */}
                <View style={styles.header}>
                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()}>
                        <Feather name="chevron-left" size={24} color="#111" />
                    </TouchableOpacity>

                    <Text style={styles.title}>Review Claim</Text>

                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => console.log('edit claim', claim.id)}>
                        <Text style={styles.editBtn}>Edit</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {/* Countdown */}
                {claim.status === 'pending' && (
                    <ReviewClaimCountdownBanner
                        deadlineIso={claim.deadlineIso}
                        deadlineDisplay={claim.deadlineDisplay}
                    />
                )}

                {/* Body */}
                <ScrollView
                    style={styles.scroll}
                    showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                    contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
                >
                    <Text style={SECTION_LABEL}>CUSTOMER</Text>
                    <ReviewClaimCustomer
                        customer={claim.customer}
                        onViewProfile={handleViewCustomerProfile}
                    />

                    <Text style={SECTION_LABEL}>ORDER</Text>
                    <ReviewClaimOrder order={claim.order} />

                    {claim.status === 'pending' && (
                        <ReviewClaimActions
                            depositAmount={claim.order.depositAmount}
                            isProcessing={isProcessing}
                            onApprove={onApprove}
                            onReject={onReject}
                        />
                    )}
                </ScrollView>

                {/* Confirmation Modal */}
                {confirmType && (
                    <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
                        <View style={styles.modal}>
                            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>
                                {confirmType === 'approve'
                                    ? 'Approve Refund'
                                    : 'Reject Claim'}
                            </Text>

                            <Text style={styles.modalDesc}>
                                {confirmType === 'approve'
                                    ? `Release $${claim.order.depositAmount.toFixed(
                                          2
                                      )} to ${claim.customer.name}?`
                                    : 'Are you sure you want to reject this refund claim?'}
                            </Text>

                            <View style={styles.modalActions}>
                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    style={styles.modalCancel}
                                    onPress={() => setConfirmType(null)}
                                    disabled={isProcessingAction}
                                >
                                    <Text style={styles.modalCancelText}>
                                        Cancel
                                    </Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>

                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    style={[
                                        styles.modalConfirm,
                                        confirmType === 'reject' && {
                                            backgroundColor: '#DC2626',
                                        },
                                    ]}
                                    onPress={handleConfirm}
                                    disabled={isProcessingAction}
                                >
                                    <Text style={styles.modalConfirmText}>
                                        {isProcessingAction
                                            ? 'Processing...'
                                            : 'Confirm'}
                                    </Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>
                            </View>
                        </View>
                    </View>
                )}
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    container: { flex: 1 },

    header: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        paddingHorizontal: 16,
        paddingTop: 16,
        paddingBottom: 10,
    },

    title: { fontSize: 17, fontWeight: '700', color: '#111' },

    editBtn: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600', color: '#9CA3AF' },

    scroll: { flex: 1 },

    scrollContent: { paddingBottom: 24 },

    notFound: {
        flex: 1,
        alignItems: 'center',

    },

    modalOverlay: {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        bottom: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        alignItems: 'center',
        padding: 16,
    },

    modal: {
        width: '100%',
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        borderRadius: 12,
        padding: 16,
    },

    modalTitle: {
        fontSize: 16,
        fontWeight: '700',
        color: '#111',
    },

    modalDesc: {
        fontSize: 13,
        color: '#4B5563',
        marginTop: 8,

    },

    modalActions: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        justifyContent: 'flex-end',
        marginTop: 16,
        gap: 8,
    },

    modalCancel: {
        paddingHorizontal: 12,
        paddingVertical: 8,
    },

    modalCancelText: {
```

```typescript
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-4 leading-4 text-center px-4">

          </Text>
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Submit button */}
        <View className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 px-4 pb-8 pt-3 bg-white border-t border-gray-100">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handleSubmit}

          >

                isValid ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'
              }`}
            >
              {isValid ? 'Submit' : 'Complete required fields'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native'

import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import {
  NEXT_STEPS,
  useDealConfirmed,
} from '@/services/hooks/store/useDealConfirmed'

export default function DealConfirmedScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{
    shoeName?: string
    agreedPrice?: string
    buyerName?: string
  }>()

  const shoeName = params.shoeName || 'Your item'
  const buyerName = params.buyerName || 'The store'
  const parsedPrice = Number(params.agreedPrice)
  const agreedPrice = Number.isFinite(parsedPrice) ? parsedPrice : 0

  const { handleViewTransaction } = useDealConfirmed({
    shoeName,
    agreedPrice,
    buyerName,
  })

  const formattedPrice = agreedPrice.toLocaleString('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#FFFFFF" scrollable>
      <View className="pt-12 px-4 pb-10 min-h-full">
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center"

        >

        <View className="items-center mt-8">
          <View className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-green-50 items-center justify-center">
            <View className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-green-500 items-center justify-center">
              <Feather name="check" size={32} color="#FFFFFF" />
            </View>
          </View>

          <Text className="text-3xl font-black text-gray-900 mt-6 text-center">

          </Text>
          <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center mt-2 leading-5 px-8">
            {buyerName} accepted the deal. Your sale is now locked in.
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-8 rounded-[28px] bg-gray-950 px-5 py-6">
          <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 tracking-[2px] uppercase">
            Your payout
          </Text>
          <Text className="text-5xl font-black text-white mt-2">${formattedPrice}</Text>

          <View className="h-px bg-gray-800 my-5" />

          <Text className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">ITEM</Text>
          <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-white">{shoeName}</Text>

          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 mt-4">
            <View className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-green-500 items-center justify-center">
              <Feather name="shopping-bag" size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />
            </View>
            <View>
              <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Buyer</Text>
              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-200">{buyerName}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-[1.6px] uppercase mt-8 mb-3">
          What happens next

        <View className="rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 px-4 overflow-hidden">
          {NEXT_STEPS.map((step, index) => (

                index !== NEXT_STEPS.length - 1 ? 'border-b border-gray-200' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <View className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white border border-gray-200 items-center justify-center">
                <Text className="text-[11px] font-black text-gray-800">{index + 1}</Text>
              </View>
              <Text className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-700 leading-5">{step}</Text>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity

        </TouchableOpacity>

}
```

```typescript
                </View>

                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1">
                  <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-500">Link</Text>
                  <Feather name="chevron-right" size={12} color="#22C55E" />
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}

            {/* Not related option */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => handleLinkOrder('none')}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              className="flex-row items-center py-3.5 gap-3"
            >
              <View
                className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 items-center justify-center ${
                  linkedOrderId === 'none'
                    ? 'border-green-500'
                    : 'border-gray-300'
                }`}
              >
                {linkedOrderId === 'none' && (
                  <View className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
                )}
              </View>
              <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500">Not related to an order</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          {/* ── DESCRIPTION ── */}
          <SectionLabel label="Describe what happened" />
          <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
            <TextInput
              value={description}
              onChangeText={setDescription}
              placeholder="Please describe the issue in detail. Be as specific as possible..."
              placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
              multiline
              numberOfLines={5}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              maxLength={500}
              className="text-sm text-gray-700 leading-5"
              style={{ minHeight: 100 }}
            />
            <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-300 text-right mt-1">
              {description.length}/500
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* ── PHOTOS ── */}
          <SectionLabel label="Upload evidence (optional)" />
          <View className="flex-row gap-3">
            {photos.map((photo, i) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={i}
                onPress={() => handlePickPhoto(i)}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
                className="flex-1 aspect-square rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 items-center justify-center"
              >
                {photo ? (
                  <Feather name="check" size={20} color="#22C55E" />
                ) : (
                  <Feather name="camera" size={20} color="#9CA3AF" />
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-1.5">
            Photos, screenshots, or receipts
          </Text>

          {/* ── CONTACT METHOD ── */}
          <SectionLabel label="How should we contact you?" />
          <View className="flex-row gap-4 bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 shadow-sm">
            {(['Email', 'In-App'] as ContactMethod[]).map(method => {
              const active = contactMethod === method
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={method}
                  onPress={() => setContactMethod(method)}
                  activeOpacity={0.8}
                  className="flex-row items-center gap-2"
                >
                  {/* Radio */}
                  <View
                    className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 items-center justify-center ${
                      active ? 'border-green-500' : 'border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {active && (
                      <View className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
                    )}
                  </View>

                  <Text
                    className={`text-sm font-semibold ${
                      active ? 'text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {method}
                  </Text>

                  {/* Beta badge for In-App */}
                  {method === 'In-App' && (
                    <View className="bg-green-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                      <Text className="text-[9px] font-bold text-white">beta</Text>
                    </View>
                  )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )
            })}
          </View>

          {/* ── IS URGENT ── */}
          <SectionLabel label="Is this urgent?" />
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 shadow-sm">
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-700">Mark as urgent</Text>
            <Switch
              value={isUrgent}
              onValueChange={setIsUrgent}
              trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#22C55E' }}
              thumbColor="#ffffff"
            />
          </View>

          {/* Disclaimer */}
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-4 leading-4 text-center px-4">
            Your report is confidential. We will review all reports within 24-48 hours.
          </Text>
        </ScrollView>

        {/* Submit button */}
        <View className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 px-4 pb-8 pt-3 bg-white border-t border-gray-100">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handleSubmit}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            disabled={!isValid}
            className={`rounded-2xl py-4 items-center ${
              isValid ? 'bg-gray-900' : 'bg-gray-100'
            }`}
          >
            <Text
              className={`text-base font-bold ${
                isValid ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'
              }`}
            >
              {isValid ? 'Submit Report' : 'Complete required fields'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default ReportStoreDetailScreen
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'
import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router'
import {
  REPORT_TOPICS,
  useReportStore,
} from '@/services/hooks/store/useReportStore'
import ReportTopicRow from '@/components/store/ReportTopicRow'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const ReportStoreScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { storeId, storeName, storeAddress } =
    useLocalSearchParams<{
      storeId: string
      storeName: string
      storeAddress: string
    }>()

  const { handleTopicSelect } = useReportStore(storeId)

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#ffffff">
      {/* Header */}
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 pt-12 pb-4 bg-white border-b border-gray-100">
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
        >
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text className="text-lg font-extrabold text-gray-900 ml-3">
          Report Store
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 }}
      >
        {/* Store card */}
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-6 shadow-sm">
          <View className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-green-500 items-center justify-center">
            <Text className="text-white text-sm font-extrabold">
              {storeName?.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() ?? 'ST'}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">{storeName}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{storeAddress}</Text>
          </View>
          {/* Verified badge */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 bg-green-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-green-200">
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={12} color="#22C55E" />
            <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-green-600">Verified</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Topic list */}
        <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900 mb-3">
          What are you reporting?
        </Text>

        <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 shadow-sm">
          {REPORT_TOPICS.map((option, i) => (
            <ReportTopicRow
              key={option.topic}
              option={option}
              isLast={i === REPORT_TOPICS.length - 1}
              onPress={() => handleTopicSelect(option.topic)}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default ReportStoreScreen
```

```typescript
// app/tabs/searchResultsScreen.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import {
  View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Image,
  StyleSheet, FlatList,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

type Condition = 'NEW' | 'PRE-OWNED'
type SortOption = 'Best Condition' | 'Price: Low to High' | 'Price: High to Low' | 'Nearest'

interface SearchResult {
  id: string
  name: string
  store: string
  condition: Condition
  size: string
  price: number
  distance: string
  colorSwatch: string
  isFeatured?: boolean
  image: string
}

const MOCK_RESULTS: SearchResult[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Supreme Box Logo Hoodie FW23', store: 'Kicks City', condition: 'NEW', size: 'M', price: 320, distance: '0.8 mi', colorSwatch: '#000', image: '' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Supreme Box Logo Tee SS24', store: 'Urban Vault', condition: 'NEW', size: 'L', price: 285, distance: '1.2 mi', colorSwatch: '#fff', image: '' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Supreme Classic Hoodie', store: 'Street Elite', condition: 'PRE-OWNED', size: 'M', price: 295, distance: '1.5 mi', colorSwatch: '#dc2626', image: '' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Supreme Essential Tee', store: 'Kicks City', condition: 'NEW', size: 'S', price: 180, distance: '0.8 mi', colorSwatch: '#000', image: '' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Supreme Overdyed Hoodie', store: 'Premium Threads', condition: 'NEW', size: 'XL', price: 340, distance: '2.3 mi', colorSwatch: '#c2b280', isFeatured: true, image: '' },
  { id: '6', name: 'Supreme Classic Crewneck', store: 'Urban Vault', condition: 'PRE-OWNED', size: 'M', price: 250, distance: '1.2 mi', colorSwatch: '#000', image: '' },
]

const CONDITION_COLOR: Record<Condition, string> = {
  'NEW': '#0a0a0a',
  'PRE-OWNED': '#f59e0b',
}

export default function SearchResultsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortOption>('Best Condition')
  const [activeFilters, setActiveFilters] = useState<string[]>(['Size M', 'In Stock'])
  const [isGrid, setIsGrid] = useState(false)

  const removeFilter = (f: string) => setActiveFilters(prev => prev.filter(x => x !== f))

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: SearchResult }) => (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => router.push('/screens/product/productScreen')}
      style={styles.card}
      activeOpacity={0.9}
    >
      {/* Image */}
      <View style={styles.imageBox}>
        <View style={[styles.conditionBadge, { backgroundColor: CONDITION_COLOR[item.condition] }]}>
          <Text style={styles.conditionText}>{item.condition}</Text>
        </View>
        {item.isFeatured && (
          <View style={[styles.conditionBadge, { backgroundColor: '#f59e0b', left: 52 }]}>
            <Text style={styles.conditionText}>Featured</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Info */}
      <View style={styles.infoCol}>
        <View style={styles.metaRow}>
          <Text style={[styles.conditionLabel, { color: CONDITION_COLOR[item.condition] }]}>
            {item.condition}
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.distanceText}>· {item.distance}</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={styles.productName} numberOfLines={2}>{item.name}</Text>
        <Text style={styles.storeName}>{item.store}</Text>

        <View style={styles.sizeRow}>
          <View style={styles.sizeLeft}>
            <Text style={styles.sizeText}>Size {item.size}</Text>
            <View style={[styles.colorDot, { backgroundColor: item.colorSwatch }]} />
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.priceText}>${item.price}</Text>
        </View>

        {/* Actions */}
        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionBtn}>
            <Feather name="map-pin" size={12} color="#374151" />
            <Text style={styles.actionBtnText}>Map</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionBtn}>
            <Feather name="heart" size={12} color="#374151" />
            <Text style={styles.actionBtnText}>Save</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.buyBtn}
            onPress={() => router.push('/screens/discover/buyNowScreen')}
          >
            <Text style={styles.buyBtnText}>Buy</Text>
            <Feather name="arrow-right" size={12} color="#fff" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  )

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} style={styles.backBtn}>
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#0a0a0a" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Search Results</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 32 }} />
      </View>

      {/* Stats + sort */}
      <View style={styles.statsRow}>
        <View>
          <Text style={styles.resultCount}>{MOCK_RESULTS.length} results</Text>
          <Text style={styles.activeFilterSummary}>
            {activeFilters.join(' · ')}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.sortBtn}>
          <Text style={styles.sortText}>Sort: {sort}</Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color="#374151" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Filter chips */}
      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} style={styles.chipsScroll} contentContainerStyle={styles.chipsContent}>
        {activeFilters.map(f => (
          <TouchableOpacity key={f} style={styles.activeChip} onPress={() => removeFilter(f)}>
            <Text style={styles.activeChipText}>{f}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.chipX}>×</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addFilterChip}>
          <Text style={styles.addFilterText}>+ Add Filter</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* View toggle */}
      <View style={styles.viewToggleRow}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.viewToggleBtn, !isGrid && styles.viewToggleActive]}
          onPress={() => setIsGrid(false)}
        >
          <Feather name="list" size={16} color={isGrid ? '#6b7280' : '#fff'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.viewToggleBtn, isGrid && styles.viewToggleActive]}
          onPress={() => setIsGrid(true)}
        >
          <Feather name="grid" size={16} color={isGrid ? '#fff' : '#6b7280'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <FlatList
        data={MOCK_RESULTS}
        keyExtractor={i => i.id}
        renderItem={renderItem}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 52, paddingBottom: 12 },
```

```typescript
// components/auth/SigninForm.tsx
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'
import EmailField from '@/components/shared/EmailField'
import PasswordField from '@/components/shared/PasswordField'
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button'
import SocialButton from '@/components/shared/SocialButton'
import GoogleIcon from '@/assets/images/auth/google.svg'
import AppleIcon from '@/assets/images/auth/apple.svg'

interface SigninFormProps {
  form: { email: string; password: string }
  errors: { email?: string; password?: string }
  loading: boolean
  updateField: (field: 'email' | 'password', value: string) => void
  handleSignin: () => void
  handleFaceID: () => void
  onForgotPassword: () => void
  onCreateAccount: () => void
}

export default function SigninForm({
  form,
  errors,
  loading,
  updateField,
  handleSignin,
  handleFaceID,
  onForgotPassword,
  onCreateAccount,
}: SigninFormProps) {
  return (
    <View className="gap-3">

      {/* ── Email ── */}
      <EmailField
      focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
        value={form.email}
        onChangeText={(val: string) => updateField('email', val)}
        error={errors.email}
      />

      {/* ── Password ── */}
      <View>
        <PasswordField
            focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
          value={form.password}
          onChangeText={(val: string) => updateField('password', val)}
          placeholder="Your password"
          error={errors.password}
        />

        {/* Forgot password — right-aligned, sits just below the field */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onForgotPassword}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          className="self-end mt-2"
        >
          <Text className="text-sm text-[#22C55E] font-semibold">
            Forgot password?
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* ── Sign In Button ── */}
      <Button
        text={loading ? 'Signing in…' : 'Sign In'}
        variant="solid"
        backgroundColor="#000000"
        height={56}
        borderRadius={14}
        fontSize={17}
        fontWeight="700"
        disabled={loading}
        opacity={loading ? 0.7 : 1}
        onPress={handleSignin}
      />

      {/* ── Divider ── */}
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 my-1">
        <View className="flex-1 h-px bg-gray-200" />
        <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400">or</Text>
        <View className="flex-1 h-px bg-gray-200" />
      </View>

      {/* ── Google ── */}
      <SocialButton
        text="Continue with Google"
        SvgIcon={GoogleIcon}
        iconSize={20}
        textColor="#111827"
        onPress={() => {}}
      />

      {/* ── Apple ── */}
      <SocialButton
        text="Continue with Apple"
        SvgIcon={AppleIcon}
        iconSize={20}
        textColor="#111827"
        onPress={() => {}}
      />

      {/* ── Footer ── */}
      <View className="flex-row justify-center items-center gap-1 mt-2">
        <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500">New to GoSNKR?</Text>
```

```typescript
  disabled?: boolean
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'

interface PromoCodeProps {
  promoCode: string
  appliedPromo: string | null
  onChangeCode: (code: string) => void
  onApply: () => void
  onRemove: () => void
}

const PromoCodeInput: React.FC<PromoCodeProps> = ({
  promoCode,
  appliedPromo,
  onChangeCode,
  onApply,
  onRemove,
}) => {
  const isValid = promoCode.trim().length > 0

  return (
    <View className="mb-7">
      
      {/* Title */}
      <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900 mb-3">
        Promo Code
      </Text>

      {appliedPromo ? (
        // -----------------------------
        // Applied State (Bigger Card)
        // -----------------------------
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4">
          
          <View className="flex-1">
            <Text className="text-green-700 font-extrabold text-base">
              {appliedPromo} applied
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-green-500 text-sm mt-1">
              Discount applied to your order
            </Text>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={onRemove}
            className="ml-4 px-3 py-2 bg-red-50 rounded-lg"
          >
            <Text className="text-red-500 text-sm font-semibold">
              Remove
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      ) : (
        // -----------------------------
        // Input State (Bigger Input)
        // -----------------------------
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
          
          <TextInput
            value={promoCode}
            onChangeText={onChangeCode}
            placeholder="Enter promo code"
            placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
            autoCapitalize="characters"
            className="flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-base text-gray-900 font-semibold"
          />

          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={onApply}
            disabled={!isValid}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            className={`px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl ${
              isValid ? 'bg-black' : 'bg-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Text
              className={`text-base font-bold ${
                isValid ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-400'
              }`}
            >
              Apply
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  )
}

export default PromoCodeInput
```

```typescript
// components/profile/wishlist/WishlistCard.tsx
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image } from 'react-native'
import { Ionicons, Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { STATUS_COLOR,WishlistItem } from '@/services/hooks/discover/useWishList'

interface Props {
  item: WishlistItem
  onWishlistToggle: () => void
  onBuy: () => void
  onNotify: () => void
}

const WishlistCard: React.FC<Props> = ({ item, onWishlistToggle, onBuy, onNotify }) => {
  const isAvailable = item.stockStatus === 'In Stock' || item.stockStatus === 'Low Stock'
  const hasDiscount = item.originalPrice && item.originalPrice > item.price
  const discountPct = hasDiscount
    ? Math.round((1 - item.price / item.originalPrice!) * 100)
    : 0

  return (
    <View
      className="bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden mb-3"
      style={{
        shadowColor: '#000',
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.06,
        shadowRadius: 8,
        elevation: 2,
      }}
    >
      <View className="flex-row">
        {/* Image */}
        <View className="w-28 h-28 bg-gray-100 relative">
          {item.imageUri
            ? <Image source={{ uri: item.imageUri }} className="w-full h-full" resizeMode="cover" />
            : <View className="w-full h-full bg-gray-200" />
          }
          {hasDiscount && (
            <View className="absolute top-2 left-2 bg-red-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              <Text className="text-white text-[10px] font-extrabold">-{discountPct}%</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Content */}
        <View className="flex-1 p-3 justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-start justify-between">
            <View className="flex-1 pr-2">
              <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide">
                {item.brand}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 mt-0.5" numberOfLines={2}>
                {item.name}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Size {item.size}</Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onWishlistToggle} className="p-1">
              <Ionicons
                name={item.isWishlisted ? 'heart' : 'heart-outline'}
                size={20}
                color={item.isWishlisted ? '#EF4444' : '#9CA3AF'}
              />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between mt-2">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
              <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900">${item.price}</Text>
              {hasDiscount && (
                <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 line-through">${item.originalPrice}</Text>
              )}
            </View>
            <View
              className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full"
              style={{ backgroundColor: STATUS_COLOR[item.stockStatus] + '20' }}
            >
              <Text
                className="text-[10px] font-extrabold"
                style={{ color: STATUS_COLOR[item.stockStatus] }}
              >
                {item.stockStatus}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Bottom row */}
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-3 py-2.5 border-t border-gray-100 gap-2">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5 flex-1">
          <Feather name="map-pin" size={11} color="#9CA3AF" />
          <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400" numberOfLines={1}>
            {item.storeName} · {item.storeDistance}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-300">{item.addedDaysAgo}d ago</Text>
        {isAvailable ? (
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onBuy} className="bg-green-500 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">
            <Text className="text-white text-xs font-extrabold">Buy</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={onNotify}
            className="border border-gray-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full flex-row items-center gap-1"
```

```typescript
  onChange: (tab: NotificationCategory) => void
}

  active,
  onChange,
}) => {
  return (
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 10, gap: 8 }}
    >

            key={label}
            onPress={() => onChange(label)}

              {label}
```

```typescript
// components/notificationSettings/SettingsSectionCard.tsx
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'
import {
  Feather,
  Ionicons,
  MaterialCommunityIcons,
  MaterialIcons,
} from '@expo/vector-icons'
import SettingsToggleItem from './SettingsToggleItem'
import type {
  NotificationSection,
  NotificationSetting,
} from '@/services/hooks/discover/useNotificationSettings'

// ─── Icon resolver ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const iconColor = (enabled: boolean) => (enabled ? '#374151' : '#9CA3AF')

const getIcon = (id: string, enabled: boolean): React.ReactNode => {
  const c = iconColor(enabled)
  switch (id) {
    case 'push_notifications':
      return <Feather name="bell" size={17} color={c} />
    case 'restock_alerts':
      return <MaterialCommunityIcons name="shoe-sneaker" size={17} color="#F97316" />
    case 'nearby_restock':
      return <Feather name="map-pin" size={17} color="#F97316" />
    case 'followed_store_restock':
      return <Feather name="heart" size={17} color="#EF4444" />
    case 'price_drop_alert':
      return <Feather name="tag" size={17} color="#F59E0B" />
    case 'order_status_updates':
      return <Ionicons name="bag-outline" size={17} color="#3B82F6" />
    case 'pickup_ready':
      return <MaterialIcons name="check-circle-outline" size={17} color="#22C55E" />
    case 'pickup_reminder':
      return <Feather name="clock" size={17} color="#F97316" />
    case 'order_cancelled':
      return <Feather name="x-circle" size={17} color="#EF4444" />
    case 'exclusive_drop_alerts':
      return <MaterialCommunityIcons name="fire" size={17} color="#F97316" />
    case 'release_reminders':
      return <Feather name="calendar" size={17} color="#8B5CF6" />
    case 'raffle_results':
      return <MaterialCommunityIcons name="ticket-outline" size={17} color="#6B7280" />
    case 'flash_sales':
      return <MaterialCommunityIcons name="lightning-bolt" size={17} color="#F59E0B" />
    case 'store_announcements':
      return <Feather name="speaker" size={17} color="#3B82F6" />
    case 'gosnkr_offers':
      return <Feather name="gift" size={17} color="#A855F7" />
    case 'quiet_hours':
      return <Feather name="moon" size={17} color="#6B7280" />
    default:
      return <Feather name="bell" size={17} color={c} />
  }
}

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface SettingsSectionCardProps {
  section: NotificationSection
  masterEnabled: boolean
  onToggle: (sectionId: string, itemId: string) => void
}

const SettingsSectionCard: React.FC<SettingsSectionCardProps> = ({
  section,
  masterEnabled,
  onToggle,
}) => {
  const isPushGlobal = section.id === 'global'

  return (
    <View className="mb-4">
      {/* Section title */}
      {section.title ? (
        <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest px-5 mb-2">
          {section.title}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      {/* Card */}
      <View
        className="bg-white mx-4 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          shadowColor: '#000',
          shadowOpacity: 0.05,
          shadowRadius: 8,
          elevation: 2,
        }}
      >
        {section.items.map((item: NotificationSetting, index: number) => (
          <SettingsToggleItem
            key={item.id}
            item={item}
            icon={getIcon(item.id, item.enabled)}
            onToggle={() => onToggle(section.id, item.id)}
            masterEnabled={isPushGlobal ? true : masterEnabled}
            isLast={index === section.items.length - 1}
          />
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

export default SettingsSectionCard
```

```typescript
// components/notificationSettings/SettingsToggleItem.tsx
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, Switch } from 'react-native'
import type { NotificationSetting } from '@/services/hooks/discover/useNotificationSettings'

interface SettingsToggleItemProps {
  item: NotificationSetting
  icon: React.ReactNode
  onToggle: () => void
  masterEnabled?: boolean   // when false, all non-master items are dimmed
  isLast?: boolean
}

const SettingsToggleItem: React.FC<SettingsToggleItemProps> = ({
  item,
  icon,
  onToggle,
  masterEnabled = true,
  isLast = false,
}) => {
  const dimmed = !masterEnabled

  return (
    <>
      <View className={`flex-row items-center px-4 py-3.5 gap-3.5 ${dimmed ? 'opacity-40' : ''}`}>
        {/* Icon bubble */}
        <View className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center">
          {icon}
        </View>

        {/* Text */}
        <View className="flex-1">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{item.label}</Text>
            {item.badge ? (
              <View
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: `${item.badgeColor}20` }}
              >
                <Text
                  className="text-[10px] font-semibold"
                  style={{ color: item.badgeColor }}
                >
                  {item.badge}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5" numberOfLines={2}>
            {item.description}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* Toggle */}
        <Switch
          value={item.enabled}
          onValueChange={onToggle}
          disabled={dimmed}
          trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#22C55E' }}
          thumbColor="#FFFFFF"
          ios_backgroundColor="#E5E7EB"
        />
      </View>

      {/* Divider (not after last item) */}
      {!isLast && <View className="h-px bg-gray-100 ml-16" />}
    </>
  )
}

export default SettingsToggleItem
```

```typescript
// components/map/MapSearchBar.tsx
import React from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  Text,
  FlatList,
} from "react-native";
import { Feather } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { Store } from "@/services/hooks/map/useMap";

const GREEN = "#22C55E";

interface MapSearchBarProps {
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (text: string) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  onFilterPress: () => void;
  onLocationPress: () => void;
  onSelectSuggestion: (store: Store) => void;  
  suggestions: Store[];                          // 👈 new
  activeFilterCount?: number;
  isFetchingLocation?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
}

const MapSearchBar = ({
  value,
  onChangeText,
  onClear,
  onFilterPress,
  onLocationPress,
  onSelectSuggestion,
  suggestions = [],
  activeFilterCount = 0,
  isFetchingLocation = false,
  placeholder = "Search stores, brands...",
}: MapSearchBarProps) => {
  const hasValue = value.length > 0;
  const hasFilters = activeFilterCount > 0;
  const showSuggestions = hasValue && suggestions.length > 0;

  return (
    <View>
      {/* Search bar row */}
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            flexDirection: "row",
            alignItems: "center",
            backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
            borderRadius: showSuggestions ? 14 : 14,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            height: 52,
            borderWidth: 1.5,
            borderColor: hasValue ? GREEN : hasFilters ? GREEN : "transparent",
            shadowColor: "#000",
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.08,
            shadowRadius: 8,
            elevation: 4,
          }}
        >
          <Feather
            name="search"
            size={18}
            color="#8A8A9A"
            style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
          />

          <TextInput
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              color: "#0F0F0F",
              fontSize: 15,
              fontWeight: "400",
              height: "100%",
            }}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            placeholderTextColor="#AFAFBF"
            value={value}
            onChangeText={onChangeText}
            returnKeyType="search"
            cursorColor={GREEN}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
          />

          {hasValue ? (
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={onClear}
              hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
            >
              <View
                style={{
                  width: 20,
                  height: 20,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  backgroundColor: "#C8C8D8",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                }}
              >
                <Feather name="x" size={12} color="#fff" />
              </View>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ) : (
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={onFilterPress}
              hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
              style={{ position: "relative" }}
            >
              <Feather
                name="sliders"
                size={18}
                color={hasFilters ? GREEN : "#8A8A9A"}
              />
              {hasFilters && (
                <View
                  style={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    top: -5,
                    right: -5,
                    width: 15,
                    height: 15,
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    backgroundColor: GREEN,
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 8, fontWeight: "700" }}>
                    {activeFilterCount > 9 ? "9+" : activeFilterCount}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Location button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onLocationPress}
          activeOpacity={0.8}
          style={{
            width: 52,
            height: 52,
            borderRadius: 14,
            backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            shadowColor: "#000",
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.08,
            shadowRadius: 8,
            elevation: 4,
          }}
        >
          {isFetchingLocation ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={GREEN} />
          ) : (
            <Feather name="navigation" size={20} color="#0F0F0F" />
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* ── Suggestions dropdown ── */}
      {showSuggestions && (
        <View
          style={{
            backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
            borderRadius: 14,
            marginTop: 8,
            // only the search bar width, not including location button
            marginRight: 62,
            shadowColor: "#000",
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.1,
            shadowRadius: 12,
            elevation: 8,
            overflow: "hidden",
          }}
        >
          <FlatList
            data={suggestions}
            keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            scrollEnabled={false}
            renderItem={({ item, index }) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => onSelectSuggestion(item)}
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  paddingHorizontal: 16,
                  paddingVertical: 12,
                  borderTopWidth: index === 0 ? 0 : 1,
                  borderTopColor: "#F0F0F5",
                  gap: 12,
                }}
              >
                {/* Icon */}
                <View
                  style={{
                    width: 34,
                    height: 34,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    backgroundColor: "#F5F5F7",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                  }}
                >
                  <Feather name="map-pin" size={15} color={GREEN} />
                </View>

                {/* Text */}
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: "#0F0F0F",
                      marginBottom: 2,
                    }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {item.name}
                  </Text>
                  <Text
                    style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#8A8A9A" }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {item.tag} · {item.distance}
                  </Text>
                </View>

                {/* Arrow */}
                <Feather name="arrow-up-left" size={16} color="#C8C8D8" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          />
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

export default MapSearchBar;
```

```typescript
import { Store } from "@/services/hooks/map/useMap";
import React from "react";
import { Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Marker } from "react-native-maps";

const GREEN = "#22C55E";

interface StoreMarkerProps {
    store: Store;
    isSelected: boolean;
    onPress: (store: Store) => void;
}

const StoreMarker = ({ store, isSelected, onPress }: StoreMarkerProps) => {
    return (
        <Marker
            coordinate={{ latitude: store.latitude, longitude: store.longitude }}
            onPress={() => onPress(store)}
            tracksViewChanges={false}
        >
            <View
                style={{
                    backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    borderWidth: isSelected ? 2 : 1,
                    borderColor: isSelected ? GREEN : "#E0E0EA",
                    shadowColor: "#000",
                    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
                    shadowOpacity: isSelected ? 0.15 : 0.08,
                    shadowRadius: 6,
                    elevation: isSelected ? 6 : 3,
                    alignItems: "flex-start",
                    minWidth: 120,
                }}
            >
                <Text
                    style={{
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: "700",
                        color: "#0F0F0F",
                        marginBottom: 3,
                    }}
                >
                    {store.name}
                </Text>
                <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 }}>
                    <View
                        style={{
                            width: 7,
                            height: 7,
                            borderRadius: 4,
                            backgroundColor: GREEN,
                        }}
                    />
                    <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#3A3A4A", fontWeight: "500" }}>
                        {store.stock} in stock
                    </Text>
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Tail / pointer */}
            <View
                style={{
                    alignSelf: "center",
                    width: 0,
                    height: 0,
                    borderLeftWidth: 6,
                    borderRightWidth: 6,
                    borderTopWidth: 7,
                    borderLeftColor: "transparent",
                    borderRightColor: "transparent",
                    borderTopColor: isSelected ? GREEN : "#E0E0EA",
                    marginTop: -1,
                }}
            />
        </Marker>
    );
};

export default StoreMarker;
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  Animated,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { LockerItem } from '@/types/locker'

interface ActionOption {
  icon: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap
  label: string
  color?: string
  onPress: () => void
}

interface ItemActionSheetProps {
  visible: boolean
  item: LockerItem | null
  onClose: () => void
  onEdit: (item: LockerItem) => void
  onDelete: (id: string) => void
  onShare: (item: LockerItem) => void
}

const ItemActionSheet: React.FC<ItemActionSheetProps> = ({
  visible,
  item,
  onClose,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onShare,
}) => {
  if (!item) return null

  const options: ActionOption[] = [
    {
      icon: 'edit-2',
      label: 'Edit Item',
      onPress: () => {
        onClose()
        onEdit(item)
      },
    },
    {
      icon: 'share-2',
      label: 'Share',
      onPress: () => {
        onClose()
        onShare(item)
      },
    },
    {
      icon: 'trash-2',
      label: 'Remove from Locker',
      color: '#EF4444',
      onPress: () => onDelete(item.id),
    },
  ]

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable
        className="flex-1 bg-black/40 justify-end"
        onPress={onClose}
      >
        <Pressable>
          <View className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl px-4 pt-4 pb-10">
            {/* Handle */}
            <View className="w-10 h-1 bg-gray-200 rounded-full self-center mb-5" />

            {/* Item name */}
            <Text className="text-base font-black text-gray-900 mb-4 px-1" numberOfLines={1}>
              {item.name}
            </Text>

            {/* Options */}
            <View className="gap-1">
              {options.map((opt, idx) => (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={idx}
                  onPress={opt.onPress}
                  className="flex-row items-center gap-4 px-3 py-4 rounded-2xl active:bg-gray-50"
                >
                  <View
                    className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full items-center justify-center"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: opt.color ? '#FEF2F2' : '#F3F4F6',
                    }}
                  >
                    <Feather
                      name={opt.icon}
                      size={18}
                      color={opt.color ?? '#374151'}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <Text
                    className="text-sm font-semibold"
                    style={{ color: opt.color ?? '#111827' }}
                  >
                    {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
            </View>

            {/* Cancel */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={onClose}
              className="mt-3 bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl py-4 items-center"
            >
              <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-500">Cancel</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  )
}

export default ItemActionSheet
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { LockerItemCardGrid, LockerItemCardList } from './LockerItemCard'
import type { LockerItem, ViewMode } from '@/types/locker'

// ─── View Toggle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface ViewToggleProps {
  viewMode: ViewMode
  onToggle: () => void
}

export const ViewToggle: React.FC<ViewToggleProps> = ({ viewMode, onToggle }) => (
  <View style={styles.toggleWrapper}>
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => viewMode !== 'grid' && onToggle()}
      style={[styles.toggleBtn, viewMode === 'grid' && styles.toggleBtnActive]}
    >
      <Feather name="grid" size={16} color={viewMode === 'grid' ? '#111827' : '#9CA3AF'} />
    </TouchableOpacity>

    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => viewMode !== 'list' && onToggle()}
      style={[styles.toggleBtn, viewMode === 'list' && styles.toggleBtnActive]}
    >
      <Feather name="list" size={16} color={viewMode === 'list' ? '#111827' : '#9CA3AF'} />
    </TouchableOpacity>
  </View>
)

// ─── Grid Container ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface LockerGridProps {
  items: LockerItem[]
  viewMode: ViewMode
  onMenuPress: (id: string) => void
}

const LockerGrid: React.FC<LockerGridProps> = ({ items, viewMode, onMenuPress }) => {
  if (viewMode === 'list') {
    return (
      <View style={styles.listContainer}>
        {items.map((item) => (
          <LockerItemCardList key={item.id} item={item} onMenuPress={onMenuPress} />
        ))}
      </View>
    )
  }

  // 2-column grid
  const rows: LockerItem[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 2) {
    rows.push(items.slice(i, i + 2))
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.gridContainer}>
      {rows.map((row, rowIdx) => (
        <View key={rowIdx} style={styles.gridRow}>
          {row.map((item) => (
            <LockerItemCardGrid key={item.id} item={item} onMenuPress={onMenuPress} />
          ))}
          {row.length === 1 && <View style={styles.gridSpacer} />}
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  )
}

export default LockerGrid

// ─── Styles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  toggleWrapper: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 4,
    backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6',
    padding: 4,
    borderRadius: 12,
  },
  toggleBtn: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    borderRadius: 8,
  },
  toggleBtnActive: {
    backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.08,
    shadowRadius: 2,
    elevation: 2,
  },

    marginTop: 8,
  },
  gridContainer: {
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    marginTop: 8,
  },
  gridRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: 12,
  },
  gridSpacer: {

  },
})
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, Image, TouchableOpacity, Dimensions, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import type { PublicLockerItem } from '@/types/lockerbrowser'

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window')
const COL_GAP = 3
const PADDING = 0
const COL_WIDTH = (width - PADDING * 2 - COL_GAP) / 2

// Alternate heights for masonry feel
const HEIGHTS = [160, 200, 175, 195, 165, 210, 180, 155]

interface PublicLockerGridProps {
  items: PublicLockerItem[]
  onItemPress?: (item: PublicLockerItem) => void
}

const PublicLockerGrid: React.FC<PublicLockerGridProps> = ({ items, onItemPress }) => {
  // Split into two columns
  const leftCol: PublicLockerItem[] = []
  const rightCol: PublicLockerItem[] = []
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (i % 2 === 0) leftCol.push(item)
    else rightCol.push(item)
  })

  const renderItem = (item: PublicLockerItem, colIndex: number, rowIndex: number) => {
    const height = HEIGHTS[(colIndex * 4 + rowIndex) % HEIGHTS.length]
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        key={item.id}
        onPress={() => onItemPress?.(item)}
        activeOpacity={0.9}
        style={[styles.item, { height }]}
      >
        <Image
          source={{ uri: item.image }}
          style={styles.image}
          resizeMode="cover"
        />
        {/* For Sale badge */}
        {item.isForSale && (
          <View style={styles.saleBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.saleBadgeText}>For Sale</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    )
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Left column */}
      <View style={styles.column}>
        {leftCol.map((item, i) => renderItem(item, 0, i))}
      </View>
      {/* Right column */}
      <View style={[styles.column, { marginLeft: COL_GAP }]}>
        {rightCol.map((item, i) => renderItem(item, 1, i))}
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

export default PublicLockerGrid

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    paddingBottom: 100,
  },
  column: {
    width: COL_WIDTH,
  },
  item: {
    width: COL_WIDTH,
    marginBottom: COL_GAP,
    overflow: 'hidden',
    position: 'relative',
  },
  image: {
    width: '100%',
    height: '100%',
  },
  saleBadge: {
    position: 'absolute',
    top: 10,
    left: 10,
    backgroundColor: '#22C55E',
    paddingHorizontal: 8,
    paddingVertical: 3,
    borderRadius: 6,
  },
  saleBadgeText: {
    fontSize: 10,
    fontWeight: '800',
    color: '#fff',
  },
})
```

```typescript
interface OrderFilterTabsProps {
  active: OrderFilter
  onChange: (filter: OrderFilter) => void
}

const OrderFilterTabs: React.FC<OrderFilterTabsProps> = ({ active, onChange }) => {

    <View className="border-b border-gray-100 bg-white">
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 16 }}
      >
        {TABS.map(tab => {
          const isActive = tab === active
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={tab}
              onPress={() => onChange(tab)}
              className="mr-6 py-3"
            >
              <Text
                className={`text-sm font-semibold ${
                  isActive ? 'text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-400'
                }`}
              >
                {tab}
              </Text>
              {/* Active underline */}
              {isActive && (
                <View className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-green-500 rounded-full" />
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )
        })}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  )
}

export default OrderFilterTabs
```
