## File: components/profile/orders/QRTimer.tsx
```typescript
// components/store/QRTimer.tsx
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'
import Svg, { Circle } from 'react-native-svg'

interface Props {
  display: string
  progress: number
}

const SIZE   = 72
const STROKE = 4
const RADIUS = (SIZE - STROKE) / 2
const CIRCUM = 2 * Math.PI * RADIUS

const QRTimer: React.FC<Props> = ({ display, progress }) => {
  // Calculate strokeDashoffset as a plain number — no shared values
  const strokeDashoffset = CIRCUM * (1 - progress)

  return (
    <View style={{ width: SIZE, height: SIZE }}>
      <Svg width={SIZE} height={SIZE}>
        {/* Track circle */}
        <Circle
          cx={SIZE / 2}
          cy={SIZE / 2}
          r={RADIUS}
          stroke="#333"
          strokeWidth={STROKE}
          fill="none"
        />
        {/* Progress circle */}
        <Circle
          cx={SIZE / 2}
          cy={SIZE / 2}
          r={RADIUS}
          stroke="#22C55E"
          strokeWidth={STROKE}
          fill="none"
          strokeDasharray={CIRCUM}
          strokeDashoffset={strokeDashoffset}
          strokeLinecap="round"
          rotation="-90"
          origin={`${SIZE / 2}, ${SIZE / 2}`}
        />
      </Svg>

      {/* Centered text */}
      <View
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '800' }}>
          {display}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

export default QRTimer
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import type { TierLevel, VipTier } from '@/types/vip'

interface VipJourneyProps {
  tiers: TierLevel[]
  currentTier: VipTier
}

const VipJourney: React.FC<VipJourneyProps> = ({ tiers, currentTier }) => {
  const currentIndex = tiers.findIndex((t) => t.tier === currentTier)

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Your Journey</Text>

      <View style={styles.row}>
        {tiers.map((tier, idx) => {
          const isActive = tier.tier === currentTier
          const isPast = idx < currentIndex
          const isLast = idx === tiers.length - 1

          return (
            <React.Fragment key={tier.tier}>
              {/* Tier node */}
              <View style={styles.tierNode}>
                <View style={[
                  styles.circle,
                  isActive && { borderColor: tier.color, backgroundColor: tier.color + '22' },
                  isPast  && { borderColor: tier.color, backgroundColor: tier.color + '44' },
                  !isActive && !isPast && styles.circleInactive,
                ]}>
                  <Text style={styles.emoji}>{tier.emoji}</Text>
                </View>
                <Text style={[
                  styles.tierLabel,
                  isActive && { color: tier.color },
                  isPast   && { color: tier.color + 'AA' },
                  !isActive && !isPast && styles.tierLabelInactive,
                ]}>
                  {tier.tier}
                </Text>
              </View>

              {/* Connector line */}
              {!isLast && (
                <View style={[
                  styles.line,
                  isPast && styles.lineActive,
                ]} />
              )}
            </React.Fragment>
          )
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

export default VipJourney

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
```

```typescript
// components/profile/waitlist/FilterTabs.tsx
import React from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
} from 'react-native'
import { FilterTab } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useWantedPairs'

interface FilterTabsProps {
  activeTab: FilterTab
  onTabChange: (tab: FilterTab) => void
  availableCount: number
}

const TABS: FilterTab[] = ['All', 'Available Now', 'Still Watching', 'Alerts On']

export const FilterTabs: React.FC<FilterTabsProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  availableCount,
}) => {
  return (
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      style={styles.container}
      contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
    >
      {TABS.map(tab => {
        const isActive = activeTab === tab
        const showCheck = tab === 'Available Now'
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={tab}
            style={[styles.tab, isActive && styles.tabActive]}
            onPress={() => onTabChange(tab)}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.tabText, isActive && styles.tabTextActive]}>
              {tab === 'All' ? `All (${availableCount})` : showCheck ? `${tab} ✓` : tab}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )
      })}
    </ScrollView>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flexGrow: 0,
    marginBottom: 16,
  },
  content: {
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    gap: 8,
    flexDirection: 'row',
  },
  tab: {
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 7,
    borderRadius: 20,
    backgroundColor: '#f0f0f0',
  },
  tabActive: {
    backgroundColor: '#1a1a1a',
  },
  tabText: {
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: '#666',
  },
  tabTextActive: {
    color: '#fff',
  },
})
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'

  View,

import { WantedPair, SneakerAlert } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useWantedPairs'

// ─── Alert Dot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const AlertDot: React.FC<{ active: boolean }> = ({ active }) => (
  <View style={[styles.dot, active ? styles.dotActive : styles.dotInactive]} />
)

// ─── Alert Icon Row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AlertIconRowProps {
  alerts: SneakerAlert
  onToggle: (key: keyof SneakerAlert) => void
  onManageAlerts: () => void
}

const AlertIconRow: React.FC<AlertIconRowProps> = ({ alerts, onToggle, onManageAlerts }) => {
  const items: { key: keyof SneakerAlert; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
    { key: 'inSize',  label: 'In Size', icon: '👟' },
    { key: 'nearby',  label: 'Nearby',  icon: '📍' },
    { key: 'stores',  label: 'Stores',  icon: '🏪' },
    { key: 'price',   label: 'Price',   icon: '💰' },
  ]

  return (
    <View style={styles.alertRow}>
      <View style={styles.alertIcons}>
        {items.map(item => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={item.key}
            style={styles.alertItem}
            onPress={() => onToggle(item.key)}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
          >
            <Text style={styles.alertIcon}>{item.icon}</Text>
            <Text style={styles.alertLabel}>{item.label}</Text>
            <AlertDot active={alerts[item.key]} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </View>
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={onManageAlerts} activeOpacity={0.7}>
        <Text style={styles.manageText}>Tap to manage alerts →</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  )
}

// ─── SneakerCard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface SneakerCardProps {
  pair: WantedPair
  /** Tap anywhere on the card row (image + info) */
  onPress: (pair: WantedPair) => void
  /**
   * Tap the green "Available Now · X stores near you" banner.
   * When NOT provided, the banner falls back to onPress.
   */
  onAvailableNowPress?: (pair: WantedPair) => void
  onToggleAlert: (pairId: string, key: keyof SneakerAlert) => void
  onManageAlerts: (pair: WantedPair) => void
}

export const SneakerCard: React.FC<SneakerCardProps> = ({
  pair,
  onPress,
  onAvailableNowPress,
  onToggleAlert,
  onManageAlerts,
}) => {
  const isAvailable = pair.status === 'available'

  // "Available Now" banner handler — uses dedicated prop if provided, else generic onPress
  const handleAvailableBannerPress = () => {
    if (onAvailableNowPress) {
      onAvailableNowPress(pair)
    } else {
      onPress(pair)
    }
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.card}>
      {/* Top row: thumbnail + info */}
      <TouchableOpacity
        style={styles.cardTop}
        onPress={() => onPress(pair)}
        activeOpacity={0.85}
      >
        {/* Thumbnail */}
        <View style={styles.thumbnail}>
          <View style={styles.sizeBadge}>
            <Text style={styles.sizeBadgeText}>Sz {pair.size}</Text>
          </View>
          {pair.imageUrl ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: pair.imageUrl }}
              style={styles.sneakerImage}
              resizeMode="cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.sneakerImagePlaceholder}>
              <Text style={styles.placeholderEmoji}>👟</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Info */}
        <View style={styles.cardInfo}>
          <Text style={styles.brandText}>{pair.brand}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.nameText}>{pair.name}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.addedText}>Added to Wanted on {pair.addedOn}</Text>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {/* Status Banner */}
      {isAvailable ? (
        /**
         * ✅ Tapping the green "Available Now" banner navigates to JoinWaitlistScreen
         * via the onAvailableNowPress prop passed from WantedPairsScreen.
         */
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.availableBanner}
          onPress={handleAvailableBannerPress}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
        >
          <Text style={styles.availableBannerText}>
            ✓ Available Now · {pair.storesNearby} stores near you
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.watchingBanner}>
          <Text style={styles.watchingText}>🔔 Not in stock near you · Watching...</Text>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Alert Icon Row */}
      <AlertIconRow
        alerts={pair.alerts}
        onToggle={key => onToggleAlert(pair.id, key)}
        onManageAlerts={() => onManageAlerts(pair)}
      />
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// components/profile/waitlist/StorePickerModal.tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Text,
  Modal,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ScrollView,
  TextInput,
  StyleSheet,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native'
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

export interface Store {
  id: string
  name: string
  address: string
  distance: string
  hasStock?: boolean
}

const MOCK_STORES: Store[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Nike Factory Store - Downtown', address: '123 Main St', distance: '0.8 mi' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Foot Locker - Westfield Mall', address: '456 Mall Dr, Unit 12', distance: '1.4 mi' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Champs Sports - Northgate', address: '789 Northgate Blvd', distance: '2.1 mi' },
  { id: '4', name: 'JD Sports - City Center', address: '321 5th Ave', distance: '2.6 mi' },
  { id: '5', name: "Dick's Sporting Goods", address: '555 Commerce Way', distance: '3.2 mi' },
  { id: '6', name: 'Finish Line - Eastgate', address: '888 Eastgate Rd', distance: '4.0 mi' },
  { id: '7', name: 'Sneaker Villa - Uptown', address: '12 Uptown Plaza', distance: '4.7 mi' },
  { id: '8', name: 'Extra Butter', address: '60 Orchard St', distance: '5.1 mi' },
]

interface StorePickerModalProps {
  visible: boolean
  selectedStores: string[]
  onConfirm: (selectedIds: string[]) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

export const StorePickerModal: React.FC<StorePickerModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  selectedStores,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(selectedStores))

  const filtered = MOCK_STORES.filter(
    s =>
      s.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      s.address.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  )

  const toggle = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelected(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id)
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    onConfirm(Array.from(selected))
    onClose()
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      animationType="slide"
      presentationStyle="pageSheet"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <BaseContainer  backgroundColor="#fff">
        <View style={styles.inner}>
          {/* Handle bar */}
          <View style={styles.handleBar} />

          {/* Header */}
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onClose} style={styles.closeBtn}>
              <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color="#1a1a1a" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Choose Stores</Text>
            <View style={styles.closeBtn} />
          </View>

          {/* Subtitle */}
          <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
            Select stores you want us to monitor. We'll alert you the moment your size is back.
          </Text>

          {/* Search */}
          <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
            <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={16} color="#9ca3af" />
            <TextInput
              style={styles.searchInput}
              placeholder="Search stores..."
              placeholderTextColor="#9ca3af"
              value={search}
              onChangeText={setSearch}
              returnKeyType="search"
            />
            {search.length > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearch('')}>
                <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color="#9ca3af" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Selection bar */}
          {selected.size > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.selectionBar}>
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-done-circle" size={15} color="#22c55e" />
              <Text style={styles.selectionText}>
                {selected.size} store{selected.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSelected(new Set())}>
                <Text style={styles.clearText}>Clear all</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Store list — own ScrollView, not nested inside another */}
          <ScrollView
            style={styles.scroll}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          >
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <View style={styles.empty}>
                <Ionicons name="storefront-outline" size={36} color="#d1d5db" />
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No stores found</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              filtered.map(item => {
                const isSelected = selected.has(item.id)
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={item.id}
                    style={[styles.storeRow, isSelected && styles.storeRowSelected]}
                    onPress={() => toggle(item.id)}
                    activeOpacity={0.75}
                  >
                    <View style={styles.storeInfo}>
                      <Text style={[styles.storeName, isSelected && styles.storeNameSelected]}>
                        {item.name}
                      </Text>
                      <Text style={styles.storeAddress}>{item.address}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={styles.storeRight}>
                      <Text style={styles.storeDistance}>{item.distance}</Text>
                      <View style={[styles.checkbox, isSelected && styles.checkboxSelected]}>
                        {isSelected && <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={13} color="#fff" />}
                      </View>
                    </View>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )
              })
            )}
          </ScrollView>

          {/* CTA — pinned outside ScrollView */}
          <View style={styles.footer}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.confirmBtn, selected.size === 0 && styles.confirmBtnDisabled]}
              onPress={handleConfirm}
              disabled={selected.size === 0}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Ionicons name="notifications" size={18} color={selected.size === 0 ? '#9ca3af' : '#fff'} />
              <Text style={[styles.confirmText, selected.size === 0 && styles.confirmTextDisabled]}>
                {selected.size === 0
                  ? 'Select at least one store'
                  : `Monitor ${selected.size} Store${selected.size > 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </BaseContainer>
    </Modal>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  inner: {
    flex: 1,
    paddingTop:10,
  },
  handleBar: {
    width: 40,
    height: 4,

  },
```

```typescript
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import type { FilterTab } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useWishlist'

interface WishlistFilterTabsProps {
  activeFilter: FilterTab
  filterCounts: Record<FilterTab, number>
  onSelect: (tab: FilterTab) => void
}

const TABS: FilterTab[] = ['All', 'In Stock', 'Low Stock', 'Sold Out']

export default function WishlistFilterTabs({
  activeFilter,
  filterCounts,
  onSelect,
}: WishlistFilterTabsProps) {
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-gray-100">
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, gap: 8, paddingVertical: 10 }}
      >
        {TABS.map(tab => {
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab
          const label = tab === 'All' ? `All (${filterCounts.All})` : tab

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={tab}
              onPress={() => onSelect(tab)}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              className={`px-4 py-[7px] rounded-full border ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-900'
                  : 'bg-white border-gray-200'
              }`}
            >
              <Text
                className={`text-[13px] font-semibold ${
                  isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500'
                }`}
              >
                {label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )
        })}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { router } from 'expo-router'

interface WishlistHeaderProps {
  activeFilterCount: number
  onBack?: () => void
  onFilterOpen: () => void
}

export default function WishlistHeader({
  activeFilterCount,
  onBack,
  onFilterOpen,
}: WishlistHeaderProps) {
  const handleBack = onBack ?? (() => router.back())

  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-5 pt-4 pb-2 bg-white">
      {/* ── Back ── */}
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleBack} activeOpacity={0.7} className="p-1 -ml-1">
        <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={24} color="#111827" />
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {/* ── Title ── */}
      <Text className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">Wishlist</Text>

      {/* ── Filter icon with active badge ── */}
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={onFilterOpen}
        hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
        className="relative p-1"
      >
        <Feather name="filter" size={20} color="#374151" />
        {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
          <View className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full items-center justify-center">
            <Text className="text-white text-[9px] font-bold">
              {activeFilterCount}
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
  <View className="mb-4 shadow-lg" style={{ shadowColor: tierColor, shadowOpacity: 0.15, shadowRadius: 15, elevation: 5 }}>
    <LinearGradient
      // Approximating your 135deg gradient with the simplified yellow palette
      colors={['#FEF9C3', '#FFFBEB']}
      start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
      end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
      className="rounded-3xl px-5 py-6 border border-white/50"
    >
      {/* Top row - Scaled Up */}
      <View className="flex-row justify-between items-center mb-2">
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
          <View className="bg-white/40 p-1.5 rounded-lg">
            <MaterialCommunityIcons name="trophy" size={22} color={tierColor} />
          </View>
          <Text className="text-lg font-black tracking-tight" style={{ color: tierColor }}>
            {memberTier} Member
          </Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity 
          onPress={onViewBenefits} 
          className="flex-row items-center gap-1 bg-white/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full"
        >
          <Text className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: tierColor }}>
            Benefits
          </Text>
          <Feather name="chevron-right" size={14} color={tierColor} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Subtitle - More readable */}
      <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600/80 mb-5 ml-1">
        {(pointsToNextTier - points).toLocaleString()} points to reach {nextTier}
      </Text>

      {/* Progress bar - Thicker (h-3) */}
      <View className="h-3 bg-white/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-2 shadow-inner">
        <View
          className="h-full rounded-full"
          style={{
            width: `${Math.min(pointsProgress * 100, 100)}%`,
            backgroundColor: tierColor,
          }}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Points label - Larger font */}
      <View className="flex-row justify-between items-center px-1">
        <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Progress</Text>
        <Text className="text-xs font-black" style={{ color: tierColor }}>
          {points.toLocaleString()} <Text className="text-gray-400">/ {pointsToNextTier.toLocaleString()}</Text>
        </Text>
      </View>
    </LinearGradient>
  </View>
)

export default MembershipCard
```

```typescript
      <StatCard 
        value={following} 
        label="Following"

        iconName="star" 
      />
      <StatCard 
        value={newDrops} 
        label="New Drops" 
        colors={['#F59E0B', '#D97706']} 
        iconName="zap" 
      />
    </View>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  value,
  label,
  colors,
  iconName,
}: {
  value: number;
  label: string;
  colors: [string, string, ...string[]];

}) {

      colors={colors}

      <View>

  );
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';

const ProductSizeTable = ({ sizes, onUpdateQty, onRemove, onAddSize }: any) => (
  <View style={styles.card}>
    <View style={styles.headerRow}>
      <Text style={[styles.headerText, styles.sizeCol]}>Size</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.headerText, styles.qtyCol]}>Qty</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.headerText, styles.priceCol]}>Price</Text>
      <View style={styles.deleteCol} />
    </View>
    {sizes.map((item: any, index: number) => (
      <View key={index} style={styles.row}>
        <Text style={[styles.sizeText, styles.sizeCol]}>{item.size}</Text>

        <View style={[styles.qtyContainer, styles.qtyCol]}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onUpdateQty(index, -1)} style={styles.qtyBtn}>
            <Feather name="minus" size={14} color="#111" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={styles.qtyVal}>{item.qty}</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onUpdateQty(index, 1)} style={styles.qtyBtn}>
            <Feather name="plus" size={14} color="#111" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <Text style={[styles.priceText, styles.priceCol]}>${item.price}</Text>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.deleteCol}
          onPress={() => onRemove?.(index)}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import Svg, { Polyline } from 'react-native-svg';

// ── Sparkline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface SparklineProps {
  data: number[];
  color?: string;
}

const Sparkline: React.FC<SparklineProps> = ({ data, color = '#00C853' }) => {
  const w = 80, h = 36;
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const pts = data
    .map((v, i) => {
      const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * w;
      const y = h - ((v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * h;
      return `${x},${y}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
  return (
    <Svg width={w} height={h}>
      <Polyline points={pts} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </Svg>
  );
};

// ── Revenue Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface AnalyticsRevenueCardProps {
  totalRevenue: string;
  revenueChange: string;
  revenueChangePercent: string;
  sparklineData: number[];
}

const AnalyticsRevenueCard: React.FC<AnalyticsRevenueCardProps> = ({
  totalRevenue,

        </View>
      </View>
      <Text style={s.amount}>{totalRevenue}</Text>
      <View style={s.changeRow}>
        <Feather name="arrow-up-right" size={12} color="#00C853" />
        <Text style={s.changeText}>{revenueChange}</Text>
      </View>
    </View>
    <Sparkline data={sparklineData} color="#00C853" />
  </View>
);
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, Dimensions } from 'react-native';
import Svg, { Rect, Text as SvgText, G } from 'react-native-svg';
import { ChartMode } from '@/types/analytics';

const { width: SCREEN_WIDTH } = Dimensions.get('window');

// ── Bar Chart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface BarChartProps {
  data: number[];
  labels: string[];
  valuePrefix?: string;
}

const BarChart: React.FC<BarChartProps> = ({ data, labels, valuePrefix = '$' }) => {
  const chartW = SCREEN_WIDTH - 64;
  const chartH = 110;

  if (!data || data.length === 0) return null;

  const gap = chartW / data.length;
  const barW = gap * 0.55;
  const max = Math.max(...data) || 1;

  return (
    <Svg width={chartW} height={chartH + 46}>
      {data.map((v, i) => {
        const barH = (v / max) * chartH;
        const x = i * gap + (gap - barW) / 2;
        const y = chartH - barH + 20;

        return (
          <G key={`bar-${i}`}>
            <SvgText
              x={x + barW / 2}
              y={y - 6}
              fontSize="11"
              fontWeight="700"
              fill="#111"
              textAnchor="middle"
            >
              {valuePrefix}{v}
            </SvgText>
            <Rect
              x={x}
              y={y}
              width={barW}
              height={barH}
              rx={6}
              fill="#00C853"
            />
            <SvgText
              x={x + barW / 2}
              y={chartH + 40}
              fontSize="11"
              fontWeight="600"
              fill="#9CA3AF"
              textAnchor="middle"
            >
              {labels[i]}
            </SvgText>
          </G>
        );
      })}
    </Svg>
  );
};

// ── Sales by Day Section ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface AnalyticsRevenueChartProps {
  chartMode: ChartMode;
  barData: number[];
  barLabels: string[];
  onChartModeChange: (mode: ChartMode) => void;
}

const CHART_MODES: ChartMode[] = ['Sales', 'Orders'];

const AnalyticsRevenueChart: React.FC<AnalyticsRevenueChartProps> = ({
  chartMode,
  barData,
  barLabels,
  onChartModeChange,
}) => (
  <View style={s.section}>
    <View style={s.sectionHeader}>
      <Text style={s.sectionTitle}>Sales by Day</Text>
      <View style={s.toggleRow}>
        {CHART_MODES.map(m => (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={m}
            onPress={() => onChartModeChange(m)}
            style={[s.toggleBtn, chartMode === m && s.toggleBtnActive]}
          >
            <Text style={[s.toggleText, chartMode === m && s.toggleTextActive]}>{m}</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
    <View style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
      <BarChart
        data={barData}
        labels={barLabels}
        valuePrefix={chartMode === 'Sales' ? '$' : ''}
      />
    </View>
  </View>
);

const s = StyleSheet.create({
  section: {
    backgroundColor: '#fff', borderRadius: 14, padding: 16,
    marginBottom: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#F3F4F6',
  },
  sectionHeader: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' },
  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800', color: '#111' },
  toggleRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row', backgroundColor: '#111',
    borderRadius: 8, padding: 2,
  },
  toggleBtn: { paddingHorizontal: 12, paddingVertical: 5, borderRadius: 6 },
  toggleBtnActive: { backgroundColor: '#fff' },
  toggleText: { fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '600', color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)' },
  toggleTextActive: { color: '#111' },
});
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
```

```typescript
interface AnalyticsStatCardsProps {
  orders: number;
  ordersChange: string;
  grossProfit: string;
  grossProfitMargin: string;
  grossProfitChange: string;
  avgOrder: string;
  avgOrderChange: string;
  pickupRate: string;
  pickupRateChange: string;
}

const AnalyticsStatCards: React.FC<AnalyticsStatCardsProps> = ({
  orders,
  ordersChange,
  grossProfit,
  grossProfitMargin,
  grossProfitChange,
  avgOrder,
  avgOrderChange,
  pickupRate,
  pickupRateChange,
}) => {

  const StatCard = ({ icon, label, value, change, isPositive = true, subValue, isLast = false }: any) => (
    <View style={[s.card, !isLast && { marginRight: 8 }]}>
      <View style={s.labelRow}>
        <Feather name={icon} size={13} color="#9CA3AF" />
        <Text style={s.label}>{label}</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.changeRow}>

        ) : null}
        <Text style={[s.changeText, { color: isPositive ? '#00C853' : '#9CA3AF' }]}>
          {change}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>

  return (
    <View style={s.container}>
      <View style={s.row}>

          value={orders}
          change={ordersChange}
        />

          value={pickupRate}
          change={pickupRateChange}
          isPositive={pickupRateChange !== 'No change'}
          isLast
        />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};
```

```typescript
const getTypeStyles = (type: string) => {

        case 'refund': return { bg: '#FFF5F5', border: '#FEB2B2', icon: 'arrow-left', iconBg: '#FED7D7', iconCol: '#C53030' };
        case 'alert': return { bg: '#FFFBEB', border: '#FDE68A', icon: 'alert-triangle', iconBg: 'transparent', iconCol: '#D97706' };

    }
};

        if (item.type === 'refund') {
            router.push({
                pathname: '/screens/retailer/refund/refundClaimsScreen',
                params: {
                    id: item.id,
                    title: item.title,
                    description: item.description,
                },
            });
        }
    };

    return (
        <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.8} onPress={handlePress}>
            <View style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: styles.bg, borderColor: styles.border }]}>
                <View style={s.header}>

                    <View style={s.content}>

                            <Text style={s.time}>{item.time}</Text>
                        </View>

                        <Text style={s.desc}>{item.description}</Text>

                        {item.deadline && (

                                    <Text style={s.btnTextSec}>Mark Ready</Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>

                    </View>

            </View>
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView } from 'react-native';
import { FilterTab } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/inventory/useInventory';

interface InventoryFilterProps {
  tabs: FilterTab[];
  active: FilterTab;
  counts: Record<FilterTab, number>;
  onChange: (tab: FilterTab) => void;
}

const InventoryFilter: React.FC<InventoryFilterProps> = ({
  tabs, active, counts, onChange,
}) => {
  return (
    <View style={{
      backgroundColor: '#fff',
      borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#F3F4F6',
    }}>
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 10, gap: 8,
        }}
      >
        {tabs.map(tab => {
          const isActive = tab === active;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={tab}
              onPress={() => onChange(tab)}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              style={{
                backgroundColor: isActive ? '#00C853' : '#F3F4F6',
                borderRadius: 20,
                paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 8,
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: '700',
                color: isActive ? '#fff' : '#374151',
              }}>
                {tab} ({counts[tab]})
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
};

export default InventoryFilter;
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import {
    View,
    Text,
    Image,
    TouchableOpacity,
    StyleSheet,
} from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Order, OrderStatus } from '@/types/Orders';

interface OrderCardProps {
    order: Order;
    onConfirmOrder: (orderId: string) => void;
    onMarkReady: (orderId: string) => void;
    onMarkPickedUp: (orderId: string) => void;
    onViewDetails: (orderId: string) => void;
    onViewHoldDetails: (orderId: string) => void;
}

const TAG_STYLE: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string }> = {
    'BUY NOW': { bg: '#EDE7F6', color: '#4A148C' },
    'DETAILS': { bg: '#EDE7F6', color: '#4A148C' },
    'PICKUP':  { bg: '#EDE7F6', color: '#4A148C' },
};

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<OrderStatus, { label: string; bg: string; color: string }> = {
    new:       { label: 'Paid',          bg: '#E8F5E9', color: '#2E7D32' },
    holding:   { label: 'Hold',          bg: '#FFF3E0', color: '#E65100' },
    ready:     { label: 'Pickup Ready',  bg: '#E3F2FD', color: '#1565C0' },
    completed: { label: 'Completed',     bg: '#F3F3F3', color: '#555555' },
    cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled',     bg: '#FFEBEE', color: '#B71C1C' },
};

type ActionConfig = {
    label: string;
    bg: string;
    icon?: keyof typeof Feather.glyphMap;
    onPress: () => void;
};

const getPrimaryAction = (
    status: OrderStatus,
    id: string,
    onConfirm: (id: string) => void,
    onReady: (id: string) => void,
    onPickup: (id: string) => void,
): ActionConfig | null => {
    switch (status) {
        case 'new':     return { label: 'Accept & Prepare', bg: '#1B5E20', onPress: () => onConfirm(id) };
        case 'holding': return { label: 'Mark Ready',        bg: '#111111', onPress: () => onReady(id)   };
        case 'ready':   return { label: 'Verify Pickup',     bg: '#1565C0', icon: 'grid', onPress: () => onPickup(id) };
        default:        return null;
    }
};

const getSecondaryLabel = (status: OrderStatus): string => {
    if (status === 'holding') return 'Hold Details';
    if (status === 'ready') return 'Details';
    return 'Order Details';
};

const OrderCard: React.FC<OrderCardProps> = ({
    order,
    onConfirmOrder,
    onMarkReady,
    onMarkPickedUp,
    onViewDetails,
    onViewHoldDetails,
}) => {
    const tagCfg         = TAG_STYLE[order.tag] ?? TAG_STYLE['BUY NOW'];
    const statusCfg      = STATUS_CONFIG[order.status];
    const primary        = getPrimaryAction(order.status, order.id, onConfirmOrder, onMarkReady, onMarkPickedUp);
    const secondaryLabel = getSecondaryLabel(order.status);
    const isCompleted    = order.status === 'completed';
    const isCancelled    = order.status === 'cancelled';
    const showActions    = !isCompleted && !isCancelled;

    const onSecondaryPress = order.status === 'holding'
        ? () => onViewHoldDetails(order.id)
        : () => onViewDetails(order.id);

    return (
        <View style={styles.card}>

            {/* ── Row 1: tag + status pill + urgency/time ── */}
            <View style={styles.topRow}>
                <View style={styles.topLeft}>
                    <View style={[styles.tagBadge, { backgroundColor: tagCfg.bg }]}>
                        <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: tagCfg.color }]}>{order.tag}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={[styles.statusPill, { backgroundColor: statusCfg.bg }]}>
                        <Text style={[styles.statusText, { color: statusCfg.color }]}>
                            {statusCfg.label}
                        </Text>
                    </View>
                </View>

                {order.status === 'new' && order.confirmWithinMinutes != null ? (
                    <View style={styles.urgencyPill}>
                        <Feather name="clock" size={10} color="#EA580C" />
                        <Text style={styles.urgencyText}>Confirm in {order.confirmWithinMinutes} min</Text>
                    </View>
                ) : (
                    <Text style={styles.timeText}>{order.timeAgo}</Text>
                )}
            </View>

            {/* ── Row 2: image + product info ── */}
            <View style={styles.productRow}>
                <View style={styles.imgWrapper}>
                    {order.imageUrl ? (
                        <Image
                            source={{ uri: order.imageUrl }}
                            style={styles.productImg}
                            resizeMode="cover"
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <View style={styles.imgPlaceholder} />
                    )}
                </View>
                <View style={styles.productInfo}>
                    <Text style={styles.productName} numberOfLines={1}>{order.productName}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.productMeta}>Size {order.size} · {order.gender}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.customerName}>{order.customerName} · Order #{order.orderNumber}</Text>
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* ── Inventory reserved (new only) ── */}
            {order.status === 'new' && order.inventoryReserved ? (
                <Text style={styles.reservedText}>Inventory reserved</Text>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Expiry row (holding only) ── */}
            {order.status === 'holding' && order.expiresIn ? (
                <View style={styles.expiryRow}>
                    <View style={[styles.expiryDot, { backgroundColor: '#FF9800' }]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.expiryText, { color: '#FF9800' }]}>
                        Expires in {order.expiresIn}
                    </Text>
                </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Ready-since row (ready only) ── */}
            {order.status === 'ready' && order.readySince ? (
                <View style={styles.expiryRow}>
                    <View style={[styles.expiryDot, { backgroundColor: '#00C853' }]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.expiryText, { color: '#00C853' }]}>
                        Ready since {order.readySince}
                    </Text>
                </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Customer notified + waiting (ready only) ── */}
            {order.status === 'ready' && order.customerNotified ? (
                <Text style={styles.customerNotif}>
                    Customer notified{order.waitingSince ? ` · Waiting ${order.waitingSince}` : ''}
                </Text>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Price row (deposit-aware for holds) ── */}
            {order.status === 'holding' && order.depositPaid ? (
                <Text style={styles.price}>
                    ${order.price} total <Text style={styles.priceSub}>· ${order.depositAmount} deposit</Text>
                </Text>
            ) : (
                <Text style={styles.price}>${order.price}</Text>
            )}

            {/* ── Completed footer ── */}
            {isCompleted && order.completedDate ? (
                <View style={styles.footerRow}>
                    <View style={styles.checkCircle}>
                        <Text style={styles.checkMark}>✓</Text>
                    </View>
                    <Text style={styles.completedText}>
                        Completed {order.completedDate} · ${order.price}
                    </Text>
                </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Cancelled footer ── */}
            {isCancelled && order.cancelledDate ? (
                <View style={styles.footerRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.cancelledText}>
                        Cancelled by {order.cancelledBy ?? 'customer'} · {order.cancelledDate}
                    </Text>
                </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* ── Action buttons (new / holding / ready only) ── */}
            {showActions ? (
                <>
                    <View style={styles.divider} />
                    <View style={styles.actionRow}>
                        {primary ? (
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={[styles.primaryBtn, { backgroundColor: primary.bg }]}
                                onPress={primary.onPress}
                                activeOpacity={0.85}
                            >
                                {primary.icon ? (
                                    <Feather name={primary.icon} size={14} color="#fff" style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                                ) : null}
                                <Text style={styles.primaryBtnText}>{primary.label}</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        ) : null}
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            style={styles.secondaryBtn}
                            onPress={onSecondaryPress}
                            activeOpacity={0.7}
                        >
                            <Text style={styles.secondaryBtnText}>{secondaryLabel}</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                </>
            ) : null}

        </View>
    );
};
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, RefreshControl, StyleSheet, View, Text } from 'react-native';
import OrderCard from './OrderCard';
import RecentActivity from './RecentActivity';
import { Order } from '@/types/Orders';

interface OrdersListProps {
    orders: Order[];
    recentActivity?: Order[];
    isRefreshing: boolean;
    onRefresh: () => void;
    onConfirmOrder: (orderId: string) => void;
    onMarkReady: (orderId: string) => void;
    onMarkPickedUp: (orderId: string) => void;
    onViewDetails: (orderId: string) => void;
    onViewHoldDetails: (orderId: string) => void;
    onViewAllActivity?: () => void;
}

const OrdersList: React.FC<OrdersListProps> = ({
    orders,
    recentActivity = [],
    isRefreshing,
    onRefresh,
    onConfirmOrder,
    onMarkReady,
    onMarkPickedUp,
    onViewDetails,
    onViewHoldDetails,
    onViewAllActivity,
}) => {
    if (orders.length === 0 && recentActivity.length === 0) {
        return (
            <View style={styles.emptyContainer}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No orders found</Text>
            </View>
        );
    }

    return (
        <ScrollView
            style={styles.scroll}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            refreshControl={
                <RefreshControl
                    refreshing={isRefreshing}
                    onRefresh={onRefresh}
                    tintColor="#00C853"
                    colors={['#00C853']}
                />
            }
        >
            {orders.map(order => (
                <OrderCard
                    key={order.id}
                    order={order}
                    onConfirmOrder={onConfirmOrder}
                    onMarkReady={onMarkReady}
                    onMarkPickedUp={onMarkPickedUp}
                    onViewDetails={onViewDetails}
                    onViewHoldDetails={onViewHoldDetails}
                />
            ))}

            {recentActivity.length > 0 && (
                <RecentActivity
                    orders={recentActivity}
                    onViewAll={() => onViewAllActivity?.()}
                    onOrderPress={onViewDetails}
                />
            )}
        </ScrollView>
    );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    scroll: {
        flex: 1,
        backgroundColor: '#F5F5F5',
    },
    content: {
        padding: 12,
        gap: 10,
        paddingBottom: 24,
    },
    emptyContainer: {
        flex: 1,
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        paddingTop: 60,
    },
    emptyText: {
        fontSize: 15,
        color: '#999',
    },
});

export default OrdersList;
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';

export type OrderTab = 'Needs Action' | 'Holds' | 'Ready' | 'History';

export interface TabCounts {
    'Needs Action': number;
    Holds: number;
    Ready: number;
    History: number;
}

interface OrdersTabsProps {
    activeTab: OrderTab;
    tabCounts: TabCounts;
    onTabChange: (tab: OrderTab) => void;
}

const TABS: OrderTab[] = ['Needs Action', 'Holds', 'Ready', 'History'];

const OrdersTabs: React.FC<OrdersTabsProps> = ({ activeTab, tabCounts, onTabChange }) => {
    return (
        <View style={styles.wrapper}>
            <ScrollView
                horizontal
                showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                contentContainerStyle={styles.container}
            >
                {TABS.map((tab) => {
                    const isActive = activeTab === tab;
                    const count = tabCounts[tab];
                    return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            key={tab}
                            onPress={() => onTabChange(tab)}
                            style={[styles.tab, isActive && styles.activeTab]}
                            activeOpacity={0.7}
                        >
                            <Text style={[styles.tabText, isActive && styles.activeTabText]}>
                                {tab}
                            </Text>
                            {count > 0 && (
                                <View style={[styles.badge, isActive && styles.activeBadge]}>
                                    <Text style={[styles.badgeText, isActive && styles.activeBadgeText]}>
                                        {count}
                                    </Text>
                                </View>
                            )}
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    );
                })}
            </ScrollView>
            <View style={styles.divider} />
        </View>
    );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    wrapper: {
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
    },
    container: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        paddingHorizontal: 12,
        paddingVertical: 8,
        gap: 6,
    },
    tab: {
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        paddingHorizontal: 14,
        paddingVertical: 8,
        borderRadius: 20,
        gap: 6,
        backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6',
    },
    activeTab: {
        backgroundColor: '#111',
    },
    tabText: {
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: '600',
        color: '#6B7280',
    },
    activeTabText: {
        color: '#fff',
    },
    badge: {
        backgroundColor: '#E5E7EB',
        borderRadius: 10,
        minWidth: 18,
        height: 18,
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        paddingHorizontal: 5,
    },
    activeBadge: {
        backgroundColor: '#00C853',
    },
    badgeText: {
        fontSize: 11,
        fontWeight: '700',
        color: '#6B7280',
    },
    activeBadgeText: {
        color: '#fff',
    },
    divider: {
        height: 1,
        backgroundColor: '#F0F0F0',
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image } from 'react-native';

import { RefundClaim } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/refund/useClaims';

interface ClaimCardProps {
  claim: RefundClaim;
  timeLabel?: string; // e.g. "just now"
  onReviewPress?: (claim: RefundClaim) => void;
}

const ClaimCard: React.FC<ClaimCardProps> = ({ claim, timeLabel, onReviewPress }) => {
  const { customer, order } = claim;

  return (
    <View style={{
      backgroundColor: '#fff',
      marginHorizontal: 12, borderRadius: 16,
      borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#E5E7EB',
      padding: 14, marginBottom: 12,

        }}>
          <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '700' }}>
            {customer.avatarLabel}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* Name + handle */}
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: '#111' }}>
              {customer.name}

      </View>

      {/* ── Product row ── */}
      <View style={{
        flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 10, marginBottom: 12,
      }}>

          <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: '#111' }} numberOfLines={1}>
            {order.productName}
          </Text>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#9CA3AF', marginTop: 2 }}>
            Size {order.size} · {order.gender}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800', color: '#EF4444' }}>
          ${order.depositAmount.toFixed(2)}
        </Text>
      </View>

      {/* ── Meta info ── */}
      <View style={{
        borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: '#F3F4F6',
        paddingTop: 10, gap: 5,
      }}>
        {[
          { label: 'Reason',    value: claim.reason },
          { label: 'Submitted', value: claim.submittedAt },
          { label: 'Claim #',   value: claim.claimNumber },
        ].map(row => (
          <View key={row.label} style={{
            flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between',
          }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#9CA3AF' }}>{row.label}</Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '600', color: '#111' }}>
              {row.value}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* ── Review link ── */}
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={() => onReviewPress?.(claim)}
        style={{ marginTop: 10, alignItems: 'flex-end' }}
      >
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#00C853', fontWeight: '600' }}>
          Review Full Claim →
        </Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
};

export default ClaimCard;
```

```typescript
      >
```

```typescript
import {
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { KeyboardAwareScrollView } from 'react-native-keyboard-aware-scroll-view';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

interface BaseContainerProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  scrollable?: boolean;
  backgroundColor?: string;
}

export default function BaseContainer({
  children,
  className = '',
  scrollable = false,
  backgroundColor,
}: BaseContainerProps) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();

  if (scrollable) {
    return (
      <KeyboardAwareScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={{ flexGrow: 1, paddingBottom: insets.bottom }}
        style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: backgroundColor ?? 'transparent' }}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        enableOnAndroid
        extraScrollHeight={20}
      >
        {children}
      </KeyboardAwareScrollView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View
      className={`flex-1 ${className}`}
      style={{
        paddingBottom: insets.bottom,
        paddingLeft: insets.left,
        paddingRight: insets.right,
        backgroundColor: backgroundColor ?? 'transparent',
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import { View, Text, TextInput, TextStyle, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import Feather from '@expo/vector-icons/Feather';

interface EmailFieldProps {
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (text: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  borderRadius?: number;
  borderColor?: string;
  focusedBorderColor?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  paddingVertical?: number;
  paddingHorizontal?: number;
  fontSize?: number;
  placeholderTextColor?: string;
  textColor?: string;
  containerStyle?: ViewStyle;
  inputStyle?: TextStyle;
  disabled?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export default function EmailField({
  value,
  onChangeText,
  placeholder = 'Email Address',
  borderRadius = 12,
  borderColor = '#D1D5DB',
  focusedBorderColor = '#4584CA',
  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',
  paddingVertical = 14,
  paddingHorizontal = 16,
  fontSize = 15,
  placeholderTextColor = '#9CA3AF',
  textColor = '#1F2937',
  containerStyle,
  inputStyle,
  disabled = false,
  error,
}: EmailFieldProps) {
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);

  return (
    <View>
      <View
        style={[
          {
            flexDirection: 'row',
            alignItems: 'center',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: error ? '#EF4444' : focused ? focusedBorderColor : borderColor,
            borderRadius,
            backgroundColor,
            paddingVertical,
            paddingHorizontal,
            opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
          },
          containerStyle,
        ]}
      >
        <Feather name="mail" size={18} color="#000" style={{ marginRight: 10 }} />
        <TextInput
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={placeholderTextColor}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          editable={!disabled}
          onFocus={() => setFocused(true)}
          onBlur={() => setFocused(false)}
          style={[{ flex: 1, fontSize, color: textColor, padding: 0 }, inputStyle]}
        />
      </View>
      {error && (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#EF4444', marginTop: 4, marginLeft: 4 }}>
          {error}
        </Text>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import React from "react";
import { Image, ImageSourcePropType, ImageResizeMode } from "react-native";
import { SvgProps } from "react-native-svg";

interface ShowPictureProps {
  SvgComponent?: React.FC<SvgProps>;
  imageSource?: ImageSourcePropType;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  resizeMode?: ImageResizeMode;
  preserveAspectRatio?: string; // new prop
}

const ShowPicture: React.FC<ShowPictureProps> = ({
  SvgComponent,
  imageSource,
  width = 100,
  height = 100,
  resizeMode = 'contain',
  preserveAspectRatio = 'xMidYMid meet', // default
}) => {
  if (SvgComponent) {
    return <SvgComponent width={width} height={height} preserveAspectRatio={preserveAspectRatio} />;
  }
  if (imageSource) {
    return (
      <Image
        source={imageSource}
        style={{ width, height, resizeMode }}
      />
    );
  }
  return null;
};

export default ShowPicture;
```

## File: services/hooks/auth/useEmailOtp.ts
```typescript
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';
import { OTPInputHandle } from '@/components/auth/OtpInput';

interface UseEmailOtpProps {
  otpRef: React.RefObject<OTPInputHandle | null>;
  countdownSeconds?: number;
  from?: string;
}

export function useEmailOtp({ otpRef, countdownSeconds = 54, from }: UseEmailOtpProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(countdownSeconds);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  const startCountdown = () => {
    setCountdown(countdownSeconds);
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown(prev => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    startCountdown();
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleChange = (digits: string[]) => {};

const handleContinue = async (code: string, onSuccess?: () => void) => {
  if (code.length < 6) {
    // ✅ Just return early without showing a toast
    return;
  }

  try {
    setLoading(true);

    await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1500));

    if (from === 'forgot-password') {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Code Verified!',
        text2: 'You can now reset your password.',
      });
    } else {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Email Verified!',
        text2: 'Your account is ready. Please log in.',
      });
    }

    await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500));
    onSuccess?.();

  } catch (error: any) {
    if (from === 'forgot-password') {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Invalid Code',
        text2: 'The reset code is incorrect. Please try again.',
      });
    } else {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Verification Failed',
        text2: 'The code you entered is incorrect.',
      });
    }
    otpRef.current?.reset();
  } finally {
    setLoading(false);
  }
};

  const handleResend = async () => {
    try {
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500));
      otpRef.current?.reset();
      startCountdown();

      if (from === 'forgot-password') {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'info',
          text1: 'Code Resent!',
          text2: 'A new password reset code has been sent.',
        });
      } else {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'info',
          text1: 'Code Resent!',
          text2: 'A new verification code has been sent to your email.',
        });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Failed to Resend',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Something went wrong. Please try again.',
      });
    }
  };

  return {
    loading,
    countdown,
    handleChange,
    handleContinue,
    handleResend,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';

interface ResetPasswordForm {
  password: string;
  confirmPassword: string;
}

interface ResetPasswordErrors {
  password?: string;
  confirmPassword?: string;
}

const getStrength = (password: string): number => {
  let score = 0;
  if (password.length >= 6) score++;
  if (password.length >= 10) score++;
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(password) && /[0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) score++;
  return score;
};

export function useResetPassword() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ResetPasswordForm>({
    password: '',
    confirmPassword: '',
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<ResetPasswordErrors>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const strength = getStrength(form.password);

  const updateField = (field: keyof ResetPasswordForm, value: string) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: undefined }));
    }
  };

const validate = (): boolean => {
  const newErrors: ResetPasswordErrors = {};

  if (!form.password.trim()) {
    newErrors.password = 'Password is required';
  } else if (form.password.length < 6) {
    newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 6 characters';
  }

  if (!form.confirmPassword.trim()) {
    newErrors.confirmPassword = 'Please confirm your password';
  } else if (form.password !== form.confirmPassword) {
    newErrors.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match';
  }

  setErrors(newErrors);

  // ✅ Return false if there are errors, but no toast
  return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
};

  const handleSave = async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      // TODO: replace with your actual API call
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1500));

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Password Reset!',
        text2: 'Your password has been changed successfully.',
      });

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500));
      onSuccess?.();

    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Reset Failed',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Something went wrong. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    form,
    errors,
    loading,
    strength,
    updateField,
    handleSave,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';

interface VerifyEmailErrors {
  email?: string;
}

export function useVerifyEmail() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<VerifyEmailErrors>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

 const validate = (): boolean => {
  const newErrors: VerifyEmailErrors = {};

  if (!email.trim()) {
    newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
  } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
    newErrors.email = 'Enter a valid email';
  }

  setErrors(newErrors);

  // ✅ Return false if there are errors, but no toast
  return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
};

  const handleSend = async (onSuccess?: () => void, from?: string) => {
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      setLoading(true);

      // TODO: replace with your actual API call
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1500));

      if (from === 'forgot-password') {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'success',
          text1: 'Reset Code Sent!',
          text2: `A password reset code has been sent to ${email}`,
        });
      } else {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'success',
          text1: 'Verification Code Sent!',
          text2: `A verification code has been sent to ${email}`,
        });
      }

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500));
      onSuccess?.();

    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Failed to Send',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Something went wrong. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    email,
    setEmail,
    errors,
    loading,
    handleSend,
  };
```

```typescript
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<NotificationSection[]>(INITIAL_SECTIONS)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  // Derive master push toggle from global section
  const pushEnabled = sections[0]?.items[0]?.enabled ?? true

  const toggleSetting = useCallback((sectionId: string, itemId: string) => {
    setSections(prev =>
      prev.map(section => {
        if (section.id !== sectionId) return section
        return {
          ...section,
          items: section.items.map(item =>
            item.id === itemId ? { ...item, enabled: !item.enabled } : item
          ),
        }
      })
    )
  }, [])

  // Toggle master push — disables/enables every setting
  const togglePushNotifications = useCallback(() => {
    setSections(prev => {
      const next = !prev[0].items[0].enabled
      return prev.map((section, si) => ({
        ...section,
        items: section.items.map((item, ii) =>
          si === 0 && ii === 0
            ? { ...item, enabled: next }
            : { ...item, enabled: next ? item.enabled : false }
        ),
      }))
    })
  }, [])

  const saveSettings = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setSaving(true)
      // TODO: persist to API
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 700))
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Settings saved',
        text2: 'Your notification preferences are updated.',
        position: 'top',
        topOffset: 56,
      })
    } catch (e: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Failed to save',
        text2: e?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
        position: 'top',
        topOffset: 56,
      })
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }, [sections])

  return {
    sections,
    pushEnabled,
    saving,
    toggleSetting,
    togglePushNotifications,
    saveSettings,
  }
}
```

```typescript
  loading: boolean

}

// ─── Mock fetcher — swap with your API call ───────────────────────────────────

async function fetchOffer(notificationId: string): Promise<StoreOffer> {
  // TODO: replace with real API
  // const res = await fetch(`/api/notifications/offer/${notificationId}`)
  // return res.json()

  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400))

    productName: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'",
    productCondition: 'New',

    inLockerSince: 'Jan 2024',
    storeOffer: 195,
    marketPrice: 220,
    discountPercent: 11,
    storeMessage:
      "We love this pair and would like to add it to our store inventory. Let us know if you're interested!",
    platformFeePercent: 5,
    platformFee: 9.75,
    netPayout: 185.25,
    store: {
      name: "Sonny's Kicks",
      initials: 'SK',
      city: 'Miami, FL',
      distance: '1.2 mi',
      rating: 4.9,
      purchases: 847,
      reviews: 142,
      yearsOnPlatform: 3,
    },
  }
}

// ─── Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useOfferFromStore(notificationId: string): UseOfferFromStoreReturn {
  const [offer, setOffer] = useState<StoreOffer | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false

    async function load() {
      try {
        setLoading(true)
        const data = await fetchOffer(notificationId)
        if (!cancelled) setOffer(data)
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(e.message ?? 'Unknown error')
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    load()
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [notificationId])

  return { offer, loading, error }
}
```

```typescript
    setLoading(true)
    // Replace with your real API / notification scheduling call
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600))
    setLoading(false)
    setReminderSet(true)
    return true
  }, [selectedDate])

    setSelectedDate(null)
    setReminderSet(false)
  }, [])

  return { selectedDate, reminderSet, loading, selectDate, setReminder, reset }
}
```

```typescript
import { useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { FlatList, Dimensions } from 'react-native'

const { width } = Dimensions.get('window')

export interface SlideItem {
  id: string
  [key: string]: unknown
}

interface UseSlidingOptions {
  totalSlides: number
  onFinish: () => void
}

interface UseSlidingReturn<T extends SlideItem> {
  currentIndex: number
  isFirst: boolean
  isLast: boolean
  // React 18: useRef(null) gives RefObject<T | null>
  flatListRef: React.RefObject<FlatList<T> | null>
  goNext: () => void
  goBack: () => void
  goToIndex: (index: number) => void
  onMomentumScrollEnd: (e: {
    nativeEvent: { contentOffset: { x: number } }
  }) => void
}

export function useSliding<T extends SlideItem>({
  totalSlides,
  onFinish,
}: UseSlidingOptions): UseSlidingReturn<T> {
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0)
  // React 18 compatible — initial null, type is FlatList<T> | null
  const flatListRef = useRef<FlatList<T> | null>(null)

  const scrollToIndex = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      flatListRef.current?.scrollToOffset({
        offset: index * width,
        animated: true,
      })
      setCurrentIndex(index)
    },
    [],
  )

  const goNext = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentIndex >= totalSlides - 1) {
      onFinish()
      return
    }
    scrollToIndex(currentIndex + 1)
  }, [currentIndex, totalSlides, onFinish, scrollToIndex])

  const goBack = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentIndex <= 0) return
    scrollToIndex(currentIndex - 1)
  }, [currentIndex, scrollToIndex])

  const goToIndex = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      if (index < 0 || index >= totalSlides) return
      scrollToIndex(index)
    },
    [totalSlides, scrollToIndex],
  )

  const onMomentumScrollEnd = useCallback(
    (e: { nativeEvent: { contentOffset: { x: number } } }) => {
      const newIndex = Math.round(e.nativeEvent.contentOffset.x / width)
      setCurrentIndex(newIndex)
    },
    [],
  )

  return {
    currentIndex,
    isFirst: currentIndex === 0,
    isLast: currentIndex === totalSlides - 1,
    flatListRef,
    goNext,
    goBack,
    goToIndex,
    onMomentumScrollEnd,
  }
}
```

```typescript
// services/hooks/store/useAddCard.ts
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export interface CardForm {
  number: string
  name: string
  expiry: string
  cvv: string
  saveCard: boolean
}

export function useAddCard() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CardForm>({
    number: '', name: '', expiry: '', cvv: '', saveCard: true,
  })

  const updateField = useCallback(<K extends keyof CardForm>(key: K, value: CardForm[K]) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }))
  }, [])

  const formatCardNumber = (val: string) => {
    const digits = val.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 16)
    return digits.replace(/(.{4})/g, '$1 ').trim()
  }

  const formatExpiry = (val: string) => {
    const digits = val.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 4)
    if (digits.length >= 3) return `${digits.slice(0, 2)}/${digits.slice(2)}`
    return digits
  }

  const handleAddCard = useCallback(async (onSuccess: () => void) => {
    if (!form.number || !form.name || !form.expiry || !form.cvv) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Missing Fields', text2: 'Please fill in all card details' })
      return
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800))
    Toast.show({ type: 'success', text1: 'Card Added!', text2: 'Your card has been saved securely' })
    onSuccess()
  }, [form])

  return { form, updateField, formatCardNumber, formatExpiry, handleAddCard }
}
```

```typescript
// services/hooks/store/useQRCode.ts
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'

export function useQRCode(initialSeconds = 585) {
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(initialSeconds)
  const [active,  setActive]  = useState(true)
  const [scanned, setScanned] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return
    if (seconds <= 0) { setActive(false); return }
    const t = setInterval(() => setSeconds(s => s - 1), 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(t)
  }, [active, seconds])

  const minutes  = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  const secs     = seconds % 60
  const display  = `${minutes}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`
  const progress = seconds / initialSeconds

  const refresh = useCallback(() => {
    setSeconds(initialSeconds)
    setActive(true)
    setScanned(false)
  }, [initialSeconds])

  const simulateScan = useCallback(() => {
    setActive(false)
    setScanned(true)
  }, [])

  return { display, progress, seconds, scanned, refresh, simulateScan }
}
```

```typescript
  { id: 'exclusive_drops',label: 'Exclusive Drops', description: 'Limited releases from followed stores',      icon: 'flash-outline',         enabled: true  },
  { id: 'flash_sales',    label: 'Flash Sales',     description: 'Limited-time offers and crazy deals',        icon: 'trending-up-outline',   enabled: false },
  { id: 'restocks',       label: 'Restocks',        description: 'When sold-out pairs are back in stock',      icon: 'refresh-outline',       enabled: true  },
]

    alerts: [

      { id: 'ed', label: 'Exclusive Drops',enabled: true  },

    alertCount: 3, expanded: false,
    alerts: [
      { id: 'na', label: 'New Arrivals',   enabled: true  },
      { id: 'ed', label: 'Exclusive Drops',enabled: true  },
      { id: 'fs', label: 'Flash Sales',    enabled: false },
      { id: 're', label: 'Restocks',       enabled: true  },
    ],
  },
  {
    storeId: 's3', storeName: 'Kicks City', initials: 'KC', brandColor: '#22C55E',
    alertCount: 2, expanded: false,
    alerts: [
      { id: 'na', label: 'New Arrivals',   enabled: true  },
      { id: 'ed', label: 'Exclusive Drops',enabled: false },
      { id: 'fs', label: 'Flash Sales',    enabled: false },
      { id: 're', label: 'Restocks',       enabled: true  },
    ],
  },
]

export function useAlertPreferences() {
  const [globals, setGlobals] = useState<GlobalAlert[]>(INITIAL_GLOBALS)
  const [stores,  setStores]  = useState<StoreAlertSetting[]>(INITIAL_STORES)
  const [quietHours, setQuietHours] = useState(true)

  const toggleGlobal = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setGlobals(prev => prev.map(g => g.id === id ? { ...g, enabled: !g.enabled } : g))
  }, [])

  const toggleStoreExpand = useCallback((storeId: string) => {
    setStores(prev => prev.map(s => s.storeId === storeId ? { ...s, expanded: !s.expanded } : s))
  }, [])

  const toggleStoreAlert = useCallback((storeId: string, alertId: string) => {
    setStores(prev => prev.map(s => {
      if (s.storeId !== storeId) return s
      const updated = s.alerts.map(a => a.id === alertId ? { ...a, enabled: !a.enabled } : a)
      return { ...s, alerts: updated, alertCount: updated.filter(a => a.enabled).length }
    }))
  }, [])

  return { globals, stores, quietHours, setQuietHours, toggleGlobal, toggleStoreExpand, toggleStoreAlert }
}
```

```typescript
// hooks/profile/useChangePassword.ts
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export interface ChangePasswordForm {
  currentPassword: string
  newPassword: string
  confirmPassword: string
}

export interface ChangePasswordErrors {
  currentPassword?: string
  newPassword?: string
  confirmPassword?: string
}

export const useChangePassword = () => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ChangePasswordForm>({
    currentPassword: '',
    newPassword: '',
    confirmPassword: '',
  })
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<ChangePasswordErrors>({})
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [showCurrent, setShowCurrent]   = useState(false)
  const [showNew, setShowNew]           = useState(false)
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm]   = useState(false)

  const updateField = useCallback(
    (field: keyof ChangePasswordForm, value: string) => {
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }))
      if (errors[field]) {
        setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: undefined }))
      }
    },
    [errors]
  )

  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const newErrors: ChangePasswordErrors = {}

    if (!form.currentPassword) {
      newErrors.currentPassword = 'Current password is required'
    }

    if (!form.newPassword) {
      newErrors.newPassword = 'New password is required'
    } else if (form.newPassword.length < 8) {
      newErrors.newPassword = 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
    }

    if (!form.confirmPassword) {
      newErrors.confirmPassword = 'Please confirm your new password'
    } else if (form.newPassword !== form.confirmPassword) {
      newErrors.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match'
    }

    setErrors(newErrors)
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0
  }

  const handleSave = useCallback(
    async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
      if (!validate()) return

      try {
        setLoading(true)
        // TODO: replace with real API call
        await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800))

        Toast.show({
          type: 'success',
          text1: 'Password changed!',
          text2: 'Your password has been updated.',
          position: 'top',
          topOffset: 56,
        })

        setForm({ currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' })
        onSuccess?.()
      } catch (error: any) {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'error',
          text1: 'Change failed',
          text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
          position: 'top',
          topOffset: 56,
        })
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    },
    [form]
  )

  return {
    form,
    errors,
    loading,
    showCurrent,
    showNew,
    showConfirm,
    setShowCurrent,
    setShowNew,
    setShowConfirm,
    updateField,
    handleSave,
  }
}
```

```typescript
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false)

  const filteredLockers = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return lockers
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase()
    return lockers.filter(
      (l) =>
        l.username.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        l.location.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    )
  }, [lockers, searchQuery])

  const toggleFollow = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setLockers((prev) =>
      prev.map((l) =>
        l.id === id
          ? {
              ...l,
              isFollowing: !l.isFollowing,
              followerCount: l.isFollowing ? l.followerCount - 1 : l.followerCount + 1,
            }
          : l,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true)
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000))
    setIsRefreshing(false)
  }, [])

  return {
    lockers: filteredLockers,
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    isRefreshing,
    refresh,
    toggleFollow,
  }
}
```

```typescript
  const [selectedReason, setReason]     = useState<RefundReason | null>(null)
  const [notes, setNotes]               = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading]           = useState(false)

  const REASONS: RefundReason[] = ['Changed my mind', 'Item not as described', 'Other']

  }, [selectedReason])

  return {
    eligibility,
    reasons: REASONS,
    selectedReason,
    setReason,

    setNotes,

  }
```
