```typescript
// services/hooks/profile/useWantedPairs.ts
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'
import { Router } from 'expo-router'

export interface SneakerAlert {
  inSize: boolean
  nearby: boolean
  stores: boolean
  price: boolean
}

export interface WantedPair {
  id: string
  brand: string
  name: string
  size: string
  addedOn: string
  status: 'available' | 'watching'
  storesNearby?: number
  imageUrl?: string
  alerts: SneakerAlert
}

const MOCK_PAIRS: WantedPair[] = [
  {
    id: '1',
    brand: 'JORDAN',
    name: "Air Jordan 1 'Chicago'",
    size: '10.5',
    addedOn: 'Mar 15',
    status: 'available',
    storesNearby: 2,
    alerts: { inSize: true, nearby: true, stores: false, price: true },
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    brand: 'NIKE',
    name: "Nike SB Dunk Low 'Travis Scott'",
    size: '10.5',
    addedOn: 'Mar 12',
    status: 'watching',
    alerts: { inSize: true, nearby: true, stores: false, price: false },
  },
]

export type FilterTab = 'All' | 'Available Now' | 'Still Watching' | 'Alerts On'

export function useWantedPairs(router?: Router) {
  const [pairs, setPairs] = useState<WantedPair[]>(MOCK_PAIRS)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<FilterTab>('All')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const filteredPairs = useCallback(() => {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'Available Now':
        return pairs.filter(p => p.status === 'available')
      case 'Still Watching':
        return pairs.filter(p => p.status === 'watching')
      case 'Alerts On':
        return pairs.filter(
          p => p.alerts.inSize || p.alerts.nearby || p.alerts.stores || p.alerts.price
        )
      default:
        return pairs
    }
  }, [pairs, activeTab])

  // ── Navigation handlers (need router) ──────────────────────────────────────

  const handleCardPress = (pair: WantedPair) => {
    router?.push({
      pathname: '/screens/profile/joinWaitlistScreen',
      params: { product: JSON.stringify(pair) },
    })
  }

  const handleAvailableNowPress = (pair: WantedPair) => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'success',
      text1: 'Available Near You! 🎉',
      text2: `${pair.name} is in stock at ${pair.storesNearby} nearby store${
        pair.storesNearby !== 1 ? 's' : ''
      }.`,
    })
    router?.push({
      pathname: '/screens/profile/joinWaitlistScreen',
      params: { product: JSON.stringify(pair) },
    })
  }

  const handleInfoPress = () => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'How Wanted Works',
      text2: "Mark a sneaker as Wanted and we'll alert you when it's back in your size nearby.",
    })
  }

  // ── Alert actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const toggleAlert = (pairId: string, alertKey: keyof SneakerAlert) => {
    setPairs(prev =>
      prev.map(p => {
        if (p.id !== pairId) return p
        const updated = { ...p, alerts: { ...p.alerts, [alertKey]: !p.alerts[alertKey] } }
        const label =
          alertKey === 'inSize'
            ? 'In Size'
            : alertKey === 'nearby'
            ? 'Nearby'
            : alertKey === 'stores'
            ? 'Stores'
            : 'Price Drop'
        Toast.show({
          type: updated.alerts[alertKey] ? 'success' : 'info',
          text1: updated.alerts[alertKey] ? `${label} alert enabled` : `${label} alert disabled`,
          text2: updated.alerts[alertKey]
            ? `You'll be notified for ${p.name}`
            : `Alert turned off for ${p.name}`,
        })
        return updated
      })
    )
  }

  const removeFromWanted = (pairId: string) => {
    const pair = pairs.find(p => p.id === pairId)
    setPairs(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== pairId))
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'Removed from Wanted',
      text2: pair ? `${pair.name} removed` : 'Item removed',
    })
  }

  const manageAlerts = (pair: WantedPair) => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'Manage Alerts',
      text2: `Opening alert settings for ${pair.name}`,
    })
  }

  const stats = {
    wanted: pairs.length,
    availableNow: pairs.filter(p => p.status === 'available').length,
    watching: pairs.filter(p => p.status === 'watching').length,
  }

  return {
    pairs: filteredPairs(),
    allPairs: pairs,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    loading,
    stats,
    toggleAlert,
    removeFromWanted,
    manageAlerts,
    handleCardPress,
    handleAvailableNowPress,
    handleInfoPress,
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'
import type { GenderTab } from './useSizeSelection'

interface SizeConfig {
  sizes: string[]
  unit: string
}

const CLOTHING_SIZE_DATA: Record<GenderTab, SizeConfig> = {
  "Men's": {
    unit: 'Clothing Size',
    sizes: ['XS', 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', 'XXL', '3XL'],
  },
  "Women's": {
    unit: 'Clothing Size',
    sizes: ['XXS', 'XS', 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL', 'XXL'],
  },
  "Kids'": {
    unit: 'Clothing Size',
    sizes: ['2T', '3T', '4T', '5T', 'XS', 'S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'],
  },
}

export function useClothingSelection() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<GenderTab>("Women's")
  const [selectedSizes, setSelectedSizes] = useState<Record<GenderTab, string | null>>({
    "Men's": null,
    "Women's": null,
    "Kids'": null,
  })
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const currentConfig = CLOTHING_SIZE_DATA[activeTab]
  const currentSelected = selectedSizes[activeTab]

  const selectSize = (size: string) => {
    setSelectedSizes(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [activeTab]: prev[activeTab] === size ? null : size,
    }))
  }

  const addCustomSize = (size: string) => {
    const trimmed = size.trim()
    if (!trimmed) return

    setSelectedSizes(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [activeTab]: trimmed,
    }))
  }

  const handleContinue = async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)

      // TODO: replace with real API call
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800))

      console.log('=== CLOTHING SIZE SELECTION DATA ===')
      console.log('Selected Clothing Sizes:', JSON.stringify(selectedSizes, null, 2))
      console.log('Active Tab:', activeTab)
      console.log('===================================')

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Clothing Sizes Saved!',
        text2: "We'll personalize apparel picks too.",
      })

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400))
      onSuccess?.()
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Something went wrong',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const removeSelectedSize = (tab: GenderTab) => {
    setSelectedSizes(prev => ({ ...prev, [tab]: null }))
  }

  const allSelectedSizes = (Object.entries(selectedSizes) as [GenderTab, string | null][])
    .filter(([, size]) => size !== null)
    .map(([tab, size]) => ({ tab, size: size! }))

  return {
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    currentConfig,
    currentSelected,
    selectSize,
    addCustomSize,
    handleContinue,
    allSelectedSizes,
    removeSelectedSize,
    loading,
  }
}
```

## File: services/hooks/profilesetup/useLocation.ts
```typescript
// services/hooks/profilesetup/useLocation.ts
import { useState } from 'react'
import * as Location from 'expo-location'
import { Linking } from 'react-native'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export function useLocation() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const handleEnableLocation = async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)

      // Check existing permission
      const { status: existingStatus } = await Location.getForegroundPermissionsAsync()
      let finalStatus = existingStatus

      // Request if not already granted
      if (existingStatus !== 'granted') {
        const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync()
        finalStatus = status
      }

      if (finalStatus !== 'granted') {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'error',
          text1: 'Location Permission Denied',
          text2: 'Please enable location access in your device settings.',
        })
        await Linking.openSettings()
        return
      }

      // Permission granted — try to get coords but don't block on failure
      // (emulators often fail getCurrentPositionAsync)
      try {
        const location =
          await Location.getLastKnownPositionAsync() ??
          await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
            accuracy: Location.Accuracy.Low,
            timeInterval: 5000,
          })
        console.log('=== LOCATION ENABLED ===')
        console.log('Coords:', location?.coords)
      } catch (coordsError) {
        // Coords failed (common on emulator) — permission is still granted, continue
        console.log('Could not get coords (emulator?):', coordsError)
      }

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Location Enabled!',
        text2: "We'll show you nearby stores in real-time.",
      })

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400))
      onSuccess?.()

    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Location Access Failed',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please enable location in your settings.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {
    loading,
    handleEnableLocation,
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

export interface ProductSize {
    size: string;
    qty: number;
    price: string;
    status: 'Active' | 'Inactive';
}

export const useAddProduct = () => {
    const [form, setForm] = useState({
        name: '',
        brand: '',
        category: '',
        colorway: '',
        sku: '',
        availability: 'Active' as 'Active' | 'Coming Soon',
    });

    const [sizes, setSizes] = useState<ProductSize[]>([]);
    const [scannedFound, setScannedFound] = useState(false);
    const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);

    const updateField = (field: string, value: string) => {
        setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    };

    const updateSizeQty = (index: number, delta: number) => {
        setSizes(prev => {
            const next = [...prev];
            next[index] = { ...next[index], qty: Math.max(0, next[index].qty + delta) };
            return next;
        });
    };

    const addSize = () => {
        setSizes(prev => [...prev, { size: '', qty: 1, price: form.category ? '' : '', status: 'Active' }]);
    };

    const removeSize = (index: number) => {
        setSizes(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    };

    // Simulates a barcode scan result filling the form automatically.
    const openScanner = () => {
        setIsScanning(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
            setForm({
                name: 'Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Black White"',
                brand: 'Jordan',
                category: 'Sneakers',
                colorway: 'Black/White',
                sku: 'DZ5485-010',
                availability: 'Active',
            });
            setSizes([{ size: '10.5', qty: 1, price: '220', status: 'Active' }]);
            setScannedFound(true);
            setIsScanning(false);

            Toast.show({
                type: 'success',
                text1: 'Barcode scanned',
                text2: 'Product details filled in automatically.',
                position: 'top',
            });
        }, 900);
    };

    const enterBarcodeManually = () => {
        // Hand off to a manual barcode-entry input/modal
        console.log('Enter barcode manually');
    };

    const handleSave = () => {
        if (!form.name) {
            Toast.show({
                type: 'error',
                text1: 'Missing Information',
                text2: 'Please enter a product name. ⚠️',
                position: 'top',
            });
            return;
        }

        // Logic to save to your database would go here
        console.log('Saving Product:', { ...form, sizes });

        Toast.show({
            type: 'success',
            text1: 'Product Saved!',
            text2: `${form.name} added successfully.`,
            position: 'top',
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
            router.back();
        }, 600);
    };

    return {
        form,
        sizes,
        scannedFound,
        isScanning,
        updateField,
        updateSizeQty,
        addSize,
        removeSize,
        setForm,
        openScanner,
        enterBarcodeManually,
        handleSave,
    };
};
```

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

export const useDropManager = () => {
  // Active Drop Timer State
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({ hours: 2, minutes: 45, seconds: 12 });
  
  // New Drop Form State
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    type: 'Raffle',
    quantity: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft(prev => {
        if (prev.seconds > 0) return { ...prev, seconds: prev.seconds - 1 };
        if (prev.minutes > 0) return { ...prev, minutes: 59, seconds: 59, hours: prev.hours };
        return prev;
      });
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const upcomingDrops = [
    {
      id: '1',
      name: "Air Jordan 1 'Chicago'",
      type: 'RAFFLE',
      typeCol: '#8B5CF6',
      date: 'Sat Mar 29 - 10:00 AM',
```

```typescript
  phone: '+1 (305) 555-0198',
  photoUri: '',
  acceptOrders: true,
  acceptDeposit: true,
  pickupAvailable: true,
});

export const useEditBranch = (id: string) => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<BranchForm>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    phone: '',
    photoUri: '',
    acceptOrders: true,
    acceptDeposit: true,
    pickupAvailable: true,
  });

  const [inventoryMode, setInventoryMode] = useState<InventoryMode>('shared');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBranch(id).then(setForm);
  }, [id]);

  const setField = <K extends keyof BranchForm>(key: K, value: BranchForm[K]) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  };

  const handleChangePhoto = () => {

  const handleSetupCustomPickup = () => {

    router.back();
  };

  return {
    form,
    setField,
    inventoryMode,
    setInventoryMode,
    handleSave,
    handleChangePhoto,
    handleSetupCustomPickup,
  };
};
```

```typescript
  const missedSearchesCount = useMemo(() => {
    return dayRange === '7' ? 42 : dayRange === '30' ? 168 : 512;
  }, [dayRange]);

  const opportunities = useMemo(() => {
    const list = OPPORTUNITIES_BY_RANGE[dayRange];

    if (category === 'Clothing') return [];
    return list;
  }, [dayRange, category]);

  const bestOpportunity: BestOpportunity | null = useMemo(() => {
    if (opportunities.length === 0) return null;
    const top = opportunities.find((o) => o.stockStatus === 'not_stocked') ?? opportunities[0];
    return {
      itemName: top.name,
      reason: 'has high local demand and no inventory.',
      potentialBuyers: 24,
    };
  }, [opportunities]);

  return {
    store,
    dayRanges: DAY_RANGES,
    dayRange,
    setDayRange,
    categoryFilters: CATEGORY_FILTERS,
    category,
    setCategory,
    missedSearchesCount,
    opportunities,
    bestOpportunity,
  };
};
```

```typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

const QUICK_OFFERS = ['185', '195', '200', '210', '215'];
const EXPIRY_OPTIONS = ['24 hours', '48 hours', '72 hours'];

export const useMakeOffer = () => {
  const [offerValue, setOfferValue] = useState('205');
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [expiry, setExpiry] = useState('24 hours');
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);

  const item = {
    name: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'",
    subtitle: "Men's US 10.5 · New / Deadstock",
    seller: {
      initials: 'SL',
      name: "Sonny's Locker",
      verified: true,
      rating: '4.9',
      completedSales: 126,
    },
    verifiedNote: 'Listing verified today',
    shipFromTo: 'Ship to Sonny\'s Kicks · Miami',
  };

  const marketContext = {
    sizeLabel: '10.5',
    updatedAgo: '5 min ago',
    recentMarketSale: 240,
    thirtyDayAverage: 235,
    goSnkrAskingAverage: 220,
    suggestedRangeLow: 195,
    suggestedRangeHigh: 215,
  };

  const costBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    const offer = Number(offerValue) || 0;
    const buyerProtectionFee = 8;
    const shippingToYou = 12;
    const totalLandedCost = offer + buyerProtectionFee + shippingToYou;
    const expectedStorePrice = 260;
    const projectedProfit = expectedStorePrice - totalLandedCost;
    const marginPct = expectedStorePrice > 0 ? (projectedProfit / expectedStorePrice) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      offer,
      buyerProtectionFee,
      shippingToYou,
      totalLandedCost,
      expectedStorePrice,
      projectedProfit,
      marginPct,
    };
  }, [offerValue]);

  const handleReviewOffer = () => {
    setIsSending(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsSending(false);
      router.push('/screens/retailer/home/more/offerSuccessScreen');
    }, 600);
  };

  return {
    item,
    marketContext,
    quickOffers: QUICK_OFFERS,
    offerValue,
    setOfferValue,
    note,
    setNote,
    expiryOptions: EXPIRY_OPTIONS,
    expiry,
    setExpiry,
    costBreakdown,
    isSending,
    handleReviewOffer,
  };
};
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';

export const useNewDrop = () => {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    product: '',
    type: 'Raffle',
    date: '',
    time: '',
    quantity: '',
  });

  const updateField = (field: string, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleCreateDrop = () => {
    if (!formData.quantity) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Quantity Required',
        text2: 'Please specify how many pairs are available.',
      });
      return;
    }

    // Show the success toast
    Toast.show({
      type: 'success',
      text1: 'Drop Scheduled! 🚀',
      text2: `Your ${formData.type} drop is now active.`,
      visibilityTime: 2500,
    });

    // Delay the navigation slightly so the user sees the toast starting
    setTimeout(() => {
      router.back();
    }, 500); 
  };

  return { formData, updateField, handleCreateDrop };
};
```

```typescript
      type: 'success',
      text1: 'Promotion Sent! 📣',
      text2: `Sent to ~${reachMap[radius]} customers near you.`,
    });

    setTimeout(() => router.back(), 2000);
  };

  return {
    radius,
    setRadius,
    message,
    setMessage,
    subMessage,
    setSubMessage,
    customerCount: reachMap[radius],
    handleSend,
  };
};
```

```typescript
    sizeLabel: "Men's US 10",
    availableCount: 12,
    minPairs: 3,

      initials: 'GLW',

    },

    filterTags: ['All', 'Bulk Lots', 'Local Pickup', 'Ships'],
  },
];

export const useSourceInventory = () => {
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<SourceFilter>('All');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [shipTo] = useState("Sonny's Kicks · Novi");

  const listings = useMemo(() => {
    return ALL_LISTINGS.filter((listing) => {
      const matchesFilter = activeFilter === 'All' || listing.filterTags.includes(activeFilter);
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch =
        q.length === 0 ||
        listing.productName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        listing.supplier.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchesFilter && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [activeFilter, searchQuery]);

  const demandMatchCount = useMemo(
    () => ALL_LISTINGS.filter((l) => l.isDemandMatch).length,
    []
  );

  return {
    shipTo,
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    filters: FILTERS,
    activeFilter,
    setActiveFilter,
    listings,
    demandMatchCount,
  };
};
```

```typescript
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

export interface OperatingHour {
  day: string;
  shortDay: string;
  open: string;
  close: string;
  isEnabled: boolean;
}

export interface SocialLink {
  id: string;
  platform: 'instagram' | 'tiktok' | 'twitter' | 'facebook';
  handle: string;
}

export interface StoreProfileData {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  location: string;
  address: string;
  phone: string;
  website: string;
  coverImageUri?: string;
  avatarLabel: string;
  isVerified: boolean;
  isPublic: boolean;
  operatingHours: OperatingHour[];
  socialLinks: SocialLink[];
}

const DEFAULT_HOURS: OperatingHour[] = [
  { day: 'Monday', shortDay: 'Mon', open: '10:00 AM', close: '9:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Tuesday', shortDay: 'Tue', open: '10:00 AM', close: '9:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Wednesday', shortDay: 'Wed', open: '10:00 AM', close: '9:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Thursday', shortDay: 'Thu', open: '10:00 AM', close: '9:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Friday', shortDay: 'Fri', open: '10:00 AM', close: '10:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Saturday', shortDay: 'Sat', open: '10:00 AM', close: '8:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
  { day: 'Sunday', shortDay: 'Sun', open: '12:00 PM', close: '8:00 PM', isEnabled: true },
];

const DEFAULT_PROFILE: StoreProfileData = {
  name: "Sonny's Kicks",
  description:
    "Miami's destination for sneakers, apparel, new releases, and everyday essentials.",
  location: 'Miami, FL',
  address: '123 Ocean Drive, Miami, FL 33139',
  phone: '+1 (305) 555-0138',
  website: 'sonnykicks.com',
  avatarLabel: 'SK',
  isVerified: true,
  isPublic: true,
  operatingHours: DEFAULT_HOURS,
  socialLinks: [{ id: 'ig', platform: 'instagram', handle: '@SonnyKicks' }],
};

/** Groups consecutive days that share identical open/close/enabled state, e.g. "Mon – Thu". */
export function groupOperatingHours(hours: OperatingHour[]) {
  const groups: { label: string; open: string; close: string; isEnabled: boolean }[] = [];

  hours.forEach((h) => {
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (last && last.open === h.open && last.close === h.close && last.isEnabled === h.isEnabled) {
      // Extend the label range, e.g. "Mon" -> "Mon – Thu"
      const [start] = last.label.split(' – ');
      last.label = `${start} – ${h.shortDay}`;
    } else {
      groups.push({ label: h.shortDay, open: h.open, close: h.close, isEnabled: h.isEnabled });
    }
  });

  return groups;
}

export const useStoreProfile = () => {
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<StoreProfileData>(DEFAULT_PROFILE);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [hasUnsavedChanges, setHasUnsavedChanges] = useState(false);

  const markDirty = useCallback(() => setHasUnsavedChanges(true), []);

  const updateField = useCallback(
    <K extends keyof StoreProfileData>(key: K, value: StoreProfileData[K]) => {
      setProfile((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
      markDirty();
    },
    [markDirty]
  );

  const toggleDay = useCallback(
    (day: string) => {
      setProfile((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        operatingHours: prev.operatingHours.map((h) =>
          h.day === day ? { ...h, isEnabled: !h.isEnabled } : h
        ),
      }));
      markDirty();
    },
    [markDirty]
  );

  const updateHour = useCallback(
    (day: string, field: 'open' | 'close', value: string) => {
      setProfile((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        operatingHours: prev.operatingHours.map((h) =>
          h.day === day ? { ...h, [field]: value } : h
        ),
      }));
      markDirty();
    },
    [markDirty]
  );

  const copyHoursToAllDays = useCallback(() => {
    setProfile((prev) => {
      const source = prev.operatingHours.find((h) => h.isEnabled);
      if (!source) return prev;
      return {
        ...prev,
        operatingHours: prev.operatingHours.map((h) => ({
          ...h,
          open: source.open,
          close: source.close,
        })),
      };
    });
    markDirty();
  }, [markDirty]);

  const addSocialLink = useCallback(() => {
    setProfile((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      socialLinks: [
        ...prev.socialLinks,
        { id: `link-${Date.now()}`, platform: 'tiktok', handle: '' },
      ],
    }));
    markDirty();
  }, [markDirty]);

  const updateSocialLink = useCallback(
    (id: string, handle: string) => {
      setProfile((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        socialLinks: prev.socialLinks.map((link) =>
          link.id === id ? { ...link, handle } : link
        ),
      }));
      markDirty();
    },
    [markDirty]
  );

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 900));
      setHasUnsavedChanges(false);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handlePickCoverImage = useCallback(() => {
    // Replace with real image picker integration
  }, []);

  const groupedHours = useMemo(() => groupOperatingHours(profile.operatingHours), [
    profile.operatingHours,
  ]);

  return {
    profile,
    groupedHours,
    isSaving,
    hasUnsavedChanges,
    updateField,
    toggleDay,
    updateHour,
    copyHoursToAllDays,
    addSocialLink,
    updateSocialLink,
    handleSave,
    handlePickCoverImage,
  };
};
```

```typescript
  },
];

export const useCreatePromotion = () => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<PromotionStep>('details');

  // Promotion type
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<PromotionType>('Flash Sale');

  // Promotion details
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('Weekend Flash Sale — 20% Off Jordans');

  // Product targeting
  const [keywords, setKeywords] = useState<string[]>(['Jordan', 'Retro']);
  const [keywordInput, setKeywordInput] = useState('');
  const [categoryTags, setCategoryTags] = useState<CategoryTag[]>(['Sneakers']);
  const [matchRule, setMatchRule] = useState<MatchRule>('Match any keyword');
  const activeListingsMatched = 48;

  // Discount
  const [discountType, setDiscountType] = useState<DiscountType>('% off');
  const [discountValue, setDiscountValue] = useState('20');
  const [startsAt] = useState('Fri, Jun 7, 6:00 PM');
  const [endsAt] = useState('Sun, Jun 9, 9:00 PM');

  // Push notification
  const [notificationMessage, setNotificationMessage] = useState(
    'This weekend only: Save 20% on selected Jordans while supplies last.'
  );
  const notificationCharLimit = 200;

  // Audience
  const [selectedAudience, setSelectedAudience] = useState<Record<AudienceSegment['id'], boolean>>({
    store_followers: true,
    nearby_opted_in: true,
    size_match: true,
  });

  // Delivery
  const [deliveryOption, setDeliveryOption] = useState<DeliveryOption>('schedule');
  const [scheduledAt] = useState('Friday, Jun 7, 6:00 PM');

  const toggleKeyword = useCallback((kw: string) => {
    setKeywords((prev) => prev.filter((k) => k !== kw));
  }, []);

  const addKeyword = useCallback(() => {
    const trimmed = keywordInput.trim();
    if (trimmed.length === 0) return;
    setKeywords((prev) => (prev.includes(trimmed) ? prev : [...prev, trimmed]));
    setKeywordInput('');
  }, [keywordInput]);

  const toggleCategoryTag = useCallback((tag: CategoryTag) => {
    setCategoryTags((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tag) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tag) : [...prev, tag]
    );
  }, []);

  const toggleAudienceSegment = useCallback((id: AudienceSegment['id']) => {
    setSelectedAudience((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: !prev[id] }));
  }, []);

  const estimatedUniqueReach = useMemo(() => {
    // Rough de-duplicated estimate across selected segments, matching the mock's ~1,842 figure.
    const selectedCounts = AUDIENCE_SEGMENTS.filter((seg) => selectedAudience[seg.id]).map(
      (seg) => seg.count
    );
    if (selectedCounts.length === 0) return 0;
    const raw = selectedCounts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c, 0);
    // Apply an overlap discount so combined reach isn't a naive sum.
    return Math.round(raw * 0.735);
  }, [selectedAudience]);

  const canGoToAudience = title.trim().length > 0 && keywords.length > 0;
  const canGoToReview = Object.values(selectedAudience).some(Boolean);
  const canSubmit = canGoToAudience && canGoToReview;

  const goToStep = useCallback((next: PromotionStep) => {
    setStep(next);
  }, []);

  const goNext = useCallback(() => {
    if (step === 'details' && canGoToAudience) setStep('audience');
    else if (step === 'audience' && canGoToReview) setStep('review');
  }, [step, canGoToAudience, canGoToReview]);

  const goBack = useCallback(() => {
    if (step === 'audience') setStep('details');
    else if (step === 'review') setStep('audience');
  }, [step]);

  return {
    step,
    goToStep,
    goNext,
    goBack,

    promotionTypes: PROMOTION_TYPES,
    selectedType,
    setSelectedType,

    title,
    setTitle,

    keywords,
    keywordInput,
    setKeywordInput,
    addKeyword,
    toggleKeyword,
    categoryTags,
    availableCategoryTags: CATEGORY_TAGS,
    toggleCategoryTag,
    matchRule,
    setMatchRule,
    activeListingsMatched,

    discountType,
    setDiscountType,
    discountValue,
    setDiscountValue,
    startsAt,
    endsAt,

    notificationMessage,
    setNotificationMessage,
    notificationCharLimit,

    audienceSegments: AUDIENCE_SEGMENTS,
    selectedAudience,
    toggleAudienceSegment,
    estimatedUniqueReach,

    deliveryOption,
    setDeliveryOption,
    scheduledAt,

    canGoToAudience,
    canGoToReview,
    canSubmit,
  };
};
```

```typescript
// services/hooks/store/useRadiusPromotion.ts
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export type RadiusOption = 5 | 10 | 25

export function useRadiusPromotion() {
  const [selectedRadius, setSelectedRadius] = useState<RadiusOption>(5)
  const [message,        setMessage]        = useState('')
  const [loading,        setLoading]        = useState(false)

  const RADIUS_CUSTOMERS: Record<RadiusOption, number> = {
    5:  2400,
    10: 5800,
    25: 12000,
  }

  const estimatedCustomers = RADIUS_CUSTOMERS[selectedRadius]

  const handleSend = useCallback(async (onSuccess: () => void) => {
    if (!message.trim()) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Add a message', text2: 'Please write a promotion message' })
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200))
    setLoading(false)
    Toast.show({
      type: 'success',
      text1: 'Promotion Sent!',
      text2: `Sent to ~${estimatedCustomers.toLocaleString()} people`,
    })
    onSuccess()
  }, [message, estimatedCustomers])

  return {
    selectedRadius, setSelectedRadius,
    message, setMessage,
    estimatedCustomers,
    loading,
    handleSend,
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type ClaimStatus =
  | 'pending'
  | 'approved'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'auto_approved'
  | 'dismissed';

export type CancelledBy = 'store' | 'customer' | 'system';

export interface ClaimCustomer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatarLabel: string;
  avatarColor: string;
  handle: string;
  totalPurchases: number;
  pastClaims: number;
  rating: number;
}

export interface ClaimOrder {
  productName: string;
  productBrand: string;
  size: string;
  gender: string;
  imageUri?: string;
  imageBg: string;
  holdPlacedAt: string;
  depositAmount: number;
  cancelledBy: CancelledBy;
  sku?: string;
}

export interface RefundClaim {
  id: string;
  claimNumber: string;
  status: ClaimStatus;
  reason: string;
  submittedAt: string;
  deadlineIso: string;
  deadlineDisplay: string;
  customer: ClaimCustomer;
  order: ClaimOrder;
}

// ─── Countdown hook ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const useCountdown = (deadlineIso: string) => {
  const calc = () => {
    const diff = new Date(deadlineIso).getTime() - Date.now();
    if (diff <= 0) return { h: '00', m: '00', s: '00', expired: true };
    const total = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
    const h = String(Math.floor(total / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
    const m = String(Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const s = String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    return { h, m, s, expired: false };
  };

  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(calc);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => setRemaining(calc()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [deadlineIso]);

  return remaining;
};

// ─── Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const MOCK_CLAIMS: RefundClaim[] = [
  {
    id: 'claim-1',
    claimNumber: 'HF-00415',
    status: 'pending',
    reason: 'Store cancelled the hold',
    submittedAt: 'Apr 04, 2025 · 3:42 PM',
    deadlineIso: new Date(Date.now() + 22 * 3600 * 1000 + 46 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
    deadlineDisplay: 'Apr 05, 10:32 AM',
    customer: {
      id: 'cust-1',
      name: 'Sonny Garcia',
      avatarLabel: 'SG',
      avatarColor: '#00C853',
      handle: '@sonny · DJ1234Member',
      totalPurchases: 13,
      pastClaims: 0,
      rating: 4,
    },
    order: {
      productName: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'",
      productBrand: 'JORDAN',
      size: '11.5',
      gender: "Men's",
      imageBg: '#1F2937',
      holdPlacedAt: 'Apr 04, 2025 · 10:30 AM',
      depositAmount: 44,
      cancelledBy: 'store',
    },
  },
];

export const useClaims = () => {
  const [claims, setClaims] = useState<RefundClaim[]>(MOCK_CLAIMS);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  const newClaims = claims.filter(c => c.status === 'pending');
  const previousClaims = claims.filter(c =>
    ['approved', 'rejected', 'auto_approved'].includes(c.status),
  );

  const updateStatus = useCallback(async (id: string, status: ClaimStatus) => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800));
      setClaims(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, status } : c));
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleApproveClaim = useCallback(
    (id: string) => updateStatus(id, 'approved'), [updateStatus]);

  const handleRejectClaim = useCallback(
    (id: string) => updateStatus(id, 'rejected'), [updateStatus]);

  const handleDismiss = useCallback(
    (id: string) => updateStatus(id, 'dismissed'), [updateStatus]);

  const handleViewCustomerProfile = useCallback((customerId: string) => {
    console.log('view customer', customerId);
  }, []);

  return {
    newClaims,
    previousClaims,
    isProcessing,
    handleApproveClaim,
    handleRejectClaim,
    handleDismiss,
    handleViewCustomerProfile,
  };
};
```

```typescript
    overall: 0,
    customerService: 0,
    authenticity: 0,
    pricing: 0,
    storeExperience: 0,
    staffHelpfulness: 0,
    pickupSpeed: 0,
  });
  const [experience, setExperience] = useState('');
  const [isAnonymous, setIsAnonymous] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const updateRating = (category: keyof ReviewRatings, value: number) => {
    setRatings(prev => ({ ...prev, [category]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (onSuccess: () => void) => {
    if (ratings.overall === 0) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Please provide an overall rating' });
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      // Simulate API call
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
      Toast.show({ type: 'success', text1: 'Review submitted successfully!' });
      onSuccess();
    } catch (error) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Failed to submit review' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    ratings,
    experience,
    setExperience,
    isAnonymous,
    setIsAnonymous,
    updateRating,
    handleSubmit,
    loading,
  };
};
```

```typescript
export type OrderStatus = 'new' | 'holding' | 'ready' | 'completed' | 'cancelled';

export type OrderTag = 'BUY NOW' | 'DETAILS' | 'PICKUP';

export interface Order {
    id: string;
    orderNumber: string;
    status: OrderStatus;
    tag: OrderTag;
    productName: string;
    size: string;
    gender: string;
    customerName: string;
    price: number;
    timeAgo: string;
    imageUrl?: string;
    // New order — urgency to confirm
    confirmWithinMinutes?: number;
    inventoryReserved?: boolean;
    // Holding — deposit + expiry
    expiresIn?: string;
    depositPaid?: boolean;
    depositAmount?: number;
    // Ready — pickup wait tracking
    readySince?: string;
    customerNotified?: boolean;
    waitingSince?: string;
    // Completed / cancelled
    completedDate?: string;
    cancelledDate?: string;
    cancelledBy?: string;
}
```

```typescript
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';

import OTPInput, { OTPInputHandle } from '@/components/auth/OtpInput';
import { useEmailOtp } from '@/services/hooks/auth/useEmailOtp';
import { router, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';
import { useRef } from 'react';

export default function EmailOtpScreen() {
  const { from } = useLocalSearchParams<{ from: string }>();
  const otpRef = useRef<OTPInputHandle | null>(null);
  const { loading, countdown, handleChange, handleContinue, handleResend } = useEmailOtp({ otpRef, from });

  const onSuccess = () => {
    if (from === 'forgot-password') {
      router.replace('/auth/resetPasswordScreen');
    } else {
      router.replace('/profilesetup/sizeScreen');
    }
  };

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>
        <View style={{ flexGrow: 1, justifyContent: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 24, paddingVertical: 40 }}>


          {/* Header */}
          <View className="items-center mb-8">
            <Text className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
              OTP Verification
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-base text-gray-500 text-center">
              Enter 6 digits code that received on{'\n'}your email
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* OTP Input */}
          <View className="items-center mb-6">
            <OTPInput
              ref={otpRef}
              length={6}
              onChange={handleChange}
              onComplete={(code) => handleContinue(code, onSuccess)}
            />
          </View>

          {/* Loading */}
          {loading && (
            <Text className="text-center text-base text-[#22C55E] mb-4">
              Verifying...
            </Text>
          )}

          {/* Resend */}
          <View className="items-center mb-6">
            {countdown > 0 ? (
              <Text className="text-base text-gray-500">
                Resend code{' '}
                <Text className="text-[#22C55E] font-semibold">
                  {String(Math.floor(countdown / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:
                  {String(countdown % 60).padStart(2, '0')}
                </Text>
              </Text>
            ) : (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleResend} disabled={loading}>
                <Text className="text-base text-gray-500">
                  Resend code{' '}
                  <Text className="text-[#22C55E] font-semibold">Now</Text>
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Wrong email */}
          <View className="items-center mt-4">
            <Text className="text-base text-gray-500">
              Wrong email?{' '}
              <Text
                className="text-[#22C55E] font-semibold"
                onPress={() => !loading && router.replace({
                  pathname: '/auth/verifyEmailScreen',
                  params: { from: from ?? 'registration' },
                })}
              >
                Change it
              </Text>
            </Text>
          </View>

        </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { View, Text } from 'react-native';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import PasswordField from '@/components/shared/PasswordField';
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button';
import { useResetPassword } from '@/services/hooks/auth/useResetPassword';
import { router } from 'expo-router';

export default function ResetPasswordScreen() {
  const { form, errors, loading, strength, updateField, handleSave } = useResetPassword();

  const onSuccess = () => {
    router.replace('/auth/signInScreen');
  };

  const strengthColors = ['#EF4444', '#F97316', '#EAB308', '#22C55E'];
  const strengthLabels = ['Weak', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Strong'];

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>

        <View
          style={{
            flexGrow: 1,
            justifyContent: 'center',
            paddingHorizontal: 24,
            paddingVertical: 40,
          }}
        >

          {/* Header */}
          <View className="items-center mb-8">
            <Text className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
              Reset Password
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-base text-gray-500 text-center">
              Change your password
            </Text>
          </View>

          {/* New Password */}
          <Text className="text-base text-gray-700 font-medium mb-2">
            New Password
          </Text>
          <PasswordField
          focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
            value={form.password}
            onChangeText={(val) => updateField('password', val)}
            placeholder="New Password"
            error={errors.password}
          />

          {/* Password Strength Bar */}
          {form.password.length > 0 && (
            <View className="mt-3 mb-1">
              <View className="flex-row gap-1 mb-1">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                  <View
                    key={i}
                    style={{
                      flex: 1,
                      height: 4,
                      borderRadius: 4,
                      backgroundColor: i < strength ? strengthColors[strength - 1] : '#E5E7EB',
                    }}
                  />
                ))}
              </View>
              <Text
                style={{ color: strengthColors[strength - 1] ?? '#E5E7EB' }}
                className="text-xs font-medium text-right"
              >
                {strength > 0 ? strengthLabels[strength - 1] : ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Confirm Password */}
          <Text className="text-base text-gray-700 font-medium mb-2 mt-4">
            Confirm Password
          </Text>
          <PasswordField
          focusedBorderColor='#22C55E'
            value={form.confirmPassword}
            onChangeText={(val) => updateField('confirmPassword', val)}
            placeholder="Confirm Password"
            error={errors.confirmPassword}
          />

          {/* Save Button */}
          <Button
            text="Save"
            variant="solid"
            backgroundColor='#000000'
            height={60}
            width="100%"
            borderRadius={14}
            fontSize={18}
            fontWeight="700"
            disabled={loading}
            onPress={() => handleSave(onSuccess)}
            style={{ marginTop: 24 }}
          />

        </View>

    </BaseContainer>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router'
import { usePickBrands } from '@/services/hooks/profilesetup/usePickBrands'
import BrandCard from '@/components/profilesetup/BrandCard'
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const NUM_COLUMNS = 3

export default function PickBrandsScreen() {
    const router = useRouter()
    const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ brands?: string }>()

    const {
        brands,
        selectedIds,
        setSelectedIds,
        search,
        setSearch,
        toggleBrand,
        handleContinue,
        loading,
        selectedCount,
    } = usePickBrands()

    // Preselect brands from params
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (params.brands) {
            const paramIds = params.brands.split(',')
            setSelectedIds(new Set(paramIds))
        }
    }, [params.brands, setSelectedIds])

    const onContinue = () => {
        if (params.brands) {
            // Came from profile edit → save then go back
            handleContinue(() => router.back())
        } else {
            // Came from onboarding → go to next screen
            handleContinue(() => router.push('/tabs/discoverScreen'))
        }
    }

    const rows: typeof brands[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < brands.length; i += NUM_COLUMNS) {
        rows.push(brands.slice(i, i + NUM_COLUMNS))
    }

    return (
        <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>
            <View className="flex-1 justify-center px-6 pt-20">
                <View className="mb-5">
                    <Text className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 mb-1">Pick your brands</Text>
                    <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 leading-5">
                        See drops and restocks from the brands you actually wear.
                    </Text>
                </View>

                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 mb-4">
                    <View className="flex-1 flex-row items-center bg-gray-100 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200">
                        <Text className="text-sm mr-2">🔍</Text>
                        <TextInput
                            className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900 p-0"
                            placeholder="Search brands..."
                            placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                            value={search}
                            onChangeText={setSearch}
                            returnKeyType="search"
                        />
                    </View>
                    {selectedCount > 0 && (
                        <View className="bg-gray-900 rounded-full px-3 py-1">
                            <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{selectedCount} selected</Text>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>

                <ScrollView className="mb-4">
                    {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
                        <View key={rowIndex} className="flex-row gap-2 mb-2">
                            {row.map(brand => (
                                <BrandCard
                                    key={brand.id}
                                    brand={brand}
                                    selected={selectedIds.has(brand.id)}
                                    onPress={toggleBrand}
                                />
                            ))}
                            {row.length < NUM_COLUMNS &&
                                Array.from({ length: NUM_COLUMNS - row.length }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <View key={`empty-${i}`} className="flex-1" />
                                ))}
                        </View>
                    ))}

                    <View className="flex-row gap-2 mb-2">
                        <TouchableOpacity className="flex-1 aspect-square rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-100 items-center justify-center gap-1">
                            <Text className="text-lg text-gray-500 font-light">+</Text>
                            <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-500 text-center">More brands</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                        <View className="flex-1" />
                        <View className="flex-1" />
                    </View>
                </ScrollView>

                <View className="px-5 pb-7 pt-3 items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                        text={loading ? 'Saving...' : 'Continue'}
                        onPress={onContinue}
                        disabled={selectedCount === 0 || loading}
                        variant="solid"
                        backgroundColor="#111827"
                        height={56}
                        borderRadius={14}
                        fontSize={16}
                        fontWeight="700"
                        opacity={selectedCount === 0 || loading ? 0.5 : 1}
                        style={{ flex: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch' }}
                    />
                    {!params.brands && (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            className="py-1"
                            onPress={() => router.push('/')}
                            activeOpacity={0.7}
                            disabled={loading}
                        >
                            <Text className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-400">Skip for now</Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                    <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-300 text-center">
                        You can change this anytime in Settings
                    </Text>
                </View>
            </View>
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}
```

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Text,
  Platform,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from 'react-native';
import { Tabs } from 'expo-router';
import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  withSpring,
  useSharedValue,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';
const ACTIVE_COLOR = '#000000';
const INACTIVE_COLOR = '#94a3b8';
const DOT_COLOR = '#22C55E';
const BAR_BG = '#FFFFFF';

/**
 * Route-based config (robust, order-independent)
 */
const tabMap: Record<
  string,
  { label: string; icon: any; activeIcon: any }
> = {
  dashboard: {
    label: 'Dashboard',
    icon: 'home-variant-outline', // Clean geometric house outline
    activeIcon: 'home-variant',    // Solid house for active state
  },
  listing: {
    label: 'Listing',
    icon: 'package-variant-closed', // Box/Cube icon as seen in the image
    activeIcon: 'package-variant-closed',
  },
  requests: {
    label: 'Requests',
    icon: 'tray-full', // Tray/Inbox style icon shown in the middle
    activeIcon: 'tray-full',
  },
  messages: {
    label: 'Messages',
    icon: 'chat-outline', // Clean square speech bubble
    activeIcon: 'chat',
  },
  profile: {
    label: 'Profile',
    icon: 'account-outline', // Standard outline person icon
    activeIcon: 'account',
  },
};
const AnimatedTabItem = ({
  isFocused,
  navigation,
  route,
}: any) => {
  const config = tabMap[route.name];
  if (!config) return null;

  const iconScale = useSharedValue(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);

  useEffect(() => {
    iconScale.value = withSpring(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);
  }, [isFocused]);

  const iconStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: iconScale.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => navigation.navigate(route.name)}
      style={styles.tabItem}
      activeOpacity={0.7}
    >
      <View style={styles.iconWrapper}>
        <Animated.View style={iconStyle}>
          <MaterialCommunityIcons
            name={isFocused ? config.activeIcon : config.icon}
            size={26}
            color={isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR}
          />
        </Animated.View>
      </View>

      <Text
        style={[
          styles.label,
          {
            color: isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR,
            fontWeight: isFocused ? '700' : '500',
          },
        ]}
      >
        {config.label}
      </Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
};

const CustomTabBar = ({ state, navigation }: any) => {
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const TAB_BAR_WIDTH = width;
  const TAB_WIDTH = TAB_BAR_WIDTH / state.routes.length;

  const translateX = useSharedValue(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    translateX.value = withSpring(state.index * TAB_WIDTH, {
      damping: 20,
      stiffness: 150,
    });
  }, [state.index]);

  const dotStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ translateX: translateX.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <View style={styles.tabBarContainer}>
      <View style={[styles.tabBarInner, { width: TAB_BAR_WIDTH }]}>
        {/* Sliding Dot */}
        <Animated.View
          style={[
            styles.slidingDotContainer,
            { width: TAB_WIDTH },
            dotStyle,
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
        </Animated.View>

        {state.routes.map((route: any, index: number) => {
          const isFocused = state.index === index;

          return (
            <AnimatedTabItem
              key={route.key}
              route={route}
              isFocused={isFocused}
              navigation={navigation}
            />
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  tabBarContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    bottom: 0,                          // flush to bottom
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  tabBarInner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: BAR_BG,
    height: 75,
    borderRadius: 0,                    // no rounding — flat/square
    borderWidth: 0,
    borderTopWidth: 1,                  // only top border
    borderTopColor: '#F1F5F9',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },   // shadow upward
    shadowOpacity: 0.05,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 10,
    width: '100%',                      // full width, not 95%
    paddingBottom: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 20 : 0, // safe area on iOS
  },
  tabItem: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    zIndex: 2,
  },
  iconWrapper: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    height: 28,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  slidingDotContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    height: 75,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    zIndex: 1,
  },
  activeDot: {
    width: 6,
    height: 6,
    borderRadius: 3,
    backgroundColor: DOT_COLOR,
    marginTop: 10,
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: 14,
    marginTop: 4,
  },
});

export default function TabLayout() {
  return (
    <Tabs
      screenOptions={{
        headerShown: false,
        tabBarStyle: { display: 'none' },
      }}
      tabBar={(props) => <CustomTabBar {...props} />}
    >
      <Tabs.Screen name="dashboard" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="listing" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="requests" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="messages" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="profile" />
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import {
  Image,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { useInventory } from '@/services/hooks/reseller/listing/useListing'

const Inventory = () => {
  const { stats, inventory, activeTab, setActiveTab, tabs, tabCounts } = useInventory()

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="pt-10 pb-20 mb-20">
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity>
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color="black" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>My Inventory</Text>
          <View style={styles.headerIcons}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={{ marginRight: 20 }}>
              <Ionicons name="filter-outline" size={22} color="black" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity>
              <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={22} color="black" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>

        <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
          <View className="pt-4 pb-20">
            <View style={styles.summaryBar}>
              <SummaryItem label="Total" value={stats.total} color="#111827" />
              <SummaryItem label="Visible" value={stats.visible} color="#22C55E" />
              <SummaryItem label="Private" value={stats.privateCount} color="#F59E0B" />
              <SummaryItem label="Requests" value={stats.liveRequests} color="#2563EB" />
            </View>

            <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.tabScroll}>
              {tabs.map((tab) => {
                const isActive = activeTab === tab
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={tab}
                    onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                    style={[styles.tabChip, isActive && styles.tabChipActive]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.tabText, isActive && styles.tabTextActive]}>
                      {tab} ({tabCounts[tab]})
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )
              })}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'

import { router } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import InventoryCard from '@/components/retailer/inventory/InventoryCard'
import InventoryFilter from '@/components/retailer/inventory/InventoryFilter'
import InventoryHeader from '@/components/retailer/inventory/InventoryHeader'
import InventoryActions from '@/components/retailer/inventory/InventoryActions'
import InventoryStats from '@/components/retailer/inventory/InventoryStats'
import {
  useInventory,
  InventoryProduct,
} from '@/services/hooks/retailer/inventory/useInventory'

export const InventoryScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    activeFilter,
    filterTabs,
    filterCounts,
    summary,
    syncInfo,
    filteredProducts,
    isRefreshing,
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, TextInput } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { Feather, MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer';
import {
  useCreatePromotion,
  type PromotionTypeOption,
  type CategoryTag,
  type AudienceSegment,
  type PromotionStep,
} from '@/services/hooks/retailer/promote/useCreatePromotion';

const STEPS: { key: PromotionStep; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'details', label: 'Details' },
  { key: 'audience', label: 'Audience' },
  { key: 'review', label: 'Review' },
];

export default function CreatePromotionScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const promo = useCreatePromotion();

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View style={{ paddingBottom: 120 }}>
        {/* Header */}
        <View style={s.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => router.back()} hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}>
            <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <Text style={s.headerTitle}>Create Promotion</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.push('/screens/retailer/promote/promotionHistoryScreen')}
            style={s.historyBtn}
          >
            <Feather name="clock" size={15} color="#10B981" />
            <Text style={s.historyText}>History</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* Stepper */}
        <View style={s.stepperRow}>
          {STEPS.map((st, i) => (
            <React.Fragment key={st.key}>
              <StepDot
                index={i + 1}
                label={st.label}
                state={getStepState(st.key, promo.step)}
                onPress={() => promo.goToStep(st.key)}
              />
              {i < STEPS.length - 1 && <View style={s.stepConnector} />}
            </React.Fragment>
          ))}
        </View>

        <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 20 }}>
          {promo.step === 'details' && <DetailsStep promo={promo} />}
          {promo.step === 'audience' && <AudienceStep promo={promo} />}
          {promo.step === 'review' && <ReviewStep promo={promo} />}
        </View>

        {/* Footer button */}
        <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, marginTop: 24 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              s.reviewBtn,
              promo.step === 'review'
                ? { opacity: promo.canSubmit ? 1 : 0.5 }
                : { opacity: promo.step === 'details' ? (promo.canGoToAudience ? 1 : 0.5) : promo.canGoToReview ? 1 : 0.5 },
            ]}
            disabled={promo.step === 'review' ? !promo.canSubmit : promo.step === 'details' ? !promo.canGoToAudience : !promo.canGoToReview}
            onPress={promo.step === 'review' ? undefined : promo.goNext}
          >
            <Text style={s.reviewBtnText}>
              {promo.step === 'review' ? 'Review Promotion' : promo.step === 'details' ? 'Continue to Audience' : 'Continue to Review'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          {promo.step === 'review' && (
            <Text style={s.reviewFootnote}>Nothing will be sent until you confirm on the next screen.</Text>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  );
}

function getStepState(key: PromotionStep, current: PromotionStep): 'done' | 'active' | 'upcoming' {
  const order: PromotionStep[] = ['details', 'audience', 'review'];
  const curIdx = order.indexOf(current);
  const idx = order.indexOf(key);
  if (idx < curIdx) return 'done';
  if (idx === curIdx) return 'active';
  return 'upcoming';
}

function StepDot({
  index,
  label,
  state,
  onPress,
}: {
  index: number;
  label: string;
  state: 'done' | 'active' | 'upcoming';
  onPress: () => void;
}) {
  const bg = state === 'upcoming' ? '#F3F4F6' : '#10B981';
  const textColor = state === 'upcoming' ? '#9CA3AF' : '#fff';
  const labelColor = state === 'upcoming' ? '#9CA3AF' : '#111827';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity onPress={onPress} style={s.stepDotWrap} disabled={state === 'upcoming'}>
      <View style={[s.stepDot, { backgroundColor: bg }]}>
        {state === 'done' ? (
          <Feather name="check" size={13} color="#fff" />
        ) : (
          <Text style={{ color: textColor, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '800' }}>{index}</Text>
        )}
      </View>
      <Text style={[s.stepLabel, { color: labelColor }]}>{label}</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------- DETAILS STEP ------------------------------- */

      <View style={s.keywordChipsRow}>

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={onSelect}

        s.typeChip,

    >

        <MaterialCommunityIcons name="bullhorn-outline" size={20} color={selected ? option.color : '#9CA3AF'} />

      )}
      <Text style={[s.typeChipText, selected && { color: option.color, fontWeight: '800' }]}>

        <Text style={s.audienceDescription}>{segment.description}</Text>
      </View>
      <Text style={s.audienceCount}>{segment.count.toLocaleString()}</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------- REVIEW STEP ------------------------------- */

function ReviewStep({ promo }: { promo: ReturnType<typeof useCreatePromotion> }) {
  const selectedSegments = promo.audienceSegments.filter((seg) => promo.selectedAudience[seg.id]);

  return (
    <View>
      <Text style={s.sectionTitle}>Review your promotion</Text>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Type</Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardValue}>{promo.selectedType}</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Title</Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardValue}>{promo.title}</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Discount</Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardValue}>
          {promo.discountType === '% off' ? `${promo.discountValue}% off` : promo.discountType}
        </Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardSubvalue}>
          {promo.startsAt} → {promo.endsAt}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Keywords</Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardValue}>{promo.keywords.join(', ') || '—'}</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Audience</Text>
        {selectedSegments.map((seg) => (
          <Text key={seg.id} style={s.reviewCardSubvalue}>
            • {seg.label} ({seg.count.toLocaleString()})
          </Text>
        ))}
        <Text style={[s.reviewCardValue, { marginTop: 6 }]}>
          Est. reach: {promo.estimatedUniqueReach.toLocaleString()} people
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View style={s.reviewCard}>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardLabel}>Delivery</Text>
        <Text style={s.reviewCardValue}>
          {promo.deliveryOption === 'send_now' ? 'Send now' : `Scheduled · ${promo.scheduledAt}`}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
          <View className="px-4 mt-5">
            <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3">Select Hold Duration</Text>
            <View className="flex-row gap-2">

                return (

                      {d.label}

                      ${d.deposit}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )
              })}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="h-36" />
        </ScrollView>

        {/* ── Sticky CTA ── */}
        <View className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 px-4 pb-8 pt-3 bg-white border-t border-gray-100">
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handlePlaceHold}
```

```typescript
// ─── Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const StoreListScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { productId } = useLocalSearchParams<{ productId: string }>()
  const { stores, productName, loading } = useStoreList(productId)

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')

    .filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || s.address.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortKey === 'distance') return a.distanceMi - b.distanceMi
      if (sortKey === 'price') return a.price - b.price
      if (sortKey === 'rating') return b.rating - a.rating
      return 0
    })

          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#22C55E" />

  return (

          </TouchableOpacity>

              {stores.length} Stores Have This
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-center text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5" numberOfLines={1}>
              {productName}
            </Text>
          </View>
          <View className="w-6" />
        </View>

        <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} bounces>

          {/* ── Search ── */}
          <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-center gap-3 bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3">
            <Feather name="search" size={16} color="#9CA3AF" />
            <TextInput
              value={search}
              onChangeText={setSearch}
              placeholder="Search stores or areas..."
              placeholderTextColor="#D1D5DB"
              className="flex-1 text-sm text-gray-800"
            />
            {search.length > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearch('')}>
                <Feather name="x" size={15} color="#9CA3AF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* ── Sort pills ── */}
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 12, gap: 8 }}
          >
            {SORT_OPTIONS.map(opt => {
              const active = sortKey === opt.key
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={opt.key}
                  onPress={() => setSortKey(opt.key)}
                  activeOpacity={0.75}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full border ${
                    active ? 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-900' : 'bg-white border-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Text className={`text-xs font-bold ${active ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
                    {opt.label}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              )
            })}
          </ScrollView>

          {/* ── Store list ── */}
          {sortedStores.length === 0 ? (
            <View className="items-center justify-center py-20">
              <Feather name="search" size={36} color="#D1D5DB" />
              <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-3 font-medium">No stores match your search</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            sortedStores.map((store, i) => (
              <StoreCard
                key={store.storeId}
                store={store}
                colorIndex={i}
                onPress={() => handleStorePress(store)}
              />
            ))
          )}

          <View className="h-10" />
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default StoreListScreen
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
```

```typescript
import { useFollowing } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useFollowing'

import AlertFilterChips from '@/components/profile/following/AlertFilterChips'

                <BrandCard brand={b} onPress={() => { }} />

            ))}
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { useJoinWaitlist, WaitlistProduct } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useJoinWaitlist'
import { WaitlistSteps } from '@/components/profile/waitlist/WishListSteps'
import { NotifyLocationSelector } from '@/components/profile/waitlist/NotifyLocationSelector'

const MOCK_PRODUCT: WaitlistProduct = {
  id: 'mock-1',
  brand: 'JORDAN',
  name: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'",
  size: '10.5',
  gender: "Men's",
  waitingCount: 47,
  demand: 'high',
}

const BENEFITS = [
  'We monitor all nearby stores for your size',
  'You get first-priority notification when restocked',
  'Your spot in line is saved — first joined, first notified',
  'You can cancel anytime',
]

export const JoinWaitlistScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()

  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ product?: string }>()
  const product: WaitlistProduct = params.product
    ? (JSON.parse(params.product) as WaitlistProduct)
    : MOCK_PRODUCT

  const {

    alertPriceDrop,
    loading,
    joined,
    selectedStores,
    handleSelectLocation,
    handleTogglePriceDrop,
    handleChooseStores,

    handleLeaveWaitlist,

  // Dynamic values for the demand bar
  const demandColorClass =
    product.demand === 'high' ? 'bg-red-500' :
      product.demand === 'medium' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-green-500';

  const demandTextClass =
    product.demand === 'high' ? 'text-red-500' :
      product.demand === 'medium' ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-green-500';

  const progressWidth = Math.min((product.waitingCount / 100) * 100, 100);

  return (

          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View className="w-9" />

          contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 32 }}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {/* Product Hero */}
          <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 items-center mb-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-50">

                <Ionicons name="footsteps-outline" size={48} color="#9ca3af" />
              </View>
            )}

            <Text className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 text-center mb-1">{product.name}</Text>
            <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center">
              Size {product.size} {product.gender} — Sold out at all nearby stores

          {/* Steps */}

          {/* Benefits Box */}

            {BENEFITS.map((benefit, i) => (
              <View key={i} className="flex-row gap-x-2 items-start">
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={16} color="#22c55e" style={{ marginTop: 2 }} />

                className={`h-full rounded-full ${demandColorClass}`}
                style={{ width: `${progressWidth}%` }}
              />
            </View>
            {product.demand === 'high' && (
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-x-1">
                <Ionicons name="flame" size={14} color="#ef4444" />
                <Text className={`text-[12px] font-bold ${demandTextClass}`}>High demand</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          <NotifyLocationSelector
            selected={notifyLocation}

            onChooseStores={handleChooseStores}   // now passes string[] up
            selectedStoreIds={selectedStores}

          {/* Price Drop Toggle */}

            </View>
            <Switch
              value={alertPriceDrop}
              onValueChange={handleTogglePriceDrop}
              trackColor={{ false: '#e0e0e0', true: '#22c55e' }}
              thumbColor="#fff"
            />
          </View>

          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 text-center mt-1">Already on 3 other waitlists</Text>
        </ScrollView>

        {/* CTA Button Container */}

          {joined ? (

                </Text>

              <TouchableOpacity
                className="rounded-xl py-3 items-center border-[1.5px] border-red-500"
                onPress={handleLeaveWaitlist}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
                disabled={loading}
              >
                {loading ? (

                ) : (
                  <Text className="text-red-500 font-bold text-sm">Leave Waitlist</Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <TouchableOpacity
              className={`bg-green-500 rounded-2xl py-4 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-x-2 ${loading ? 'opacity-70' : ''}`}
              onPress={handleJoinWaitlist}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Image } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import {
  useMySales,
  STATUS_COLOR,
  SaleItem,
  SaleTab,
} from '@/services/hooks/profile/useMySales'

const TABS: SaleTab[] = ['All', 'Active Listings', 'Offers Received', 'Completed']

const TabBar: React.FC<{ active: SaleTab; onChange: (t: SaleTab) => void }> = ({
  active,
  onChange,
}) => (
  <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} className="mb-4">
    <View className="flex-row gap-2 pr-4">
      {TABS.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = tab === active
        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={tab}
            onPress={() => onChange(tab)}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border ${
              isActive ? 'bg-gray-900 border-gray-900' : 'bg-white border-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Text className={`text-xs font-semibold ${isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
              {tab}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )
      })}
    </View>
  </ScrollView>
)

const SectionLabel: React.FC<{ label: string }> = ({ label }) => (
  <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest uppercase mb-2 mt-5">
    {label}
  </Text>
)

const StatusDot: React.FC<{ status: SaleItem['status'] }> = ({ status }) => {
  const bgColor = STATUS_COLOR[status]
  const icon =
    status === 'Sold'
      ? 'check'
      : status === 'Active'
        ? 'radio'
        : status === 'Pending'
          ? 'clock'
          : 'x'

  return (
    <View className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full items-center justify-center" style={{ backgroundColor: bgColor }}>
      <Feather name={icon} size={10} color="#fff" />
    </View>
  )
}

const SaleSubLine: React.FC<{ item: SaleItem }> = ({ item }) => {
  if (item.status === 'Pending' && item.offerFrom) {
    return <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">Offer from {item.offerFrom}</Text>
  }

  if (item.status === 'Active' && item.stores) {
    return (
      <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
        Listing active · {item.stores} stores
      </Text>
    )
  }

  if (item.status === 'Sold' && item.soldFor) {
    return (
      <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
        Sold for ${item.soldFor} · {item.soldAt} · {item.soldDate}
      </Text>
    )
  }

  if (item.listingExpired) {
    return <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">No offers · Listing expired</Text>
  }

  return null
}

const SaleActions: React.FC<{
  item: SaleItem
  onViewOffer: () => void
  onEdit: () => void
  onRemark: () => void
  onDetails: () => void
}> = ({ item, onViewOffer, onEdit, onRemark, onDetails }) => {
  if (item.status === 'Pending') {
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={onViewOffer}
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        className="bg-green-500 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full mt-1"
      >
        <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white">View Offer</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    )
  }

  if (item.status === 'Active') {
    return (
      <View className="flex-row gap-3 mt-1">
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={onEdit} activeOpacity={0.8}>
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">Edit</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <TouchableOpacity onPress={onRemark} activeOpacity={0.8}>
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-400">Remark</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    )
  }

  if (item.status === 'Sold') {
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={onDetails} activeOpacity={0.8} className="mt-1">
        <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">Details</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    )
  }

  return null
}

const SaleRow: React.FC<{
  item: SaleItem
  isLast: boolean
  onViewOffer: () => void
  onEdit: () => void
  onRemark: () => void
  onDetails: () => void
}> = ({ item, isLast, onViewOffer, onEdit, onRemark, onDetails }) => (
  <View
    className={`flex-row items-center py-3.5 gap-3 ${
      !isLast ? 'border-b border-gray-100' : ''
    }`}
  >
    <StatusDot status={item.status} />

    <View className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
      {item.imageUri ? (
        <Image source={{ uri: item.imageUri }} className="w-full h-full" resizeMode="cover" />
      ) : (
        <View className="w-full h-full bg-gray-200" />
      )}
    </View>

    <View className="flex-1">
      <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-green-500">
        {item.productType}
      </Text>
      <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900" numberOfLines={1}>
        {item.name}
      </Text>
      <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Size {item.sizeLabel}</Text>
      <SaleSubLine item={item} />
    </View>

    <View className="items-end">
      <Text className="text-sm font-extrabold text-gray-900">${item.askingPrice}</Text>
      {item.priceDelta !== undefined ? (
        <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-green-500">+${item.priceDelta}</Text>
      ) : null}
      <SaleActions
        item={item}
        onViewOffer={onViewOffer}
        onEdit={onEdit}
        onRemark={onRemark}
        onDetails={onDetails}
      />
    </View>
  </View>
)

const MySalesScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()
  const {
    thisWeek,
    lastMonth,
    totalEarned,
    soldCount,

    handleNewSale,

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 pt-12 pb-4 bg-white">
        <TouchableOpacity
```
