```typescript
          hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
        >
          <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#111827" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text className="text-lg font-extrabold text-gray-900 ml-3">My Sales</Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 }}>
        <View className="bg-black rounded-2xl p-5 mb-4">
          <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-green-100 tracking-widest uppercase mb-1">
            Total Earned
          </Text>
          <Text className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-white">${totalEarned}</Text>
          <Text className="text-xs text-green-100 mt-1">
            From {soldCount} completed sale{soldCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
          </Text>

          <View className="flex-row gap-3 mt-4">
            {[
              { label: 'Sold', value: soldCount },
              { label: 'Active', value: activeCount },

            ].map(({ label, value }) => (
              <View
                key={label}
                className="flex-1 rounded-xl py-2.5 items-center"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}

            ))}

              {thisWeek.map((item, index) => (
                <SaleRow
                  key={item.id}
                  item={item}
                  isLast={index === thisWeek.length - 1}
                  onViewOffer={() => handleViewOffer(item)}
                  onEdit={() => handleEdit(item)}
                  onRemark={() => handleRemark(item)}
                  onDetails={() => handleDetails(item)}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {lastMonth.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <SectionLabel label="Last Month" />
            <View className="bg-white rounded-2xl px-4 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
              {lastMonth.map((item, index) => (
                <SaleRow
                  key={item.id}
                  item={item}
                  isLast={index === lastMonth.length - 1}
                  onViewOffer={() => handleViewOffer(item)}
                  onEdit={() => handleEdit(item)}
                  onRemark={() => handleRemark(item)}
                  onDetails={() => handleDetails(item)}
                />
              ))}
            </View>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {thisWeek.length === 0 && lastMonth.length === 0 ? (
          <View className="py-16 items-center gap-3">

        <TouchableOpacity

        >

          <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-green-600">List a new item</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React, { useCallback } from 'react'
import { ScrollView, Share, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router'
import { usePublicLocker } from '@/services/hooks/profile/usePublicLocker'
import PublicLockerHeader from '@/components/profile/locker/PublicLockerHeader'
import PublicLockerFilter from '@/components/profile/locker/PublicLockerFilter'
import PublicLockerGrid from '@/components/profile/locker/PublicLockerGrid'
import type { PublicLockerItem } from '@/types/lockerbrowser'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { View } from 'react-native'
const PublicLockerScreen: React.FC = () => {
    const router = useRouter()
    const { lockerId, username } = useLocalSearchParams<{ lockerId: string; username: string }>()

    const {
        profile,
        filters,
        activeFilter,
        setActiveFilter,
        filteredItems,
        filterCounts,
        toggleFollow,
    } = usePublicLocker(lockerId)

    const handleBack = useCallback(() => {
        if (router.canGoBack()) router.back()
    }, [router])

    const handleShare = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            await Share.share({
                message: `Check out ${profile.username}'s locker on GoSNKR! 👟`,
                url: `https://gosnkr.com/locker/${profile.username}`,
            })
        } catch (_) { }
    }, [profile.username])

    const handleItemPress = useCallback((item: PublicLockerItem) => {
        router.push({
            pathname: '/screens/profile/itemDetailScreen',
            params: {
                itemId: item.id,
                lockerId: lockerId ?? profile.id,
                username: username ?? profile.username,
            },
        })
    }, [lockerId, profile.id, profile.username, router, username])

    return (
        <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor='#fff'>
            <View className='pt-10'></View>
            <PublicLockerHeader
                profile={profile}
                onBack={handleBack}
                onShare={handleShare}
                onFollow={toggleFollow}
            />

            <PublicLockerFilter
                filters={filters}
                activeFilter={activeFilter}
                filterCounts={filterCounts}
                onSelect={setActiveFilter}
            />

            {/* Scrollable masonry grid */}
            <ScrollView
                showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                style={styles.scroll}
                contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
            >
                <PublicLockerGrid items={filteredItems} onItemPress={handleItemPress} />
            </ScrollView>
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}

export default PublicLockerScreen

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    root: {
        flex: 1,
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
    },
    scroll: {
        flex: 1,
        paddingHorizontal: 10,
    },
    scrollContent: {
        flexGrow: 1,
    },
})
```

```typescript
import { View, TouchableOpacity, Text } from 'react-native'

import { useWishlistFilter } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useWishlistFilter'

export default function WishlistScreen() {
  const filter = useWishlistFilter()
  const { items, activeFilter, setActiveFilter, filterCounts, toggleLike } =
    useWishlist(filter.applied)

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="pt-10">
        <WishlistHeader
          activeFilterCount={filter.activeFilterCount}
          onFilterOpen={filter.open}
        />

          activeFilter={activeFilter}

          onSelect={setActiveFilter}
        />

        {filter.activeFilterCount > 0 && (

              <View className="flex-row items-center bg-gray-900 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  {filter.applied.category}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}

            {filter.applied.sort !== 'Default' && (

                <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  {filter.applied.sort}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}

            <TouchableOpacity onPress={filter.reset}>
              <Text className="text-xs text-red-400 font-semibold ml-1">Clear</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        <WishlistList items={items} onToggleLike={toggleLike} />

        <WishlistFilterSheet
          visible={filter.visible}
          draft={filter.draft}
          sortOptions={filter.sortOptions}
          categoryOptions={filter.categoryOptions}
          onClose={filter.close}
          onSetSort={filter.setSort}
          onSetCategory={filter.setCategory}
          onReset={filter.reset}
          onApply={filter.apply}
        />
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// screens/MapScreen.tsx
import MapSearchBar from "@/components/map/MapSearchBar";
import StoreBottomSheet from "@/components/map/StoreBottomSheet";
import StoreMarker from "@/components/map/StoreMarker";
import FilterModal from "@/components/search/FilterModal";
import { Store, useMap } from "@/services/hooks/map/useMap";
import React, { useRef } from "react";
import { StatusBar, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from "react-native";
import MapView, { PROVIDER_DEFAULT } from "react-native-maps";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

const MapScreen = () => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const mapRef = useRef<MapView>(null);

  const {
    query,
    handleQueryChange,
    handleClearQuery,
    filters,
    activeFilterCount,
    isFilterModalOpen,
    handleOpenFilterModal,
    handleCloseFilterModal,
    handleApplyFilters,
    region,
    setRegion,
    filteredStores,
    nearbyCount,
    selectedStore,
    handleSelectStore,
    handleCloseStore,
    handleToggleFollow,
    isFetchingLocation,
    handleGoToCurrentLocation,
  } = useMap();

  const handleLocationPress = async () => {
    await handleGoToCurrentLocation();
    if (mapRef.current) {
      mapRef.current.animateToRegion(region, 600);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectSuggestion = (store: Store) => {
    handleClearQuery();
    mapRef.current?.animateToRegion(
      {
        latitude: store.latitude,
        longitude: store.longitude,
        latitudeDelta: 0.008,
        longitudeDelta: 0.008,
      },
      600,
    );
    handleSelectStore(store);
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" />

      {/* ── Full-screen map ── */}
      <MapView
        ref={mapRef}
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        provider={PROVIDER_DEFAULT}
        region={region}
        onRegionChangeComplete={setRegion}
        showsUserLocation
        showsMyLocationButton={false}
        showsCompass={false}
        onPress={handleClearQuery}
      >
        {filteredStores.map((store) => (
          <StoreMarker
            key={store.id}
            store={store}
            isSelected={selectedStore?.id === store.id}
            onPress={handleSelectStore}
          />
        ))}
      </MapView>

      {/* ── Search bar ── */}
      <View
        style={{
          position: "absolute",
          top: insets.top + 12,
          left: 16,
          right: 16,
          zIndex: 20,
        }}
      >
        <MapSearchBar
          value={query}
          onChangeText={handleQueryChange}
          onClear={handleClearQuery}
          onFilterPress={handleOpenFilterModal}
          onLocationPress={handleLocationPress}
          onSelectSuggestion={handleSelectSuggestion}
          suggestions={filteredStores}
          activeFilterCount={activeFilterCount}
          isFetchingLocation={isFetchingLocation}
        />
      </View>

      {/* ── Nearby pill ── */}
      {!selectedStore && (
        <View
          style={{ position: "absolute", left: 16, bottom: 110, zIndex: 5 }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
              borderRadius: 12,
              paddingHorizontal: 14,
              paddingVertical: 10,
              shadowColor: "#000",
              shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
              shadowOpacity: 0.08,
              shadowRadius: 8,
              elevation: 4,
            }}
          >
            <Text
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: "700",
                color: "#0F0F0F",
                textAlign: "center",
              }}
            >
              {nearbyCount}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#8A8A9A", marginTop: 1 }}>
              stores{"\n"}nearby
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Zoom controls ── */}
      {!selectedStore && (
        <View
          style={{
            position: "absolute",
            right: 16,
            bottom: 110,
            zIndex: 5,
            gap: 1,
          }}
        >
          {["+", "−"].map((symbol) => (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={symbol}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              onPress={() => {
                const delta = symbol === "+" ? 0.5 : 2;
                mapRef.current?.animateToRegion(
                  {
                    ...region,
                    latitudeDelta: region.latitudeDelta / delta,
                    longitudeDelta: region.longitudeDelta / delta,
                  },
                  300,
                );
              }}
              style={{
                width: 44,
                height: 44,
                backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
                borderTopLeftRadius: symbol === "+" ? 12 : 0,
                borderTopRightRadius: symbol === "+" ? 12 : 0,
                borderBottomLeftRadius: symbol === "−" ? 12 : 0,
                borderBottomRightRadius: symbol === "−" ? 12 : 0,
                shadowColor: "#000",
                shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 2 },
                shadowOpacity: 0.08,
                shadowRadius: 6,
                elevation: 3,
              }}
            >
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 22,
                  color: "#0F0F0F",
                  fontWeight: "300",
                  lineHeight: 26,
                }}
              >
                {symbol}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Bottom sheet — rendered DIRECTLY in root View, no wrapper ──
            This is critical: the old <View pointerEvents="box-none"> wrapper
            had no height, so StoreBottomSheet's absolute children were
            positioning against a 0-height box, breaking scroll and tap-to-close. ── */}
      {selectedStore && (
        <StoreBottomSheet
          store={selectedStore}
          onClose={handleCloseStore}
          onToggleFollow={handleToggleFollow}
        />
      )}

      {/* ── Filter modal ── */}
      <FilterModal
        visible={isFilterModalOpen}
        initialFilters={filters}
        onApply={handleApplyFilters}
        onClose={handleCloseFilterModal}
      />
    </View>
  );
};

export default MapScreen;
```

## File: components/auth/OtpInput.tsx
```typescript
import React, {
  useState,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
  useImperativeHandle,
  forwardRef,
} from "react";
import { View, TextInput } from "react-native";

export interface OTPInputProps {
  length?: number;
  onComplete?: (code: string) => void;
  onChange?: (digits: string[]) => void;
  autoFocusOnMount?: boolean;
}

export interface OTPInputHandle {
  reset: () => void;
  focus: () => void;
}

const OTPInput = forwardRef<OTPInputHandle, OTPInputProps>(
  ({ length = 6, onComplete, onChange, autoFocusOnMount = true }, ref) => {
    const [digits, setDigits] = useState<string[]>(Array(length).fill(""));
    const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState<number>(0);
    const inputRefs = useRef<(TextInput | null)[]>([]);

    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
      reset: () => {
        setDigits(Array(length).fill(""));
        setFocusIndex(0);
        setTimeout(() => inputRefs.current[0]?.focus(), 50);
      },
      focus: () => {
        inputRefs.current[focusIndex]?.focus();
      },
    }));

    useEffect(() => {
      if (autoFocusOnMount) {
        setTimeout(() => inputRefs.current[0]?.focus(), 300);
      }
    }, []);

    const handleChangeText = (value: string, index: number) => {
      const char = value.slice(-1);

      if (char === "") {
        const updated = [...digits];
        updated[index] = "";
        setDigits(updated);
        onChange?.(updated);
        const prev = index - 1;
        if (prev >= 0) {
          setFocusIndex(prev);
          inputRefs.current[prev]?.focus();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (!/\d/.test(char)) return;

      const updated = [...digits];
      updated[index] = char;
      setDigits(updated);
      onChange?.(updated);

      const next = index + 1;
      if (next < length) {
        setFocusIndex(next);
        inputRefs.current[next]?.focus();
      } else {
        setFocusIndex(index);
        onComplete?.(updated.join(""));
      }
    };

    const handleKeyPress = (e: any, index: number) => {
      if (e.nativeEvent.key === "Backspace" && digits[index] === "") {
        const prev = index - 1;
        if (prev >= 0) {
          const updated = [...digits];
          updated[prev] = "";
          setDigits(updated);
          onChange?.(updated);
          setFocusIndex(prev);
          inputRefs.current[prev]?.focus();
        }
      }
    };

    return (
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10 }}>
        {digits.map((digit, i) => {
          const isFocus = focusIndex === i;
          const hasDigit = digit !== "";

          return (
            <TextInput
              key={i}
              ref={(r) => { inputRefs.current[i] = r; }}
              style={{
                width: 48,
                height: 56,
                borderRadius: 12,
                borderWidth: 1.5,
                borderColor: isFocus ? '#22C55E' : hasDigit ? '#22C55E' : '#D1D5DB',
                backgroundColor: isFocus ? '##E6F1EE' : '#FFFFFF',
                textAlign: 'center',
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 'bold',
                color: '#1F2937',
                padding: 0,
              }}
              value={digit}
              onChangeText={(val) => handleChangeText(val, i)}
              onKeyPress={(e) => handleKeyPress(e, i)}
              onFocus={() => setFocusIndex(i)}
              maxLength={2}
              keyboardType="number-pad"
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
              importantForAutofill="yes"
              selectionColor="#4584CA"
            />
          );
        })}
      </View>
    );
  },
);

OTPInput.displayName = "OTPInput";
export default OTPInput;
```

```typescript
        return (
          <View
            key={pair.id}
            className="flex-row items-center py-3 border-b border-gray-100 gap-3"
          >
            {/* Tag badge (absolute-style left strip) */}
            {tag && pair.tag && (
              <View className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${tag.bg} self-start mt-1`}>
                <Text className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${tag.text}`}>{pair.tag}</Text>

              <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 leading-snug" numberOfLines={2}>
                {pair.name}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
```

```typescript
import { Store } from '@/services/hooks/map/useMap'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import {
  Animated,
  Dimensions,
  Easing,
  PanResponder,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import StoreProductCard from './StoreProductCard'

const { height: SCREEN_HEIGHT } = Dimensions.get('window')
const GREEN = '#22C55E'
const TAB_BAR_HEIGHT = 60
const DRAG_HANDLE_HEIGHT = 28
const BUTTON_HEIGHT = 54
const SHEET_VISIBLE = SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.8

interface StoreBottomSheetProps {
  store: Store | null
  onClose: () => void
  onToggleFollow: (storeId: string) => void
}

const StoreBottomSheet = ({
  store,
  onClose,
  onToggleFollow,
}: StoreBottomSheetProps) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const router = useRouter()

  const tabBarTotal = TAB_BAR_HEIGHT + insets.bottom
  const sheetFullHeight = SHEET_VISIBLE
  const footerTotal = BUTTON_HEIGHT + 24 + tabBarTotal
  const scrollHeight = SHEET_VISIBLE - DRAG_HANDLE_HEIGHT - footerTotal
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(sheetFullHeight)).current

  const show = useCallback(() => {
    Animated.timing(translateY, {
      toValue: 0,
      duration: 340,
      easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
      useNativeDriver: true,
    }).start()
  }, [translateY])

  const hide = useCallback(
    (cb?: () => void) => {
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: sheetFullHeight,
        duration: 280,
        easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic),
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }).start(cb)
    },
    [sheetFullHeight, translateY],
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (store) {
      show()
    } else {
      hide()
    }
  }, [hide, show, store])

  const sectionLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (!store) return 'Available Now'

    const hasSneakers = store.products.some((product) => product.productType === 'Sneakers')
    const hasClothing = store.products.some((product) => product.productType === 'Clothing')

    if (hasSneakers && hasClothing) return 'Sneakers & Clothing Nearby'
    if (hasClothing) return 'Clothing Nearby'
    return 'Sneakers Nearby'
  }, [store])

  const panResponder = useRef(
    PanResponder.create({
      onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => true,
      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: (_, { dy }) => Math.abs(dy) > 5,
      onPanResponderMove: (_, { dy }) => {
        if (dy > 0) translateY.setValue(dy)
      },
      onPanResponderRelease: (_, { dy, vy }) => {
        if (dy > SHEET_VISIBLE * 0.3 || vy > 0.8) {
          Animated.timing(translateY, {
            toValue: sheetFullHeight,
            duration: 240,
            easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic),
            useNativeDriver: true,
          }).start(onClose)
        } else {
          Animated.timing(translateY, {
            toValue: 0,
            duration: 240,
            easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
            useNativeDriver: true,
          }).start()
        }
      },
    }),
  ).current

  if (!store) return null

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => hide(onClose)}
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
        }}
      />

      <Animated.View
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          bottom: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          height: SHEET_VISIBLE,
          backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
          borderTopLeftRadius: 24,
          borderTopRightRadius: 24,
          shadowColor: '#000',
          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },
          shadowOpacity: 0.12,
          shadowRadius: 16,
          elevation: 20,
          transform: [{ translateY }],
        }}
      >
        <View
          {...panResponder.panHandlers}
          style={{
            height: DRAG_HANDLE_HEIGHT,
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              width: 36,
              height: 4,
              borderRadius: 2,
              backgroundColor: '#E0E0EA',
            }}
          />
        </View>

        <ScrollView
          style={{ height: scrollHeight }}
          contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 8 }}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          scrollEnabled
          bounces
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'flex-start',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              paddingHorizontal: 20,
              paddingTop: 4,
              paddingBottom: 12,
            }}
          >
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 12 }}>
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: '800',
                  color: '#0F0F0F',
                  letterSpacing: -0.5,
                }}
              >
                {store.name}
              </Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#8A8A9A', marginTop: 3 }}>
                {store.distance} • {store.hours}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => onToggleFollow(store.id)}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
              style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
                paddingHorizontal: 14,
                paddingVertical: 9,
                borderRadius: 100,
                backgroundColor: store.isFollowing ? '#0F0F0F' : '#F5F5F7',
              }}
            >
              {store.isFollowing && (
                <Feather name="check" size={13} color="#fff" />
              )}
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: '700',
                  color: store.isFollowing ? '#FFFFFF' : '#0F0F0F',
                }}
              >
                {store.isFollowing ? 'Following' : 'Follow'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View
            style={{
              height: 1,
              backgroundColor: '#F0F0F5',
              marginHorizontal: 20,
            }}
          />

          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              paddingHorizontal: 20,
              paddingVertical: 12,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}
          >
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
              <Feather name="map-pin" size={12} color="#8A8A9A" />
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#3A3A4A', fontWeight: '500' }}>
                {store.tag}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text style={{ color: '#D0D0DF' }}>•</Text>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: GREEN }}>
              {store.stock} items available
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: '#D0D0DF' }}>•</Text>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>★</Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: '#0F0F0F' }}>
                {store.rating}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 20, marginBottom: 10 }}>
            <Text
              style={{
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: '700',
                color: '#8A8A9A',
                letterSpacing: 1,
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
              }}
            >
              {sectionLabel}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            nestedScrollEnabled
            contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 20, paddingBottom: 4 }}
          >
            {store.products.map((product) => (
              <StoreProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </ScrollView>

        <View
          style={{
            paddingHorizontal: 40,
            paddingTop: 12,
            paddingBottom: tabBarTotal + 24,
            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
          }}
        >
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => router.push('/')}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={{
              height: BUTTON_HEIGHT,
              borderRadius: 100,
              backgroundColor: '#0F0F0F',
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 6,
            }}
          >
            <Text style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '700', color: '#FFFFFF' }}>
              View full store
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </Animated.View>
    </>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// components/profile/waitlist/NotifyLocationSelector.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import { NotifyLocation } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useJoinWaitlist'
import { StorePickerModal } from './StorePickerModal'

interface NotifyLocationSelectorProps {
  selected: NotifyLocation
  onSelect: (loc: NotifyLocation) => void
  onChooseStores: (storeIds: string[]) => void
  selectedStoreIds?: string[]
}

export const NotifyLocationSelector: React.FC<NotifyLocationSelectorProps> = ({
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onChooseStores,
  selectedStoreIds = [],
}) => {
  const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false)
  const [confirmedStores, setConfirmedStores] = useState<string[]>(selectedStoreIds)

  const handleConfirm = (ids: string[]) => {
    setConfirmedStores(ids)
    onChooseStores(ids)
  }

  const handleSpecificPress = () => {
    onSelect('specific')
    setModalVisible(true)
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.label}>Notify me when available at:</Text>
      <View style={styles.options}>

        {/* Anywhere nearby */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.option, selected === 'anywhere' && styles.optionSelected]}
          onPress={() => onSelect('anywhere')}
          activeOpacity={0.8}
        >
          <Text style={styles.optionIcon}>📍</Text>
          {selected === 'anywhere' && (
            <View style={styles.checkBadge}>
              <Text style={styles.checkText}>✓</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          <Text style={[styles.optionTitle, selected === 'anywhere' && styles.optionTitleSelected]}>
            Anywhere nearby
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.optionSub}>Within 10 miles</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Specific stores — entire card opens modal */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.option, selected === 'specific' && styles.optionSelected]}
          onPress={handleSpecificPress}
          activeOpacity={0.8}
        >
          <Text style={styles.optionIcon}>🏪</Text>
          {selected === 'specific' && (
            <View style={styles.checkBadge}>
              <Text style={styles.checkText}>✓</Text>
            </View>
          )}
          <Text style={[styles.optionTitle, selected === 'specific' && styles.optionTitleSelected]}>
            Specific stores only
          </Text>
          {selected === 'specific' && confirmedStores.length > 0 ? (
            <Text style={styles.storeCount}>
              {confirmedStores.length} store{confirmedStores.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <Text style={styles.optionSub}>Tap to choose</Text>
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <StorePickerModal
        visible={modalVisible}
        selectedStores={confirmedStores}
        onConfirm={handleConfirm}
        onClose={() => setModalVisible(false)}
      />
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
  'Sold Out': '#6B7280',

}: WishlistCardProps) {

          <Text className="text-white text-[10px] font-extrabold">

          </Text>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => onToggleLike(item.id)}
          activeOpacity={0.7}

          />

        {item.isPriceDropped && (

              Price Drop
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      <View className="flex-1">
        <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-green-500 tracking-widest uppercase">
          {item.productType}
        </Text>

        <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-gray-400 tracking-widest uppercase mt-[2px]">
          {item.brand}
        </Text>

        <Text numberOfLines={1} className="text-[14px] font-bold text-gray-900 mt-[1px]">
          {item.name}
        </Text>

        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 mt-1">

          <Text className="text-[12px] text-gray-500">Saved in size {item.size}</Text>

        <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-[1px]">
```

```typescript
  onToggleLike: (id: string) => void
}

function EmptyState() {

    <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center py-24 gap-3">
      <Ionicons name="heart-outline" size={48} color="#D1D5DB" />
      <Text className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-gray-400">

      </Text>
      <Text className="text-[13px] text-gray-300 text-center px-8">
        Tap the heart on any sneaker or clothing item to add it to your wishlist.
      </Text>
    </View>
  )
}

export default function WishlistList({ items, onToggleLike }: WishlistListProps) {
  if (items.length === 0) return <EmptyState />

  return (
    <View className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-sm mx-5 mt-3">
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        <WishlistCard
          key={item.id}
          item={item}
          isLast={index === items.length - 1}
          onToggleLike={onToggleLike}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// components/profilesetup/CustomSizeModal.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Modal,
  View,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  TouchableWithoutFeedback,
} from 'react-native'
import type { GenderTab } from '@/services/hooks/profilesetup/useSizeSelection'

interface Props {
  visible: boolean
  activeTab: GenderTab
  onConfirm: (size: string) => void
  onClose: () => void
  title?: string
  subtitle?: (tab: GenderTab) => string
  placeholder?: string
  confirmText?: string
  errorText?: string
}

export default function CustomSizeModal({
  visible,
  activeTab,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
  title = 'Add Custom Size',
  subtitle = (tab) => `Enter your ${tab} shoe size below`,
  placeholder = 'e.g. 10.5 or 11W',
  confirmText = 'Add Size',
  errorText = 'Please enter a size',
}: Props) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const trimmed = value.trim()
    if (!trimmed) {
      setError(errorText)
      return
    }
    onConfirm(trimmed)
    setValue('')
    setError('')
    onClose()
  }

  const handleClose = () => {
    setValue('')
    setError('')
    onClose()
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <TouchableWithoutFeedback onPress={handleClose}>
        <View style={styles.overlay}>
          <TouchableWithoutFeedback>
            <KeyboardAvoidingView
              behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}
            >
              <View style={styles.card}>
                {/* Header */}
                <Text style={styles.title}>{title}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
                  {subtitle(activeTab)}
                </Text>

                {/* Input */}
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.input, !!error && styles.inputError]}
                  placeholder={placeholder}
                  placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                  value={value}
                  onChangeText={text => {
                    setValue(text)
                    if (error) setError('')
                  }}
                  autoFocus
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={handleConfirm}
                />
                {!!error && <Text style={styles.errorText}>{error}</Text>}

                {/* Actions */}
                <View style={styles.actions}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={styles.cancelBtn}
                    onPress={handleClose}
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.cancelText}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>

                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={styles.confirmBtn}
                    onPress={handleConfirm}
                    activeOpacity={0.85}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.confirmText}>{confirmText}</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>
            </KeyboardAvoidingView>
          </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
        </View>
      </TouchableWithoutFeedback>
    </Modal>
  )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
```

```typescript
  tab: GenderTab
  size: string
}

interface Props {
  selectedSizes: SelectedEntry[]
  onRemove: (tab: GenderTab) => void
  label?: string
  valuePrefix?: string
}

export default function SelectedSizeChips({
  selectedSizes,
  onRemove,
  label = 'Your sizes:',
  valuePrefix = 'US ',
}: Props) {
  if (selectedSizes.length === 0) return null

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={styles.label}>{label}</Text>
      <View style={styles.chips}>
        {selectedSizes.map(({ tab, size }) => (
          <View key={tab} style={styles.chip}>
            <Text style={styles.chipText}>{`${valuePrefix}${size}`}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => onRemove(tab)}
              hitSlop={{ top: 6, bottom: 6, left: 6, right: 6 }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.remove}>×</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image } from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';

export type OrderStatus = 'Pickup Ready' | 'Hold Confirmed' | 'Processing' | 'Cancelled';

export interface RecentOrder {
  id: string;
  productName: string;
  size: string;
  customer: string;
  placedAgo: string;
  price: number;
  status: OrderStatus;
  imageUri?: string;
}

interface HomeRecentOrdersProps {
  orders: RecentOrder[];
  onViewAll?: () => void;
  onOrderPress?: (order: RecentOrder) => void;
}

const statusConfig: Record<OrderStatus, { bg: string; text: string; label: string }> = {
  'Pickup Ready':   { bg: '#00C853', text: '#fff',    label: 'Pickup Ready' },
  'Hold Confirmed': { bg: '#FEF3C7', text: '#92400E', label: 'Hold Confirmed' },
  'Processing':     { bg: '#F3F4F6', text: '#6B7280', label: 'Processing' },
  'Cancelled':      { bg: '#FEE2E2', text: '#991B1B', label: 'Cancelled' },
};

const placeholderBg = ['#F3F4F6', '#DBEAFE', '#FCE7F3'];
const placeholderStroke = ['#9CA3AF', '#93C5FD', '#F9A8D4'];

const HomeRecentOrders: React.FC<HomeRecentOrdersProps> = ({
  orders,
  onViewAll,
  onOrderPress,
}) => {
  return (
    <View style={{ paddingHorizontal: 14, paddingTop: 14 }}>
      {/* Section header */}
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          marginBottom: 12,
        }}
      >
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '700', color: '#111' }}>
          Recent Orders
        </Text>

        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onViewAll}
          style={{
            flexDirection: 'row',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 2,
          }}
        >
          <Text
            style={{
              fontSize: 12,
              color: '#00C853',
              fontWeight: '600',
            }}
          >
            View all
          </Text>

          <Feather name="arrow-right" size={14} color="#00C853" />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Rows */}
      {orders.map((order, i) => {
        const cfg = statusConfig[order.status];
        const bg = placeholderBg[i % placeholderBg.length];
        const stroke = placeholderStroke[i % placeholderStroke.length];

        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={order.id}
            onPress={() => onOrderPress?.(order)}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row',
              alignItems: 'center',
              backgroundColor: '#fff',
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderColor: '#E5E7EB',
              borderRadius: 16,
              padding: 12,
              marginBottom: 8,
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            {/* Thumbnail */}
            {order.imageUri ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: order.imageUri }}
                style={{
                  width: 48,
                  height: 48,
                  borderRadius: 12,
                }}
                resizeMode="cover"
              />
            ) : (
              <View
                style={{
                  width: 48,
                  height: 48,
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  backgroundColor: bg,
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                <Feather name="package" size={20} color={stroke} />
              </View>
            )}

            {/* Details */}
            <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: '700',
                  color: '#111',
                }}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {order.productName}
              </Text>

              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: '#9CA3AF',
                  marginTop: 2,
                }}
              >
                {order.size} · {order.customer}
              </Text>

              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 10,
                  color: '#D1D5DB',
                  marginTop: 2,
                }}
              >
                {order.placedAgo}
              </Text>
            </View>

            {/* Price + status */}
            <View
              style={{
                alignItems: 'flex-end',

              }}
            >
              <Text
                style={{
                  fontSize: 14,

                ${order.price}

              <View
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: cfg.bg,
                  borderRadius: 20,
                  paddingHorizontal: 8,
                  paddingVertical: 3,
                }}
              >
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,

                  {cfg.label}

            {/* Far-right Chevron */}
            <Feather
              name="chevron-right"
              size={20}
              color="#9CA3AF"
            />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}

};
```

```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Image } from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import {
  InventoryProduct,
  StockStatus,
} from '@/services/hooks/retailer/inventory/useInventory'

interface InventoryCardProps {
  product: InventoryProduct
  onPress?: (product: InventoryProduct) => void
  onEditPress?: (product: InventoryProduct) => void
}

const statusBadge: Record<StockStatus, { bg: string; text: string }> = {
  'In Stock': { bg: '#00C853', text: '#fff' },
  'Low Stock': { bg: '#F97316', text: '#fff' },
  'Out of Stock': { bg: '#EF4444', text: '#fff' },
  'On Hold': { bg: '#374151', text: '#fff' },
}

const productTypeBadge = {
  Sneakers: { bg: '#ECFDF5', text: '#047857' },
  Clothing: { bg: '#EFF6FF', text: '#1D4ED8' },
}

const SIZES_VISIBLE = 4

const InventoryCard: React.FC<InventoryCardProps> = ({
  product,
  onPress,
  onEditPress,
}) => {
  const badge = statusBadge[product.status]
  const typeBadge = productTypeBadge[product.productType]
  const badgeLabel =
    product.status === 'Low Stock' && product.lowCount != null
      ? `Low: ${product.lowCount}`
      : product.status

  const visibleSizes = product.sizes.slice(0, SIZES_VISIBLE)
  const hiddenCount = product.sizes.length - SIZES_VISIBLE

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => onPress?.(product)}
      activeOpacity={0.85}
      style={{
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: '#F3F4F6',
        borderRadius: 18,
        padding: 12,
        flexDirection: 'row',
        gap: 12,
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        marginBottom: 10,
      }}
    >
      <View style={{ position: 'relative', flexShrink: 0 }}>
        {product.imageUri ? (
          <Image
            source={{ uri: product.imageUri }}
            style={{ width: 76, height: 76, borderRadius: 12 }}
            resizeMode="cover"
          />
        ) : (
          <View
            style={{
              width: 76,
              height: 76,
              borderRadius: 12,
              backgroundColor: product.imageBg,
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <Feather name="package" size={28} color="#9CA3AF" />
          </View>
        )}

        <View
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: 5,
            left: 5,
            backgroundColor: badge.bg,
            borderRadius: 6,
            paddingHorizontal: 6,
            paddingVertical: 2,
          }}
        >
          <Text style={{ color: badge.text, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: '700' }}>
            {badgeLabel}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexShrink: 1 }}>
            <Text
              style={{
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: '700',
                color: '#9CA3AF',
                letterSpacing: 0.5,
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
              }}
            >
              {product.brand}
            </Text>
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: typeBadge.bg,
                borderRadius: 999,
                paddingHorizontal: 8,
                paddingVertical: 2,
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '700', color: typeBadge.text }}>
                {product.productType}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => onEditPress?.(product)} hitSlop={8}>
            <Feather name="edit-2" size={15} color="#9CA3AF" />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <Text
          style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '800', color: '#111', marginTop: 3 }}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {product.name}
        </Text>

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 6 }}>
          {visibleSizes.map(({ size, qty }) => {
            const available = qty > 0

            return (
              <View
                key={size}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: available ? '#DCFCE7' : '#F3F4F6',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  paddingHorizontal: 7,
                  paddingVertical: 3,
                  marginRight: 4,
                  marginBottom: 4,
                }}
              >
                <Text
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: '700',
                    color: available ? '#15803D' : '#9CA3AF',
                  }}
                >
                  {size} · {qty}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )
          })}

          {hiddenCount > 0 && (
            <View
              style={{
                backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6',
                borderRadius: 8,
                paddingHorizontal: 7,
                paddingVertical: 3,
                marginRight: 4,
                marginBottom: 4,
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '700', color: '#9CA3AF' }}>
                +{hiddenCount}
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginTop: 4 }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '800', color: '#111' }}>
            ${product.price}
          </Text>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#9CA3AF' }}>
            | Cost: ${product.cost}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <Text style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#D1D5DB', marginTop: 2 }}>
          {product.sku}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  )
}

export default InventoryCard
```

## File: components/retailer/profile/StoreProfileHours.tsx
```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Switch, Modal,
  ScrollView, Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { OperatingHour } from '@/services/hooks/retailer/profile/useStoreProfile';

interface StoreProfileHoursProps {
  hours: OperatingHour[];
  onToggleDay: (day: string) => void;
  onUpdateHour: (day: string, field: 'open' | 'close', value: string) => void;
  onCopyToAll: () => void;
}

// Simple time picker options (30-min slots)
const TIME_OPTIONS = [
  '6:00 AM','6:30 AM','7:00 AM','7:30 AM','8:00 AM','8:30 AM',
  '9:00 AM','9:30 AM','10:00 AM','10:30 AM','11:00 AM','11:30 AM',
  '12:00 PM','12:30 PM','1:00 PM','1:30 PM','2:00 PM','2:30 PM',
  '3:00 PM','3:30 PM','4:00 PM','4:30 PM','5:00 PM','5:30 PM',
  '6:00 PM','6:30 PM','7:00 PM','7:30 PM','8:00 PM','8:30 PM',
  '9:00 PM','9:30 PM','10:00 PM','10:30 PM','11:00 PM','11:30 PM',
];

interface TimePickerState {
  visible: boolean;
  day: string;
  field: 'open' | 'close';
  current: string;
}

const SECTION_LABEL_STYLE = {
  fontSize: 10, fontWeight: '700' as const,
  color: '#9CA3AF', letterSpacing: 0.8,
  paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 14, paddingBottom: 6,
  backgroundColor: '#fff',
} as const;

const StoreProfileHours: React.FC<StoreProfileHoursProps> = ({
  hours, onToggleDay, onUpdateHour, onCopyToAll,
}) => {
  const [picker, setPicker] = useState<TimePickerState>({
    visible: false, day: '', field: 'open', current: '',
  });

  const openPicker = (day: string, field: 'open' | 'close', current: string) => {
    setPicker({ visible: true, day, field, current });
  };

  const closePicker = () => setPicker(p => ({ ...p, visible: false }));

  const selectTime = (time: string) => {
    onUpdateHour(picker.day, picker.field, time);
    closePicker();
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <Text style={SECTION_LABEL_STYLE}>OPERATING HOURS</Text>

      <View style={{ backgroundColor: '#fff' }}>
        {hours.map((hour, idx) => (
          <View
            key={hour.day}
            style={{
              flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center',
              paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 12,
              borderBottomWidth: idx < hours.length - 1 ? 1 : 0,
              borderBottomColor: '#F3F4F6',
            }}
          >
            {/* Day + times */}
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600', color: '#111' }}>
                {hour.day}
              </Text>
              {hour.isEnabled && (
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#9CA3AF', marginTop: 2 }}>
                  {hour.open} – {hour.close}
                </Text>
              )}
              {!hour.isEnabled && (
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#D1D5DB', marginTop: 2 }}>Closed</Text>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* Toggle + clock */}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
              <Switch
                value={hour.isEnabled}
                onValueChange={() => onToggleDay(hour.day)}
                trackColor={{ false: '#E5E7EB', true: '#00C853' }}
                thumbColor="#fff"
                ios_backgroundColor="#E5E7EB"
              />
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => openPicker(hour.day, 'open', hour.open)}
                disabled={!hour.isEnabled}
              >
                <Feather
                  name="clock"
                  size={14}
                  color={hour.isEnabled ? '#9CA3AF' : '#D1D5DB'}
                />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        ))}
      </View>

      {/* Copy to all */}
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={onCopyToAll} style={{ padding: 16 }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#00C853', fontWeight: '600', textDecorationLine: 'underline' }}>
          Copy hours to all days
        </Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {/* Simple time picker modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={picker.visible}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={closePicker}
      >
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' }}
          activeOpacity={1}
          onPress={closePicker}
        />
        <View style={{
          backgroundColor: '#fff', borderTopLeftRadius: 20, borderTopRightRadius: 20,
          padding: 16, maxHeight: 340,
          position: 'absolute', bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0,
        }}>
          <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700', color: '#111', marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            {picker.field === 'open' ? 'Opening Time' : 'Closing Time'} — {picker.day}
          </Text>
          <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            {TIME_OPTIONS.map(t => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={t}
                onPress={() => selectTime(t)}
                style={{
                  paddingVertical: 12, paddingHorizontal: 16,
                  borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#F3F4F6',
                  backgroundColor: t === picker.current ? '#F0FDF4' : '#fff',
                }}
              >
                <Text style={{
                  fontSize: 14,
                  fontWeight: t === picker.current ? '700' : '400',
                  color: t === picker.current ? '#00C853' : '#111',
                }}>
                  {t}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};

export default StoreProfileHours;
```

```typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Dimensions,
  Modal,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TouchableWithoutFeedback,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { BlurView } from 'expo-blur'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import {
  BRAND_OPTIONS,
  DEFAULT_FILTERS,
  SearchFilters,
  SIZE_OPTIONS,
  SizeOption,
  STORE_OPTIONS,
} from '@/services/hooks/search/useSearch'
import { PRODUCT_TYPE_OPTIONS, ProductType } from '@/types/catalog'

const { height: SCREEN_HEIGHT } = Dimensions.get('window')
const GREEN = '#22C55E'
const SHEET_HEIGHT = SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.82

const SectionTitle = ({ title }: { title: string }) => (
  <Text
    style={{
      fontSize: 12,
      fontWeight: '700',
      color: '#8A8A9A',
      letterSpacing: 1,
      textTransform: 'uppercase',
      marginBottom: 12,
      marginTop: 24,
    }}
  >
    {title}
  </Text>
)

interface PillProps {
  label: string
  selected: boolean
  onPress: () => void
}

const Pill = ({ label, selected, onPress }: PillProps) => (
  <TouchableOpacity
    onPress={onPress}
    activeOpacity={0.7}
    style={{
      paddingHorizontal: 16,
      paddingVertical: 9,
      borderRadius: 100,
      backgroundColor: selected ? GREEN : '#F5F5F7',
      borderWidth: 1.5,
      borderColor: selected ? GREEN : 'transparent',
      marginRight: 8,
      marginBottom: 10,
    }}
  >
    <Text
      style={{
        fontSize: 14,
        fontWeight: '600',
        color: selected ? '#FFFFFF' : '#3A3A4A',
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </Text>
  </TouchableOpacity>
)

interface FilterModalProps {
  visible: boolean
  initialFilters: SearchFilters
  onApply: (filters: SearchFilters) => void
  onClose: () => void
}

const FilterModal = ({
  visible,
  initialFilters,
  onApply,
  onClose,
}: FilterModalProps) => {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<SearchFilters>(initialFilters)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) setDraft(initialFilters)
  }, [visible, initialFilters])

  const setSize = useCallback(
    (size: SizeOption) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, size })),
    [],
  )

  const toggleProductType = useCallback(
    (type: ProductType) =>
      setDraft((current) => ({
        ...current,
        productTypes: current.productTypes.includes(type)
          ? current.productTypes.filter((item) => item !== type)
          : [...current.productTypes, type],
      })),
    [],
  )

  const toggleBrand = useCallback(
    (brand: string) =>
      setDraft((current) => ({
        ...current,
        brands: current.brands.includes(brand)
          ? current.brands.filter((item) => item !== brand)
          : [...current.brands, brand],
      })),
    [],
  )

  const toggleStore = useCallback(
    (store: string) =>
      setDraft((current) => ({
        ...current,
        stores: current.stores.includes(store)
          ? current.stores.filter((item) => item !== store)
          : [...current.stores, store],
      })),
    [],
  )

  const handleReset = useCallback(() => setDraft(DEFAULT_FILTERS), [])

  const activeCount =
    draft.productTypes.length +
    (draft.size !== 'Default' ? 1 : 0) +
    draft.brands.length +
    draft.stores.length

  return (
    <Modal
```

```typescript
// components/search/SearchInput.tsx
import React from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  Text,
} from "react-native";
import { Feather } from "@expo/vector-icons";

interface SearchInputProps {
  value: string;
  onChangeText: (text: string) => void;
  onSubmitEditing?: () => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  onFilterPress: () => void;
  activeFilterCount?: number;
  isFetching?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
}

const GREEN = "#22C55E";

const SearchInput = ({
  value,
  onChangeText,
  onSubmitEditing,
  onClear,
  onFilterPress,
  activeFilterCount = 0,
  isFetching = false,
  placeholder = "Sneakers, clothing, brands, SKU...",
}: SearchInputProps) => {
  const hasValue = value.length > 0;
  const hasFilters = activeFilterCount > 0;

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: "row",
        alignItems: "center",
        backgroundColor: "#F5F5F7",
        borderRadius: 14,
        paddingHorizontal: 14,
        height: 52,
        borderWidth: 1.5,
        // green border when typing, green when filters active, transparent otherwise
        borderColor: hasValue ? GREEN : hasFilters ? GREEN : "transparent",
      }}
    >
      {/* Left — search / spinner */}
      {isFetching ? (
        <ActivityIndicator
          size="small"
          color="#8A8A9A"
          style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
        />
      ) : (
        <Feather
          name="search"
          size={20}
          color="#8A8A9A"
          style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Text input */}
      <TextInput
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          color: "#0F0F0F",
          fontSize: 16,
          fontWeight: "400",
          height: "100%",
        }}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        placeholderTextColor="#AFAFBF"
        value={value}
        onChangeText={onChangeText}
        onSubmitEditing={onSubmitEditing}
        returnKeyType="search"
        cursorColor={GREEN}
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoCorrect={false}
      />

      {/* Right — clear X or filter icon */}
      {hasValue ? (
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onClear}
          hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              width: 22,
              height: 22,
              borderRadius: 11,
              backgroundColor: "#C8C8D8",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "center",
            }}
          >
            <Feather name="x" size={13} color="#ffffff" />
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : (
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onFilterPress}
          hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
          style={{ position: "relative" }}
        >
          <Feather
            name="sliders"
            size={20}
            color={hasFilters ? GREEN : "#8A8A9A"}
          />
          {hasFilters && (
            <View
              style={{
                position: "absolute",
                top: -5,
                right: -5,
                width: 16,
                height: 16,
                borderRadius: 8,
                backgroundColor: GREEN,
                alignItems: "center",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 9, fontWeight: "700" }}>
                {activeFilterCount > 9 ? "9+" : activeFilterCount}
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

export default SearchInput;
```

```typescript
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { SearchResult } from '@/services/hooks/search/useSearch'

interface SearchResultsProps {
  results: SearchResult[]
  isFetching: boolean
  isError: boolean
  query: string
  onSelectItem: (item: SearchResult) => void
}

const EmptyState = ({ query }: { query: string }) => (
  <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 48, paddingBottom: 24 }}>
    <Feather name="search" size={24} color="black" />
    <Text
      style={{
        marginTop: 12,
        fontSize: 15,
        fontWeight: '600',
        color: '#8A8A9A',
      }}
    >
      No results for "{query}"
    </Text>
    <Text style={{ marginTop: 4, fontSize: 13, color: '#B0B0C0' }}>
      Try a different product, brand, or store.
    </Text>
  </View>
)

const SearchResults = ({
  results,
  isFetching,
  isError,
  query,
  onSelectItem,
}: SearchResultsProps) => {
  if (isFetching) {
    return (
      <View style={{ paddingTop: 40, alignItems: 'center' }}>
```

```typescript
import { TouchableOpacity, Text, ViewStyle, TextStyle } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';

interface ButtonProps {
  text: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  variant?: 'solid' | 'outline';
  backgroundColor?: string;
  textColor?: string;
  borderColor?: string;
  borderWidth?: number;
  borderRadius?: number;
  paddingVertical?: number;
  paddingHorizontal?: number;
  fontSize?: number;
  fontWeight?: TextStyle['fontWeight'];
  disabled?: boolean;
  opacity?: number;
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number;
  useGradient?: boolean;
  gradientColors?: [string, string, ...string[]];
  shadowColor?: string;
  style?: ViewStyle;
  textStyle?: TextStyle;
}

export default function Button({
  text,
  onPress,
  variant = 'solid',
  backgroundColor = '#4A90D9',
  textColor,
  borderColor,
  borderWidth = 1,
  borderRadius = 12,
  paddingVertical = 16,
  paddingHorizontal = 24,
  fontSize = 16,
  fontWeight = '600',
  disabled = false,
  opacity = 1,
  width,
  height,
  useGradient = false,
  gradientColors = ['#4584CA', '#2360A5'],
  shadowColor = '#000000',
  style,
  textStyle,
}: ButtonProps) {
  const isOutline = variant === 'outline';

  const shadowStyle: ViewStyle = useGradient
    ? {
        shadowColor,
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.25,
        shadowRadius: 4,
        elevation: 4,
      }
    : {};

  const textContent = (
    <Text
      style={[
        {
          fontSize,
          fontWeight,
          color: textColor ?? (isOutline ? '#4B5563' : '#FFFFFF'),
        },
        textStyle,
      ]}
    >
      {text}
    </Text>
  );

  const borderStyle: ViewStyle = {
    borderWidth: isOutline && borderColor ? borderWidth : 0,
    borderColor: borderColor ?? 'transparent',
  };

  if (useGradient && !isOutline) {
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={onPress}
        disabled={disabled}
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        style={[
          {
            flex: width ? 0 : 1,
            width: width as number | undefined,
            height,
            borderRadius,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : opacity,
          },
          shadowStyle,
          style,
        ]}
      >
        <LinearGradient
          colors={gradientColors}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 1, y: 0 }}
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            paddingVertical,
            paddingHorizontal,
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          {textContent}
        </LinearGradient>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  }

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled}
      activeOpacity={0.8}
      style={[
        {
          flex: width ? 0 : 1,
          width: width as number | undefined,
          height,
          borderRadius,
          paddingVertical,
          paddingHorizontal,
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          backgroundColor: isOutline ? 'transparent' : backgroundColor,
          opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : opacity,
        },
        borderStyle,
        shadowStyle,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {textContent}
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// components/shared/DropdownField.tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Modal,
  FlatList,
  ViewStyle,
  TextStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import Feather from '@expo/vector-icons/Feather';

interface DropdownOption {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

interface DropdownFieldProps {
  options: DropdownOption[];
  value: string | null;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  sheetTitle?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  borderRadius?: number;
  borderColor?: string;
  focusedBorderColor?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  paddingVertical?: number;
  paddingHorizontal?: number;
  fontSize?: number;
  placeholderTextColor?: string;
  textColor?: string;
  containerStyle?: ViewStyle;
  textStyle?: TextStyle;
  disabled?: boolean;
  leftIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  error?: string;
}

export default function DropdownField({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'Select an option',
  sheetTitle = 'I am a...',
  confirmLabel = 'Confirm',
  borderRadius = 12,
  borderColor = '#D1D5DB',
  focusedBorderColor = '#22C55E',
  backgroundColor = '#FFFFFF',
  paddingVertical = 14,
  paddingHorizontal = 16,
  fontSize = 15,
  placeholderTextColor = '#9CA3AF',
  textColor = '#1F2937',
  containerStyle,
  textStyle,
  disabled = false,
  leftIcon,
  error,
}: DropdownFieldProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  // local pending selection before confirm
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<string | null>(value);

  const selected = options.find(o => o.value === value);

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (pending) onChange(pending);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleOpen = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    setPending(value); // reset to current value each time sheet opens
    setOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <View>
      {/* ── Trigger ── */}
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={handleOpen}
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        style={[
          {
            flexDirection: 'row',
            alignItems: 'center',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderColor: error ? '#EF4444' : open ? focusedBorderColor : borderColor,
            borderRadius,
            backgroundColor,
            paddingVertical,
            paddingHorizontal,
            opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
          },
          containerStyle,
        ]}
      >
        {leftIcon && <View style={{ marginRight: 10 }}>{leftIcon}</View>}
        <Text
          style={[
            { flex: 1, fontSize, color: selected ? textColor : placeholderTextColor },
            textStyle,
          ]}
        >
          {selected ? selected.label : placeholder}
        </Text>
        <Feather name="chevron-down" size={18} color="#9CA3AF" />
      </TouchableOpacity>

      {error && (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#EF4444', marginTop: 4, marginLeft: 4 }}>
          {error}
        </Text>
      )}

      {/* ── Bottom Sheet Modal ── */}
      <Modal visible={open} transparent animationType="slide">
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' }}
          onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          activeOpacity={1}
        />

        <View
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            bottom: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
            borderTopLeftRadius: 24,
            borderTopRightRadius: 24,
            paddingBottom: 36,
            paddingHorizontal: 20,
            paddingTop: 12,
            shadowColor: '#000',
            shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },
            shadowOpacity: 0.1,
            shadowRadius: 12,
            elevation: 16,
          }}
        >
          {/* Drag handle */}
          <View
            style={{
              width: 40,
              height: 4,
              borderRadius: 2,
              backgroundColor: '#D1D5DB',
              alignSelf: 'center',
              marginBottom: 20,
            }}
          />

          {/* Sheet title */}
          <Text
            style={{
              fontSize: 22,
              fontWeight: '800',
              color: '#111827',
              marginBottom: 16,
            }}
          >
            {sheetTitle}
          </Text>

          {/* Options */}
          <FlatList
            data={options}
            keyExtractor={item => item.value}
            scrollEnabled={false}
            ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 10 }} />}
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const isSelected = item.value === pending;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => setPending(item.value)}
                  activeOpacity={0.85}
                  style={{
                    flexDirection: 'row',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    borderWidth: 1.5,
                    borderColor: isSelected ? focusedBorderColor : '#E5E7EB',
                    borderRadius: 14,
                    backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
                    paddingVertical: 14,
                    paddingHorizontal: 16,
                    gap: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Option icon */}
                  {item.icon && (
                    <View
                      style={{
                        width: 38,
                        height: 38,
                        borderRadius: 10,
                        backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.icon}
                    </View>
                  )}

                  {/* Label + subtitle */}
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: '600',
                        color: '#111827',
                      }}
                    >
                      {item.label}
                    </Text>
                    {item.subtitle && (
                      <Text
                        style={{
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: '#9CA3AF',
                          marginTop: 2,
                        }}
                      >
                        {item.subtitle}
                      </Text>
                    )}
                  </View>

                  {/* Checkmark */}
                  {isSelected && (
                    <Feather name="check" size={18} color={focusedBorderColor} />
                  )}
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            }}
          />

          {/* Confirm button */}
          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={handleConfirm}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
            style={{
              marginTop: 20,
              backgroundColor: '#111827',
              borderRadius: 14,
              height: 56,
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              opacity: pending ? 1 : 0.4,
            }}
            disabled={!pending}
          >
            <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '700' }}>
              {confirmLabel}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// hooks/auth/useCreateAccount.ts
import { useState } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

interface CreateAccountForm {
  fullName:        string
  email:           string
  password:        string
  confirmPassword: string
  accountType:     string | null
  agreed:          boolean
}

interface CreateAccountErrors {
  fullName?:        string
  email?:           string
  password?:        string
  confirmPassword?: string
  accountType?:     string
  agreed?:          string
}

const EMAIL_REGEX    = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
const PASSWORD_REGEX = /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&#^()_\-+=])/

export function useCreateAccount() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CreateAccountForm>({
    fullName:        '',
    email:           '',
    password:        '',
    confirmPassword: '',
    accountType:     null,
    agreed:          false,
  })

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<CreateAccountErrors>({})
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const updateField = (
    field: keyof CreateAccountForm,
    value: string | boolean | null,
  ) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }))
    // Clear the error for this field as the user edits it
    if (errors[field as keyof CreateAccountErrors]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: undefined }))
    }
  }

  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const e: CreateAccountErrors = {}

    // ── Full Name ──────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.fullName.trim()) {
      e.fullName = 'Full name is required'
    } else if (form.fullName.trim().length < 2) {
      e.fullName = 'Full name must be at least 2 characters'
    } else if (form.fullName.trim().length > 60) {
      e.fullName = 'Full name must be under 60 characters'
    } else if (!/^[a-zA-Z\s'-]+$/.test(form.fullName.trim())) {
      e.fullName = 'Full name can only contain letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes'
    }

    // ── Email ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.email.trim()) {
      e.email = 'Email is required'
    } else if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(form.email.trim())) {
      e.email = 'Enter a valid email address'
    }

    // ── Account Type ───────────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.accountType) {
      e.accountType = 'Please select an account type'
    }

    // ── Password ───────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.password) {
      e.password = 'Password is required'
    } else if (form.password.length < 8) {
      e.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters'
    } else if (form.password.length > 72) {
      e.password = 'Password must be under 72 characters'
    } else if (!PASSWORD_REGEX.test(form.password)) {
      e.password =
        'Password must include uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character'
    }

    // ── Confirm Password ───────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.confirmPassword) {
      e.confirmPassword = 'Please confirm your password'
    } else if (form.confirmPassword !== form.password) {
      e.confirmPassword = 'Passwords do not match'
    }

    // ── Terms ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!form.agreed) {
      e.agreed = 'You must accept the Terms & Conditions to continue'
    }

    setErrors(e)
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0
  }

  const handleCreateAccount = async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
    if (!validate()) return

    try {
      setLoading(true)

      // TODO: replace with real API call
      console.log('CreateAccount data:', form)
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800))

      Toast.show({
        type:  'success',
        text1: 'Account Created!',
        text2: `Welcome, ${form.fullName.trim()}!`,
      })

      onSuccess?.()
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type:  'error',
        text1: 'Something went wrong',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return { form, errors, loading, updateField, handleCreateAccount }
}
```
