import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import type { ProductType } from '@/types/catalog'

export interface CartItem {
  id: string
  brand: string
  name: string
  colorway: string
  sku: string
  size: string
  productType: ProductType
  store: string
  distance: string
  price: number
  quantity: number
  image: string
}

interface CartState {
  items: CartItem[]
  promoCode: string
  appliedPromo: string | null
  discount: number
  shippingFee: number
}

const INITIAL_CART: CartState = {
  items: [
    {
      id: '1',
      brand: 'NIKE',
      name: 'Air Jordan 4 Retro',
      colorway: 'Black Cat',
      sku: 'CU1110-010',
      size: '10.5',
      productType: 'Sneakers',
      store: 'Kicks City',
      distance: '0.8mi',
      price: 220,
      quantity: 1,
      image:
        'https://static.nike.com/a/images/t_PDP_1728_v1/f_auto,q_auto:eco/99486859-0ff3-46b4-949b-2d16af2ad421/AIR+JORDAN+4+RETRO.png',
    },
    {
      id: '2',
      brand: 'ESSENTIALS',
      name: 'Pullover Hoodie',
      colorway: 'Stretch Limo',
      sku: 'ESS-HOODIE-BLK',
      size: 'L',
      productType: 'Clothing',
      store: 'Union Archive',
      distance: '1.2mi',
      price: 120,
      quantity: 1,
      image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1521572163474-6864f9cf17ab?w=800',
    },
  ],
  promoCode: '',
  appliedPromo: null,
  discount: 0,
  shippingFee: 0,
}

const VALID_PROMO_CODES: Record<string, number> = {
  SAVE10: 10,
  NIKE20: 20,
  FREESHIP: 0,
}

export const useCart = () => {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartState>(INITIAL_CART)

  const updateQuantity = useCallback((id: string, size: string, delta: number) => {
    setCart((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      items: prev.items
        .map((item) =>
          item.id === id && item.size === size
            ? { ...item, quantity: Math.max(0, item.quantity + delta) }
            : item,
        )
        .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0),
    }))
  }, [])

  const removeItem = useCallback((id: string, size: string) => {
    setCart((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      items: prev.items.filter((item) => !(item.id === id && item.size === size)),
    }))
  }, [])

  const setPromoCode = useCallback((code: string) => {
    setCart((prev) => ({ ...prev, promoCode: code }))
  }, [])

  const applyPromoCode = useCallback(() => {
    setCart((prev) => {
      const code = prev.promoCode.trim().toUpperCase()

      if (VALID_PROMO_CODES[code] !== undefined) {
        return { ...prev, appliedPromo: code, discount: VALID_PROMO_CODES[code] }
      }

      return prev
    })
  }, [])

  const removePromo = useCallback(() => {
    setCart((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      appliedPromo: null,
      discount: 0,
      promoCode: '',
    }))
  }, [])

  const subtotal = cart.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0)
  const discountAmount =
    cart.appliedPromo === 'FREESHIP' ? 0 : (subtotal * cart.discount) / 100
  const shipping = cart.appliedPromo === 'FREESHIP' ? 0 : cart.shippingFee
  const total = subtotal - discountAmount + shipping
  const itemCount = cart.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0)

  return {
    items: cart.items,
    promoCode: cart.promoCode,
    appliedPromo: cart.appliedPromo,
    discount: cart.discount,
    subtotal,
    discountAmount,
    shipping,
    total,
    itemCount,
    updateQuantity,
    removeItem,
    setPromoCode,
    applyPromoCode,
    removePromo,
  }
}

// hooks/notifications/useNotifications.ts
import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type NotificationCategory = 'All' | 'Restocks' | 'Orders' | 'Drops' | 'Stores'
export type NotificationGroup = 'NOW' | 'TODAY' | 'YESTERDAY' | 'THIS WEEK'

export interface Notification {
  id: string
  category: Exclude<NotificationCategory, 'All'>
  group: NotificationGroup
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  time: string
  read: boolean
  // ✅ ADD THESE
  brand?: string
  imageUri?: string
  icon: 'restock' | 'order' | 'drop' | 'store' | 'system'
}

// ─── Mock Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const MOCK_NOTIFICATIONS: Notification[] = [
  {
    id: '1',
    category: 'Restocks',
    group: 'NOW',
    title: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat' is back! 🔥",
    subtitle: "Size 10.5 now in stock at Sonny's Kicks · 1.1 mi",
    time: 'Just now',
    read: false,
    icon: 'restock',
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    category: 'Orders',
    group: 'NOW',
    title: 'Your order is ready for pickup',
    subtitle: 'GS-2024-7843 · Kicks City · Ready now',
    time: '15 min ago',
    read: false,
    icon: 'order',
  },
  {
    id: '3',
    category: 'Drops',
    group: 'TODAY',
    title: "Nike Dunk Low 'Panda' dropping Saturday",
    subtitle: "3 followed stores are stocking this. Set reminder →",
    time: '2 hrs ago',
    read: true,
    icon: 'drop',
  },
  {
    id: '4',
    category: 'Restocks',
    group: 'YESTERDAY',
    title: "Price drop: Yeezy Boost 350 'Carbon'",
    subtitle: 'Now $320, down from $350 · Available in your size',
    time: 'Yesterday',
    read: true,
    icon: 'restock',
  },
  {
    id: '5',
    category: 'Stores',
    group: 'YESTERDAY',
    title: "Flash Sale at Sonny's Kicks — 20% off today!",
    subtitle: "Today only · Tap to see what's on sale",
    time: 'Yesterday',
    read: true,
    icon: 'store',
  },
  {
    id: '6',
    category: 'Stores',
    group: 'THIS WEEK',
    title: 'Profile updated successfully',
    subtitle: "Size preferences saved · Size 10.5 Men's",
    time: '3 days ago',
    read: true,
    icon: 'system',
  },
]

// ─── Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const useNotifications = () => {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>(MOCK_NOTIFICATIONS)
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<NotificationCategory>('All')

  const unreadCount = useMemo(
    () => notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length,
    [notifications]
  )

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeCategory === 'All') return notifications
    return notifications.filter(n => n.category === activeCategory)
  }, [notifications, activeCategory])

  // Group filtered notifications by their group label
  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const order: NotificationGroup[] = ['NOW', 'TODAY', 'YESTERDAY', 'THIS WEEK']
    const map: Partial<Record<NotificationGroup, Notification[]>> = {}
    filtered.forEach(n => {
      if (!map[n.group]) map[n.group] = []
      map[n.group]!.push(n)
    })
    return order
      .filter(g => map[g] && map[g]!.length > 0)
      .map(g => ({ group: g, items: map[g]! }))
  }, [filtered])

  const markAllRead = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, read: true })))
  }, [])

  const clearAll = useCallback(() => {
    setNotifications([])
  }, [])

  const markRead = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev =>
      prev.map(n => (n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n))
    )
  }, [])

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.filter(n => n.id !== id))
  }, [])

  return {
    notifications,
    grouped,
    activeCategory,
    unreadCount,
    setActiveCategory,
    markAllRead,
    clearAll,
    markRead,
    dismiss,
  }
}

export interface WatchlistPair {

  brand: string
  price: number
  imageUrl: string
  tag?: 'Just Restocked' | 'Low Stock'
  tagColor?: 'green' | 'red'
  storeDistance: string
}

interface UseRestockAlertReturn {
  alert: RestockAlert | null
  watchlistPairs: WatchlistPair[]
  loading: boolean
  error: string | null
}

// ─── Mock fetcher — swap with your API call ───────────────────────────────────

async function fetchRestockAlert(notificationId: string): Promise<RestockAlert> {
  // TODO: replace with real API
  // const res = await fetch(`/api/notifications/restock/${notificationId}`)

  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)) // simulate latency

    },
  }
}

async function fetchWatchlistPairs(_productId: string): Promise<WatchlistPair[]> {
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200))
  return [
    {
      id: 'panda-1',
      name: 'Nike Dunk Low "Panda"',
      brand: 'Kicks City',
      price: 120,
      imageUrl: 'https://images.stockx.com/images/Nike-Dunk-Low-Retro-White-Black-2021.png',
      tag: 'Just Restocked',
      tagColor: 'green',
      storeDistance: '2.5 mi',
    },
    {
      id: 'yeezy-carbon',
      name: 'Yeezy Boost 350 "Carbon"',
      brand: 'Jordan Hub',
      price: 320,
      imageUrl: 'https://images.stockx.com/images/adidas-Yeezy-Boost-350-V2-Carbon.png',
      tag: 'Low Stock',
      tagColor: 'red',
      storeDistance: '1.3 mi',
    },
  ]
}

// ─── Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useRestockAlert(notificationId: string): UseRestockAlertReturn {
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState<RestockAlert | null>(null)
  const [watchlistPairs, setWatchlistPairs] = useState<WatchlistPair[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false

    async function load() {
      try {
        setLoading(true)
        const data = await fetchRestockAlert(notificationId)
        if (cancelled) return
        setAlert(data)

        const pairs = await fetchWatchlistPairs(data.productId)
        if (cancelled) return
        setWatchlistPairs(pairs)
      } catch (e: any) {
        if (!cancelled) setError(e.message ?? 'Unknown error')
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    load()
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [notificationId])

  return { alert, watchlistPairs, loading, error }
}

const DEFAULT_REGION: MapRegion = {
  latitude: 40.7525,
  longitude: -73.9857,
  latitudeDelta: 0.018,
  longitudeDelta: 0.018,
}

export function useMap() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  const [region, setRegion] = useState<MapRegion>(DEFAULT_REGION)
  const [stores] = useState<Store[]>(MOCK_STORES)
  const [selectedStore, setSelectedStore] = useState<Store | null>(null)

  const [isFetchingLocation, setIsFetchingLocation] = useState(false)
  const [locationError, setLocationError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<SearchFilters>(DEFAULT_FILTERS)
  const [isFilterModalOpen, setIsFilterModalOpen] = useState(false)

  const activeFilterCount =
    filters.productTypes.length +
    (filters.size !== 'Default' ? 1 : 0) +
    filters.brands.length +
    filters.stores.length

  const [filteredStores, setFilteredStores] = useState<Store[]>(MOCK_STORES)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)

    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase()

      const result = stores.filter((store) => {
        const hasMatchingProduct = store.products.some((product) => {
          const matchesType =
            filters.productTypes.length === 0 ||
            filters.productTypes.includes(product.productType)

          const matchesAudience =
            filters.size === 'Default' ||
            filters.size === 'Custom' ||
            product.audience === filters.size

          const matchesBrand =
            filters.brands.length === 0 ||
            filters.brands.some((brand) =>
              product.brand.toLowerCase().includes(brand.toLowerCase()),
            )

          return matchesType && matchesAudience && matchesBrand
        })

        if (!hasMatchingProduct) return false

        if (
          filters.stores.length > 0 &&
          !filters.stores.some((selectedStoreName) =>
            store.name.toLowerCase().includes(selectedStoreName.toLowerCase()),
          )
        ) {
          return false
        }

        if (!normalizedQuery) return true

        const haystacks = [
          store.name.toLowerCase(),
          store.tag.toLowerCase(),
          ...store.products.flatMap((product) => [
            product.name.toLowerCase(),
            product.brand.toLowerCase(),
            product.productType.toLowerCase(),
          ]),
        ]

        return haystacks.some((value) => value.includes(normalizedQuery))
      })

      setFilteredStores(result)
    }, 150)

    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)
    }
  }, [query, stores, filters])

  const handleQueryChange = useCallback((text: string) => setQuery(text), [])
  const handleClearQuery = useCallback(() => setQuery(''), [])

  const handleSelectStore = useCallback((store: Store) => setSelectedStore(store), [])
  const handleCloseStore = useCallback(() => setSelectedStore(null), [])

  const handleToggleFollow = useCallback((storeId: string) => {
    setSelectedStore((prev) =>
      prev?.id === storeId ? { ...prev, isFollowing: !prev.isFollowing } : prev,
    )
  }, [])

  const handleGoToCurrentLocation = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsFetchingLocation(true)
    setLocationError(null)

    try {
      const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync()
      if (status !== 'granted') {
        setLocationError('Location permission denied.')
        return
      }

      const location = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
        accuracy: Location.Accuracy.Balanced,
      })

      setRegion((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        latitude: location.coords.latitude,
        longitude: location.coords.longitude,
      }))
    } catch {
      setLocationError('Could not get your location.')
    } finally {
      setIsFetchingLocation(false)
    }
  }, [])

  const handleOpenFilterModal = useCallback(() => setIsFilterModalOpen(true), [])
  const handleCloseFilterModal = useCallback(() => setIsFilterModalOpen(false), [])

  const handleApplyFilters = useCallback((applied: SearchFilters) => {
    setFilters(applied)
    setIsFilterModalOpen(false)
  }, [])

  const handleResetFilters = useCallback(() => setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS), [])

  return {
    query,
    handleQueryChange,
    handleClearQuery,
    filters,
    activeFilterCount,
    isFilterModalOpen,
    handleOpenFilterModal,
    handleCloseFilterModal,
    handleApplyFilters,
    handleResetFilters,
    region,
    setRegion,
    filteredStores,
    nearbyCount: filteredStores.length,
    selectedStore,
    handleSelectStore,
    handleCloseStore,
    handleToggleFollow,
    isFetchingLocation,
    locationError,
    handleGoToCurrentLocation,
  }
}

```typescript
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export interface PrivacySettings {
  profileVisibility: boolean
  wishlist: boolean
  purchaseHistory: boolean
  lockerCollection: boolean
  vipStatus: boolean
  activity: boolean
}

export interface EditProfileForm {
  username: string
  fullName: string
  email: string
  bio: string
  privacy: PrivacySettings
}

export interface EditProfileErrors {
  username?: string
  fullName?: string
  email?: string
  bio?: string
}

const INITIAL_FORM: EditProfileForm = {
  username: 'sonnysgr',
  fullName: 'Sonny Garcia',
  email: 'sonny@example.com',
  bio: '',
  privacy: {
    profileVisibility: true,
    wishlist: true,
    purchaseHistory: false,
    lockerCollection: true,
    vipStatus: true,
    activity: false,
  }
}

export const useEditProfile = () => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<EditProfileForm>(INITIAL_FORM)
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<EditProfileErrors>({})
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const updateField = useCallback(
    (field: keyof Omit<EditProfileForm, 'privacy'>, value: string) => {
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }))
      if (errors[field]) {
        setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: undefined }))
      }
    },
    [errors]
  )

const updatePrivacy = useCallback((field: keyof PrivacySettings, label: string) => {
    setForm(prev => {
      const newValue = !prev.privacy[field];
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: `${label} Updated`,
        text2: `Setting changed to ${newValue ? 'Public' : 'Private'}`,
        position: 'top', // Bottom is usually better for small toggles
        bottomOffset: 100,
        visibilityTime: 2000,
      });

      return {
        ...prev,
        privacy: {
          ...prev.privacy,
          [field]: newValue
        }
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const newErrors: EditProfileErrors = {}

    if (!form.username.trim()) {
      newErrors.username = 'Username is required'
    } else if (form.username.length > 20) {
      newErrors.username = 'Max 20 characters'
    }

    if (!form.fullName.trim()) {
      newErrors.fullName = 'Full name is required'
    }

    if (!form.email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required'
    } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(form.email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Enter a valid email'
    }

    if (form.bio.length > 150) {
      newErrors.bio = 'Max 150 characters'
    }

    setErrors(newErrors)
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0
  }

  const handleSave = useCallback(
    async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
      if (!validate()) return

      try {
        setLoading(true)
        await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800))

        Toast.show({
          type: 'success',
          text1: 'Profile updated!',
          text2: 'Your changes have been saved.',
          position: 'top',
          topOffset: 56,
        })

        onSuccess?.()
      } catch (error: any) {
        Toast.show({
          type: 'error',
          text1: 'Update failed',
          text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
          position: 'top',
          topOffset: 56,
        })
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    },
    [form]
  )

  const handleChangePhoto = useCallback(() => {
    console.log('Change profile photo')
  }, [])

  return {
    form,
    errors,
    loading,
    updateField,
    updatePrivacy,
    handleSave,
    handleChangePhoto,
  }
}

  const [brands] = useState<FollowedBrand[]>(MOCK_BRANDS)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'Stores' | 'Brands'>('Stores')
  const [activeAlertFilters, setActiveAlertFilters] = useState<AlertType[]>([])

  const toggleStoreNotification = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setStores((prev) =>
      prev.map((store) =>
        store.id === id ? { ...store, notificationsOn: !store.notificationsOn } : store,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const toggleAlertFilter = useCallback((alert: AlertType) => {
    setActiveAlertFilters((prev) =>
      prev.includes(alert) ? prev.filter((item) => item !== alert) : [...prev, alert],
    )
  }, [])

  const filteredStores =
    activeAlertFilters.length === 0
      ? stores
      : stores.filter((store) => activeAlertFilters.every((filter) => store.alerts.includes(filter)))

  return {
    stores: filteredStores,
    brands,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    activeAlertFilters,
    toggleAlertFilter,
    toggleStoreNotification,
    storeCount: stores.length,
    brandCount: brands.length,
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

export type NotifyLocation = 'anywhere' | 'specific'

export interface WaitlistProduct {
  id: string
  brand: string
  name: string
  size: string
  gender: string
  waitingCount: number
  demand: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'
  imageUrl?: string
}

export function useJoinWaitlist(product: WaitlistProduct, onSuccess?: () => void) {
  const [notifyLocation, setNotifyLocation] = useState<NotifyLocation>('anywhere')
  const [alertPriceDrop, setAlertPriceDrop] = useState(false)
  const [selectedStores, setSelectedStores] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [joined, setJoined] = useState(false)

  const handleSelectLocation = (loc: NotifyLocation) => {
    setNotifyLocation(loc)
    if (loc === 'specific') {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'info',
        text1: 'Choose Your Stores',
        text2: 'Select specific stores to monitor for your size.',
      })
    }
  }

  const handleTogglePriceDrop = () => {
    const next = !alertPriceDrop
    setAlertPriceDrop(next)
    Toast.show({
      type: next ? 'success' : 'info',
      text1: next ? 'Price Drop Alert On' : 'Price Drop Alert Off',
      text2: next
        ? `We'll notify you if ${product.name} drops in price.`
        : 'You won\'t receive price drop alerts.',
    })
  }

// Replace the handleChooseStores stub with:
const handleChooseStores = (storeIds: string[]) => {
  setSelectedStores(storeIds)
}

  const handleJoinWaitlist = async () => {
    if (joined) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'info',
        text1: 'Already on Waitlist',
        text2: `You're already waiting for ${product.name} in size ${product.size}.`,
      })
      return
    }

    if (notifyLocation === 'specific' && selectedStores.length === 0) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'No Stores Selected',
        text2: 'Please choose at least one store or switch to "Anywhere nearby".',
      })
      return
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      // TODO: replace with real API call
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 900))

      setJoined(true)
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: "You're on the Waitlist! 🎉",
        text2: `We'll notify you the moment ${product.name} is back in size ${product.size}.`,
      })
      onSuccess?.()
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Failed to Join',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Something went wrong. Please try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleLeaveWaitlist = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 600))
      setJoined(false)
      Toast.show({
        type: 'info',
        text1: 'Left Waitlist',
        text2: `You've been removed from the waitlist for ${product.name}.`,
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Error',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Could not leave waitlist. Try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {
    notifyLocation,
    alertPriceDrop,
    selectedStores,
    loading,
    joined,
    handleSelectLocation,
    handleTogglePriceDrop,
    handleChooseStores,
    handleJoinWaitlist,
    handleLeaveWaitlist,
  }
}

    condition: '9/10',
    estimatedValue: 310,
    size: 'L',
    colorway: 'Black/Cream',
  },

export const useLocker = () => {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<LockerItem[]>(MOCK_ITEMS)
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(true)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>('grid')
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const [selectedItemId, setSelectedItemId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showActionSheet, setShowActionSheet] = useState(false)

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const conditionToNumber = (condition: ConditionLabel): number => {
      if (condition === 'DS') return 10
      if (condition === 'VNDS') return 9.5
      return parseFloat(condition.replace('/10', ''))
    }

    const totalValue = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.estimatedValue, 0)
    const avgCondition =
      items.length > 0
        ? items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + conditionToNumber(item.condition), 0) / items.length
        : 0

    return {
      totalPairs: items.length,
      estimatedValue: totalValue,
      avgCondition: Math.round(avgCondition * 10) / 10,
    }
  }, [items])

  const toggleVisibility = useCallback(() => setIsPublic((value) => !value), [])

  const toggleViewMode = useCallback(
    () => setViewMode((value) => (value === 'grid' ? 'list' : 'grid')),
    [],
  )

  const openItemMenu = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedItemId(id)
    setShowActionSheet(true)
  }, [])

  const closeActionSheet = useCallback(() => {
    setShowActionSheet(false)
    setSelectedItemId(null)
  }, [])

  const deleteItem = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id))
    setShowActionSheet(false)
    setSelectedItemId(null)
  }, [])

  const addItem = useCallback((newItem: Omit<LockerItem, 'id'>) => {
    const item: LockerItem = {
      ...newItem,
      id: Date.now().toString(),
    }
    setItems((prev) => [...prev, item])
  }, [])

  const updateItem = useCallback((id: string, updates: Partial<LockerItem>) => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updates } : item)))
  }, [])

  const selectedItem = useMemo(
    () => items.find((item) => item.id === selectedItemId) ?? null,
    [items, selectedItemId],
  )

  return {
    items,
    isPublic,
    viewMode,
    isLoading,
    stats,
    selectedItem,
    showActionSheet,
    toggleVisibility,
    toggleViewMode,
    openItemMenu,
    closeActionSheet,
    deleteItem,
    addItem,
    updateItem,
  }
}

import type { ProductType } from '@/types/catalog'

export type SaleStatus = 'Active' | 'Sold' | 'Pending' | 'Expired'
export type SaleTab = 'All' | 'Active Listings' | 'Offers Received' | 'Completed'

export interface SaleItem {
  id: string
  name: string
  productType: ProductType
  sizeLabel: string
  askingPrice: number
  priceDelta?: number
  status: SaleStatus
  imageUri?: string
  soldFor?: number
  soldAt?: string
  soldDate?: string
  offerFrom?: string
  stores?: number
  noOffers?: boolean
  listingExpired?: boolean
  section: 'This Week' | 'Last Month'
}

export const STATUS_COLOR: Record<SaleStatus, string> = {
  Active: '#22C55E',
  Sold: '#3B82F6',
  Pending: '#F59E0B',
  Expired: '#9CA3AF',
}

const MOCK: SaleItem[] = [
  {
    id: 'sl1',
    name: "Air Jordan 4 'Black Cat'",
    productType: 'Sneakers',
    sizeLabel: '10.5',
    askingPrice: 220,
    priceDelta: 160,
    status: 'Pending',
    offerFrom: "Sonny's Kicks",
    section: 'This Week',
  },
  {
    id: 'sl2',
    name: 'Essentials Pullover Hoodie',
    productType: 'Clothing',
    sizeLabel: 'L',
    askingPrice: 120,
    status: 'Active',
    stores: 3,
    section: 'This Week',
  },
  {
    id: 'sl3',
    name: 'Stussy Varsity Jacket',
    productType: 'Clothing',
    sizeLabel: 'XL',
    askingPrice: 285,
    priceDelta: 225,
    status: 'Sold',
    soldFor: 225,
    soldAt: 'Union Archive',
    soldDate: 'Mar 18',
    section: 'This Week',
  },
  {
    id: 'sl4',
    name: "Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1",
    productType: 'Sneakers',
    sizeLabel: '10.5',
    askingPrice: 300,
    status: 'Expired',
    noOffers: true,
    listingExpired: true,
    section: 'Last Month',
  },
  {
    id: 'sl5',
    name: 'Nike Sportswear Club Tee',
    productType: 'Clothing',
    sizeLabel: 'M',
    askingPrice: 45,
    status: 'Expired',
    noOffers: true,
    listingExpired: true,
    section: 'Last Month',
  },
]

export function useMySales() {
  const [sales] = useState<SaleItem[]>(MOCK)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<SaleTab>('All')

  const totalEarned = sales
    .filter((sale) => sale.status === 'Sold')
    .reduce((acc, sale) => acc + sale.askingPrice, 0)

  const soldCount = sales.filter((sale) => sale.status === 'Sold').length
  const activeCount = sales.filter((sale) => sale.status === 'Active').length
  const declineCount = sales.filter((sale) => sale.status === 'Expired').length

  const filteredSales = sales.filter((sale) => {
    if (activeTab === 'All') return true
    if (activeTab === 'Active Listings') return sale.status === 'Active'
    if (activeTab === 'Offers Received') return sale.status === 'Pending'
    if (activeTab === 'Completed') return sale.status === 'Sold' || sale.status === 'Expired'
    return true
  })

  const thisWeek = filteredSales.filter((sale) => sale.section === 'This Week')
  const lastMonth = filteredSales.filter((sale) => sale.section === 'Last Month')

  const handleNewSale = useCallback(() => {}, [])
  const handleViewOffer = useCallback((_item: SaleItem) => {
    router.push('/screens/discover/offerFromStoreScreen')
  }, [])
  const handleEdit = useCallback((_item: SaleItem) => {}, [])
  const handleRemark = useCallback((_item: SaleItem) => {}, [])
  const handleDetails = useCallback((_item: SaleItem) => {}, [])

  return {
    sales,
    thisWeek,
    lastMonth,
    totalEarned,
    soldCount,
    activeCount,
    declineCount,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    handleNewSale,
    handleViewOffer,
    handleEdit,
    handleRemark,
    handleDetails,
  }
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import type { ProductType } from '@/types/catalog'

export type SortOption = 'Newest' | 'Oldest' | 'Price: Low to High' | 'Price: High to Low'

export interface FilterState {
  sort: SortOption
  category: 'All' | ProductType
}

const DEFAULT_FILTER: FilterState = {
  sort: 'Newest',
  category: 'All',
}

const SORT_OPTIONS: SortOption[] = [
  'Newest',
  'Oldest',
  'Price: Low to High',
  'Price: High to Low',
]

const CATEGORY_OPTIONS: FilterState['category'][] = ['All', 'Sneakers', 'Clothing']

export const useOrderFilter = () => {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTER)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<FilterState>(DEFAULT_FILTER)

  const open = useCallback(() => {
    setDraft(applied)
    setVisible(true)
  }, [applied])

  const close = useCallback(() => setVisible(false), [])

  const setSort = useCallback((sort: SortOption) => {
    setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, sort }))
  }, [])

  const setCategory = useCallback((category: FilterState['category']) => {
    setDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, category }))
  }, [])

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setDraft(DEFAULT_FILTER)
    setApplied(DEFAULT_FILTER)
  }, [])

  const apply = useCallback(() => {
    setApplied(draft)
    setVisible(false)
  }, [draft])

  const activeFilterCount =
    (applied.sort !== 'Newest' ? 1 : 0) + (applied.category !== 'All' ? 1 : 0)

  return {
    visible,
    draft,
    applied,
    activeFilterCount,
    sortOptions: SORT_OPTIONS,
    categoryOptions: CATEGORY_OPTIONS,
    open,
    close,
    setSort,
    setCategory,
    reset,
    apply,
  }
}

  },
  {
    id: '7',
    productName: 'Fear of God Track Pant',
    productType: 'Clothing',
    brand: 'Fear of God',
    size: 'Kids L',
    audience: "Kids'",
    store: 'Sneaker Haven',
    date: 'Mar 20',
    price: 98,
    status: 'Active',
    imageColor: '#DDD6FE',
    group: 'THIS WEEK',
    sortDate: new Date('2024-03-20').getTime(),
  },
]

const TAB_FILTER_MAP: Record<OrderFilter, OrderStatus[]> = {
  All: ['Completed', 'Active', 'Pick Up Ready', 'On Hold', 'Cancelled'],
  Completed: ['Completed'],
  Active: ['Active'],
  'Pick Up Ready': ['Pick Up Ready'],
  Holds: ['On Hold'],
  Cancelled: ['Cancelled'],
}

export const useOrders = (appliedFilter?: FilterState) => {
  const [orders] = useState<Order[]>(MOCK_ORDERS)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OrderFilter>('All')

  const processed = useMemo(() => {
    let result = [...orders]

    const tabStatuses = TAB_FILTER_MAP[activeTab]
    result = result.filter((order) => tabStatuses.includes(order.status))

    if (appliedFilter?.category && appliedFilter.category !== 'All') {
      result = result.filter((order) => order.productType === appliedFilter.category)
    }

    switch (appliedFilter?.sort) {
      case 'Oldest':
        result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.sortDate - b.sortDate)
        break
      case 'Price: Low to High':
        result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)
        break
      case 'Price: High to Low':
        result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price)
        break
      default:
        result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.sortDate - a.sortDate)
        break
    }

    return result
  }, [orders, activeTab, appliedFilter])

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const groupOrder = ['THIS WEEK', 'MARCH 2024']
    const groupedOrders: Record<string, Order[]> = {}

    processed.forEach((order) => {
      if (!groupedOrders[order.group]) {
        groupedOrders[order.group] = []
      }

      groupedOrders[order.group].push(order)
    })

    return groupOrder
      .filter((group) => groupedOrders[group]?.length > 0)
      .map((group) => ({ group, items: groupedOrders[group] }))
  }, [processed])

  return {
    grouped,
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
  }
}

const MOCK_ITEMS: WishlistItem[] = [

  },

    productType: 'Clothing',
    isLiked: true,
  },
  {
    id: '3',
    brand: 'STUSSY',
    name: 'Varsity Jacket',
    size: 'L',
    storesNearby: 1,
    price: 320,
    status: 'Low Stock',

    productType: 'Clothing',
    isLiked: true,
  },
  {
    id: '4',
    brand: 'NIKE',
    name: "Air Max 90 'Infrared'",
    size: '10.5',
    storesNearby: 0,
    price: 140,
    status: 'Sold Out',
    image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1606107557195-0e29a4b5b4aa?w=200',
    productType: 'Sneakers',
    isLiked: true,
  },
]

export function useWishlist(appliedFilter: WishlistFilterState) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<WishlistItem[]>(MOCK_ITEMS)
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<FilterTab>('All')

  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    let result =
      activeFilter === 'All'
        ? items
        : items.filter((item) => item.status === activeFilter)

    if (appliedFilter.category !== 'All') {
      result = result.filter((item) => item.productType === appliedFilter.category)
    }

    if (appliedFilter.sort === 'Price: Low to High') {
      result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)
    }

    if (appliedFilter.sort === 'Price: High to Low') {
      result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price)
    }

    if (appliedFilter.sort === 'Name: A-Z') {
      result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
    }

    return result
  }, [items, activeFilter, appliedFilter])

  const toggleLike = (id: string) => {
    setItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, isLiked: !item.isLiked } : item,
      ),
    )
  }

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id))
  }

  const filterCounts: Record<FilterTab, number> = useMemo(
    () => ({
      All: items.length,
      'In Stock': items.filter((item) => item.status === 'In Stock').length,
      'Low Stock': items.filter((item) => item.status === 'Low Stock').length,
      'Sold Out': items.filter((item) => item.status === 'Sold Out').length,
    }),
    [items],
  )

  return {
    items: filteredItems,
    activeFilter,
    setActiveFilter,
    filterCounts,
    toggleLike,
    removeItem,
  }
}

export function usePickBrands() {
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(['nike', 'jordan', 'adidas']))
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const filteredBrands = DEFAULT_BRANDS.filter(b =>
    b.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  )

  const toggleBrand = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id)
      return next
    })
  }

  const handleContinue = async (onSuccess?: () => void) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)

        text1: 'Brands Saved!',
        text2: "We'll show you drops from your favorite brands.",
      })

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400))
      onSuccess?.()
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Something went wrong',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {

    selectedIds,
    setSelectedIds, // 👈 add this
    search,
    setSearch,
    toggleBrand,
    handleContinue,
    loading,
    selectedCount: selectedIds.size,
  }
}

    setSelectedSizes(prev => ({ ...prev, [tab]: null }))
  }

  const allSelectedSizes = (Object.entries(selectedSizes) as [GenderTab, string | null][])
    .filter(([, size]) => size !== null)
    .map(([tab, size]) => ({ tab, size: size! }))

  return {
    activeTab,
    setActiveTab,
    currentConfig,
    currentSelected,
    setSelectedSizes,
    selectSize,
    addCustomSize,
    handleContinue,
    allSelectedSizes,
    removeSelectedSize,
    loading,
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { router } from 'expo-router';
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message';

export type InventoryMode = 'shared' | 'separate';

export interface BranchForm {
  name: string;
  address: string;
  phone: string;
  acceptOrders: boolean;
  acceptDeposit: boolean;
  pickupAvailable: boolean;
}

export const useAddBranch = () => {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<BranchForm>({
    name: '',
    address: '',
    phone: '',
    acceptOrders: true,
    acceptDeposit: true,
    pickupAvailable: true,
  });

  const [inventoryMode, setInventoryMode] = useState<InventoryMode>('shared');

  const setField = <K extends keyof BranchForm>(key: K, value: BranchForm[K]) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
  };

  const handleAddPhoto = () => {
    Toast.show({ type: 'info', text1: 'Photo picker coming soon' });
  };

  const handleSetupCustomPickup = () => {
    router.push('/retailer/branch/pickup-rules');
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Branch name is required' });
      return;
    }
    if (!form.address.trim()) {
      Toast.show({ type: 'error', text1: 'Address is required' });
      return;
    }
    // TODO: call API
    Toast.show({ type: 'success', text1: 'Branch saved!', text2: form.name });
    router.back();
  };
  
  return {
    form,
    setField,
    inventoryMode,
    setInventoryMode,
    handleSave,
    handleAddPhoto,
    handleSetupCustomPickup,
  };
};
```

const secureGet = async (key: string): Promise<string | null> => {
  try {
    return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(key)
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const secureSet = async (key: string, value: string): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value)
  } catch {}
}

const secureDelete = async (key: string): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key)
  } catch {}
}

const RECENT_SEARCHES_KEY = 'search_recent'
const MAX_RECENT = 8

export type SearchMode = 'products'

export type SizeOption = "Men's" | "Women's" | "Kids'" | 'Custom' | 'Default'

export const SIZE_OPTIONS: SizeOption[] = [
  'Default',
  "Men's",
  "Women's",
  "Kids'",
  'Custom',
]

export const BRAND_OPTIONS = [

  'Stussy Lab',
  'Kicks City',
]

export interface SearchFilters {
  productTypes: ProductType[]
  size: SizeOption
  brands: string[]
  stores: string[]
}

export const DEFAULT_FILTERS: SearchFilters = {
  productTypes: [],
  size: 'Default',
  brands: [],
  stores: [],
}

export interface TrendingItem {
  id: string
  label: string
}

export const TRENDING_ITEMS: TrendingItem[] = [

export interface SearchResult {
  id: string
  name: string
  brand: string
  store: string
  price: number
  size: string
  audience: Audience
  productType: ProductType
  image?: string
}

const MOCK_PRODUCTS: SearchResult[] = [
  {
    id: '1',

const mockSearch = (
  query: string,
  _mode: SearchMode,
  filters: SearchFilters,
): SearchResult[] => {
  const normalizedQuery = query.toLowerCase()

  return MOCK_PRODUCTS.filter((item) => {
    const matchesQuery =
      item.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
      item.brand.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
      item.store.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
      item.productType.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)

    const matchesType =
      filters.productTypes.length === 0 ||
      filters.productTypes.includes(item.productType)

    const matchesAudience =
      filters.size === 'Default' ||
      filters.size === 'Custom' ||
      item.audience === filters.size

    const matchesBrand =
      filters.brands.length === 0 ||
      filters.brands.includes(item.brand)

    const matchesStore =
      filters.stores.length === 0 ||
      filters.stores.includes(item.store)

    return matchesQuery && matchesType && matchesAudience && matchesBrand && matchesStore
  })
}

export function useSearch(mode: SearchMode = 'products') {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [debouncedQuery, setDebouncedQuery] = useState('')
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<SearchFilters>(DEFAULT_FILTERS)
  const [isFilterModalOpen, setIsFilterModalOpen] = useState(false)

  const [recentSearches, setRecentSearches] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [isLoadingRecent, setIsLoadingRecent] = useState(true)

  const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchResult[]>([])
  const [isFetching, setIsFetching] = useState(false)
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    ;(async () => {
      try {
        const stored = await secureGet(RECENT_SEARCHES_KEY)
        if (stored) setRecentSearches(JSON.parse(stored))
      } finally {
        setIsLoadingRecent(false)
      }
    })()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedQuery(query), 350)
    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)
    }
  }, [query])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!debouncedQuery.trim()) {
      setResults([])
      setIsError(false)
      return
    }

    setIsFetching(true)
    setIsError(false)

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        const found = mockSearch(debouncedQuery, mode, filters)
        setResults(found)
      } catch {
        setIsError(true)
      } finally {
        setIsFetching(false)
      }
    }, 400)

    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [debouncedQuery, mode, filters])

  const hasResults = results.length > 0
  const isSearchActive = query.trim().length >= 1

  const activeFilterCount =
    filters.productTypes.length +
    (filters.size !== 'Default' ? 1 : 0) +
    filters.brands.length +
    filters.stores.length

  const searchParams = {
    query: debouncedQuery,
    productTypes: filters.productTypes.length > 0 ? filters.productTypes : undefined,
    size: filters.size !== 'Default' ? filters.size : undefined,
    brands: filters.brands.length > 0 ? filters.brands : undefined,
    stores: filters.stores.length > 0 ? filters.stores : undefined,
  }

  const handleQueryChange = useCallback((text: string) => setQuery(text), [])

  const handleClearQuery = useCallback(() => {
    setQuery('')
    setDebouncedQuery('')
    setResults([])
  }, [])

  const handleSubmitSearch = useCallback(async () => {
    const trimmed = query.trim()
    if (!trimmed) return

    setRecentSearches((prev) => {
      const next = [trimmed, ...prev.filter((item) => item !== trimmed)].slice(
        0,
        MAX_RECENT,
      )
      secureSet(RECENT_SEARCHES_KEY, JSON.stringify(next))
      return next
    })
  }, [query])

  const handleOpenFilterModal = useCallback(() => setIsFilterModalOpen(true), [])
  const handleCloseFilterModal = useCallback(() => setIsFilterModalOpen(false), [])

  const handleApplyFilters = useCallback((applied: SearchFilters) => {
    setFilters(applied)
    setIsFilterModalOpen(false)
  }, [])

  const handleResetFilters = useCallback(() => setFilters(DEFAULT_FILTERS), [])

  const handleSelectRecent = useCallback((term: string) => setQuery(term), [])

  const handleRemoveRecent = useCallback((term: string) => {
    setRecentSearches((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((item) => item !== term)
      secureSet(RECENT_SEARCHES_KEY, JSON.stringify(next))
      return next
    })
  }, [])

  const handleClearAllRecent = useCallback(() => {
    setRecentSearches([])
    secureDelete(RECENT_SEARCHES_KEY)
  }, [])

  const handleSelectTrending = useCallback((label: string) => setQuery(label), [])

  return {
    query,
    debouncedQuery,
    isSearchActive,
    handleQueryChange,
    handleClearQuery,
    handleSubmitSearch,

    filters,
    activeFilterCount,
    isFilterModalOpen,
    handleOpenFilterModal,
    handleCloseFilterModal,
    handleApplyFilters,
    handleResetFilters,
    searchParams,

    trendingItems: TRENDING_ITEMS,
    handleSelectTrending,

    recentSearches,
    isLoadingRecent,
    handleSelectRecent,
    handleRemoveRecent,
    handleClearAllRecent,

    results,
    isFetching,
    isError,
    hasResults,
  }
}

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'
import type { ProductType } from '@/types/catalog'

export type ProductCondition = 'Deadstock' | 'Near Deadstock' | 'Very Good' | 'Good'

export interface ConditionOption {
  label: ProductCondition
  sub: string
  code: string
}

export const CONDITIONS: ConditionOption[] = [
  { label: 'Deadstock', sub: 'DS', code: 'DS' },
  { label: 'Near Deadstock', sub: '9/10', code: 'ND' },
  { label: 'Very Good', sub: '8/10', code: 'VG' },
  { label: 'Good', sub: '7/10', code: 'GD' },
]

export const PRODUCT_TYPE_OPTIONS: ProductType[] = ['Sneakers', 'Clothing']
export const RADIUS_OPTIONS = [10, 30, 60] as const
export type RadiusMiles = typeof RADIUS_OPTIONS[number]

export type PhotoSlot =
  | 'Your photo'
  | 'Front'
  | 'Back'
  | 'Tag'
  | 'Detail'
  | 'Receipt'

export const PHOTO_SLOTS: PhotoSlot[] = [
  'Your photo',
  'Front',
  'Back',
  'Tag',
  'Detail',
  'Receipt',
]

export function useSellToStore() {
  const router = useRouter()

  const [productType, setProductType] = useState<ProductType>('Sneakers')
  const [productName, setProductName] = useState('')
  const [condition, setCondition] = useState<ProductCondition | null>(null)
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('')
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<Partial<Record<PhotoSlot, string>>>({})
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('')
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true)
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState<RadiusMiles>(30)
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)

  const handlePickPhoto = useCallback((slot: PhotoSlot) => {
    console.log('pick photo for', slot)
  }, [])

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(() => {
    if (!productName || !condition || !price) return

    setSubmitted(true)
    Toast.show({
      type: 'success',
      text1: 'Listing submitted!',
      text2: 'Nearby stores can now see your item.',
      visibilityTime: 2000,
    })
    router.back()
  }, [condition, price, productName, router])

  const isValid = !!productName && !!condition && !!price && Number(price) > 0

  return {
    productType,
    setProductType,
    productName,
    setProductName,
    condition,
    setCondition,
    price,
    setPrice,
    photos,
    details,
    setDetails,
    visible,
    setVisible,
    radius,
    setRadius,
    submitted,
    isValid,
    handlePickPhoto,
    handleSubmit,
    goBack: () => router.back(),
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet, ScrollView } from 'react-native'
import { router, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router'
import { useSizeSelection } from '@/services/hooks/profilesetup/useSizeSelection'
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button'
import GenderTabBar from '@/components/profilesetup/GenderTabBar'
import SizeGrid from '@/components/profilesetup/SizeGrid'
import SelectedSizeChips from '@/components/profilesetup/SelectedSizeChips'
import CustomSizeModal from '@/components/profilesetup/CustomizedModal'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

export default function SizeScreen() {
    const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ sizes?: string }>()

    const {
        activeTab,
        setActiveTab,
        currentConfig,
        currentSelected,
        selectSize,
        addCustomSize,
        handleContinue,
        allSelectedSizes,
        removeSelectedSize,
        setSelectedSizes, // make sure hook exposes this
        loading,
    } = useSizeSelection()

    const [modalVisible, setModalVisible] = useState(false)

    // Preselect sizes from params
    useEffect(() => {
        if (params.sizes) {
            const paramSizes = params.sizes.split(',')
      setSelectedSizes(paramSizes as any)
        }
    }, [params.sizes, setSelectedSizes])

    const onContinue = () => {
        if (params.sizes) {
            // Came from profile edit → save then go back
            handleContinue(() => router.back())
        } else {
            // Came from onboarding → go to next screen
            handleContinue(() => router.push('/profilesetup/clothingSizeScreen' as any))
        }
    }

    return (
        <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff" scrollable>
            <ScrollView
                style={styles.body}
                contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
                showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
                <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>Personalize</Text>
                <Text style={styles.heading}>What's your{'\n'}size?</Text>
                <Text style={styles.subheading}>
                    We'll show you only what fits. Set all your sizes below.
                </Text>

                <GenderTabBar activeTab={activeTab} onTabChange={setActiveTab} />

                <SizeGrid
                    unit={currentConfig.unit}
                    sizes={currentConfig.sizes}
                    selectedSize={currentSelected}
                    onSelectSize={selectSize}
                    onAddCustom={() => setModalVisible(true)}
                />

                <SelectedSizeChips
                    selectedSizes={allSelectedSizes}
                    onRemove={removeSelectedSize}
                />
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.footer}>
                <Button
                    text={loading ? 'Saving' : 'Continue'}
                    onPress={onContinue}
                    variant="solid"
                    backgroundColor="#000000"
                    height={56}
                    borderRadius={14}
                    fontSize={17}
                    fontWeight="700"
                    disabled={loading}
                    opacity={loading ? 0.7 : 1}
                    style={{ flex: 0, alignSelf: 'stretch' }}
                />
                {!params.sizes && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                        style={styles.skipBtn}
                        onPress={() => router.push('/')}
                        activeOpacity={0.7}
                        disabled={loading}
                    >
                        <Text style={styles.skipBtnText}>Skip for now</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                )}
            </View>

            <CustomSizeModal
                visible={modalVisible}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onConfirm={addCustomSize}
                onClose={() => setModalVisible(false)}
            />
        </BaseContainer>
    )
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    root: {
        flex: 1,
        backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
    },
    body: {

        paddingHorizontal: 20,
    },

import React from 'react'
import {
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import { useRequests } from '@/services/hooks/reseller/requests/useRequests'

const Requests = () => {
  const { requests, activeTab, setActiveTab, summary, tabs, tabCounts } = useRequests()
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <View className="mt-10 pt-10 pb-20 mb-20">
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Store Requests</Text>

          <View style={styles.summaryAlert}>
            <View style={styles.alertIconRow}>
              <Ionicons name="notifications-outline" size={16} color="#B45309" />
              <Text style={styles.alertText}>
                <Text style={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{summary.total} requests</Text> ·{' '}
                {summary.newToday} new today ·
                <Text style={{ color: '#B45309', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                  {' '}
                  {summary.expiringSoon} expiring soon
                </Text>
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity>
              <Text style={styles.markReadText}>Mark all read</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={styles.tabScroll}>
            {tabs.map((tab) => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={tab}
                onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                style={[styles.tabChip, activeTab === tab && styles.tabChipActive]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.tabText, activeTab === tab && styles.tabTextActive]}>
                  {tab} ({tabCounts[tab]})
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>

          <View style={styles.listContainer}>
            {requests.map((item) => (

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Text,
  Platform,
  StyleSheet,
  useWindowDimensions,
} from 'react-native';
import { Tabs } from 'expo-router';
import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  withSpring,
  useSharedValue,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

const ACTIVE_COLOR = '#000000';
const INACTIVE_COLOR = '#94a3b8';
const DOT_COLOR = '#22C55E';
const BAR_BG = '#FFFFFF';

/**
 * Route-based config (robust, order-independent)
 */
const tabMap: Record<
  string,
  { label: string; icon: any; activeIcon: any }
> = {
  home: {
    label: 'Dashboard',
    icon: 'home-outline',
    activeIcon: 'home',
  },
  inventory: {
    label: 'Inventory',
    icon: 'warehouse',
    activeIcon: 'warehouse',
  },
  orders: {
    label: 'Orders',
    icon: 'clipboard-text-outline',
    activeIcon: 'clipboard-text',
  },
  promote: {
    label: 'Promote',
    icon: 'bullhorn-outline',
    activeIcon: 'bullhorn',
  },
  profile: {
    label: 'Profile',
    icon: 'account-outline',
    activeIcon: 'account',
  },
};

const AnimatedTabItem = ({
  isFocused,
  navigation,
  route,
}: any) => {
  const config = tabMap[route.name];
  if (!config) return null;

  const iconScale = useSharedValue(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);

  useEffect(() => {
    iconScale.value = withSpring(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);
  }, [isFocused]);

  const iconStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: iconScale.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => navigation.navigate(route.name)}
      style={styles.tabItem}
      activeOpacity={0.7}
    >
      <View style={styles.iconWrapper}>
        <Animated.View style={iconStyle}>
          <MaterialCommunityIcons
            name={isFocused ? config.activeIcon : config.icon}
            size={26}
            color={isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR}
          />
        </Animated.View>
      </View>

      <Text
        style={[
          styles.label,
          {
            color: isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR,
            fontWeight: isFocused ? '700' : '500',
          },
        ]}
      >
        {config.label}
      </Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
};

const CustomTabBar = ({ state, navigation }: any) => {
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const TAB_BAR_WIDTH = width;
  const TAB_WIDTH = TAB_BAR_WIDTH / state.routes.length;

  const translateX = useSharedValue(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    translateX.value = withSpring(state.index * TAB_WIDTH, {
      damping: 20,
      stiffness: 150,
    });
  }, [state.index]);

  const dotStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ translateX: translateX.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <View style={styles.tabBarContainer}>
      <View style={[styles.tabBarInner, { width: TAB_BAR_WIDTH }]}>
        {/* Sliding Dot */}
        <Animated.View
          style={[
            styles.slidingDotContainer,
            { width: TAB_WIDTH },
            dotStyle,
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
        </Animated.View>

        {state.routes.map((route: any, index: number) => {
          const isFocused = state.index === index;

          return (
            <AnimatedTabItem
              key={route.key}
              route={route}
              isFocused={isFocused}
              navigation={navigation}
            />
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  tabBarContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    bottom: 0,                          // flush to bottom
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  tabBarInner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: BAR_BG,
    height: 75,
    borderRadius: 0,                    // no rounding — flat/square
    borderWidth: 0,
    borderTopWidth: 1,                  // only top border
    borderTopColor: '#F1F5F9',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },   // shadow upward
    shadowOpacity: 0.05,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 10,
    width: '100%',                      // full width, not 95%
    paddingBottom: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 20 : 0, // safe area on iOS
  },
  tabItem: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    zIndex: 2,
  },
  iconWrapper: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    height: 28,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  slidingDotContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    height: 75,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    zIndex: 1,
  },
  activeDot: {
    width: 6,
    height: 6,
    borderRadius: 3,
    backgroundColor: DOT_COLOR,
    marginTop: 10,
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: 14,
    marginTop: 4,
  },
});

export default function TabLayout() {
  return (
    <Tabs
      screenOptions={{
        headerShown: false,
        tabBarStyle: { display: 'none' },
      }}
      tabBar={(props) => <CustomTabBar {...props} />}
    >
      <Tabs.Screen name="home" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="inventory" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="orders" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="promote" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="profile" />
    </Tabs>
  );
}

};

function capitalize(str: string) {
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

function getSocialIcon(platform: string): any {
  switch (platform) {
    case 'instagram':
      return 'logo-instagram';
    case 'tiktok':
      return 'logo-tiktok';
    case 'twitter':
      return 'logo-twitter';
    case 'facebook':
      return 'logo-facebook';
    default:
      return 'link';
  }
}

const RestockAlertScreen: React.FC = () => {

  const { alert, watchlistPairs, loading } = useRestockAlert(notificationId)

    router.push(
      `/screens/discover/buyNowScreen?productId=${alert.productId}&size=${encodeURIComponent(alert.size)}` as any
    )
  }, [alert, router])

  const handleHold = useCallback(() => {

    router.push(

    )
  }, [alert, router])

  const handleReserve = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(
      `/screens/discover/reserveForPickupScreen?productId=${alert.productId}&storeId=${alert.store.id}&size=${encodeURIComponent(alert.size)}` as any
    )
  }, [alert, router])

  const handleSeeOtherStores = useCallback(() => {
    if (!alert) return
    router.push(`/screens/discover/storeListScreen?productId=${alert.productId}` as any)

          </View>

          {/* ── Hero card ── */}
          <View className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-3xl bg-gray-900 overflow-hidden">
            <RestockHeroBadge />

            <View className="items-center py-5">
              <Image
                source={{ uri: alert.imageUrl }}
                className="w-56 h-36"
                resizeMode="contain"
              />
            </View>

            <View className="items-center px-6 pb-6">
              <Text className="text-white text-xl font-bold text-center leading-snug">
                {alert.name}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1">{alert.colorway}</Text>
              <View className="mt-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full px-5 py-1.5">
                <Text className="text-white text-xs font-bold">{alert.size}</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <RestockStoreInfo store={alert.store} />
          </View>

          {/* ── Scarcity + social proof ── */}
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-5 mt-4">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
              <MaterialCommunityIcons name="fire" size={16} color="#F97316" />
              <Text className="text-orange-600 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-tight">
                Only {alert.stockLeft} left in this size
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text className="text-gray-400 text-xs">{alert.viewerCount} viewing</Text>
          </View>

          {/* ── Price ── */}
          <View className="px-5 mt-5">
            <Text className="text-4xl font-black text-gray-900">
              ${alert.currentPrice.toFixed(2)}
            </Text>
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 mt-1">
              <Text className="text-gray-400 text-sm line-through">
                Was ${alert.originalPrice}
              </Text>
              <Text className="text-green-600 text-sm font-bold">
                ${(alert.originalPrice - alert.currentPrice).toFixed(2)} saved
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* ── Action buttons ── */}
          <View className="px-1">
            <RestockActionButtons
              onBuyNow={handleBuyNow}
              onHold={handleHold}
              onReserve={handleReserve}
              onSeeOtherStores={handleSeeOtherStores}
            />
          </View>

          {/* ── Watchlist pairs ── */}
          <RestockWatchlistPairs pairs={watchlistPairs} />

          <View className="h-10" />
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default RestockAlertScreen

import React, { useCallback } from 'react'
import {
  View,
  Text,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Share,
  Alert,
} from 'react-native'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import ItemActionSheet from '@/components/profile/locker/ItemActionSheet'
import LockerGrid, { ViewToggle } from '@/components/profile/locker/LockerGrid'
import LockerHeader from '@/components/profile/locker/LockerHeader'
import LockerStats from '@/components/profile/locker/LockerStats'
import { useLocker } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useLocker'
import type { LockerItem } from '@/types/locker'

const AddToLockerButton: React.FC<{ onPress: () => void }> = ({ onPress }) => (
  <TouchableOpacity
    onPress={onPress}
    activeOpacity={0.85}
    className="mx-4 mb-4 py-4 rounded-full bg-green-500 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2"
    style={{
      shadowColor: '#22C55E',
      shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
      shadowOpacity: 0.4,
      shadowRadius: 12,
      elevation: 8,
    }}
  >
    <Feather name="plus" size={20} color="#fff" />
    <Text className="text-base font-black text-black tracking-wide">Add Item</Text>
  </TouchableOpacity>
)

interface LockerScreenProps {
  username?: string
  onBack?: () => void
  onAddItem?: () => void
  onEditItem?: (item: LockerItem) => void
}

const LockerScreen: React.FC<LockerScreenProps> = ({
  username = 'sonnysgr',
  onBack,
  onAddItem,
  onEditItem,
}) => {
  const {
    items,
    isPublic,
    viewMode,
    stats,
    selectedItem,
    showActionSheet,
    toggleVisibility,
    toggleViewMode,
    openItemMenu,
    closeActionSheet,
    deleteItem,
  } = useLocker()

  const router = useRouter()

  const handleBack = useCallback(() => {
    if (onBack) {
      onBack()
      return
    }

    if (router.canGoBack()) {
      router.back()
    }
  }, [onBack, router])

  const handleShare = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: `Check out ${username}'s locker on GoSNKR!`,
        url: `https://gosnkr.com/locker/${username}`,
      })
    } catch {
      // noop
    }
  }, [username])

  const handleShareItem = useCallback(async (item: LockerItem) => {
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: `Check out my ${item.name} on GoSNKR!`,
        url: `https://gosnkr.com/item/${item.id}`,
      })
    } catch {
      // noop
    }
  }, [])

  const handleDeleteItem = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      Alert.alert('Remove Item', 'Are you sure you want to remove this from your locker?', [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Remove',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: () => deleteItem(id),
        },
      ])
    },
    [deleteItem],
  )

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <LockerHeader
        username={username}
        pairCount={stats.totalPairs}
        isPublic={isPublic}
        onBack={handleBack}
        onShare={handleShare}
        onToggleVisibility={toggleVisibility}
      />

      <LockerStats stats={stats} />

      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-end px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100">
        <ViewToggle viewMode={viewMode} onToggle={toggleViewMode} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 120 }}
        className="flex-1"
      >
        <LockerGrid items={items} viewMode={viewMode} onMenuPress={openItemMenu} />
      </ScrollView>

      <View
        className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 pt-2 pb-6 bg-white"
        style={{
          shadowColor: '#000',
          shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },
          shadowOpacity: 0.06,
          shadowRadius: 12,
          elevation: 12,
        }}
      >
        <AddToLockerButton onPress={onAddItem ?? (() => {})} />
      </View>

      <ItemActionSheet
        visible={showActionSheet}
        item={selectedItem}
        onClose={closeActionSheet}
        onEdit={onEditItem ?? (() => {})}
        onDelete={handleDeleteItem}
        onShare={handleShareItem}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default LockerScreen
```

import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { View, Text } from 'react-native'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'

import { useCart } from '@/services/hooks/cart/useCart'
import CartItemCard from '@/components/cart/CartItemCard'
import PromoCodeInput from '@/components/cart/PromoCodeInput'
import OrderSummary from '@/components/cart/OrderSummary'
import CheckoutButton from '@/components/cart/CheckOutButton'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'

const CartScreen = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const {
    items,
    promoCode,
    appliedPromo,
    subtotal,
    discountAmount,
    shipping,
    total,
    itemCount,
    updateQuantity,
    removeItem,
    setPromoCode,
    applyPromoCode,
    removePromo,
  } = useCart()

  // -----------------------------
  // Checkout Handler (FIXED)
  // -----------------------------
  const handleCheckout = async () => {
    if (items.length === 0) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Cart is empty',
        text2: 'Add items before checkout',
      })
      return
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true)

      // Simulate API call
      await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1000))

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Order placed',
        text2: `Total: $${total.toFixed(2)}`,
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Checkout failed',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#ffff">
      <View className="px-6 pt-20">
        {/* Header */}
        <View className="items-center mb-5">
          <Text className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">
            My Cart
          </Text>
          <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
            {itemCount} {itemCount === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {/* Empty State */}
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center py-20">
            <Text className="text-5xl mb-4">🛒</Text>
            <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-700">
              Your cart is empty
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-1">
              Add some sneakers or clothing to get started
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Cart Items */}
            <View className="mb-4">
              {items.map((item) => (
                <CartItemCard
                  key={`${item.id}-${item.size}`}
                  item={item}
                  onIncrement={(id) =>
                    updateQuantity(id, item.size, 1)
                  }
                  onDecrement={(id) =>
                    updateQuantity(id, item.size, -1)
                  }
                  onRemove={(id) =>
                    removeItem(id, item.size)
                  }
                />
              ))}
            </View>

            {/* Divider */}
            <View className="h-px bg-gray-200 mb-5" />

            {/* Promo Code */}
            <PromoCodeInput
              promoCode={promoCode}
              appliedPromo={appliedPromo}
              onChangeCode={setPromoCode}
              onApply={applyPromoCode}
              onRemove={removePromo}
            />

            {/* Divider */}
            <View className="h-px bg-gray-200 mb-5" />

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <OrderSummary
              subtotal={subtotal}
              discountAmount={discountAmount}
              shipping={shipping}
              total={total}
              appliedPromo={appliedPromo}
            />
          </>
        )}

        {/* Checkout Button */}
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <View className="px-4 border-t border-gray-100">
            <CheckoutButton
              total={total}
              loading={loading}
              onPress={handleCheckout}
            />
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default CartScreen

import React from 'react'
import { View, Text, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native'
import { Feather, Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons'

interface NotificationItemProps {

// ─── Icon by type ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const NotifIcon: React.FC<{ icon: Notification['icon']; read: boolean }> = ({ icon, read }) => {
  const bg = read ? 'bg-gray-100' : 'bg-green-50'

  const renderIcon = () => {
    switch (icon) {
      case 'restock':
        return <Feather name="bell" size={18} color={read ? '#9CA3AF' : '#22C55E'} />
      case 'order':
        return <Ionicons name="bag-outline" size={18} color={read ? '#9CA3AF' : '#3B82F6'} />
      case 'drop':
        return <MaterialCommunityIcons name="fire" size={18} color={read ? '#9CA3AF' : '#F97316'} />
      case 'store':
        return <Feather name="tag" size={18} color={read ? '#9CA3AF' : '#A855F7'} />
      case 'system':
        return <Feather name="settings" size={18} color={read ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
    }
  }

  return (
    <View className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full ${bg} items-center justify-center`}>
      {renderIcon()}
    </View>
  )
}

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      case 'store':
        router.push(`/screens/discover/offerFromStoreScreen?id=${item.id}`)
        break
      // In NotificationItem.tsx — add this case inside handlePress switch:

      case 'drop':
  router.push({
  pathname: '/screens/discover/setDropReminderScreen',
  params: {
    id: item.id,
    brand: item.brand ?? '',
    name: item.title,
    dropTime: item.subtitle ?? '',
    imageUri: item.imageUri ?? '',
  },
})
        break
      default:
        break
    }
    onPress?.(item.id)
  }

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={handlePress}
      activeOpacity={0.7}
      className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3.5 gap-3"
    >
      {/* Unread dot */}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Image,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  FlatList,
  Dimensions,
  NativeSyntheticEvent,
  NativeScrollEvent,
  ViewToken,
} from 'react-native';
import { AdBanner } from '@/services/hooks/discover/useDiscover';

const { width: SCREEN_W } = Dimensions.get('window');
// Card width = screen minus horizontal margins (20 each side)
const CARD_W = SCREEN_W - 40;
// Auto-advance interval in ms
const AUTO_SLIDE_MS = 3500;

interface DiscoverAdProps {
  /** ✅ Now accepts AdBanner[] — the type error is gone */
  ads: AdBanner[];
  onPress?: (ad: AdBanner) => void;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const DiscoverAd: React.FC<DiscoverAdProps> = ({ ads, onPress }) => {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const flatRef = useRef<FlatList<AdBanner>>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  // Shared pulse animation (one instance, passed to each card)
  const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(pulseAnim, { toValue: 1.04, duration: 900, useNativeDriver: true }),
        Animated.timing(pulseAnim, { toValue: 1, duration: 900, useNativeDriver: true }),
      ])
    ).start();
  }, []);

  // ── Auto-advance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const startTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setActiveIndex(prev => {
        const next = (prev + 1) % ads.length;
        flatRef.current?.scrollToIndex({ index: next, animated: true });
        return next;
      });
    }, AUTO_SLIDE_MS);
  }, [ads.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ads.length > 1) startTimer();
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [ads.length, startTimer]);

  // ── Track visible index via viewability ──────────────────────────────
  const onViewableItemsChanged = useRef(
    ({ viewableItems }: { viewableItems: ViewToken[] }) => {
      if (viewableItems.length > 0 && viewableItems[0].index != null) {
        setActiveIndex(viewableItems[0].index);
      }
    }
  ).current;

  const viewabilityConfig = useRef({ viewAreaCoveragePercentThreshold: 50 }).current;

  // Reset timer when user swipes manually
  const onScrollBeginDrag = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  }, []);

  const onMomentumScrollEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (ads.length > 1) startTimer();
  }, [ads.length, startTimer]);

  // ── Render each ad card ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderItem = useCallback(
    ({ item }: { item: AdBanner }) => {
      if (item.ctaVariant === 'discount') {
        return (
          <AdDiscount
            ad={item}
            onPress={onPress}
            pulseAnim={pulseAnim}
            cardWidth={CARD_W}
          />
        );
      }
      return (
        <AdDropping
          ad={item}
          onPress={onPress}
          pulseAnim={pulseAnim}
          cardWidth={CARD_W}
        />
      );
    },
    [onPress, pulseAnim]
  );

  const keyExtractor = useCallback((item: AdBanner) => item.id, []);

  if (ads.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <FlatList
        ref={flatRef}
        data={ads}
        renderItem={renderItem}
        keyExtractor={keyExtractor}
        horizontal
        pagingEnabled
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        snapToInterval={CARD_W + 12}   // card + gap so cards peek slightly
        snapToAlignment="start"
        decelerationRate="fast"
        contentContainerStyle={styles.flatContent}
        onViewableItemsChanged={onViewableItemsChanged}
        viewabilityConfig={viewabilityConfig}
        onScrollBeginDrag={onScrollBeginDrag}
        onMomentumScrollEnd={onMomentumScrollEnd}
        getItemLayout={(_, index) => ({
          length: CARD_W + 12,
          offset: (CARD_W + 12) * index,
          index,
        })}
      />

      {/* Dot indicators */}
      {ads.length > 1 && (
        <View style={styles.dots}>
          {ads.map((_, i) => (
            <View
              key={i}
              style={[styles.dot, i === activeIndex && styles.dotActive]}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

// ─── Variant A: "DROPPING SOON" — full-bleed image card ──────────────────
interface CardProps {
  ad: AdBanner;
  onPress?: (ad: AdBanner) => void;
  pulseAnim: Animated.Value;
  cardWidth: number;
}

const AdDropping: React.FC<CardProps> = ({ ad, onPress, pulseAnim, cardWidth }) => (
  <TouchableOpacity
    style={[styles.droppingCard, { width: cardWidth }]}

      <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }], alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginTop: 10 }}>

        </View>

);

      <Image source={{ uri: ad.image }} style={styles.discountImg} resizeMode="cover" />
    </View>
  </TouchableOpacity>
);

// ─── Styles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
