```typescript
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    Text,
    TouchableOpacity,
    ScrollView,
    TextInput,
    Animated,
    Keyboard,
    ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons';

const GREEN = '#22C55E';

interface DiscoverFilterProps<FilterCategory extends string> {
    filters: FilterCategory[];
    active: FilterCategory;
    onChange: (filter: FilterCategory) => void;
    greeting: string;
    userName: string;
    onCustomSize?: (size: string) => void;
    searchValue?: string;
    onSearchChange?: (text: string) => void;
    onSearchSubmit?: () => void;
}

const DiscoverFilter = <FilterCategory extends string>({
    filters,
    active,
    onChange,
    greeting,
    userName,
    onCustomSize,
    searchValue = '',
    onSearchChange,
    onSearchSubmit,
}: DiscoverFilterProps<FilterCategory>) => {
    const [customExpanded, setCustomExpanded] = useState(false);
    const [customValue, setCustomValue] = useState('');
    const [customError, setCustomError] = useState('');
    const expandAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const inputRef = useRef<TextInput>(null);

    const openCustomInput = () => {
        setCustomExpanded(true);
        setCustomError('');
        Animated.spring(expandAnim, {
            toValue: 1,
            useNativeDriver: false,
        }).start(() => inputRef.current?.focus());
    };

    const closeCustomInput = () => {
        Keyboard.dismiss();
        Animated.timing(expandAnim, {
            toValue: 0,
            duration: 180,
            useNativeDriver: false,
        }).start(() => {
            setCustomExpanded(false);
            setCustomValue('');
            setCustomError('');
        });
    };

    const handleCustomConfirm = () => {
        const trimmed = customValue.trim();
        if (!trimmed) {
            setCustomError('Enter a size');
            return;
        }
        onCustomSize?.(trimmed);
        onChange('Custom' as FilterCategory);
        closeCustomInput();
    };

    const handlePillPress = (f: FilterCategory) => {
        if (f === ('Custom' as FilterCategory)) {
            customExpanded ? closeCustomInput() : openCustomInput();
            return;
        }
        if (customExpanded) closeCustomInput();
        onChange(f);
    };

    const inputHeight = expandAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0, 80],
    });

    const inputOpacity = expandAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 0.5, 1],
        outputRange: [0, 0, 1],
    });

    return (
        <View>

            {/* Greeting */}
            <View className=" px-5 pb-3">
                <Text className="text-base text-gray-500">
                    {greeting},{' '}
                    <Text className="text-gray-900 font-bold text-base">
                        {userName} 👋
                    </Text>
                </Text>
            </View>

            {/* Search bar — same style as Search tab, no filter button */}
            <View className="px-4 pb-3 bg-white">
                <View
                    style={{
                        flexDirection: 'row',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        backgroundColor: '#F5F5F7',
                        borderRadius: 14,
                        paddingHorizontal: 14,
                        height: 52,
                        borderWidth: 1.5,
                        borderColor: searchValue.length > 0 ? GREEN : 'transparent',
                    }}
                >
                    <Feather
                        name="search"
                        size={20}
                        color="#8A8A9A"
                        style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
                    />
                    <TextInput
                        style={{
                            flex: 1,
                            color: '#0F0F0F',
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: '400',
                            height: '100%',
                        }}
                        placeholder="Sneakers, clothing, brands, SKU..."
                        placeholderTextColor="#AFAFBF"
                        value={searchValue}
                        onChangeText={onSearchChange}
                        onSubmitEditing={onSearchSubmit}
                        returnKeyType="search"
                        cursorColor={GREEN}
                        autoCapitalize="none"
                        autoCorrect={false}
                    />
                    {searchValue.length > 0 && (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                            onPress={() => onSearchChange?.('')}
                            hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
                        >
                            <View
                                style={{
                                    width: 22,
                                    height: 22,
                                    borderRadius: 11,
                                    backgroundColor: '#C8C8D8',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                    justifyContent: 'center',
                                }}
                            >
                                <Feather name="x" size={14} color="#fff" />
                            </View>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                </View>
            </View>

            {/* Pills */}
            <View className="flex-row items-center bg-white">
                <ScrollView
                    horizontal
                    showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                    className="flex-1"
                    contentContainerStyle={{
                        paddingRight: 24,
                        paddingVertical: 12,
                        gap: 10,
                        paddingLeft: 16,
                    }}
                >
                    {filters.map((f) => {
                        const isActive = f === active;
                        const isCustomOpen = f === ('Custom' as FilterCategory) && customExpanded;

                        return (
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                key={f}
                                onPress={() => handlePillPress(f)}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}
                                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full
                  ${isCustomOpen ? 'bg-gray-900'
                                        : isActive ? 'bg-green-600'
                                            : 'bg-gray-100'}
                `}
                            >
                                <Text
                                    className={`text-base font-semibold
                    ${isCustomOpen || isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-700'}
                  `}
                                >
                                    {f}
                                </Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        );
                    })}
                </ScrollView>
            </View>

            {/* Custom Input */}
            <Animated.View
                style={{ height: inputHeight, opacity: inputOpacity }}
                className="overflow-hidden px-4 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200"
            >
                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 py-3">

                    <TextInput
                        ref={inputRef}
                        value={customValue}
                        onChangeText={(t) => {
                            setCustomValue(t);
                            if (customError) setCustomError('');
                        }}
                        placeholder="e.g. 10.5 or 11W"
                        placeholderTextColor="#9CA3AF"
                        returnKeyType="done"
                        onSubmitEditing={handleCustomConfirm}
                        className={`flex-1 h-11 px-3 rounded-xl text-base font-semibold bg-white border
              ${customError ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-gray-300'}
            `}
                    />

                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={handleCustomConfirm}
                        className="h-11 px-5 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 justify-center items-center"
                    >
                        <Text className="text-white font-bold text-base">Add</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>

                    <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={closeCustomInput}
                        className="h-11 w-11 rounded-xl border border-gray-300 justify-center items-center bg-white"
                    >
                        <Text className="text-gray-500 text-base">✕</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>

                {!!customError && (
                    <Text className="text-red-500 text-xs ml-1 -mt-1">{customError}</Text>
                )}
            </Animated.View>
        </View>
    );
};

export default DiscoverFilter;
```

```typescript
  >
    <View 
      className="w-[60px] h-[60px] rounded-full border-[2.5px] p-[2px] items-center justify-center overflow-hidden"
      style={{ borderColor: store.isFollowing ? '#00C853' : '#D0D0D0' }}
    >
      <Image 
        source={{ uri: store.avatar }} 
        className="w-[52px] h-[52px] rounded-full" 
        resizeMode="cover" 
      />
    </View>
    <Text className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-neutral-600 text-center" numberOfLines={1}>
      {store.name}
    </Text>
  </TouchableOpacity>
);

// ─── Full store card (Brand-style sizing) ────────────────────────────────
const StoreCard = ({
  store,
  isLast,
  onPress,
  onBuy,
  onWishlist,
}: {
  store: FollowedStore;
  isLast: boolean;
  onPress?: () => void;
  onBuy?: () => void;
  onWishlist?: () => void;
}) => {
  const stockBg = store.stockStatus ? STOCK_BG[store.stockStatus] : '#00C853';

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      className={`flex-row items-center px-4 py-4 gap-4 ${!isLast ? 'border-b border-neutral-100' : ''}`}
      onPress={onPress}
      activeOpacity={0.85}
    >
      {/* Left: Image (120x120 matching BrandProduct) */}
      <View className="w-[120px] h-[120px] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-200 relative">
        <Image source={{ uri: store.image }} className="w-full h-full" resizeMode="cover" />

        {/* Stock badge */}
        {store.stockStatus && (
          <View 
            className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full" 
            style={{ backgroundColor: stockBg }}
          >
            <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold">{store.stockStatus}</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Heart icon */}
<TouchableOpacity
  onPress={(e) => {
    e.stopPropagation(); // Stops the card's onStorePress from firing
    onWishlist?.();      // Calls the toggleStoreWishlist(id) function
  }}
  className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-10 h-10 items-center justify-center z-10"
>
  <Ionicons
    name={store.isWishlisted ? 'heart' : 'heart-outline'}
    size={28}
    color={store.isWishlisted ? '#FF3B6B' : '#fff'}
  />
</TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Brand initial badge */}
        <View
          className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md"
          style={{ backgroundColor: store.brandColor }}
        >
          <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold">{store.brandInitial}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Middle: Info */}
      <View className="flex-1">
        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-neutral-900" numberOfLines={1}>
          {store.name}
        </Text>
        <Text className="text-sm text-neutral-400 mt-1">{store.location}</Text>
        <Text className="text-sm text-neutral-400">{store.distance}</Text>
      </View>

      {/* Right: Price, stock, buy */}
      <View className="items-end gap-2">
        {store.price != null && (
          <Text className="text-xl font-extrabold text-neutral-900">${store.price}</Text>
        )}
        
        {store.stockStatus && (
          <View 
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full" 
            style={{ backgroundColor: stockBg }}
          >
            <Text className="text-white text-sm font-extrabold">{store.stockStatus}</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity 
          onPress={onBuy} 
          className="bg-green-600 px-5 py-2 rounded-full"
        >
          <Text className="text-white text-sm font-extrabold">Buy</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
};

// ─── Main Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const DiscoverStores: React.FC<DiscoverStoresProps> = ({
  stores,
  onManagePress,
  onStorePress,
  onWishlistToggle,
  onBuyPress,
}) => (
  <View className="mt-7">
    {/* Section Header */}
    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-5 mb-4">
      <Text className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-neutral-900">From Followed Stores</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={onManagePress}>
        <Text className="text-lg font-semibold text-green-600">Manage</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>

    {/* Horizontal Story Row */}
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      className="mb-4"
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingHorizontal: 20, gap: 14 }}
    >
      {stores.map(s => (
        <StoreAvatar key={s.id} store={s} onPress={() => onStorePress?.(s)} />
      ))}
    </ScrollView>

    {/* Store Cards List */}
    {stores.length > 0 ? (
      <View className="mx-5 bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        {stores.map((s, i) => (
          <StoreCard
            key={s.id}
            store={s}
            isLast={i === stores.length - 1}
            onPress={() => onStorePress?.(s)}
            onBuy={() => onBuyPress?.(s)}
            onWishlist={() => onWishlistToggle?.(s.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </View>
    ) : (
      <View className="items-center py-10 gap-2 px-5">
        <Ionicons name="storefront-outline" size={32} color="#ddd" />
        <Text className="text-neutral-400 font-medium">No followed stores yet</Text>
      </View>
    )}
  </View>
);

export default DiscoverStores;
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'
import Toast from 'react-native-toast-message'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'

interface SigninForm {
  email: string
  password: string
}

interface SigninErrors {
  email?: string
  password?: string
}

type UserRole = 'retailer' | 'buyer' | 'reseller'

export function useSignin() {
  const router = useRouter()

  const [form, setForm] = useState<SigninForm>({
    email: '',
    password: '',
  })

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<SigninErrors>({})
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  const updateField = (field: keyof SigninForm, value: string) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }))

    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: undefined }))
    }
  }

  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const newErrors: SigninErrors = {}
    const email = form.email.trim()

    if (!email) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required'
    } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Enter a valid email address'
    }

    if (!form.password) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password is required'
    } else if (form.password.length < 6) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 6 characters'
    }

    setErrors(newErrors)
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0
  }

  /**
   * TEMP role resolver (replace with backend later)
   */
  const resolveRole = (email: string): UserRole => {
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase()

    if (normalizedEmail === 'retailer@gmail.com') return 'retailer'
    if (normalizedEmail === 'reseller@gmail.com') return 'reseller'
    return 'buyer'
  }

  const redirectByRole = (role: UserRole) => {
    console.log(role)
    switch (role) {
      case 'retailer':
        router.replace('/retailerTabs/home')
        break
      case 'reseller':
        router.replace('/resellerTabs/dashboard')
        break
      case 'buyer':
      default:
        router.replace('/tabs/discoverScreen')
        break
    }
  }

  const handleSignin = async () => {
    if (!validate()) return

    try {
      setLoading(true)

      // simulate API
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 800))

      const role = resolveRole(form.email)

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Welcome back!',
        text2: `Logged in as ${role}`,
      })

      redirectByRole(role)
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Sign in failed',
        text2:
          error?.message ??
          'Please check your credentials and try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleFaceID = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true)

      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 600))

      // assume retailer for demo
      const role: UserRole = 'retailer'

      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Face ID successful',
      })

      redirectByRole(role)
    } catch (error: any) {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Face ID failed',
        text2: error?.message ?? 'Please try again.',
      })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {
    form,
    errors,
    loading,
    updateField,
    handleSignin,
    handleFaceID,
  }
}
```

```typescript
    },
    {
      id: 'p6',
      name: 'Nike Dunk Low Panda',
      size: '4Y',
      price: 110,
      productType: 'Sneakers',
      audience: "Kids'",
      badge: 'Low Stock',
      badgeColor: '#F97316',
    },
  ],
  reviewScore: 4.8,
  reviewBreakdown: [
    { star: 5, percent: 70 },
    { star: 4, percent: 50 },
    { star: 3, percent: 6 },
    { star: 2, percent: 2 },
    { star: 1, percent: 1 },
  ],
  customerService: 4.9,
  authenticity: 5,
  pickupSpeed: 4.7,
  pricing: 4.6,
}

export function useStoreProfile(storeId?: string) {
  const [store, setStore] = useState<StoreProfile>(MOCK)
  const [activeTag, setActiveTag] = useState<string>('All')

  const visibleProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeTag === 'All') return store.products

    if (activeTag === 'Sneakers' || activeTag === 'Clothing') {
      return store.products.filter((product) => product.productType === activeTag)
    }

    return store.products.filter((product) => product.audience === activeTag)
  }, [activeTag, store.products])

  const toggleFollow = useCallback(() => {
    setStore((prev) => {
      const nowFollowing = !prev.isFollowing

      Toast.show({
        type: nowFollowing ? 'success' : 'info',
        text1: nowFollowing ? 'Following!' : 'Unfollowed',
        text2: nowFollowing
          ? `You're now following ${prev.name}`
          : `You unfollowed ${prev.name}`,
      })

      return {
        ...prev,
        isFollowing: nowFollowing,
        followers: nowFollowing ? prev.followers + 1 : prev.followers - 1,
      }
    })
  }, [])

  const toggleNotifications = useCallback(() => {
    setStore((prev) => {
      const nowOn = !prev.notificationsOn

      Toast.show({
        type: nowOn ? 'success' : 'info',
        text1: nowOn ? 'Notifications On' : 'Notifications Off',
        text2: nowOn
          ? `You'll be notified about ${prev.name}`
          : `Notifications disabled for ${prev.name}`,
      })

      return { ...prev, notificationsOn: nowOn }
    })
  }, [])

  const handleShare = useCallback(async (shareFn: () => Promise<void>) => {
    try {
      await shareFn()
      Toast.show({
        type: 'success',
        text1: 'Shared!',
        text2: 'Link ready to share',
      })
    } catch {
      Toast.show({
        type: 'error',
        text1: 'Share Failed',
        text2: 'Could not share at this time',
      })
    }
  }, [])

  const handleProductPress = useCallback((product: StoreProduct) => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'Viewing Product',
      text2: product.name,
    })
  }, [])

  const handleSeeAll = useCallback(() => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'Showing Products',
      text2: 'Viewing all available sneakers and clothing',
    })
  }, [])

  const handleSeeAllReviews = useCallback(() => {
    Toast.show({
      type: 'info',
      text1: 'Reviews',
      text2: 'Loading all reviews...',
    })
  }, [])

  return {
    store,
    activeTag,
    visibleProducts,
    visibleProductCount: visibleProducts.length,
    setActiveTag,
    toggleFollow,
    toggleNotifications,
    handleShare,
    handleProductPress,
    handleSeeAll,
    handleSeeAllReviews,
  }
}
```

```typescript
// ─── Counter Offer Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface CounterOfferModalProps {
  visible: boolean
  storeName: string
  currentOffer: number
  onClose: () => void
  onSubmit: (price: number) => void
}

const CounterOfferModal: React.FC<CounterOfferModalProps> = ({
  visible,
  storeName,
  currentOffer,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('')
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const parsedValue = parseFloat(value)
  const isValid = !isNaN(parsedValue) && parsedValue > 0

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!isValid) {
      setError('Please enter a valid price.')
      return
    }
    if (parsedValue <= currentOffer) {
      setError(`Counter must be above the store's offer of $${currentOffer}.`)
      return
    }
    setError('')
    setSubmitting(true)
    // TODO: replace with your real API call
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900))
    setSubmitting(false)
    onSubmit(parsedValue)
  }

  const handleClose = () => {
    setValue('')
    setError('')
    onClose()
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={1}
        onPress={handleClose}
        className="flex-1 bg-black/50 justify-end"
      >
        <KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}>
          <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={1}>
            <View className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl px-6 pt-5 pb-10">
              {/* Drag handle */}
              <View className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-gray-200 self-center mb-5" />

              {/* Header */}
              <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <Text className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900">Make Counter Offer</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleClose} hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}>
                  <Feather name="x" size={20} color="#6B7280" />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-6">
                {storeName} offered ${currentOffer.toFixed(2)}. Enter your asking price below.
              </Text>

              {/* Price input */}
              <View className={`flex-row items-center border-2 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3.5 gap-2 ${error ? 'border-red-400' : 'border-gray-200'}`}>
                <Text className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-400">$</Text>
                <TextInput
                  value={value}
                  onChangeText={text => {
                    setValue(text.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''))
                    setError('')
                  }}
                  keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  placeholderTextColor="#D1D5DB"
                  className="flex-1 text-2xl font-black text-gray-900"
                  autoFocus
                  returnKeyType="done"
                  onSubmitEditing={handleSubmit}
                />
              </View>

              {/* Error */}
              {!!error && (
                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
                  <Feather name="alert-circle" size={12} color="#EF4444" />
                  <Text className="text-xs text-red-500">{error}</Text>
                </View>
              )}

              {/* Live hint */}
              {!error && isValid && parsedValue > currentOffer && (
                <Text className="text-xs text-green-600 mt-2">
                  +${(parsedValue - currentOffer).toFixed(2)} above current offer
                </Text>
              )}

              {/* Submit */}
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={handleSubmit}
                disabled={submitting}
                activeOpacity={0.85}
                className={`mt-6 rounded-2xl py-4 items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2 ${submitting ? 'bg-gray-200' : 'bg-gray-900'}`}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Feather name="send" size={15} color="#fff" />
                    <Text className="text-white font-bold text-sm">Send Counter Offer</Text>
                  </>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleClose} className="items-center mt-3 py-2">
                <Text className="text-gray-400 text-sm">Cancel</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Modal>
  )
}

// ─── Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

            <View className="flex-1">

                <Text className="font-bold">{offer.store.name}</Text> wants to buy your item!
              </Text>
```

```typescript
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, TouchableOpacity, Text, Platform, StyleSheet, useWindowDimensions } from 'react-native';
import { Tabs } from 'expo-router';
import { MaterialCommunityIcons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import Animated, {
  useAnimatedStyle,
  withSpring,
  useSharedValue,
} from 'react-native-reanimated';

const ACTIVE_COLOR = '#000000'; 
const INACTIVE_COLOR = '#94a3b8'; 
const DOT_COLOR = '#22C55E'; 
const BAR_BG = '#FFFFFF';

const tabConfig = [
  { name: 'discoverScreen', label: 'Discover', icon: 'home-variant-outline', activeIcon: 'home-variant' },
  { name: 'searchScreen', label: 'Search', icon: 'magnify', activeIcon: 'magnify' },
  { name: 'mapScreen', label: 'Map', icon: 'map-marker-outline', activeIcon: 'map-marker' },
  { name: 'cartScreen', label: 'Cart', icon: 'shopping-outline', activeIcon: 'shopping' },
  { name: 'profileScreen', label: 'Profile', icon: 'account-outline', activeIcon: 'account' },
];

const AnimatedTabItem = ({ isFocused, navigation, route, label, icon, activeIcon }: any) => {
  const iconScale = useSharedValue(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);

  useEffect(() => {
    iconScale.value = withSpring(isFocused ? 1.1 : 1);
  }, [isFocused]);

  const iconStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ scale: iconScale.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => navigation.navigate(route.name)}
      style={styles.tabItem}
      activeOpacity={0.7}
    >
      <View style={styles.iconWrapper}>
        <Animated.View style={iconStyle}>
          <MaterialCommunityIcons 
            name={isFocused ? activeIcon : icon} 
            size={26} 
            color={isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR} 
          />
        </Animated.View>
      </View>

      <Text style={[
        styles.label, 
        { color: isFocused ? ACTIVE_COLOR : INACTIVE_COLOR, fontWeight: isFocused ? '700' : '500' }
      ]}>
        {label}
      </Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
};

const CustomTabBar = ({ state, navigation }: any) => {
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
 const TAB_BAR_WIDTH = width;
  const TAB_WIDTH = TAB_BAR_WIDTH / tabConfig.length;
  
  // Shared value for the dot's X position
  const translateX = useSharedValue(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Update position whenever the index changes
    translateX.value = withSpring(state.index * TAB_WIDTH, {
        damping: 20,
        stiffness: 150,
    });
  }, [state.index]);

  const dotStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({
    transform: [{ translateX: translateX.value }],
  }));

  return (
    <View style={styles.tabBarContainer}>
      <View style={[styles.tabBarInner, { width: TAB_BAR_WIDTH }]}>
        
        {/* The Sliding Green Dot Indicator */}
        <Animated.View 
          style={[
            styles.slidingDotContainer, 
            { width: TAB_WIDTH }, 
            dotStyle
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.activeDot} />
        </Animated.View>

        {state.routes.map((route: any, index: number) => {
          const isFocused = state.index === index;
          const config = tabConfig[index];
          if (!config) return null;

          return (
            <AnimatedTabItem
              key={route.key}
              route={route}
              isFocused={isFocused}
              navigation={navigation}
              label={config.label}
              icon={config.icon}
              activeIcon={config.activeIcon}
            />
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  tabBarContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    bottom: 0,                          // flush to bottom
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  tabBarInner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    backgroundColor: BAR_BG,
    height: 75,
    borderRadius: 0,                    // no rounding — flat/square
    borderWidth: 0,
    borderTopWidth: 1,                  // only top border
    borderTopColor: '#F1F5F9',
    shadowColor: '#000',
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 },   // shadow upward
    shadowOpacity: 0.05,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 10,
    width: '100%',                      // full width, not 95%
    paddingBottom: Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 20 : 0, // safe area on iOS
  },
  tabItem: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    zIndex: 2,
  },
  iconWrapper: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    height: 28,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  slidingDotContainer: {
    position: 'absolute',
    height: 75,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    zIndex: 1,
  },
  activeDot: {
    width: 6,
    height: 6,
    borderRadius: 3,
    backgroundColor: DOT_COLOR,
    marginTop: 10, // Position it under the icon
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: 16,
    marginTop: 4,
  },
});

export default function TabLayout() {
  return (
    <Tabs
      screenOptions={{ headerShown: false, tabBarStyle: { display: 'none' } }}
      tabBar={(props) => <CustomTabBar {...props} />}
    >
      <Tabs.Screen name="discoverScreen" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="searchScreen" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="mapScreen" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="cartScreen" />
      <Tabs.Screen name="profileScreen" />
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// screens/SearchScreen.tsx
import React from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import { useRouter } from "expo-router";

import { SearchResult, useSearch } from "@/services/hooks/search/useSearch";
import BaseContainer from "@/components/shared/BaseContainer";
import SearchHeader from "@/components/search/SearchHeader";
import SearchInput from "@/components/search/SearchInput";
import FilterModal from "@/components/search/FilterModal";
import TrendingList from "@/components/search/TrendingList";
import RecentSearches from "@/components/search/RecentSearches";
import SearchResults from "@/components/search/SearchResults";

const SearchScreen = () => {
  const router = useRouter();

  const {
    // query
    query,
    isSearchActive,
    handleQueryChange,
    handleClearQuery,
    handleSubmitSearch,

    // filters
    filters,
    activeFilterCount,
    isFilterModalOpen,
    handleOpenFilterModal,
    handleCloseFilterModal,
    handleApplyFilters,

    // trending
    trendingItems,
    handleSelectTrending,

    // recent
    recentSearches,
    handleSelectRecent,
    handleRemoveRecent,
    handleClearAllRecent,

    // results
    results,
    isFetching,
    isError,
  } = useSearch();

  const handleSelectResult = (_item: SearchResult) => {
    router.push('/tabs/searchResultsScreen')
  };

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="px-6 pt-10">

        {/* ── Header ── */}
        <SearchHeader />

        {/* ── Search input (filter icon replaces mic) ── */}
        <SearchInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={handleQueryChange}
          onSubmitEditing={handleSubmitSearch}
          onClear={handleClearQuery}
          onFilterPress={handleOpenFilterModal}
          activeFilterCount={activeFilterCount}
          isFetching={isFetching}
        />

        {/* ── Conditional content ── */}
        {isSearchActive ? (
          <SearchResults
            results={results}
            isFetching={isFetching}
            isError={isError}
            query={query}
            onSelectItem={handleSelectResult}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <TrendingList
              items={trendingItems}
              onSelect={handleSelectTrending}
            />
            <RecentSearches
              items={recentSearches}
              onSelect={handleSelectRecent}
              onRemove={handleRemoveRecent}
              onClearAll={handleClearAllRecent}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* ── Filter modal ── */}
      <FilterModal
        visible={isFilterModalOpen}
        initialFilters={filters}
        onApply={handleApplyFilters}
        onClose={handleCloseFilterModal}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  );
};

export default SearchScreen;
```

## File: app/screens/profile/orderScreen.tsx
```typescript
import React from 'react'
import { ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native'
import { router } from 'expo-router'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import OrderFilterSheet from '@/components/profile/orders/OrderFilterSheet'
import OrderFilterTabs from '@/components/profile/orders/OrderFilterTabs'
import OrderGroup from '@/components/profile/orders/OrderGroup'
import OrdersEmptyState from '@/components/profile/orders/OrdersEmptyState'
import { useOrderFilter } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useOrderFilter'
import { useOrders } from '@/services/hooks/profile/useOrders'

const OrdersScreen = () => {
  const filter = useOrderFilter()
  const { grouped, activeTab, setActiveTab } = useOrders(filter.applied)

  const handleOrderPress = (id: string) => {
    const order = grouped.flatMap((group) => group.items).find((item) => item.id === id)

    if (order?.status === 'Cancelled') {
      router.push(`/screens/order/orderDetailsScreen?id=${id}`)
      return
    }

    router.push(`/screens/order/orderStatusScreen?id=${id}`)
  }

  return (
    <BaseContainer scrollable backgroundColor="#fff">
      <View className="pt-10">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between px-5 pt-4 pb-2 bg-white">
          <Text className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">My Orders</Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            onPress={filter.open}
            hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
            className="relative"
          >
            <Feather name="filter" size={20} color="#374151" />
            {filter.activeFilterCount > 0 && (
              <View className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-4 h-4 bg-green-500 rounded-full items-center justify-center">
                <Text className="text-white text-[9px] font-bold">
                  {filter.activeFilterCount}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        <OrderFilterTabs active={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} />

        {filter.activeFilterCount > 0 && (
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50">
            {filter.applied.category !== 'All' && (
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 bg-gray-900 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  {filter.applied.category}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}

            {filter.applied.sort !== 'Newest' && (
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 bg-gray-900 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                <Text className="text-white text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  {filter.applied.sort}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}

            <TouchableOpacity onPress={filter.reset}>
              <Text className="text-xs text-red-400 font-semibold ml-1">Clear</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}

        <ScrollView
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 48, paddingTop: 4 }}
        >
          {grouped.length === 0 ? (
            <OrdersEmptyState message="No orders match your filters" />
          ) : (
            grouped.map(({ group, items }) => (
              <OrderGroup
                key={group}
                group={group}
                items={items}
                onPressOrder={handleOrderPress}
              />
            ))
          )}

          {grouped.length > 0 && (
            <View className="items-center mt-2 pb-4">
              <Text className="text-xs text-gray-400">No more orders this month</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>

        <OrderFilterSheet
          visible={filter.visible}
          draft={filter.draft}
          sortOptions={filter.sortOptions}
          categoryOptions={filter.categoryOptions}
          onClose={filter.close}
          onSetSort={filter.setSort}
          onSetCategory={filter.setCategory}
          onReset={filter.reset}
          onApply={filter.apply}
        />
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default OrdersScreen
```

```typescript
              <Feather name="arrow-left" size={22} color="#fff" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={onShare} className="p-1">
              <Feather name="share" size={20} color="#fff" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-4 mb-3">
            <View
              className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl items-center justify-center"
              style={{ backgroundColor: store.avatarColor }}
            >
              <Text className="text-white text-xl font-extrabold">{store.initials}</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="flex-1 gap-1">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <Text className="text-white text-xl font-extrabold">{store.name}</Text>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={18} color="#22C55E" />
              </View>
              <StoreBadge label={store.badge} bgColor="#F59E0B" />
            </View>
          </View>

          <StoreStatsRow
            stats={[
              { label: 'Rating', value: store.rating },
              { label: 'Followers', value: store.followers },
              { label: 'Posts', value: store.posts },
              { label: 'Distance', value: store.distance },
            ]}
          />

          <View className="flex-row gap-3 mt-4">
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={toggleFollow}
              className={`flex-1 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-2xl border ${
                store.isFollowing
                  ? 'border-white/30 bg-transparent'
                  : 'border-transparent bg-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={store.isFollowing ? 'person-remove-outline' : 'person-add-outline'}
                size={16}
                color={store.isFollowing ? '#fff' : '#111827'}
              />
              <Text
                className={`text-sm font-extrabold ${
                  store.isFollowing ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-900'
                }`}
              >
                {store.isFollowing ? 'Unfollow' : 'Follow Store'}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={toggleNotifications}
              className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl items-center justify-center border ${
                store.notificationsOn
                  ? 'bg-green-500 border-green-500'
                  : 'border-white/30'
              }`}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={store.notificationsOn ? 'notifications' : 'notifications-outline'}
                size={20}
                color="#fff"
              />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View className="flex-row items-center mt-3">
            <Feather name="map-pin" size={18} color="#22C55E" />

            <Text className="ml-2 text-sm text-gray-200 flex-1">
              {store.address}
            </Text>

            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={openMaps}
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl items-center justify-center bg-green-500"
            >
              <Feather name="navigation" size={18} color="#fff" />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <StoreTrustBadges
            isVerified={store.isVerified}
            isFastPickup={store.isFastPickup}
            isTopRated={store.isTopRated}
          />

          <View className="mt-1 gap-0.5">
            <StoreInfoRow
              icon="time-outline"
              text={`${store.isOpen ? 'Open' : 'Closed'} · Closes ${store.closingTime}`}
              highlight={store.isOpen}
            />
            <StoreInfoRow icon="location-outline" text={store.address} />
            <StoreInfoRow icon="call-outline" text={store.phone} />
            <StoreInfoRow icon="globe-outline" text={store.website} />
            <StoreInfoRow icon="logo-instagram" text={store.instagram} />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl -mt-2 pt-5">
          <View className="px-4 mb-5">
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
                <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900">Available Now</Text>
                <View className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
              </View>
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1">
                <Text className="text-xs text-green-500 font-semibold">
                  {visibleProductCount} items
                </Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSeeAll}>
                  <Text className="text-xs text-green-500 font-semibold">See all</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>

            <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} className="mb-3">
              {store.tags.map((tag) => (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={tag}
                  onPress={() => setActiveTag(tag)}
                  className={`mr-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full ${
                    activeTag === tag ? 'bg-gray-900' : 'bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Text
                    className={`text-xs font-semibold ${
                      activeTag === tag ? 'text-white' : 'text-gray-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              ))}
            </ScrollView>

            <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
              {visibleProducts.map((product) => (
                <StoreProductCard
                  key={product.id}
                  product={product}
                  onPress={() => handleProductPress(product)}
                />
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>

          <View className="h-2 bg-gray-50" />

          <View className="px-4 pt-5 pb-4">
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
                <Text className="text-base font-extrabold text-gray-900">Reviews</Text>
                <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1">
                  <Ionicons name="star" size={14} color="#F59E0B" />
                  <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-500">{store.reviewScore}</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSeeAllReviews}>
                <Text className="text-xs text-green-500 font-semibold">See All</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {store.reviewBreakdown.map((review) => (
              <StoreReviewBar key={review.star} star={review.star} percent={review.percent} />
            ))}

            <StoreScoreGrid
              scores={[
                { label: 'Customer Service', value: store.customerService },
                { label: 'Authenticity', value: store.authenticity },
                { label: 'Pickup Speed', value: store.pickupSpeed },
                { label: 'Pricing', value: store.pricing },
              ]}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="px-4 pt-4 pb-10">
            <Button
              text="Sell to Store"
              onPress={() => router.push('/screens/store/sellToStoreScreen')}
              useGradient
              gradientColors={['#1a1a1a', '#111827']}
              borderRadius={16}
              paddingVertical={18}
              fontSize={15}
              fontWeight="800"
            />
          {/* Store offer buttons — injected by patch_step2.js */}
          <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 10, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => router.push('/screens/store/storeOfferReviewScreen' as any)}
              style={{ flex: 1, paddingVertical: 14, borderRadius: 16, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#e5e7eb', alignItems: 'center' }}
            >
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700', color: '#374151' }}>View Offer</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() => router.push('/screens/store/sellToStoreOfferScreen' as any)}
              style={{ flex: 1, paddingVertical: 14, borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: '#22c55e', alignItems: 'center' }}
            >
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700', color: '#fff' }}>Sell to Store</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
          </View>

          <View className="px-4 pb-10 pt-2">
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={() =>
                router.push({
                  pathname: '/screens/store/reportStoreScreen',
                  params: {
                    storeId: id,
                    storeName: store.name,
                    storeAddress: store.address,
                  },
                })
              }
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3"
            >
              <Feather name="flag" size={14} color="#9CA3AF" />
              <Text className="text-sm text-gray-400 font-semibold">Report this store</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}
```

```typescript
export function useDiscover() {
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<FilterCategory>('Sneakers')
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [nearbyInventory, setNearbyInventory] = useState<NearbyProduct[]>(NEARBY)
  const [brandInventory, setBrandInventory] = useState<BrandProduct[]>(BRANDS)
  const [adBanners] = useState<AdBanner[]>(AD_BANNERS)
  const [followedStores, setFollowedStores] = useState<FollowedStore[]>(STORES)
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false)

  const greeting = getGreeting()
  const userName = 'Sonny'

  const handleFilterChange = useCallback((filter: FilterCategory) => {
    setActiveFilter(filter)
  }, [])

  const matchesFilter = useCallback(
    (item: { productType: ProductType; audience: Audience }) => {
      switch (activeFilter) {
        case 'Sneakers':
        case 'Clothing':
          return item.productType === activeFilter
        case "Men's":
        case "Women's":
        case "Kids'":
          return item.audience === activeFilter
        default:
          return true
      }
    },
    [activeFilter],
  )

  const matchesSearch = useCallback(
    (item: { name: string; brand: string; store: string }) => {
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!q) return true
      return (
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.brand.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.store.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    },
    [searchQuery],
  )

  const nearbyProducts = useMemo(
    () => nearbyInventory.filter((item) => matchesFilter(item) && matchesSearch(item)),
    [nearbyInventory, matchesFilter, matchesSearch],
  )

  const brandProducts = useMemo(
    () => brandInventory.filter((item) => matchesFilter(item) && matchesSearch(item)),
    [brandInventory, matchesFilter, matchesSearch],
  )

  const toggleWishlist = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setNearbyInventory((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, isWishlisted: !item.isWishlisted } : item,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const toggleBrandWishlist = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setBrandInventory((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, isWishlisted: !item.isWishlisted } : item,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const toggleStoreWishlist = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setFollowedStores((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, isWishlisted: !item.isWishlisted } : item,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const toggleFollow = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setFollowedStores((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, isFollowing: !item.isFollowing } : item,
      ),
    )
  }, [])

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true)
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200))
    setIsRefreshing(false)
  }, [])

  return {
    filters: FILTERS,
    activeFilter,
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    nearbyProducts,
    brandProducts,
    adBanners,
    followedStores,
    isRefreshing,
    greeting,
    userName,
    handleFilterChange,
    toggleWishlist,
    toggleFollow,
    toggleBrandWishlist,
    toggleStoreWishlist,
    handleRefresh,
  }
}

function getGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours()
  if (hour < 12) return 'Good morning'
  if (hour < 18) return 'Good afternoon'
  return 'Good evening'
}
```

```typescript
import Button from '@/components/shared/Button'
import ShowPicture from '@/components/shared/ShowPicture'
import { useSliding, type SlideItem } from '@/services/hooks/onboarding/useSliding'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import BaseContainer from '@/components/shared/BaseContainer'
import React from 'react'
import {
  Dimensions,
  FlatList,
  ListRenderItemInfo,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native'
import { SvgProps } from 'react-native-svg'

import WelcomeSVG from '@/assets/images/onboarding/welcome.svg'
import FindSVG from '@/assets/images/onboarding/find.svg'
import SizeSVG from '@/assets/images/onboarding/size.svg'
import BuySVG from '@/assets/images/onboarding/buy.svg'

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window')
const IMAGE_HEIGHT = height / 2

const GREEN = '#22C55E'

interface DotsProps {
  total: number
  current: number
  onPress: (i: number) => void
}

interface Slide extends SlideItem {
  SVG: React.FC<SvgProps>
  title: string
  titleHighlight?: string
  subtitle: string
  buttonText: string
}

const SLIDES: Slide[] = [
  {
    id: 'welcome',
    SVG: WelcomeSVG,
    title: 'Welcome to ',
    titleHighlight: 'GdSNKR',
    subtitle: 'Discover, track, and buy sneakers and clothing you love in one place.',
    buttonText: 'Explore Nearby Stores',
  },
  {
    id: 'find',
    SVG: FindSVG,
    title: 'Find Sneakers & Clothing\nNear You',
    subtitle: 'Locate verified sellers and retailers close to you with real-time availability.',
    buttonText: 'Next',
  },
  {
    id: 'size',
    SVG: SizeSVG,
    title: 'Your Size.\nEverywhere.',
    subtitle: 'Set your size once and instantly filter every listing to exactly what fits you.',
    buttonText: 'Next',
  },
  {
    id: 'buy',
    SVG: BuySVG,
    title: 'Buy It.\nHold It.\nPick It Up.',
    subtitle: 'Checkout in seconds from your phone and track your order every step of the way.',
    buttonText: 'Start Exploring',
  },
]

interface SlidePageProps {
  slide: Slide
  onNext: () => void
  onSkip: () => void
  isLast: boolean
}

const SlidePage: React.FC<SlidePageProps> = ({
  slide,
  onNext,
  onSkip,
  isLast,
}) => {
  const { SVG, title, titleHighlight, subtitle, buttonText } = slide
  const showSkip = !isLast

  return (
    <View style={{ width, flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'white' }}>
      <View style={{ width, height: IMAGE_HEIGHT, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <ShowPicture
          SvgComponent={SVG}
          width={width}
          height={IMAGE_HEIGHT}
          preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
          resizeMode="cover"
        />
      </View>

      {showSkip && (
        <View className="items-end mt-4 px-4">
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={onSkip} activeOpacity={0.7}>
            <Text className="text-gray-500 text-base font-medium">Skip</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      )}

      <View className="px-7 flex-1 justify-center">
        <Text className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight mb-3">
          {title}
          {titleHighlight != null && (
            <Text style={{ color: GREEN }}>{titleHighlight}</Text>
          )}
        </Text>
        <Text className="text-gray-500 text-base leading-6">
          {subtitle}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <View className="px-7 pb-8">
        <Button
          text={buttonText}
          onPress={onNext}
          useGradient={false}
          backgroundColor={GREEN}
          borderRadius={14}
          paddingVertical={16}
          fontSize={16}
          fontWeight="600"
          textColor="#FFFFFF"
          width="100%"
        />
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

const Dots: React.FC<DotsProps> = ({ total, current, onPress }) => (
  <View className="flex-row justify-center items-center gap-1.5 pb-7">
    {Array.from({ length: total }).map((_, i) => (
      <TouchableOpacity
        key={i}
        onPress={() => onPress(i)}
        activeOpacity={0.7}
        className={`h-2 rounded-full ${
          i === current ? 'w-6 bg-green-500' : 'w-2 bg-gray-200'
        }`}
      />
    ))}
  </View>
)

const SlidingScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()

  const {
    currentIndex,
    isLast,
    flatListRef,
    goNext,
    goToIndex,
    onMomentumScrollEnd,
  } = useSliding<Slide>({
    totalSlides: SLIDES.length,
    onFinish: () => router.replace('/auth/createAccountScreen'),
  })

  const handleSkip = () => goToIndex(SLIDES.length - 1)

  const renderItem = ({ item }: ListRenderItemInfo<Slide>) => (
    <SlidePage
      slide={item}
      onNext={goNext}
      onSkip={handleSkip}
      isLast={isLast}
    />
  )

  return (
    <BaseContainer backgroundColor="#fff">
      <FlatList<Slide>
        ref={flatListRef}
        data={SLIDES}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        horizontal
        pagingEnabled
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        scrollEventThrottle={16}
        onMomentumScrollEnd={onMomentumScrollEnd}
        renderItem={renderItem}
        bounces={false}
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
      />
      <Dots
        total={SLIDES.length}
        current={currentIndex}
        onPress={goToIndex}
      />
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default SlidingScreen
```

```typescript
            onBag={() => router.push('/screens/profile/bagScreen')}
          />

          {/* My Sales — taps navigate to full screen */}
          <MySales
            onSeeAll={() => router.push('/screens/profile/mySalesScreen')}
          />

          <MyLocker
            items={profile.lockerItems}
            lockerCount={profile.lockerCount}
            lockerPublic={lockerPublic}
            onToggleVisibility={toggleLockerVisibility}
            onAddItem={addToLocker}
            onViewAll={() => console.log('View all locker')}
          />
          <ReferralRow
            referralCode={profile.referralCode}
            onPress={() => router.push('/screens/profile/referralScreen')}
          />
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </BaseContainer>
  )
}

export default ProfileScreen
```
